title: Spectral Kernel Dynamics via Maximum Caliber: Fixed Points, Geodesics, and Phase Transitions
summary: We derive a closed-form geometric functional for kernel dynamics on finite graphs by applying the Maximum Caliber (MaxCal) variational principle to the spectral transfer function h(lambda) of the graph Laplacian eigenbasis. The main result is that the MaxCal stationarity condition decouples into N one-dimensional problems with explicit solution: h*(lambda_l) = h_0(lambda_l) exp(-1 - T_l[h*]), yielding self-consistent (fixed-point) kernels via exponential tilting (Corollary 1), log-linear Fisher-Rao geodesics (Corollary 2), a diagonal Hessian stability criterion (Corollary 3), and an l^2_+ isometry for the spectral kernel space (Proposition 3). The spectral entropy H[h_t] provides a computable O(N) early-warning signal for network-structural phase transitions (Remark 7). All claims are numerically verified on the path graph P_8 with a Gaussian mutual-information source, using the open-source kernelcal library. The framework is grounded in a structural analogy with Einstein's field equations, used as a guiding template rather than an established equivalence; explicit limits are stated in Section 6.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了基于最大熵变分原理的图核动力学闭式几何泛函，通过谱转移函数获得自洽核，并提供网络结构相变的早期预警信号。
AI.motivation: 研究图核动力学的数学框架，通过最大熵原理建立谱空间中的几何泛函，为网络结构分析提供理论基础和计算工具。
AI.method: 应用最大熵变分原理于图拉普拉斯特征基的谱转移函数，推导出闭式几何泛函，得到解耦的一维问题，产生自洽核、对数线性Fisher-Rao测地线等结果。
AI.result: 获得MaxCal平稳条件的显式解，产生指数倾斜的自洽核、Fisher-Rao测地线、对角Hessian稳定性准则，谱熵H[h_t]提供O(N)复杂度的网络结构相变早期预警信号。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一个基于最大熵原理的图核动力学统一框架，具有明确的几何解释和实际计算价值，为网络结构分析提供了新的理论工具和预警机制。

title: Kinematics of continuum planar grasping
summary: This paper presents an analytical framework to study the geometry arising when a soft continuum arm grasps a planar object. Both the arm centerline and the object boundary are modeled as smooth curves. The grasping problem is formulated as a kinematic boundary following problem, in which the object boundary acts as the arm's 'shadow curve'. This formulation leads to a set of reduced kinematic equations expressed in terms of relative geometric shape variables, with the arm curvature serving as the control input. An optimal control problem is formulated to determine feasible arm shapes that achieve optimal grasping configurations, and its solution is obtained using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle. Based on the resulting optimal grasp kinematics, a class of continuum grasp quality metrics is proposed using the algebraic properties of the associated continuum grasp map. Feedback control aspects in the dynamic setting are also discussed. The proposed methodology is illustrated through systematic numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分析框架，研究软连续体臂抓取平面物体时的几何结构，将抓取问题表述为运动学边界跟随问题，并基于最优控制理论确定最优抓取构型。
AI.motivation: 研究软连续体臂抓取平面物体时的几何特性，建立理论框架来分析抓取过程中的几何约束和运动学关系，为软体机器人抓取提供理论基础。
AI.method: 将臂中心线和物体边界建模为光滑曲线，将抓取问题表述为运动学边界跟随问题，建立简化运动学方程，使用庞特里亚金极大值原理求解最优控制问题，提出连续体抓取质量度量。
AI.result: 建立了软连续体臂抓取平面物体的几何分析框架，推导出最优抓取构型的解析解，提出了基于连续体抓取映射代数特性的抓取质量度量方法，并通过数值仿真验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为软连续体臂抓取提供了系统的几何分析方法，将抓取问题转化为最优控制问题，提出的抓取质量度量为评估抓取性能提供了量化指标，为软体机器人抓取控制奠定了理论基础。

title: ProGAL-VLA: Grounded Alignment through Prospective Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision language action (VLA) models enable generalist robotic agents but often exhibit language ignorance, relying on visual shortcuts and remaining insensitive to instruction changes. We present Prospective Grounding and Alignment VLA (ProGAL-VLA), which constructs a 3D entity-centric graph (GSM), uses a slow planner to produce symbolic sub-goals, and aligns them with grounded entities via a Grounding Alignment Contrastive (GAC) loss. All actions are conditioned on a verified goal embedding $g_t$, whose attention entropy provides an intrinsic ambiguity signal. On LIBERO-Plus, ProGAL-VLA increases robustness under robot perturbations from 30.3 to 71.5 percent, reduces language ignorance by 3x-4x, and improves entity retrieval from 0.41 to 0.71 Recall@1. On the Custom Ambiguity Benchmark, it reaches AUROC 0.81 (vs. 0.52), AUPR 0.79, and raises clarification on ambiguous inputs from 0.09 to 0.81 without harming unambiguous success. The verification bottleneck increases mutual information of language-actions, the GAC loss imposes an entity-level InfoNCE bound, and attention entropy yields calibrated selective prediction, indicating that explicit verified grounding is an effective path toward instruction-sensitive, ambiguity-aware agents.

AI.tldr: ProGAL-VLA通过构建3D实体图、慢速规划器生成符号子目标，并使用Grounding Alignment Contrastive损失对齐实体，提高VLA模型对语言指令的敏感性和处理模糊性的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型存在语言忽视问题，依赖视觉捷径，对指令变化不敏感，需要提高模型对语言指令的理解和响应能力。
AI.method: 构建3D实体中心图(GSM)，使用慢速规划器生成符号子目标，通过Grounding Alignment Contrastive损失对齐实体，所有动作基于经过验证的目标嵌入$g_t$，注意力熵提供内在模糊性信号。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus上，机器人扰动下的鲁棒性从30.3%提升到71.5%，语言忽视减少3-4倍，实体检索Recall@1从0.41提升到0.71。在Custom Ambiguity Benchmark上，AUROC达到0.81（对比0.52），AUPR 0.79，模糊输入澄清率从0.09提升到0.81。
AI.conclusion: 验证瓶颈增加了语言-动作的互信息，GAC损失施加了实体级InfoNCE约束，注意力熵提供校准的选择性预测，表明显式验证接地是实现指令敏感、模糊感知智能体的有效途径。

title: Perception Is All You Need: A Neuroscience Framework for Low Cost Sensorless Gaze in HRI
summary: Gaze-following in child-robot interaction improves attention, recall, and learning, but requires expensive platforms (\$30,000+), sensors, algorithms, and raises privacy concerns. We propose a framework that avoids sensors and computation entirely, instead relying on the human visual system's assumption of convexity to produce perceptual gaze-following between a robot and its viewer. Specifically, we motivate sub-dollar cardboard robot design that directly implements the brain's own gaze computation pipeline in reverse, making the viewer's perceptual system the robot's "actuator", with no sensors, no power, and no privacy concerns. We ground this framework in three converging lines of theoretical and empirical neuroscience evidence. Namely, the distributed face processing network that computes gaze direction via the superior temporal sulcus, the high-precision convexity prior that causes the brain to perceive concave faces as convex, and the predictive processing hierarchy in which top-down face knowledge overrides bottom-up depth signals. These mechanisms explain why a concave eye socket with a painted pupil produces the perception of mutual gaze from any viewing angle. We derive design constraints from perceptual science, present a sub-dollar open-template robot with parameterized interchangeable eye inserts, and identify boundary conditions (developmental, clinical, and geometric) that predict where the framework will succeed and where it will fail. If leveraged, two decades of HRI gaze findings become deliverable at population scale.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需传感器和计算的廉价机器人设计框架，利用人类视觉系统的凸性假设实现感知性视线跟随，成本低于1美元，无隐私问题。
AI.motivation: 传统视线跟随技术需要昂贵平台（3万美元以上）、传感器和算法，且存在隐私问题。需要一种低成本、无传感器、无隐私问题的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用人类视觉系统的凸性假设，设计凹形眼窝加绘制瞳孔的纸质机器人，使大脑将凹面感知为凸面，从而在任何视角下产生相互注视的感知。基于神经科学证据：1) 面部处理网络通过上颞沟计算视线方向；2) 高精度凸性先验使大脑将凹面感知为凸面；3) 预测处理层次中自上而下的面部知识覆盖自下而上的深度信号。
AI.result: 开发出低于1美元的开源模板机器人，具有参数化可互换眼插片。从感知科学推导设计约束，识别了发展、临床和几何边界条件，预测框架的成功和失败场景。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使20年的人机交互视线研究成果能够大规模应用，通过利用人类感知系统作为机器人的"执行器"，无需传感器、电源或隐私担忧。

title: LABBench2: An Improved Benchmark for AI Systems Performing Biology Research
summary: Optimism for accelerating scientific discovery with AI continues to grow. Current applications of AI in scientific research range from training dedicated foundation models on scientific data to agentic autonomous hypothesis generation systems to AI-driven autonomous labs. The need to measure progress of AI systems in scientific domains correspondingly must not only accelerate, but increasingly shift focus to more real-world capabilities. Beyond rote knowledge and even just reasoning to actually measuring the ability to perform meaningful work. Prior work introduced the Language Agent Biology Benchmark LAB-Bench as an initial attempt at measuring these abilities. Here we introduce an evolution of that benchmark, LABBench2, for measuring real-world capabilities of AI systems performing useful scientific tasks. LABBench2 comprises nearly 1,900 tasks and is, for the most part, a continuation of LAB-Bench, measuring similar capabilities but in more realistic contexts. We evaluate performance of current frontier models, and show that while abilities measured by LAB-Bench and LABBench2 have improved substantially, LABBench2 provides a meaningful jump in difficulty (model-specific accuracy differences range from -26% to -46% across subtasks) and underscores continued room for performance improvement. LABBench2 continues the legacy of LAB-Bench as a de facto benchmark for AI scientific research capabilities and we hope that it continues to help advance development of AI tools for these core research functions. To facilitate community use and development, we provide the task dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/futurehouse/labbench2 and a public eval harness at https://github.com/EdisonScientific/labbench2.

AI.tldr: LABBench2是LAB-Bench的进化版，包含近1900个任务，在更真实的情境中测量AI系统的科学能力，难度显著提高，模型准确率下降26-46%
AI.motivation: 随着AI在科学发现中的应用日益增长，需要从测量基础知识和推理能力转向评估AI系统执行实际有意义工作的能力，因此需要更贴近现实世界的评估基准
AI.method: 开发LABBench2作为LAB-Bench的进化版本，包含近1900个任务，在更真实的情境中测量AI系统的科学能力，并评估当前前沿模型的性能
AI.result: 虽然LAB-Bench和LABBench2测量的能力都有显著提升，但LABBench2难度大幅增加，模型在子任务上的准确率差异达到-26%到-46%，显示仍有很大改进空间
AI.conclusion: LABBench2延续了LAB-Bench作为AI科学研究能力事实基准的传统，有助于推动AI工具在核心研究功能方面的发展，已提供数据集和评估工具供社区使用

title: 3D Multi-View Stylization with Pose-Free Correspondences Matching for Robust 3D Geometry Preservation
summary:
Artistic style transfer is well studied for images and videos, but extending it to multi-view 3D scenes remains difficult because stylization can disrupt correspondences needed by geometry-aware pipelines. Independent per-view stylization often causes texture drift, warped edges, and inconsistent shading, degrading SLAM, depth prediction, and multi-view reconstruction. This thesis addresses multi-view stylization that remains usable for downstream 3D tasks without assuming camera poses or an explicit 3D representation during training.
  We introduce a feed-forward stylization network trained with per-scene test-time optimization under a composite objective coupling appearance transfer with geometry preservation. Stylization is driven by an AdaIN-inspired loss from a frozen VGG-19 encoder, matching channel-wise moments to a style image. To stabilize structure across viewpoints, we propose a correspondence-based consistency loss using SuperPoint and SuperGlue, constraining descriptors from a stylized anchor view to remain consistent with matched descriptors from the original multi-view set. We also impose a depth-preservation loss using MiDaS/DPT and use global color alignment to reduce depth-model domain shift. A staged weight schedule introduces geometry and depth constraints.
  We evaluate on Tanks and Temples and Mip-NeRF 360 using image and reconstruction metrics. Style adherence and structure retention are measured by Color Histogram Distance (CHD) and Structure Distance (DSD). For 3D consistency, we use monocular DROID-SLAM trajectories and symmetric Chamfer distance on back-projected point clouds. Across ablations, correspondence and depth regularization reduce structural distortion and improve SLAM stability and reconstructed geometry; on scenes with MuVieCAST baselines, our method yields stronger trajectory and point-cloud consistency while maintaining competitive stylization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于多视角3D场景的艺术风格迁移方法，通过几何保持约束确保风格化后的图像仍可用于SLAM、深度预测等下游3D任务，无需在训练时假设相机位姿或显式3D表示。
AI.motivation: 传统图像风格迁移应用于多视角3D场景时，独立视角的风格化会导致纹理漂移、边缘扭曲和光照不一致，破坏几何对应关系，从而影响SLAM、深度预测和多视角重建等下游3D任务的效果。
AI.method: 采用前馈风格化网络，结合场景级测试时优化。使用AdaIN风格损失进行外观迁移，通过SuperPoint和SuperGlue构建对应一致性损失来稳定跨视角结构，利用MiDaS/DPT深度保持损失，并采用全局颜色对齐减少深度模型域偏移。通过分阶段权重调度引入几何和深度约束。
AI.result: 在Tanks and Temples和Mip-NeRF 360数据集上评估，使用颜色直方图距离和结构距离衡量风格保持和结构保留。对应一致性和深度正则化减少了结构失真，提高了SLAM稳定性和重建几何质量。相比MuVieCAST基线，在保持竞争性风格化的同时，获得了更强的轨迹和点云一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了多视角3D场景的风格迁移，同时保持了足够的几何一致性，使风格化后的图像仍能有效支持下游3D任务，为艺术风格化与3D计算机视觉的融合提供了可行方案。

title: RoboLab: A High-Fidelity Simulation Benchmark for Analysis of Task Generalist Policies
summary: The pursuit of general-purpose robotics has yielded impressive foundation models, yet simulation-based benchmarking remains a bottleneck due to rapid performance saturation and a lack of true generalization testing. Existing benchmarks often exhibit significant domain overlap between training and evaluation, trivializing success rates and obscuring insights into robustness. We introduce RoboLab, a simulation benchmarking framework designed to address these challenges. Concretely, our framework is designed to answer two questions: (1) to what extent can we understand the performance of a real-world policy by analyzing its behavior in simulation, and (2) which external factors most strongly affect that behavior under controlled perturbations. First, RoboLab enables human-authored and LLM-enabled generation of scenes and tasks in a robot- and policy-agnostic manner within a physically realistic and photorealistic simulation. With this, we propose the RoboLab-120 benchmark, consisting of 120 tasks categorized into three competency axes: visual, procedural, relational competency, across three difficulty levels. Second, we introduce a systematic analysis of real-world policies that quantify both their performance and the sensitivity of their behavior to controlled perturbations, indicating that high-fidelity simulation can serve as a proxy for analyzing performance and its dependence on external factors. Evaluation with RoboLab exposes significant performance gap in current state-of-the-art models. By providing granular metrics and a scalable toolset, RoboLab offers a scalable framework for evaluating the true generalization capabilities of task-generalist robotic policies.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboLab仿真基准框架，解决现有基准测试中训练与评估领域重叠、性能饱和快、缺乏真正泛化测试的问题，通过120个任务评估机器人策略的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人仿真基准存在训练与评估领域重叠严重的问题，导致性能快速饱和，无法真正测试泛化能力。需要新的基准框架来评估机器人策略在真实世界中的表现和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 开发RoboLab仿真框架，支持人工和LLM生成场景与任务，提出RoboLab-120基准，包含120个任务，分为视觉、程序、关系三个能力维度，三个难度级别，并引入系统分析方法量化策略性能和对外部扰动的敏感性。
AI.result: 评估显示当前最先进模型存在显著性能差距，高保真仿真可作为分析策略性能和外部因素依赖性的有效代理，RoboLab提供了可扩展的框架来评估任务通用机器人策略的真正泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RoboLab通过提供细粒度指标和可扩展工具集，为评估任务通用机器人策略的真正泛化能力提供了有效的仿真基准框架，揭示了当前模型的局限性并支持系统性分析。

title: Linear Programming for Multi-Criteria Assessment with Cardinal and Ordinal Data: A Pessimistic Virtual Gap Analysis
summary: Multi-criteria Analysis (MCA) is used to rank alternatives based on various criteria. Key MCA methods, such as Multiple Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) methods, estimate parameters for criteria to compute the performance of each alternative. Nonetheless, subjective evaluations and biases frequently influence the reliability of results, while the diversity of data affects the precision of the parameters. The novel linear programming-based Virtual Gap Analysis (VGA) models tackle these issues. This paper outlines a two-step method that integrates two novel VGA models to assess each alternative from a pessimistic perspective, using both quantitative and qualitative criteria, and employing cardinal and ordinal data. Next, prioritize the alternatives to eliminate the least favorable one. The proposed method is dependable and scalable, enabling thorough assessments efficiently and effectively within decision support systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于虚拟间隙分析的两步法，从悲观视角评估多准则决策中的替代方案，提高可靠性和可扩展性
AI.motivation: 传统多准则分析方法受主观评价、偏见和数据多样性影响，导致结果可靠性不足和参数精度问题
AI.method: 采用基于线性规划的虚拟间隙分析模型，分两步：1) 从悲观视角评估每个替代方案，结合定量/定性准则和基数/序数数据；2) 优先排序并淘汰最不利替代方案
AI.result: 提出的方法可靠且可扩展，能够在决策支持系统中高效有效地进行全面评估
AI.conclusion: 新型VGA模型有效解决了多准则分析中的主观偏见和数据多样性问题，提供了一种更可靠的决策支持方法

title: PA-SFM: Tracker-free differentiable acoustic radiation for freehand 3D photoacoustic imaging
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) handheld photoacoustic tomography typically relies on bulky and expensive external positioning sensors to correct motion artifacts, which severely limits its clinical flexibility and accessibility. To address this challenge, we present PA-SFM, a tracker-free framework that leverages exclusively single-modality photoacoustic data for both sensor pose recovery and high-fidelity 3D reconstruction via differentiable acoustic radiation modeling. Unlike traditional structure-from-motion (SFM) methods based on visual features, PA-SFM integrates the acoustic wave equation into a differentiable programming pipeline. By leveraging a high-performance, GPU-accelerated acoustic radiation kernel, the framework simultaneously optimizes the 3D photoacoustic source distribution and the sensor array pose via gradient descent. To ensure robust convergence in freehand scenarios, we introduce a coarse-to-fine optimization strategy that incorporates geometric consistency checks and rigid-body constraints to eliminate motion outliers. We validated the proposed method through both numerical simulations and in-vivo rat experiments. The results demonstrate that PA-SFM achieves sub-millimeter positioning accuracy and restores high-resolution 3D vascular structures comparable to ground-truth benchmarks, offering a low-cost, software-defined solution for clinical freehand photoacoustic imaging. The source code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/JaegerCQ/PA-SFM}{https://github.com/JaegerCQ/PA-SFM}.

AI.tldr: PA-SFM：一种无需外部跟踪器的三维手持光声成像框架，仅使用单模态光声数据通过可微分声辐射建模同时恢复传感器位姿并重建高保真3D图像。
AI.motivation: 传统三维手持光声成像依赖笨重昂贵的外部定位传感器来校正运动伪影，这严重限制了临床应用的灵活性和可及性。需要一种低成本、软件定义的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出PA-SFM框架，将声波方程集成到可微分编程流程中，利用GPU加速的声辐射核同时优化3D光声源分布和传感器阵列位姿。采用由粗到细的优化策略，结合几何一致性检查和刚体约束来消除运动异常值。
AI.result: 数值模拟和活体大鼠实验验证表明，PA-SFM实现了亚毫米级定位精度，恢复了与基准真值相当的高分辨率3D血管结构。
AI.conclusion: PA-SFM为临床自由手持光声成像提供了一种低成本、软件定义的解决方案，无需外部跟踪器即可实现高精度3D重建。

title: CableTract: A Co-Designed Cable-Driven Field Robot for Low-Compaction, Off-Grid Capable Agriculture
summary: Conventional field operations spend most of their energy moving the tractor body, not the implement. Yet feasibility studies for novel agricultural vehicles rarely tie mechanics, energy harvest, draft, field geometry, economics, life-cycle CO2, and uncertainty quantification together on a single reproducible code path. This paper builds such a framework and applies it to CableTract, a two-module cable-driven field robot. A stationary Main Unit (winch + motor + battery + harvester module) (MU) and a lighter Anchor module (held by helical screw piles) tension a cable across a strip while a lightweight implement carriage rolls along it. The heavy bodies stay on the headland; only the carriage enters the field. The carriage runs a 10-implement library co-designed for the cable architecture. This co-design is the paper's central analytical lever. The framework is prototype-free. It chains a catenary cable model, a drivetrain efficiency chain, a stochastic draft model fitted to the co-designed library, an hourly solar + wind + battery simulator on six sites, a polygon coverage planner on a 50-field corpus, a contact-pressure compaction model, a discounted cash-flow economics engine with battery replacement and life-cycle CO2, and a global sensitivity analysis on 20 inputs. An operating-envelope sweep and an architectural-variant comparison close the loop. The full implementation is open source. Applied to the codesigned reference, the framework yields energy, compaction advantages and potential off-grid operation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个综合框架，用于评估新型农业车辆（特别是CableTract电缆驱动机器人）的性能，该框架整合了机械、能源、经济、环境等多方面因素，并应用于原型设计前的分析。
AI.motivation: 传统田间作业大部分能量消耗在拖拉机本体移动而非农具上，现有可行性研究很少将机械、能源收获、牵引力、田间几何、经济性、生命周期CO2和不确定性量化整合到一个可复现的代码路径中。
AI.method: 构建了一个原型无关的综合框架，包含悬链线电缆模型、传动效率链、随机牵引力模型、六站点小时级太阳能+风能+电池模拟器、50块田地多边形覆盖规划器、接触压力压实模型、考虑电池更换和生命周期CO2的贴现现金流经济引擎，以及20个输入的全局敏感性分析。
AI.result: 应用于协同设计的参考系统，该框架显示出能源和压实优势，并具备潜在的离网运行能力。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功开发了一个可复现的综合评估框架，能够在新农业车辆原型设计前进行全面分析，特别展示了CableTract电缆驱动机器人在能源效率和减少土壤压实方面的潜力。

title: Seven simple steps for log analysis in AI systems
summary: AI systems produce large volumes of logs as they interact with tools and users. Analysing these logs can help understand model capabilities, propensities, and behaviours, or assess whether an evaluation worked as intended. Researchers have started developing methods for log analysis, but a standardised approach is still missing. Here we suggest a pipeline based on current best practices. We illustrate it with concrete code examples in the Inspect Scout library, provide detailed guidance on each step, and highlight common pitfalls. Our framework provides researchers with a foundation for rigorous and reproducible log analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于当前最佳实践的标准化AI日志分析流程，并提供具体代码示例和详细指导
AI.motivation: AI系统在与工具和用户交互时产生大量日志，分析这些日志有助于理解模型能力、倾向和行为，或评估实验是否按预期进行。目前研究人员已开始开发日志分析方法，但缺乏标准化方法。
AI.method: 提出一个基于当前最佳实践的日志分析流程管道，通过Inspect Scout库提供具体代码示例，详细指导每个步骤，并突出常见陷阱。
AI.result: 开发了一个为研究人员提供严谨和可复现日志分析基础的框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为AI日志分析提供了标准化方法，有助于提高研究的严谨性和可复现性。

title: TRACE: Thermal Recognition Attentive-Framework for CO2 Emissions from Livestock
summary: Quantifying exhaled CO2 from free-roaming cattle is both a direct indicator of rumen metabolic state and a prerequisite for farm-scale carbon accounting, yet no existing system can deliver continuous, spatially resolved measurements without physical confinement or contact. We present TRACE (Thermal Recognition Attentive-Framework for CO2 Emissions from Livestock), the first unified framework to jointly address per-frame CO2 plume segmentation and clip-level emission flux classification from mid-wave infrared (MWIR) thermal video. TRACE contributes three domain-specific advances: a Thermal Gas-Aware Attention (TGAA) encoder that incorporates per-pixel gas intensity as a spatial supervisory signal to direct self-attention toward high-emission regions at each encoder stage; an Attention-based Temporal Fusion (ATF) module that captures breath-cycle dynamics through structured cross-frame attention for sequence-level flux classification; and a four-stage progressive training curriculum that couples both objectives while preventing gradient interference. Benchmarked against fifteen state-of-the-art models on the CO2 Farm Thermal Gas Dataset, TRACE achieves an mIoU of 0.998 and the best result on every segmentation and classification metric simultaneously, outperforming domain-specific gas segmenters with several times more parameters and surpassing all baselines in flux classification. Ablation studies confirm that each component is individually essential: gas-conditioned attention alone determines precise plume boundary localization, and temporal reasoning is indispensable for flux-level discrimination. TRACE establishes a practical path toward non-invasive, continuous, per-animal CO2 monitoring from overhead thermal cameras at commercial scale. Codes are available at https://github.com/taminulislam/trace.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个用于从热成像视频中检测牛群CO2排放的统一框架，通过热气体感知注意力机制和时序融合模块，实现了高精度的CO2羽流分割和排放通量分类。
AI.motivation: 量化自由放牧牛的呼出CO2对于监测瘤胃代谢状态和农场碳核算至关重要，但现有系统无法在不限制动物活动的情况下提供连续、空间分辨的测量。
AI.method: 提出了TRACE框架，包含三个关键技术：1) 热气体感知注意力编码器，利用像素级气体强度作为空间监督信号；2) 基于注意力的时序融合模块，捕捉呼吸周期动态；3) 四阶段渐进训练课程，防止梯度干扰。
AI.result: 在CO2农场热气体数据集上，TRACE在15个最先进模型中取得最佳性能，mIoU达到0.998，在所有分割和分类指标上均表现最优，超越了参数多几倍的专用气体分割器。
AI.conclusion: TRACE为非侵入式、连续、个体化的牛群CO2监测提供了实用路径，通过热成像相机实现了商业规模的监测，每个组件都被证明是必要的。

title: GPU-Accelerated Continuous-Time Successive Convexification for Contact-Implicit Legged Locomotion
summary: Contact-implicit trajectory optimization (CITO) enables the automatic discovery of contact sequences, but most methods rely on fine time discretization to capture all contact events accurately, which increases problem size and runtime while tying solution quality to grid resolution. We extend the recently proposed sequential convex programming (SCP) approach for trajectory optimization, continuous-time successive convexification (ct-SCvx), to CITO by introducing integral cross-complementarity constraints, which eliminate the risk of missing contact events between discretization nodes while preserving the flexibility of contact mode changes. The resulting framework, contact-implicit successive convexification (ci-SCvx), models full multibody dynamics in maximal coordinates, including stick-slip friction and partially elastic impacts. To handle complementarity constraints, we embed a backtracking homotopy scheme within SCP for reliable convergence. We implement this framework in a stand-alone Python software, leveraging JAX for GPU acceleration and a custom canonical-form parser for the convex subproblems of SCP to avoid the overhead of general-purpose modeling tools such as CVXPY. We demonstrate ci-SCvx on diverse legged-locomotion tasks. In particular, we validate the approach in MuJoCo with the Gymnasium HalfCheetah model against the MuJoCo MPC baseline, showing that a tracking simulation with the optimized torque profiles from ci-SCvx produces physically consistent trajectories with lesser energy consumption. We also show that the resulting software achieves faster solve times than existing state-of-the-art SCP implementations by over an order of magnitude, thereby demonstrating a practically important contribution to scalable real-time trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出ci-SCvx框架，将连续时间逐次凸化方法扩展到接触隐式轨迹优化，通过积分交叉互补约束避免接触事件遗漏，实现高效求解
AI.motivation: 传统接触隐式轨迹优化方法依赖精细时间离散化来准确捕捉接触事件，这会增加问题规模和计算时间，且解的质量受网格分辨率限制。需要一种能避免接触事件遗漏、同时保持接触模式变化灵活性的方法。
AI.method: 扩展连续时间逐次凸化方法到接触隐式轨迹优化，引入积分交叉互补约束，在最大坐标下建模完整多体动力学（包括粘滑摩擦和部分弹性碰撞），采用回溯同伦方案处理互补约束，用JAX实现GPU加速和自定义凸子问题解析器
AI.result: 在多种足式运动任务中验证了ci-SCvx的有效性，与MuJoCo MPC基线相比，优化出的扭矩轨迹在跟踪仿真中产生物理一致且能耗更低的运动。求解速度比现有最先进的SCP实现快一个数量级以上
AI.conclusion: ci-SCvx框架通过积分交叉互补约束解决了接触事件遗漏问题，实现了高效、可扩展的实时轨迹优化，在求解速度和物理一致性方面均优于现有方法

title: Turing Test on Screen: A Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agent Humanization
summary: The rise of autonomous GUI agents has triggered adversarial countermeasures from digital platforms, yet existing research prioritizes utility and robustness over the critical dimension of anti-detection. We argue that for agents to survive in human-centric ecosystems, they must evolve Humanization capabilities. We introduce the ``Turing Test on Screen,'' formally modeling the interaction as a MinMax optimization problem between a detector and an agent aiming to minimize behavioral divergence. We then collect a new high-fidelity dataset of mobile touch dynamics, and conduct our analysis that vanilla LMM-based agents are easily detectable due to unnatural kinematics. Consequently, we establish the Agent Humanization Benchmark (AHB) and detection metrics to quantify the trade-off between imitability and utility. Finally, we propose methods ranging from heuristic noise to data-driven behavioral matching, demonstrating that agents can achieve high imitability theoretically and empirically without sacrificing performance. This work shifts the paradigm from whether an agent can perform a task to how it performs it within a human-centric ecosystem, laying the groundwork for seamless coexistence in adversarial digital environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GUI智能体需要具备"拟人化"能力以在对抗性数字环境中生存，建立了Agent Humanization Benchmark，并展示了如何在不牺牲性能的情况下实现高拟人度。
AI.motivation: 随着自主GUI智能体的兴起，数字平台采取了对抗性反制措施。现有研究过于关注实用性和鲁棒性，而忽视了反检测这一关键维度。为了让智能体在以人为中心的生态系统中生存，它们必须发展拟人化能力。
AI.method: 1. 提出"屏幕上的图灵测试"，将其形式化为检测器与智能体之间的MinMax优化问题；2. 收集新的高保真移动触摸动态数据集；3. 建立Agent Humanization Benchmark和检测指标；4. 提出从启发式噪声到数据驱动的行为匹配等多种方法。
AI.result: 分析显示基于LMM的智能体由于不自然的运动学特征容易被检测。提出的方法在理论和实证上都表明，智能体可以在不牺牲性能的情况下实现高拟人度。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作将研究范式从"智能体能否完成任务"转向"智能体如何在以人为中心的生态系统中执行任务"，为在对抗性数字环境中实现无缝共存奠定了基础。

title: FlowHijack: A Dynamics-Aware Backdoor Attack on Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as a cornerstone for robotics, with flow-matching policies like $π_0$ showing great promise in generating smooth, continuous actions. As these models advance, their unique action generation mechanism - the vector field dynamics - presents a critical yet unexplored security vulnerability, particularly backdoor vulnerabilities. Existing backdoor attacks designed for autoregressive discretization VLAs cannot be directly applied to this new continuous dynamics. We introduce FlowHijack, the first backdoor attack framework to systematically target the underlying vector-field dynamics of flow-matching VLAs. Our method combines a novel $τ$-conditioned injection strategy, which manipulates the initial phase of the action generation, with a dynamics mimicry regularizer. Experiments demonstrate that FlowHijack achieves high attack success rates using stealthy, context-aware triggers where prior works failed. Crucially, it preserves benign task performance and, by enforcing kinematic similarity, generates malicious actions that are behaviorally indistinguishable from normal actions. Our findings reveal a significant vulnerability in continuous embodied models, highlighting the urgent need for defenses targeting the model's internal generative dynamics.

AI.tldr: FlowHijack：首个针对流匹配VLA模型向量场动态的后门攻击框架，通过τ条件注入策略和动态模仿正则器实现隐蔽攻击
AI.motivation: 随着VLA模型在机器人领域的发展，其独特的向量场动态动作生成机制存在未探索的安全漏洞。现有的后门攻击方法无法直接应用于这种连续动态系统，需要专门针对流匹配VLA底层动态的攻击框架
AI.method: FlowHijack结合了τ条件注入策略（操纵动作生成的初始阶段）和动态模仿正则器，系统性地针对流匹配VLA的向量场动态进行攻击
AI.result: 实验显示FlowHijack使用隐蔽的上下文感知触发器实现了高攻击成功率，而先前方法失败。关键的是，它保持了良性任务性能，并通过强制运动学相似性生成与正常动作行为上无法区分的恶意动作
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了连续具身模型中的重大安全漏洞，强调了针对模型内部生成动态的防御措施的紧迫需求

title: Vision-Language-Action Model, Robustness, Multi-modal Learning, Robot Manipulation
summary: Despite their strong performance in embodied tasks, recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain highly fragile under multimodal perturbations, where visual corruption and linguistic noise jointly induce distribution shifts that degrade task-level execution. Existing robustness approaches typically rely on joint training with perturbed data, treating robustness as a static objective, which leads to conflicting optimization between robustness and task fidelity. In this work, we propose STRONG-VLA, a decoupled fine-tuning framework that explicitly separates robustness acquisition from task-aligned refinement. In Stage I, the model is exposed to a curriculum of multimodal perturbations with increasing difficulty, enabling progressive robustness learning under controlled distribution shifts. In Stage II, the model is re-aligned with clean task distributions to recover execution fidelity while preserving robustness. We further establish a comprehensive benchmark with 28 perturbation types spanning both textual and visual modalities, grounded in realistic sources of sensor noise, occlusion, and instruction corruption. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark show that STRONG-VLA consistently improves task success rates across multiple VLA architectures. On OpenVLA, our method achieves gains of up to 12.60% under seen perturbations and 7.77% under unseen perturbations. Notably, similar or larger improvements are observed on OpenVLA-OFT (+14.48% / +13.81%) and pi0 (+16.49% / +5.58%), demonstrating strong cross-architecture generalization. Real-world experiments on an AIRBOT robotic platform further validate its practical effectiveness. These results highlight the importance of decoupled optimization for multimodal robustness and establish STRONG-VLA as a simple yet principled framework for robust embodied control.

AI.tldr: STRONG-VLA：一种解耦微调框架，通过分阶段训练（先学习鲁棒性再对齐任务）提升VLA模型在多模态扰动下的性能，在多个架构上显著提高任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在多模态扰动（视觉损坏+语言噪声）下表现脆弱，现有鲁棒性方法通常依赖扰动数据联合训练，将鲁棒性视为静态目标，导致鲁棒性与任务保真度之间的优化冲突。
AI.method: 提出STRONG-VLA解耦微调框架：第一阶段通过难度递增的多模态扰动课程学习，实现渐进式鲁棒性学习；第二阶段使用干净任务数据重新对齐，恢复执行保真度同时保持鲁棒性。建立包含28种扰动类型的综合基准。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准测试中，STRONG-VLA持续提升多个VLA架构的任务成功率：OpenVLA在已知扰动下提升12.60%，未知扰动下提升7.77%；OpenVLA-OFT提升14.48%/13.81%；pi0提升16.49%/5.58%。在AIRBOT机器人平台上的真实世界实验进一步验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦优化对多模态鲁棒性至关重要，STRONG-VLA是一个简单而有原则的框架，能够显著提升具身控制任务的鲁棒性，并展现出良好的跨架构泛化能力。

title: AHC: Meta-Learned Adaptive Compression for Continual Object Detection on Memory-Constrained Microcontrollers
summary: Deploying continual object detection on microcontrollers (MCUs) with under 100KB memory requires efficient feature compression that can adapt to evolving task distributions. Existing approaches rely on fixed compression strategies (e.g., FiLM conditioning) that cannot adapt to heterogeneous task characteristics, leading to suboptimal memory utilization and catastrophic forgetting. We introduce Adaptive Hierarchical Compression (AHC), a meta-learning framework featuring three key innovations: (1) true MAML-based compression that adapts via gradient descent to each new task in just 5 inner-loop steps, (2) hierarchical multi-scale compression with scale-aware ratios (8:1 for P3, 6.4:1 for P4, 4:1 for P5) matching FPN redundancy patterns, and (3) a dual-memory architecture combining short-term and long-term banks with importance-based consolidation under a hard 100KB budget. We provide formal theoretical guarantees bounding catastrophic forgetting as O(ε{sq.root(T)} + 1/{sq.root(M)}) where ε is compression error, T is task count, and M is memory size. Experiments on CORe50, TiROD, and PASCAL VOC benchmarks with three standard baselines (Fine-tuning,EWC, iCaRL) demonstrate that AHC enables practical continual detection within a 100KB replay budget, achieving competitive accuracy through mean-pooled compressed feature replay combined with EWC regularization and feature distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出AHC框架，通过元学习自适应分层压缩，在100KB内存限制下实现MCU上的持续目标检测，减少灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 在内存小于100KB的微控制器上部署持续目标检测需要高效的特征压缩方法。现有固定压缩策略无法适应异构任务特性，导致内存利用不佳和灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出自适应分层压缩(AHC)框架：1) 基于MAML的压缩，仅需5步内循环适应新任务；2) 分层多尺度压缩，针对FPN冗余模式设置不同压缩比；3) 双内存架构，结合短期和长期存储库，在100KB预算下进行重要性整合。
AI.result: 在CORe50、TiROD和PASCAL VOC基准测试中，与三种基线方法相比，AHC在100KB重放预算下实现了实用的持续检测，通过均值池化压缩特征重放结合EWC正则化和特征蒸馏获得有竞争力的准确率。
AI.conclusion: AHC框架通过自适应分层压缩和双内存架构，在严格内存限制下有效解决了MCU上持续目标检测的挑战，提供了理论保证并展示了实际可行性。

title: Prints in the Magnetic Dust: Robust Similarity Search in Legacy Media Images Using Checksum Count Vectors
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Peer-reviewed, presented on Machine Intelligence and Digital Interaction (MIDI) Conference on 11 december 2025 in Warsaw, POLAND. To be included in the proceedings (print in progress)
summary: Digitizing magnetic media containing computer data is only the first step towards the preservation of early home computing era artifacts. The audio tape images must be decoded, verified, repaired if necessary, tested, and documented. If parts of this process could be effectively automated, volunteers could focus on contributing contextual and historical knowledge rather than struggling with technical tools. We therefore propose a feature representation based on Checksum Count Vectors and evaluate its applicability to detecting duplicates and variants of recordings within a large data store. The approach was tested on a collection of decoded tape images (n=4902), achieving 58\% accuracy in detecting variants and 97% accuracy in identifying alternative copies, for damaged recordings with up to 75% of records missing. These results represent an important step towards fully automated pipelines for restoration, de-duplication, and semantic integration of historical digital artifacts through sequence matching, automatic repair and knowledge discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出基于校验和计数向量的特征表示方法，用于在大型数据存储中检测录音副本和变体，实现历史数字文物的自动化修复、去重和语义集成。
AI.motivation: 早期家用计算时代文物的数字化保存需要解码、验证、修复、测试和记录音频磁带图像。如果这些过程能够有效自动化，志愿者可以专注于贡献背景和历史知识，而不是与技术工具作斗争。
AI.method: 提出基于校验和计数向量（Checksum Count Vectors）的特征表示方法，用于检测大型数据存储中录音的副本和变体。该方法在包含4902个解码磁带图像的数据集上进行测试。
AI.result: 在检测变体方面达到58%准确率，在识别替代副本方面达到97%准确率，即使在记录缺失高达75%的损坏录音中也能有效工作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为实现历史数字文物完全自动化管道（包括修复、去重和语义集成）迈出了重要一步，通过序列匹配、自动修复和知识发现支持文化遗产保护。

title: Natural Gradient Gaussian Approximation Filter on Lie Groups for Robot State Estimation
summary: Accurate state estimation for robotic systems evolving on Lie group manifolds, such as legged robots, is a prerequisite for achieving agile control. However, this task is challenged by nonlinear observation models defined on curved manifolds, where existing filters rely on local linearization in the tangent space to handle such nonlinearity, leading to accumulated estimation errors. To address this limitation, we reformulate manifold filtering as a parameter optimization problem over a Gaussian-distributed increment variable, thereby avoiding linearization. Under this formulation, the increment can be mapped to the Lie group through the exponential operator, where it acts multiplicatively on the prior estimate to yield the posterior state. We further propose a natural gradient optimization scheme for solving this problem, whose iteration process leverages the Fisher information matrix of the increment variable to account for the curvature of the tangent space. This results in an iterative algorithm named the Natural Gradient Gaussian Approximation on Lie Groups (NANO-L) filter. Leveraging the perturbation model in Lie derivative, we prove that for the invariant observation model widely adopted in robotic localization tasks, the covariance update in NANO-L admits an exact closed-form solution, eliminating the need for iterative updates thus improving computational efficiency. Hardware experiments on a Unitree GO2 legged robot operating across different terrains demonstrate that NANO-L achieves approximately 40% lower estimation error than commonly used filters at a comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出NANO-L滤波器，通过自然梯度优化解决李群上机器人状态估计问题，避免局部线性化误差，在足式机器人上实现40%误差降低。
AI.motivation: 李群流形上的机器人状态估计面临非线性观测模型挑战，现有滤波器依赖切空间局部线性化导致累积误差。
AI.method: 将流形滤波重构为高斯分布增量变量的参数优化问题，避免线性化；提出自然梯度优化方案，利用增量变量的Fisher信息矩阵考虑切空间曲率；针对不变观测模型推导出协方差更新的闭式解。
AI.result: 在Unitree GO2足式机器人不同地形实验中，NANO-L比常用滤波器降低约40%估计误差，计算成本相当。
AI.conclusion: NANO-L滤波器通过避免线性化和利用自然梯度优化，有效解决了李群流形上的状态估计问题，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升估计精度。

title: Explainable Planning for Hybrid Systems
summary: The recent advancement in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies facilitates a paradigm shift toward automation. Autonomous systems are fully or partially replacing manually crafted ones. At the core of these systems is automated planning. With the advent of powerful planners, automated planning is now applied to many complex and safety-critical domains, including smart energy grids, self-driving cars, warehouse automation, urban and air traffic control, search and rescue operations, surveillance, robotics, and healthcare. There is a growing need to generate explanations of AI-based systems, which is one of the major challenges the planning community faces today. The thesis presents a comprehensive study on explainable artificial intelligence planning (XAIP) for hybrid systems that capture a representation of real-world problems closely.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究混合系统的可解释人工智能规划（XAIP），旨在为复杂安全关键领域的AI系统生成解释
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在智能电网、自动驾驶、医疗等安全关键领域的广泛应用，AI系统需要提供可解释性来增强信任和透明度，这是规划社区面临的主要挑战
AI.method: 论文对混合系统的可解释人工智能规划（XAIP）进行了全面研究，混合系统能够更贴近地表示现实世界问题
AI.result: 未在摘要中明确说明具体结果，但表明该研究为混合系统的可解释规划提供了全面分析框架
AI.conclusion: 可解释AI规划对于复杂安全关键领域的AI系统至关重要，混合系统的XAIP研究为解决现实世界问题提供了重要基础

title: A Modular Zero-Shot Pipeline for Accident Detection, Localization, and Classification in Traffic Surveillance Video
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the ACCIDENT @ CVPR 2026 Workshop. Source code and notebook available at https://www.kaggle.com/code/ameythakur20/zero-shot-cctv-traffic-accident-understanding/
summary: We describe a zero-shot pipeline developed for the ACCIDENT @ CVPR 2026 challenge. The challenge requires predicting when, where, and what type of traffic accident occurs in surveillance video, without labeled real-world training data. Our method separates the problem into three independent modules. The first module localizes the collision in time by running peak detection on z-score normalized frame-difference signals. The second module finds the impact location by computing the weighted centroid of cumulative dense optical flow magnitude maps using the Farneback algorithm. The third module classifies collision type by measuring cosine similarity between CLIP image embeddings of frames near the detected peak and text embeddings built from multi-prompt natural language descriptions of each collision category. No domain-specific fine-tuning is involved; the pipeline processes each video using only pre-trained model weights. Our implementation is publicly available as a Kaggle notebook.

AI.tldr: 提出一个零样本的交通事故检测流水线，通过三个独立模块分别定位事故时间、位置和类型，无需真实世界标注数据或领域微调。
AI.motivation: 针对CVPR 2026 ACCIDENT挑战赛的要求，需要在不使用标注真实世界训练数据的情况下，从监控视频中预测交通事故的发生时间、位置和类型。
AI.method: 采用三个独立模块：1) 时间定位：基于z-score归一化的帧差信号进行峰值检测；2) 位置定位：使用Farneback算法计算密集光流幅度图的加权质心；3) 类型分类：通过CLIP图像嵌入与多提示自然语言描述的文本嵌入之间的余弦相似度进行分类。
AI.result: 开发了一个完整的零样本流水线，能够处理监控视频中的交通事故检测任务，无需领域特定微调，仅使用预训练模型权重，代码已公开为Kaggle笔记本。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了通过组合现有预训练模型和简单信号处理技术，可以在没有标注数据的情况下有效解决复杂的交通事故检测问题。

title: A Ray Intersection Algorithm for Fast Growth Distance Computation Between Convex Sets
summary: In this paper, we discuss an efficient algorithm for computing the growth distance between two compact convex sets with representable support functions. The growth distance between two sets is the minimum scaling factor such that the sets intersect when scaled about some center points. Unlike the minimum distance between sets, the growth distance provides a unified measure for set intersection and separation. We first reduce the growth distance problem to an equivalent ray intersection problem on the Minkowski difference set. Then, we propose an algorithm to solve the ray intersection problem by iteratively constructing inner and outer polyhedral approximations of the Minkowski difference set. We show that our algorithm satisfies several key properties, such as primal and dual feasibility and monotone convergence. We provide extensive benchmark results for our algorithm and show that our open-source implementation achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide variety of convex sets. Finally, we demonstrate robotics applications of our algorithm in motion planning and rigid-body simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效算法计算凸集间的增长距离，通过Minkowski差集的射线相交问题求解，在机器人运动规划和刚体仿真中应用。
AI.motivation: 增长距离为凸集相交和分离提供了统一度量，优于传统最小距离，在机器人学等领域有重要应用价值。
AI.method: 将增长距离问题转化为Minkowski差集的射线相交问题，通过迭代构造内外部多面体逼近来求解。
AI.result: 算法具有原始和对偶可行性、单调收敛等关键性质，开源实现达到最先进性能，在机器人应用中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 提出的增长距离算法高效可靠，为机器人运动规划和刚体仿真等应用提供了有效的几何计算工具。

title: Help Without Being Asked: A Deployed Proactive Agent System for On-Call Support with Continuous Self-Improvement
summary: In large-scale cloud service platforms, thousands of customer tickets are generated daily and are typically handled through on-call dialogues. This high volume of on-call interactions imposes a substantial workload on human support analysts. Recent studies have explored reactive agents that leverage large language models as a first line of support to interact with customers directly and resolve issues. However, when issues remain unresolved and are escalated to human support, these agents are typically disengaged. As a result, they cannot assist with follow-up inquiries, track resolution progress, or learn from the cases they fail to address. In this paper, we introduce Vigil, a novel proactive agent system designed to operate throughout the entire on-call life-cycle. Unlike reactive agents, Vigil focuses on providing assistance during the phase in which human support is already involved. It integrates into the dialogue between the customer and the analyst, proactively offering assistance without explicit user invocation. Moreover, Vigil incorporates a continuous self-improvement mechanism that extracts knowledge from human-resolved cases to autonomously update its capabilities. Vigil has been deployed on Volcano Engine, ByteDance's cloud platform, for over ten months, and comprehensive evaluations based on this deployment demonstrate its effectiveness and practicality. The open source version of this work is publicly available at https://github.com/volcengine/veaiops.

AI.tldr: Vigil是一个主动式AI代理系统，在云服务平台的全生命周期值班对话中为人类分析师提供持续协助，具备自我改进能力，已在字节跳动火山引擎部署10个月以上。
AI.motivation: 云服务平台每天产生大量客户工单，传统反应式AI代理只在第一线支持时介入，当问题升级到人工支持时就会断开，无法协助后续跟进、跟踪解决进度或从失败案例中学习。
AI.method: 开发了Vigil主动式代理系统，在人工支持阶段持续运作，集成到客户与分析师的对话中，无需用户显式调用即可主动提供协助，并包含持续自我改进机制，从人工解决的案例中提取知识自主更新能力。
AI.result: Vigil已在字节跳动的火山引擎云平台部署超过10个月，基于实际部署的全面评估证明了其有效性和实用性，开源版本已公开。
AI.conclusion: Vigil系统通过在整个值班生命周期提供主动协助和持续自我改进，有效减轻了人工支持分析师的工作负担，提升了云服务平台的支持效率。

title: Grid2Matrix: Revealing Digital Agnosia in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel on many multimodal reasoning benchmarks, but these evaluations often do not require an exhaustive readout of the image and can therefore obscure failures in faithfully capturing all visual details. We introduce Grid2Matrix (G2M), a controlled benchmark in which a model is shown a color grid and a color-to-number mapping, and must output the corresponding matrix. By varying grid size and the number of colors, G2M provides a simple way to increase visual complexity while minimizing semantic confounds. We find that VLMs exhibit a sharp early collapse in zero-shot end-to-end evaluation, failing on surprisingly small grids rather than degrading gradually as the task becomes denser. We probe the visual encoders of VLMs from two representative families and find that they preserve substantially more of the grid information than the corresponding end-to-end outputs. This suggests that the failure is not explained by visual encoding alone, but also reflects a gap between what remains recoverable from visual features and what is ultimately expressed in language. We term this gap \textit{Digital Agnosia}. Further analyses show that these errors are highly structured and depend strongly on how grid cells overlap with visual patch boundaries. We also find that common strategies such as model scaling and multimodal alignment do not fully eliminate this failure mode. We expect G2M to serve as a useful testbed for understanding where and how VLMs lose fine visual details, and for evaluating tasks where missing even small visual details can matter, such as tables, charts, forms, and GUIs.

AI.tldr: Grid2Matrix (G2M) 基准测试揭示视觉语言模型在需要精确视觉细节读取的任务中存在"数字失认症"问题，即使对于小尺寸网格也会出现早期崩溃而非渐进退化。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型评测往往不需要对图像进行详尽读取，可能掩盖模型在捕捉所有视觉细节方面的失败。需要创建能控制视觉复杂度并最小化语义干扰的基准来评估模型对精细视觉细节的忠实度。
AI.method: 提出Grid2Matrix (G2M)基准：向模型展示彩色网格和颜色到数字的映射，要求输出对应矩阵。通过改变网格大小和颜色数量来增加视觉复杂度。对两类代表性VLM家族的视觉编码器进行探测分析。
AI.result: VLMs在零样本端到端评估中表现出早期崩溃，在出人意料的小网格上就失败，而非随着任务变密集而渐进退化。视觉编码器保留了比端到端输出更多的网格信息，表明失败不仅源于视觉编码，还存在视觉特征与语言表达之间的差距（数字失认症）。错误高度结构化且强烈依赖于网格单元与视觉补丁边界的重叠方式。
AI.conclusion: G2M可作为理解VLMs在何处以及如何丢失精细视觉细节的有用测试平台，适用于评估缺失小视觉细节可能产生影响的场景（如表格、图表、表单、GUI）。常见的模型缩放和多模态对齐策略无法完全消除这种失败模式。

title: MoRI: Mixture of RL and IL Experts for Long-Horizon Manipulation Tasks
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) are the standard frameworks for policy acquisition in manipulation. While IL offers efficient policy derivation, it suffers from compounding errors and distribution shift. Conversely, RL facilitates autonomous exploration but is frequently hindered by low sample efficiency and the high cost of trial and error. Since existing hybrid methods often struggle with complex tasks, we introduce Mixture of RL and IL Experts (MoRI). This system dynamically switches between IL and RL experts based on the variance of expert actions to handle coarse movements and fine-grained manipulations. MoRI employs an offline pre-training stage followed by online fine-tuning to accelerate convergence. To maintain exploration safety and minimize human intervention, the system applies IL-based regularization to the RL component. Evaluation across four complex real-world tasks shows that MoRI achieves an average success rate of 97.5% within 2 to 5 hours of fine-tuning. Compared to baseline RL algorithms, MoRI reduces human intervention by 85.8% and shortens convergence time by 21%, demonstrating its capability in robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: MoRI是一种结合强化学习和模仿学习的混合方法，通过动态切换专家来处理机器人操作任务，在减少人工干预的同时提高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的混合方法在处理复杂任务时存在困难。模仿学习（IL）虽然能高效推导策略，但存在累积误差和分布偏移问题；强化学习（RL）支持自主探索，但样本效率低且试错成本高。需要一种能结合两者优势的方法。
AI.method: 提出MoRI（Mixture of RL and IL Experts）系统：1）基于专家动作方差动态切换IL和RL专家，分别处理粗粒度运动和细粒度操作；2）采用离线预训练和在线微调两阶段加速收敛；3）对RL组件应用基于IL的正则化，确保探索安全并减少人工干预。
AI.result: 在四个复杂真实世界任务中，MoRI在2-5小时微调后平均成功率97.5%。相比基线RL算法，减少85.8%人工干预，缩短21%收敛时间。
AI.conclusion: MoRI通过动态结合IL和RL专家，有效解决了机器人操作中效率与安全性的平衡问题，在复杂任务中表现出色，为混合学习方法提供了新思路。

title: OOWM: Structuring Embodied Reasoning and Planning via Object-Oriented Programmatic World Modeling
summary: Standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) with reasoning capabilities, yet its reliance on linear natural language is inherently insufficient for effective world modeling in embodied tasks. While text offers flexibility, it fails to explicitly represent the state-space, object hierarchies, and causal dependencies required for robust robotic planning. To address these limitations, we propose Object-Oriented World Modeling (OOWM), a novel framework that structures embodied reasoning through the lens of software engineering formalisms. We redefine the world model not as a latent vector space, but as an explicit symbolic tuple $W = \langle S, T \rangle$: a State Abstraction ($G_\text{state}$) instantiating the environmental state $S$, coupled with a Control Policy ($G_\text{control}$) representing the transition logic $T: S \times A \rightarrow S'$. OOWM leverages the Unified Modeling Language (UML) to materialize this definition: it employs Class Diagrams to ground visual perception into rigorous object hierarchies, and Activity Diagrams to operationalize planning into executable control flows. Furthermore, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline combining Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Crucially, this method utilizes outcome-based rewards from the final plan to implicitly optimize the underlying object-oriented reasoning structure, enabling effective learning even with sparse annotations. Extensive evaluations on the MRoom-30k benchmark demonstrate that OOWM significantly outperforms unstructured textual baselines in planning coherence, execution success, and structural fidelity, establishing a new paradigm for structured embodied reasoning.

AI.tldr: OOWM提出基于软件工程形式化的对象导向世界建模框架，用UML类图和活动图结构化具身推理，通过SFT+GRPO训练，在MRoom-30k基准上显著优于文本基线。
AI.motivation: 标准CoT提示依赖线性自然语言，无法有效表示状态空间、对象层次和因果依赖，限制了在具身任务中的世界建模能力。
AI.method: 提出OOWM框架，将世界模型定义为符号元组W=⟨S,T⟩，使用UML类图进行视觉感知的对象层次建模，活动图实现可执行控制流规划，采用SFT+GRPO三阶段训练管道。
AI.result: 在MRoom-30k基准测试中，OOWM在规划一致性、执行成功率和结构保真度方面显著优于非结构化文本基线方法。
AI.conclusion: OOWM通过软件工程形式化方法实现了结构化具身推理的新范式，将世界模型从潜在向量空间转变为显式符号表示，提升了机器人规划的鲁棒性。

title: Immunizing 3D Gaussian Generative Models Against Unauthorized Fine-Tuning via Attribute-Space Traps
summary: Recent large-scale generative models enable high-quality 3D synthesis. However, the public accessibility of pre-trained weights introduces a critical vulnerability. Adversaries can fine-tune these models to steal specialized knowledge acquired during pre-training, leading to intellectual property infringement. Unlike defenses for 2D images and language models, 3D generators require specialized protection due to their explicit Gaussian representations, which expose fundamental structural parameters directly to gradient-based optimization. We propose GaussLock, the first approach designed to defend 3D generative models against fine-tuning attacks. GaussLock is a lightweight parameter-space immunization framework that integrates authorized distillation with attribute-aware trap losses targeting position, scale, rotation, opacity, and color. Specifically, these traps systematically collapse spatial distributions, distort geometric shapes, align rotational axes, and suppress primitive visibility to fundamentally destroy structural integrity. By jointly optimizing these dual objectives, the distillation process preserves fidelity on authorized tasks while the embedded traps actively disrupt unauthorized reconstructions. Experiments on large-scale Gaussian models demonstrate that GaussLock effectively neutralizes unauthorized fine-tuning attacks. It substantially degrades the quality of unauthorized reconstructions, evidenced by significantly higher LPIPS and lower PSNR, while effectively maintaining performance on authorized fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: GaussLock：首个针对3D生成模型的微调攻击防御方法，通过参数空间免疫框架保护预训练权重不被未经授权的知识窃取。
AI.motivation: 预训练3D生成模型的公开可访问性带来了知识产权风险，攻击者可以通过微调窃取专业知识。与2D图像和语言模型不同，3D生成器使用显式高斯表示，其基本结构参数直接暴露给基于梯度的优化，需要专门的保护。
AI.method: GaussLock是一个轻量级参数空间免疫框架，结合了授权蒸馏和属性感知陷阱损失。这些陷阱针对位置、尺度、旋转、不透明度和颜色等参数，通过系统性地破坏空间分布、扭曲几何形状、对齐旋转轴和抑制基元可见性来破坏结构完整性。
AI.result: 在大规模高斯模型上的实验表明，GaussLock能有效中和未经授权的微调攻击，显著降低未经授权重建的质量（LPIPS显著升高，PSNR显著降低），同时有效保持授权微调的性能。
AI.conclusion: GaussLock是首个专门针对3D生成模型微调攻击的防御方法，通过参数空间免疫有效保护知识产权，在保持授权任务性能的同时破坏未经授权的重建。

title: Device-Conditioned Neural Architecture Search for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
summary: The growing complexity of visuomotor policies poses significant challenges for deployment with heterogeneous robotic hardware constraints. However, most existing model-efficient approaches for robotic manipulation are device- and model-specific, lack generalizability, and require time-consuming per-device optimization during the adaptation process. In this work, we propose a unified framework named \textbf{D}evice-\textbf{C}onditioned \textbf{Q}uantization-\textbf{F}or-\textbf{A}ll (DC-QFA) which amortizes deployment effort with the device-conditioned quantization-aware training and hardware-constrained architecture search. Specifically, we introduce a single supernet that spans a rich design space over network architectures and mixed-precision bit-widths. It is optimized with latency- and memory-aware regularization, guided by per-device lookup tables. With this supernet, for each target platform, we can perform a once-for-all lightweight search to select an optimal subnet without any per-device re-optimization, which enables more generalizable deployment across heterogeneous hardware, and substantially reduces deployment time. To improve long-horizon stability under low precision, we further introduce multi-step on-policy distillation to mitigate error accumulation during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on three representative policy backbones, such as DiffusionPolicy-T, MDT-V, and OpenVLA-OFT, demonstrate that our DC-QFA achieves $2\text{-}3\times$ acceleration on edge devices, consumer-grade GPUs, and cloud platforms, with negligible performance drop in task success. Real-world evaluations on an Inovo robot equipped with a force/torque sensor further validates that our low-bit DC-QFA policies maintain stable, contact-rich manipulation even under severe quantization.

AI.tldr: DC-QFA是一个统一的设备感知量化框架，通过单一超网支持异构硬件部署，无需每设备重新优化，实现2-3倍加速且性能损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉运动策略部署方法存在设备特定、缺乏通用性、需要耗时优化等问题，难以适应异构机器人硬件约束。
AI.method: 提出设备条件量化感知训练和硬件约束架构搜索的统一框架，构建单一超网覆盖网络架构和混合精度位宽设计空间，使用延迟和内存感知正则化优化，通过多步策略蒸馏减少低精度下的误差累积。
AI.result: 在边缘设备、消费级GPU和云平台上实现2-3倍加速，任务成功率下降可忽略；真实机器人实验验证低比特策略在严重量化下仍能保持稳定的接触式操作。
AI.conclusion: DC-QFA框架有效解决了异构硬件部署难题，显著减少部署时间，提高策略通用性，为机器人策略的实际部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: OpeFlo: Automated UX Evaluation via Simulated Human Web Interaction with GUI Grounding
summary: Evaluating web usability typically requires time-consuming user studies and expert reviews, which often limits iteration speed during product development, especially for small teams and agile workflows. We present OpenFlo, a user-experience evaluation agent that simulates user behavior on websites and produces standardized usability. Unlike traditional tools that rely on DOM parsing, OpenFlo grounds actions and observations, enabling it to interact with real web pages end-to-end while maintaining a coherent trace of the user journey. Building on Avenir-Web, our system pairs this robust interaction with simulated user behavior profiles and a structured evaluation protocol that integrates the System Usability Scale (SUS), step-wise Single Ease Questions (SEQ), and concurrent Think Aloud. Subsequently, a comprehensive User Experience (UX) report will be generated. We discuss the architecture of OpenFlo and illustrate how its multimodal grounding improves robustness for web-based interaction and UX evaluation scenarios, paving the way for a new era of continuous, scalable, and data-driven usability testing that empowers every developer to build web interfaces that are usable. Code is available at: https://github.com/Onflow-AI/OpenFlo

AI.tldr: OpenFlo是一个用户体验评估代理，通过模拟用户在网站上的行为来生成标准化可用性报告，无需传统耗时的人工用户研究。
AI.motivation: 传统的网页可用性评估需要耗时的用户研究和专家评审，限制了产品开发迭代速度，特别是对小团队和敏捷工作流程不友好。
AI.method: 基于Avenir-Web系统，OpenFlo通过模拟用户行为配置文件与结构化评估协议（整合SUS、SEQ和Think Aloud方法），实现端到端的真实网页交互和用户体验评估。
AI.result: OpenFlo的多模态基础架构提高了网页交互和用户体验评估场景的鲁棒性，能够生成全面的用户体验报告。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为持续、可扩展、数据驱动的可用性测试开辟了新途径，使每个开发者都能构建更易用的网页界面。

title: Face Density as a Proxy for Data Complexity: Quantifying the Hardness of Instance Count
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE CAI 2026
summary:
Machine learning progress has historically prioritized model-centric innovations, yet achievable performance is frequently capped by the intrinsic complexity of the data itself. In this work, we isolate and quantify the impact of instance density (measured by face count) as a primary driver of data complexity. Rather than simply observing that ``crowded scenes are harder,'' we rigorously control for class imbalance to measure the precise degradation caused by density alone.
  Controlled experiments on the WIDER FACE and Open Images datasets, restricted to exactly 1 to 18 faces per image with perfectly balanced sampling, reveal that model performance degrades monotonically with increasing face count. This trend holds across classification, regression, and detection paradigms, even when models are fully exposed to the entire density range. Furthermore, we demonstrate that models trained on low-density regimes fail to generalize to higher densities, exhibiting a systematic under-counting bias, with error rates increasing by up to 4.6x, which suggests density acts as a domain shift.
  These findings establish instance density as an intrinsic, quantifiable dimension of data hardness and motivate specific interventions in curriculum learning and density-stratified evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究发现实例密度（图像中人脸数量）是数据复杂度的关键驱动因素，即使控制类别平衡，模型性能仍随密度增加单调下降，且存在密度域偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 机器学习研究通常关注模型中心创新，但性能常受限于数据本身的固有复杂性。本研究旨在分离和量化实例密度作为数据复杂度的主要驱动因素，超越简单的"拥挤场景更难"观察，通过严格控制类别不平衡来精确测量密度单独造成的影响。
AI.method: 在WIDER FACE和Open Images数据集上进行受控实验，限制每张图像恰好包含1到18个人脸，并采用完美平衡采样。研究涵盖分类、回归和检测三种范式，即使模型完全暴露于整个密度范围，也测量性能随密度增加的变化。
AI.result: 模型性能随人脸数量增加单调下降，这一趋势在分类、回归和检测任务中均成立。在低密度区域训练的模型无法泛化到高密度区域，表现出系统性低估偏差，错误率最高增加4.6倍，表明密度起到了域偏移的作用。
AI.conclusion: 实例密度是数据硬度的固有可量化维度，这些发现为课程学习和密度分层评估提供了具体的干预动机，强调了在模型开发和评估中考虑密度因素的重要性。

title: ReaLiTy and LADS: A Unified Framework and Dataset Suite for LiDAR Adaptation Across Sensors and Adverse Weather Conditions
summary: Reliable LiDAR perception requires robustness across sensors, environments, and adverse weather. However, existing datasets rarely provide physically consistent observations of the same scene under varying sensor configurations and weather conditions, limiting systematic analysis of domain shifts. This work presents ReaLiTy, a unified physics-informed framework that transforms LiDAR data to match target sensor specifications and weather conditions. The framework integrates physically grounded cues with a learning-based module to generate realistic intensity patterns, while a physics-based weather model introduces consistent geometric and radiometric degradations. Building on this framework, we introduce the LiDAR Adaptation Dataset Suite (LADS), a collection of physically consistent, transformation-ready point clouds with one-to-one correspondence to original datasets. Experiments demonstrate improved cross-domain consistency and realistic weather effects. ReaLiTy and LADS provide a reproducible foundation for studying LiDAR adaptation and simulation-driven perception in intelligent transportation systems.

AI.tldr: ReaLiTy是一个统一的物理信息框架，用于将LiDAR数据转换为匹配目标传感器规格和天气条件，并引入LiDAR Adaptation Dataset Suite (LADS)数据集，为LiDAR感知的跨域一致性研究提供基础。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR数据集很少提供相同场景在不同传感器配置和天气条件下的物理一致观测，这限制了领域偏移的系统性分析。可靠的LiDAR感知需要在传感器、环境和恶劣天气条件下具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出ReaLiTy框架，整合物理基础线索与学习模块生成真实强度模式，同时使用基于物理的天气模型引入一致的几何和辐射度退化。基于此框架创建LADS数据集，包含物理一致、可转换的点云数据。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法提高了跨域一致性并产生了真实的天气效果。ReaLiTy和LADS为研究LiDAR适应性和仿真驱动感知提供了可重复的基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过物理信息框架和一致性数据集，为智能交通系统中的LiDAR适应性和仿真驱动感知研究提供了系统性的解决方案。

title: Factorizing formal contexts from closures of necessity operators
summary: Factorizing datasets is an interesting process in a multitude of approaches, but many times it is not possible or efficient the computation of a factorization of the dataset. A method to obtain independent subcontexts of a formal context with Boolean data was proposed in~\cite{dubois:2012}, based on the operators used in possibility theory. In this paper, we will analyze this method and study different properties related to the pairs of sets from which a factorization of a formal context arises. We also inspect how the properties given in the classical case can be extended to the fuzzy framework, which is essential to obtain a mechanism that allows the computation of independent subcontexts of a fuzzy context.

AI.tldr: 分析基于可能性理论的形式上下文分解方法，研究分解集合对的性质，并将经典性质扩展到模糊框架
AI.motivation: 数据集分解在许多方法中很重要，但计算因子分解通常不可行或效率低下。现有基于可能性理论的方法能获得形式上下文的独立子上下文，需要分析其性质并扩展到模糊框架
AI.method: 分析Dubois等人提出的基于可能性理论算子的形式上下文分解方法，研究产生因子分解的集合对的性质，并将经典性质扩展到模糊框架
AI.result: 对形式上下文分解方法进行了深入分析，研究了分解集合对的相关性质，并成功将经典性质扩展到模糊框架
AI.conclusion: 该研究为计算模糊上下文的独立子上下文提供了理论基础，扩展了形式概念分析在模糊环境中的应用

title: Are We Recognizing the Jaguar or Its Background? A Diagnostic Framework for Jaguar Re-Identification
summary: Jaguar re-identification (re-ID) from citizen-science imagery can look strong on standard retrieval metrics while still relying on the wrong evidence, such as background context or silhouette shape, instead of the coat pattern that defines identity. We introduce a diagnostic framework for wildlife re-ID with two axes: a leakage-controlled context ratio, background/foreground, computed from inpainted background-only versus foreground-only images, and a laterality diagnostic based on cross-flank retrieval and mirror self-similarity. To make these diagnostics measurable, we curate a Pantanal jaguar benchmark with per-pixel segmentation masks and an identity-balanced evaluation protocol. We then use representative mitigation families, ArcFace fine-tuning, anti-symmetry regularization, and Lorentz hyperbolic embeddings, as case studies under the same evaluation lens. The goal is not only to ask which model ranks best, but also what visual evidence it uses to do so.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个诊断框架来评估野生动物重识别模型是否真正依赖个体特征（如美洲豹的皮毛花纹），而非背景或轮廓等虚假线索，并构建了包含分割掩码的Pantanal美洲豹基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 公民科学图像中的美洲豹重识别模型可能在标准检索指标上表现良好，但实际上依赖错误的证据（如背景环境或轮廓形状），而不是定义个体身份的皮毛花纹。需要诊断工具来评估模型是否真正学习到个体特征。
AI.method: 提出一个双轴诊断框架：1）泄漏控制上下文比率（背景/前景），通过修复背景图像和前景图像计算；2）侧向性诊断，基于跨侧面检索和镜像自相似性。构建了包含像素级分割掩码的Pantanal美洲豹基准数据集和身份平衡评估协议。
AI.result: 使用代表性缓解方法（ArcFace微调、反对称正则化、Lorentz双曲嵌入）作为案例研究，在统一评估框架下分析不同模型的表现。诊断框架能够揭示模型依赖的视觉证据类型。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断框架不仅能评估哪个模型排名最好，还能揭示模型使用什么视觉证据进行重识别，有助于开发真正依赖个体特征而非虚假线索的野生动物重识别系统。

title: A Coordinate-Invariant Local Representation of Motion and Force Trajectories for Identification and Generalization Across Coordinate Systems
comment: This preprint has been accepted for presentation at the 17th World Symposium on the Algorithmic Foundations of Robotics (WAFR 2026). The preprint corresponds to the version submitted for peer review
summary: Identifying the trajectories of rigid bodies and of interaction forces is essential for a wide range of tasks in robotics, biomechanics, and related domains. These tasks include trajectory segmentation, recognition, and prediction. For these tasks, a key challenge lies in achieving consistent results when the trajectory is expressed in different coordinate systems. A way to address this challenge is to utilize trajectory models that can generalize across coordinate systems. The focus of this paper is on such trajectory models obtained by transforming the trajectory into a coordinate-invariant representation. However, coordinate-invariant representations often suffer from sensitivity to measurement noise and the manifestation of singularities in the representation, where the representation is not uniquely defined. This paper aims to address this limitation by introducing the novel Dual-Upper-Triangular Invariant Representation (DUTIR), with improved robustness to singularities, along with its computational algorithm. The proposed representation is formulated at a level of abstraction that makes it applicable to both rigid-body trajectories and interaction-force trajectories, hence making it a versatile tool for robotics, biomechanics, and related domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的对偶上三角不变表示(DUTIR)，用于刚性体和相互作用力轨迹的坐标不变建模，提高了对奇异性的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在机器人学、生物力学等领域中，识别刚性体和相互作用力的轨迹对于轨迹分割、识别和预测等任务至关重要。这些任务面临的关键挑战是当轨迹在不同坐标系中表达时如何获得一致的结果。坐标不变表示虽然能解决这个问题，但通常对测量噪声敏感且在表示中存在奇异性问题。
AI.method: 提出了新颖的对偶上三角不变表示(DUTIR)，通过将轨迹转换为坐标不变表示来建模。该方法在抽象层次上制定，使其既适用于刚性体轨迹也适用于相互作用力轨迹，并提供了相应的计算算法以提高对奇异性的鲁棒性。
AI.result: DUTIR表示在保持坐标不变性的同时，显著提高了对奇异性的鲁棒性，为机器人学、生物力学及相关领域提供了一个通用的轨迹建模工具。
AI.conclusion: DUTIR是一种有效的坐标不变轨迹表示方法，解决了传统坐标不变表示对噪声敏感和存在奇异性问题，为跨坐标系的轨迹分析提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: Agentic Exploration of PDE Spaces using Latent Foundation Models for Parameterized Simulations
summary: Flow physics and more broadly physical phenomena governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), are inherently continuous, high-dimensional and often chaotic in nature. Traditionally, researchers have explored these rich spatiotemporal PDE solution spaces using laboratory experiments and/or computationally expensive numerical simulations. This severely limits automated and large-scale exploration, unlike domains such as drug discovery or materials science, where discrete, tokenizable representations naturally interface with large language models. We address this by coupling multi-agent LLMs with latent foundation models (LFMs), a generative model over parametrised simulations, that learns explicit, compact and disentangled latent representations of flow fields, enabling continuous exploration across governing PDE parameters and boundary conditions. The LFM serves as an on-demand surrogate simulator, allowing agents to query arbitrary parameter configurations at negligible cost. A hierarchical agent architecture orchestrates exploration through a closed loop of hypothesis, experimentation, analysis and verification, with a tool-modular interface requiring no user support. Applied to flow past tandem cylinders at Re = 500, the framework autonomously evaluates over 1,600 parameter-location pairs and discovers divergent scaling laws: a regime-dependent two-mode structure for minimum displacement thickness and a robust linear scaling for maximum momentum thickness, with both landscapes exhibiting a dual-extrema structure that emerges at the near-wake to co-shedding regime transition. The coupling of the learned physical representations with agentic reasoning establishes a general paradigm for automated scientific discovery in PDE-governed systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合多智能体LLM与潜在基础模型（LFM）的框架，用于自动探索偏微分方程（PDE）控制的物理现象，特别是在流体力学领域，实现了对高维连续解空间的高效探索。
AI.motivation: 传统上，研究PDE控制的物理现象（如流体力学）依赖于实验室实验或计算昂贵的数值模拟，这限制了大规模自动化探索。与药物发现或材料科学等具有离散、可标记化表示的领域不同，连续高维的物理现象难以与大型语言模型直接交互。
AI.method: 方法结合了多智能体LLM与潜在基础模型（LFM）。LFM作为参数化模拟的生成模型，学习流场的显式、紧凑且解耦的潜在表示，可作为按需替代模拟器。采用分层智能体架构，通过假设、实验、分析和验证的闭环进行探索，具有无需用户支持的工具模块化接口。
AI.result: 在Re=500的串联圆柱绕流案例中，该框架自动评估了超过1,600个参数-位置对，发现了不同的标度律：最小位移厚度呈现依赖于流态的双模态结构，而最大动量厚度则表现出稳健的线性标度。两种景观都显示出在近尾流到共脱落流态转变时出现的双极值结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习到的物理表示与智能体推理的耦合，为PDE控制系统的自动化科学发现建立了一个通用范式，能够高效探索连续高维的物理现象空间。

title: CAGE: Bridging the Accuracy-Aesthetics Gap in Educational Diagrams via Code-Anchored Generative Enhancement
summary: Educational diagrams -- labeled illustrations of biological processes, chemical structures, physical systems, and mathematical concepts -- are essential cognitive tools in K-12 instruction. Yet no existing method can generate them both accurately and engagingly. Open-source diffusion models produce visually rich images but catastrophically garble text labels. Code-based generation via LLMs guarantees label correctness but yields visually flat outputs. Closed-source APIs partially bridge this gap but remain unreliable and prohibitively expensive at educational scale. We quantify this accuracy-aesthetics dilemma across all three paradigms on 400 K-12 diagram prompts, measuring both label fidelity and visual quality through complementary automated and human evaluation protocols. To resolve it, we propose CAGE (Code-Anchored Generative Enhancement): an LLM synthesizes executable code producing a structurally correct diagram, then a diffusion model conditioned on the programmatic output via ControlNet refines it into a visually polished graphic while preserving label fidelity. We also introduce EduDiagram-2K, a collection of 2,000 paired programmatic-stylized diagrams enabling this pipeline, and present proof-of-concept results and a research agenda for the multimedia community.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CAGE方法，通过结合LLM生成代码和扩散模型增强，解决教育图表生成中标签准确性与视觉美观性的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 教育图表在K-12教学中至关重要，但现有方法无法同时保证标签准确性和视觉吸引力：开源扩散模型视觉丰富但标签错误严重；基于LLM的代码生成方法标签准确但视觉平淡；闭源API部分解决但不可靠且昂贵。
AI.method: 提出CAGE方法：1) LLM生成可执行代码产生结构正确的图表；2) 扩散模型通过ControlNet以程序化输出为条件，将其精炼为视觉精美的图形，同时保持标签保真度。还创建了EduDiagram-2K数据集（2000个配对的程序化-风格化图表）。
AI.result: 在400个K-12图表提示上量化了准确性-美观性困境，通过自动和人工评估协议测量标签保真度和视觉质量。CAGE方法能够生成既准确又美观的教育图表。
AI.conclusion: CAGE方法成功解决了教育图表生成中的准确性-美观性矛盾，为多媒体社区提供了新的研究方向和实用解决方案。

title: Trajectory-based actuator identification via differentiable simulation
summary: Accurate actuation models are critical for bridging the gap between simulation and real robot behavior, yet obtaining high-fidelity actuator dynamics typically requires dedicated test stands and torque sensing. We present a trajectory-based actuator identification method that uses differentiable simulation to fit system-level actuator models from encoder motion alone. Identification is posed as a trajectory-matching problem: given commanded joint positions and measured joint angles and velocities, we optimize actuator and simulator parameters by backpropagating through the simulator, without torque sensors, current/voltage measurements, or access to embedded motor-control internals. The framework supports multiple model classes, ranging from compact structured parameterizations to neural actuator mappings, within a unified optimization pipeline. On held-out real-robot trajectories under identical commands, the proposed torque-sensor-free identification achieves much tighter trajectory alignment than a supervised stand-trained baseline dominated by steady-state data, reducing mean absolute position error from 14.20 mrad to as low as 7.54 mrad (1.88 times). Finally, we demonstrate downstream impact in a real-robot locomotion study: training policies with the refined actuator model increases travel distance by 46% and reduces rotational deviation by 75% relative to the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可微分仿真的轨迹匹配方法，仅用编码器数据即可识别高精度执行器模型，无需扭矩传感器或电机内部参数，显著提升仿真-现实一致性
AI.motivation: 传统执行器建模需要专用测试台和扭矩传感器，成本高且复杂。需要一种仅使用编码器运动数据就能获得高保真执行器动力学的方法，以缩小仿真与现实机器人行为之间的差距
AI.method: 基于可微分仿真的轨迹匹配识别方法：将识别问题转化为轨迹匹配优化问题，给定指令关节位置和测量的关节角度/速度，通过反向传播优化执行器和仿真器参数。支持从紧凑结构化参数化到神经网络执行器映射的多种模型类别
AI.result: 在相同指令下的真实机器人轨迹测试中，该方法将平均绝对位置误差从14.20 mrad降低至7.54 mrad（提升1.88倍）。在真实机器人运动研究中，使用精炼执行器模型训练策略使行进距离增加46%，旋转偏差减少75%
AI.conclusion: 提出的无扭矩传感器执行器识别方法仅使用编码器数据就能获得高精度系统级执行器模型，显著提升仿真-现实一致性，并在下游机器人控制任务中展现出实质性性能改进

title: MobiFlow: Real-World Mobile Agent Benchmarking through Trajectory Fusion
summary: Mobile agents can autonomously complete user-assigned tasks through GUI interactions. However, existing mainstream evaluation benchmarks, such as AndroidWorld, operate by connecting to a system-level Android emulator and provide evaluation signals based on the state of system resources. In real-world mobile-agent scenarios, however, many third-party applications do not expose system-level APIs to determine whether a task has succeeded, leading to a mismatch between benchmarks and real-world usage and making it difficult to evaluate model performance accurately. To address these issues, we propose MobiFlow, an evaluation framework built on tasks drawn from arbitrary third-party applications. Using an efficient graph-construction algorithm based on multi-trajectory fusion, MobiFlow can effectively compress the state space, support dynamic interaction, and better align with real-world third-party application scenarios. MobiFlow covers 20 widely used third-party applications and comprises 240 diverse real-world tasks, with enriched evaluation metrics. Compared with AndroidWorld, MobiFlow's evaluation results show higher alignment with human assessments and can guide the training of future GUI-based models under real workloads.

AI.tldr: MobiFlow是一个针对移动代理的评估框架，专注于第三方应用程序的真实任务评估，解决了现有基准测试与真实使用场景不匹配的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有移动代理评估基准（如AndroidWorld）依赖系统级Android模拟器和系统资源状态提供评估信号，但在真实场景中，许多第三方应用不暴露系统级API来确定任务是否成功，导致基准测试与真实使用场景不匹配，难以准确评估模型性能。
AI.method: 提出MobiFlow评估框架，基于多轨迹融合的高效图构建算法，能够有效压缩状态空间，支持动态交互，更好地对齐真实第三方应用场景。框架覆盖20个广泛使用的第三方应用，包含240个多样化的真实世界任务。
AI.result: 与AndroidWorld相比，MobiFlow的评估结果与人类评估具有更高的一致性，能够指导未来基于GUI的模型在真实工作负载下的训练。
AI.conclusion: MobiFlow解决了现有移动代理评估基准与真实第三方应用场景不匹配的问题，提供了一个更贴近实际使用场景的评估框架，能够更准确地评估模型性能并指导模型训练。

title: TaFall: Balance-Informed Fall Detection via Passive Thermal Sensing
summary: Falls are a major cause of injury and mortality among older adults, yet most incidents occur in private indoor environments where monitoring must balance effectiveness with privacy. Existing privacy-preserving fall detection approaches, particularly those based on radio frequency sensing, often rely on coarse motion cues, which limits reliability in real-world deployments. We introduce TaFall, a balance-informed fall detection system based on low-cost, privacy-preserving thermal array sensing. The key insight is that TaFall models a fall as a process of balance degradation and detects falls by estimating pose-driven biomechanical balance dynamics. To enable this capability from low-resolution thermal array maps, we propose (i) an appearance-motion fusion model for robust pose reconstruction, (ii) physically grounded balance-aware learning, and (iii) pose-bridged pretraining to improve robustness. TaFall achieves a detection rate of 98.26% with a false alarm rate of 0.65% on our dataset with over 3,000 fall instances from 35 participants across diverse indoor environments. In 27 day deployments across four homes, TaFall attains an ultra-low false alarm rate of 0.00126% and a pilot bathroom study confirms robustness under moisture and thermal interference. Together, these results establish TaFall as a reliable and privacy-preserving approach to fall detection in everyday living environments.

AI.tldr: TaFall：基于热成像阵列的平衡感知跌倒检测系统，通过建模平衡退化过程实现高精度隐私保护跌倒检测
AI.motivation: 老年人跌倒是一个严重的健康问题，但大多数跌倒发生在室内私人环境中，需要在监测效果和隐私保护之间取得平衡。现有的隐私保护跌倒检测方法（特别是基于射频传感的）通常依赖粗略的运动线索，在真实世界部署中可靠性有限。
AI.method: TaFall采用低成本、隐私保护的热成像阵列传感，将跌倒建模为平衡退化过程，通过估计姿态驱动的生物力学平衡动态来检测跌倒。关键技术包括：(1)外观-运动融合模型用于鲁棒姿态重建；(2)物理基础的平衡感知学习；(3)姿态桥接预训练以提高鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在包含35名参与者、超过3000次跌倒实例的数据集上，检测率达到98.26%，误报率为0.65%。在四个家庭的27天部署中，误报率仅为0.00126%。浴室试点研究证实了在湿度和热干扰下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TaFall为日常居住环境提供了一种可靠且隐私保护的跌倒检测方法，通过建模平衡动态实现了高精度检测，同时保护用户隐私。

title: COSMIK-MPPI: Scaling Constrained Model Predictive Control to Collision Avoidance in Close-Proximity Dynamic Human Environments
summary: Ensuring safe physical interaction between torque-controlled manipulators and humans is essential for deploying robots in everyday environments. Model Predictive Control (MPC) has emerged as a suitable framework thanks to its capacity to handle hard constraints, provide strong guarantees and zero-shot adaptability through predictive reasoning. However, Gradient-Based MPC (GB-MPC) solvers have demonstrated limited performance for collision avoidance in complex environments. Sampling-based approaches such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control offer an alternative via stochastic rollouts, but enforcing safety via additive penalties is inherently fragile, as it provides no formal constraint satisfaction guarantees. We propose a collision avoidance framework called COSMIK-MPPI combining MPPI with the toolbox for human motion estimation RT-COSMIK and the Constraints-as-Terminations transcription, which enforces safety by treating constraint violations as terminal events, without relying on large penalty terms or explicit human motion prediction. The proposed approach is evaluated against state-of-the-art GB-MPC and vanilla MPPI in simulation and on a real manipulator arm. Results show that COSMIK-MPPI achieves a 100% task success rate with a constant computation time (22 ms), largely outperforming GB-MPC. In simulated infeasible scenarios, COSMIK-MPPI consistently generates collision-free trajectories, contrary to vanilla MPPI. These properties enabled safe execution of complex real-world human-robot interaction tasks in shared workspaces using an affordable markerless human motion estimator, demonstrating a robust, compliant, and practical solution for predictive collision avoidance (cf. results showcased at https://exquisite-parfait-ffa925.netlify.app)

AI.tldr: 提出COSMIK-MPPI框架，结合MPPI控制、RT-COSMIK人体运动估计和Constraints-as-Terminations方法，实现安全的人机交互碰撞避免，在计算效率和安全性上优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：梯度基MPC在复杂环境中碰撞避免性能有限，采样基MPPI通过惩罚项确保安全但缺乏形式化约束满足保证。需要一种既能保证安全约束又能高效计算的人机交互碰撞避免方法。
AI.method: 结合MPPI（模型预测路径积分控制）、RT-COSMIK（实时人体运动估计工具箱）和Constraints-as-Terminations转录方法。将约束违反视为终端事件，不依赖大惩罚项或显式人体运动预测，实现安全约束的强制执行。
AI.result: COSMIK-MPPI达到100%任务成功率，计算时间恒定（22ms），显著优于梯度基MPC。在模拟不可行场景中始终生成无碰撞轨迹，而传统MPPI无法做到。在真实人机交互任务中展示了鲁棒、柔顺和实用的碰撞避免能力。
AI.conclusion: COSMIK-MPPI提供了一个鲁棒、柔顺且实用的预测性碰撞避免解决方案，通过结合MPPI的采样优势和安全约束的终端事件处理，实现了高效安全的人机交互，适用于共享工作空间的实际应用。

title: Persistent Identity in AI Agents: A Multi-Anchor Architecture for Resilient Memory and Continuity
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Submitting to arXiv cs.ET (Emerging Technologies)
summary: Modern AI agents suffer from a fundamental identity problem: when context windows overflow and conversation histories are summarized, agents experience catastrophic forgetting -- losing not just information, but continuity of self. This technical limitation reflects a deeper architectural flaw: AI agent identity is centralized in a single memory store, creating a single point of failure. Drawing on neurological case studies of human memory disorders, we observe that human identity survives damage because it is distributed across multiple systems: episodic memory, procedural memory, emotional continuity, and embodied knowledge. We present soul.py, an open-source architecture that implements persistent identity through separable components (identity files and memory logs), and propose extensions toward multi-anchor resilience. The framework introduces a hybrid RAG+RLM retrieval system that automatically routes queries to appropriate memory access patterns, achieving efficient retrieval without sacrificing comprehensiveness. We formalize the notion of identity anchors for AI systems and present a roadmap for building agents whose identity can survive partial memory failures. Code is available at github.com/menonpg/soul.py

AI.tldr: 提出soul.py框架解决AI代理身份连续性丢失问题，通过分布式记忆架构和多锚点设计实现身份持久性
AI.motivation: 现代AI代理存在根本性的身份问题：当上下文窗口溢出或对话历史被总结时，代理会经历灾难性遗忘——不仅丢失信息，还失去自我连续性。这种技术限制反映了更深层次的架构缺陷：AI代理身份集中在单一记忆存储中，形成了单点故障。
AI.method: 借鉴人类记忆障碍的神经学案例，提出soul.py开源架构，通过可分离组件（身份文件和记忆日志）实现持久身份，采用混合RAG+RLM检索系统自动路由查询到适当的记忆访问模式，并形式化AI系统的身份锚点概念。
AI.result: 实现了在不牺牲全面性的情况下实现高效检索，提出了构建能够承受部分记忆故障的代理路线图，代码已在GitHub开源。
