AI.motivation: 多人社交互动依赖于群体内所有个体之间的连贯性和关系，因此多人定位和姿态估计对于理解社交动态至关重要。现有的2D到3D姿态提升方法往往忽视人物间关系或无法处理变化的群体大小，限制了它们在多人场景中的有效性。
AI.method: 提出了MuPPet框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 人物编码(Person Encoding)来结构化个体表示；2) 排列增强(Permutation Augmentation)来提高训练多样性；3) 动态多人注意力(Dynamic Multi-Person Attention)来自适应建模个体间的相关性。
AI.result: 在群体互动数据集上的广泛实验表明，MuPPet显著优于最先进的单人和多人2D到3D姿态提升方法，并在遮挡场景中提高了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了建模人物间相关性的重要性，为准确且具有社会意识的3D姿态估计铺平了道路。

title: Fast-SegSim: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Segmentation for Robotics in Simulation
summary: Open-vocabulary panoptic reconstruction is crucial for advanced robotics and simulation. However, existing 3D reconstruction methods, such as NeRF or Gaussian Splatting variants, often struggle to achieve the real-time inference frequency required by robotic control loops. Existing methods incur prohibitive latency when processing the high-dimensional features required for robust open-vocabulary segmentation. We propose Fast-SegSim, a novel, simple, and end-to-end framework built upon 2D Gaussian Splatting, designed to realize real-time, high-fidelity, and 3D-consistent open-vocabulary segmentation reconstruction. Our core contribution is a highly optimized rendering pipeline that specifically addresses the computational bottleneck of high-channel segmentation feature accumulation. We introduce two key optimizations: Precise Tile Intersection to reduce rasterization redundancy, and a novel Top-K Hard Selection strategy. This strategy leverages the geometric sparsity inherent in the 2D Gaussian representation to greatly simplify feature accumulation and alleviate bandwidth limitations, achieving render rates exceeding 40 FPS. Fast-SegSim provides critical value in robotic applications: it serves both as a high-frequency sensor input for simulation platforms like Gazebo, and its 3D-consistent outputs provide essential multi-view 'ground truth' labels for fine-tuning downstream perception tasks. We demonstrate this utility by using the generated labels to fine-tune the perception module in object goal navigation, successfully doubling the navigation success rate. Our superior rendering speed and practical utility underscore Fast-SegSim's potential to bridge the sim-to-real gap.

AI.tldr: Fast-SegSim：基于2D高斯泼溅的实时开放词汇全景重建框架，通过优化渲染流水线实现超过40FPS的3D一致分割重建，用于机器人仿真和感知任务训练。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建方法（如NeRF或高斯泼溅变体）在处理高维特征时延迟过高，无法满足机器人控制回路所需的实时推理频率，限制了开放词汇全景重建在机器人应用中的实用性。
AI.method: 基于2D高斯泼溅构建端到端框架，核心是高度优化的渲染流水线，包含两个关键优化：1）精确瓦片相交减少光栅化冗余；2）新颖的Top-K硬选择策略，利用2D高斯表示的几何稀疏性简化特征累积并缓解带宽限制。
AI.result: 实现超过40FPS的渲染速度，显著优于现有方法。在机器人应用中，既可作为Gazebo等仿真平台的高频传感器输入，又能为下游感知任务提供多视角"真实"标签用于微调。在物体目标导航任务中，使用生成标签微调感知模块后，导航成功率翻倍。
AI.conclusion: Fast-SegSim通过创新的优化策略实现了实时、高保真、3D一致的开放词汇分割重建，其高渲染速度和实际应用价值展示了弥合仿真与现实差距的潜力，对机器人感知和控制具有重要意义。

title: Competing with AI Scientists: Agent-Driven Approach to Astrophysics Research
summary: We present an agent-driven approach to the construction of parameter inference pipelines for scientific data analysis. Our method leverages a multi-agent system, Cmbagent (the analysis system of the AI scientist Denario), in which specialized agents collaborate to generate research ideas, write and execute code, evaluate results, and iteratively refine the overall pipeline. As a case study, we apply this approach to the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Uncertainty Challenge, a competition under time constraints focused on robust cosmological parameter inference with realistic observational uncertainties. While the fully autonomous exploration initially did not reach expert-level performance, the integration of human intervention enabled our agent-driven workflow to achieve a first-place result in the challenge. This demonstrates that semi-autonomous agentic systems can compete with, and in some cases surpass, expert solutions. We describe our workflow in detail, including both the autonomous and semi-autonomous exploration by Cmbagent. Our final inference pipeline utilizes parameter-efficient convolutional neural networks, likelihood calibration over a known parameter grid, and multiple regularization techniques. Our results suggest that agent-driven research workflows can provide a scalable framework to rapidly explore and construct pipelines for inference problems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于多智能体系统的参数推断流水线构建方法，在宇宙弱透镜不确定性挑战赛中通过半自主方式获得第一名
AI.motivation: 为科学数据分析提供可扩展的参数推断流水线构建框架，解决传统方法在复杂问题上面临的探索效率低和专家依赖问题
AI.method: 使用Cmbagent多智能体系统，让专门化智能体协作生成研究想法、编写执行代码、评估结果并迭代优化流水线；最终采用参数高效卷积神经网络、已知参数网格上的似然校准和多种正则化技术
AI.result: 在FAIR宇宙弱透镜不确定性挑战赛中，全自主探索未达专家水平，但结合人工干预的半自主工作流获得第一名，超越了专家解决方案
AI.conclusion: 半自主智能体系统能够与专家解决方案竞争甚至超越，为快速探索和构建推断问题流水线提供了可扩展框架

title: Training Deep Visual Networks Beyond Loss and Accuracy Through a Dynamical Systems Approach
summary: Deep visual recognition models are usually trained and evaluated using metrics such as loss and accuracy. While these measures show whether a model is improving, they reveal very little about how its internal representations change during training. This paper introduces a complementary way to study that process by examining training through the lens of dynamical systems. Drawing on ideas from signal analysis originally used to study biological neural activity, we define three measures from layer activations collected across training epochs: an integration score that reflects long-range coordination across layers, a metastability score that captures how flexibly the network shifts between more and less synchronised states, and a combined dynamical stability index. We apply this framework to nine combinations of model architecture and dataset, including several ResNet variants, DenseNet-121, MobileNetV2, VGG-16, and a pretrained Vision Transformer on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. The results suggest three main patterns. First, the integration measure consistently distinguishes the easier CIFAR-10 setting from the more difficult CIFAR-100 setting. Second, changes in the volatility of the stability index may provide an early sign of convergence before accuracy fully plateaus. Third, the relationship between integration and metastability appears to reflect different styles of training behaviour. Overall, this study offers an exploratory but promising new way to understand deep visual training beyond loss and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过动力学系统视角分析深度视觉模型训练过程的新方法，使用层激活定义了三个度量指标来研究训练动态。
AI.motivation: 传统的损失和准确率指标虽然能显示模型是否在改进，但很少揭示其内部表示在训练过程中的变化。需要一种补充方法来更深入地理解训练动态。
AI.method: 借鉴用于研究生物神经活动的信号分析思想，从训练过程中收集的层激活定义了三个度量：反映层间长程协调的整合分数、捕捉网络在同步状态间灵活转换的亚稳定性分数，以及组合的动态稳定性指数。
AI.result: 在9种模型架构和数据集组合上的实验显示：1）整合度量能一致区分CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100的难度差异；2）稳定性指数的波动变化可能提供收敛的早期信号；3）整合与亚稳定性的关系反映了不同的训练行为风格。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究提供了一种探索性但有前景的新方法，超越了传统的损失和准确率，从动力学系统角度理解深度视觉模型的训练过程。

title: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning Based Online 3D Bin Packing Spatial Strategy Optimization
comment: 8 pages, double-column. Jie Han and Tong Li contributed equally to this work. Qingyang Xu is the corresponding author
summary: The online 3D bin packing problem is important in logistics, warehousing and intelligent manufacturing, with solutions shifting to deep reinforcement learning (DRL) which faces challenges like low sample efficiency. This paper proposes a diffusion reinforcement learning-based algorithm, using a Markov decision chain for packing modeling, height map-based state representation and a diffusion model-based actor network. Experiments show it significantly improves the average number of packed items compared to state-of-the-art DRL methods, with excellent application potential in complex online scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散强化学习的在线3D装箱算法，显著提升装箱物品数量
AI.motivation: 在线3D装箱问题在物流、仓储和智能制造中很重要，现有深度强化学习方法面临样本效率低等挑战
AI.method: 使用马尔可夫决策链建模装箱过程，基于高度图的状态表示，以及基于扩散模型的行动者网络
AI.result: 相比最先进的DRL方法，显著提高了平均装箱物品数量，在复杂在线场景中具有优秀应用潜力
AI.conclusion: 提出的扩散强化学习算法有效解决了在线3D装箱问题，提升了装箱效率和性能

title: How LLMs Might Think
summary: Do large language models (LLMs) think? Daniel Stoljar and Zhihe Vincent Zhang have recently developed an argument from rationality for the claim that LLMs do not think. We contend, however, that the argument from rationality not only falters, but leaves open an intriguing possibility: that LLMs engage only in arational, associative forms of thinking, and have purely associative minds. Our positive claim is that if LLMs think at all, they likely think precisely in this manner.

AI.tldr: 论文反驳了Stoljar和Zhang关于LLM不思考的理性论证，提出LLM可能进行非理性、联想式思考，具有纯粹联想思维
AI.motivation: 针对Stoljar和Zhang提出的"LLM不思考"的理性论证进行批判性分析，探讨LLM是否具有思考能力以及思考的本质
AI.method: 通过哲学分析和概念论证，批判理性论证的缺陷，提出LLM可能进行联想式思考的理论框架
AI.result: 理性论证存在缺陷，LLM可能具有纯粹联想思维，进行非理性的联想式思考而非理性思考
AI.conclusion: 如果LLM确实思考，它们很可能以非理性、联想的方式进行，具有纯粹联想思维而非理性思维

title: Multi-Head Attention based interaction-aware architecture for Bangla Handwritten Character Recognition: Introducing a Primary Dataset
summary: Character recognition is the fundamental part of an optical character recognition (OCR) system. Word recognition, sentence transcription, document digitization, and language processing are some of the higher-order activities that can be done accurately through character recognition. Nonetheless, recognizing handwritten Bangla characters is not an easy task because they are written in different styles with inconsistent stroke patterns and a high degree of visual character resemblance. The datasets available are usually limited in intra-class and inequitable in class distribution. We have constructed a new balanced dataset of Bangla written characters to overcome those problems. This consists of 78 classes and each class has approximately 650 samples. It contains the basic characters, composite (Juktobarno) characters and numerals. The samples were a diverse group comprising a large age range and socioeconomic groups. Elementary and high school students, university students, and professionals are the contributing factors. The sample also has right and left-handed writers. We have further proposed an interaction-aware hybrid deep learning architecture that integrates EfficientNetB3, Vision Transformer, and Conformer modules in parallel. A multi-head cross-attention fusion mechanism enables effective feature interaction across these components. The proposed model achieves 98.84% accuracy on the constructed dataset and 96.49% on the external CHBCR benchmark, demonstrating strong generalization capability. Grad-CAM visualizations further provide interpretability by highlighting discriminative regions. The dataset and source code of this research is publicly available at: https://huggingface.co/MIRZARAQUIB/Bangla_Handwritten_Character_Recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出新的平衡孟加拉手写字符数据集和交互感知混合深度学习架构，在自建数据集上达到98.84%准确率，在外部基准上达到96.49%
AI.motivation: 孟加拉手写字符识别面临挑战：字符书写风格多样、笔画模式不一致、视觉相似度高，且现有数据集通常类内样本有限、类别分布不均衡
AI.method: 1) 构建新的平衡孟加拉手写字符数据集（78个类别，每类约650个样本）；2) 提出交互感知混合深度学习架构，并行集成EfficientNetB3、Vision Transformer和Conformer模块，通过多头交叉注意力融合机制实现特征交互
AI.result: 在自建数据集上达到98.84%准确率，在外部CHBCR基准上达到96.49%准确率，展示出强大的泛化能力；Grad-CAM可视化提供可解释性
AI.conclusion: 提出的平衡数据集和混合深度学习架构有效解决了孟加拉手写字符识别的挑战，模型表现出优异的性能和泛化能力，数据集和源代码已公开

title: ScoRe-Flow: Complete Distributional Control via Score-Based Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching
summary: Flow Matching (FM) policies have emerged as an efficient backbone for robotic control, offering fast and expressive action generation that underpins recent large-scale embodied AI systems. However, FM policies trained via imitation learning inherit the limitations of demonstration data; surpassing suboptimal behaviors requires reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning. Recent methods convert deterministic flows into stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with learnable noise injection, enabling exploration and tractable likelihoods, but such noise-only control can compromise training efficiency when demonstrations already provide strong priors. We observe that modulating the drift via the score function, i.e., the gradient of log-density, steers exploration toward high-probability regions, improving stability. The score admits a closed-form expression from the velocity field, requiring no auxiliary networks. Based on this, we propose ScoRe-Flow, a score-based RL fine-tuning method that combines drift modulation with learned variance prediction to achieve decoupled control over the mean and variance of stochastic transitions. Experiments demonstrate that ScoRe-Flow achieves 2.4x faster convergence than flow-based SOTA on D4RL locomotion tasks and up to 5.4% higher success rates on Robomimic and Franka Kitchen manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: ScoRe-Flow：一种基于分数的强化学习微调方法，通过调制漂移项和学习方差预测，实现随机转移的均值与方差解耦控制，相比现有方法收敛更快且成功率更高。
AI.motivation: 流匹配策略虽然高效，但基于模仿学习训练会继承演示数据的局限性，需要强化学习微调来超越次优行为。现有方法通过可学习噪声注入将确定性流转换为随机微分方程，但仅依赖噪声控制在演示已提供强先验时会影响训练效率。
AI.method: 提出ScoRe-Flow方法：1）通过分数函数（对数密度梯度）调制漂移项，引导探索朝向高概率区域；2）分数可从速度场闭式表达，无需额外网络；3）结合学习方差预测，实现随机转移的均值与方差解耦控制。
AI.result: 在D4RL运动任务上比基于流的SOTA方法收敛快2.4倍；在Robomimic和Franka Kitchen操作任务上成功率提升高达5.4%。
AI.conclusion: ScoRe-Flow通过分数调制漂移和学习方差预测，实现了更高效的强化学习微调，在运动和控制任务上都表现出显著优势。

title: Belief-Aware VLM Model for Human-like Reasoning
summary: Traditional neural network models for intent inference rely heavily on observable states and struggle to generalize across diverse tasks and dynamic environments. Recent advances in Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Language Action (VLA) models introduce common-sense reasoning through large-scale multimodal pretraining, enabling zero-shot performance across tasks. However, these models still lack explicit mechanisms to represent and update belief, limiting their ability to reason like humans or capture the evolving human intent over long-horizon. To address this, we propose a belief-aware VLM framework that integrates retrieval-based memory and reinforcement learning. Instead of learning an explicit belief model, we approximate belief using a vector-based memory that retrieves relevant multimodal context, which is incorporated into the VLM for reasoning. We further refine decision-making using a reinforcement learning policy over the VLM latent space. We evaluate our approach on publicly available VQA datasets such as HD-EPIC and demonstrate consistent improvements over zero-shot baselines, highlighting the importance of belief-aware reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出一个信念感知的视觉语言模型框架，通过检索式记忆和强化学习来近似人类信念，提升意图推理能力
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络意图推理模型依赖可观察状态，难以泛化到多样化任务和动态环境。现有的视觉语言模型虽然通过大规模多模态预训练引入了常识推理，但缺乏显式的信念表示和更新机制，限制了其像人类一样推理或捕捉长期演化的人类意图的能力。
AI.method: 提出信念感知VLM框架，集成检索式记忆和强化学习。不学习显式信念模型，而是使用基于向量的记忆来检索相关多模态上下文，将其整合到VLM中进行推理。进一步在VLM潜在空间上使用强化学习策略来优化决策。
AI.result: 在HD-EPIC等公开VQA数据集上评估，相比零样本基线获得了一致的改进，突显了信念感知推理的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的信念感知VLM框架通过集成检索式记忆和强化学习，有效提升了意图推理能力，证明了信念感知推理在视觉语言任务中的重要性。

title: Data-Driven Automated Identification of Optimal Feature-Representative Images in Infrared Thermography Using Statistical and Morphological Metrics
summary: Infrared thermography (IRT) is a widely used non-destructive testing technique for detecting structural features such as subsurface defects. However, most IRT post-processing methods generate image sequences in which defect visibility varies strongly across time, frequency, or coefficient/index domains, making the identification of defect-representative images a critical challenge. Conventional evaluation metrics, such as the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) or the Tanimoto criterion, often require prior knowledge of defect locations or defect-free reference regions, limiting their suitability for automated and unsupervised analysis. In this work, a data-driven methodology is proposed to identify images within IRT datasets that are most likely to contain and represent structural features, particularly anomalies and defects, without requiring prior spatial information. The approach is based on three complementary metrics: the Homogeneity Index of Mixture (HI), which quantifies statistical heterogeneity via deviations of local intensity distributions from a global reference distribution; a Representative Elementary Area (REA), derived from a Minkowski-functional adaptation of the Representative Elementary Volume concept to two-dimensional images; and a geometrical-topological Total Variation Energy (TVE) index, also based on two-dimensional Minkowski functionals, designed to improve sensitivity to localized anomalies. The framework is validated experimentally using pulse-heated IRT data from a carbon fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) plate containing six artificial defects at depths between 0.135 mm and 0.810 mm, and is further supported by one-dimensional N-layer thermal model simulations. The results demonstrate robust and unbiased ranking of image sequences and provide a reliable basis for automated defect-oriented image selection in IRT.

AI.tldr: 提出基于三种互补指标的数据驱动方法，用于在红外热成像序列中自动识别最能代表结构特征（特别是缺陷）的图像，无需先验空间信息。
AI.motivation: 红外热成像后处理生成的图像序列中，缺陷可见性在时间、频率或系数域中变化很大，传统评估指标（如SNR或Tanimoto准则）通常需要缺陷位置或无缺陷参考区域的先验知识，限制了自动化和无监督分析的适用性。
AI.method: 提出基于三种互补指标的数据驱动框架：1）混合均匀性指数（HI），通过局部强度分布与全局参考分布的偏差量化统计异质性；2）代表性基本面积（REA），基于Minkowski函数将代表性基本体积概念适应到二维图像；3）几何拓扑总变分能量（TVE）指数，同样基于二维Minkowski函数，旨在提高对局部异常的敏感性。
AI.result: 使用含6个人工缺陷（深度0.135-0.810mm）的碳纤维增强聚合物板的脉冲加热红外热成像数据进行实验验证，并辅以一维N层热模型模拟。结果表明该方法能够对图像序列进行稳健且无偏的排序，为红外热成像中的自动缺陷导向图像选择提供了可靠基础。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了无需先验空间信息的自动缺陷图像识别，为红外热成像的无监督分析提供了有效解决方案，能够可靠地识别最能代表结构特征的图像。

title: Ψ-Map: Panoptic Surface Integrated Mapping Enables Real2Sim Transfer
summary: Open-vocabulary panoptic reconstruction is essential for advanced robotics perception and simulation. However, existing methods based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) often struggle to simultaneously achieve geometric accuracy, coherent panoptic understanding, and real-time inference frequency in large-scale scenes. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive framework that integrates geometric reinforcement, end-to-end panoptic learning, and efficient rendering. First, to ensure physical realism in large-scale environments, we leverage LiDAR data to construct plane-constrained multimodal Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) and employ 2D Gaussian surfels as the map representation, enabling high-precision surface alignment and continuous geometric supervision. Building upon this, to overcome the error accumulation and cumbersome cross-frame association inherent in traditional multi-stage panoptic segmentation pipelines, we design a query-guided end-to-end learning architecture. By utilizing a local cross-attention mechanism within the view frustum, the system lifts 2D mask features directly into 3D space, achieving globally consistent panoptic understanding. Finally, addressing the computational bottlenecks caused by high-dimensional semantic features, we introduce Precise Tile Intersection and a Top-K Hard Selection strategy to optimize the rendering pipeline. Experimental results demonstrate that our system achieves superior geometric and panoptic reconstruction quality in large-scale scenes while maintaining an inference rate exceeding 40 FPS, meeting the real-time requirements of robotic control loops.

AI.tldr: 提出一个集成几何增强、端到端全景学习和高效渲染的框架，用于大规模场景的开放词汇全景重建，在保持40+FPS实时推理的同时实现高质量几何和全景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的方法难以同时在大规模场景中实现几何精度、连贯的全景理解和实时推理频率，需要一种综合解决方案来满足机器人感知和仿真的需求。
AI.method: 1) 利用LiDAR数据构建平面约束的多模态高斯混合模型，使用2D高斯面元作为地图表示；2) 设计查询引导的端到端学习架构，通过视锥体内的局部交叉注意力机制将2D掩码特征直接提升到3D空间；3) 引入精确瓦片相交和Top-K硬选择策略优化渲染流水线。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该系统在大规模场景中实现了卓越的几何和全景重建质量，同时保持超过40FPS的推理速率，满足机器人控制回路的实时要求。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了大规模开放词汇全景重建中几何精度、全景一致性和实时性能的平衡问题，为机器人感知和仿真提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Tipiano: Cascaded Piano Hand Motion Synthesis via Fingertip Priors
summary: Synthesizing realistic piano hand motions requires both precision and naturalness. Physics-based methods achieve precision but produce stiff motions; data-driven models learn natural dynamics but struggle with positional accuracy. Piano motion exhibits a natural hierarchy: fingertip positions are nearly deterministic given piano geometry and fingering, while wrist and intermediate joints offer stylistic freedom. We present [OURS], a four-stage framework exploiting this hierarchy: (1) statistics-based fingertip positioning, (2) FiLM-conditioned trajectory refinement, (3) wrist estimation, and (4) STGCN-based pose synthesis. We contribute expert-annotated fingerings for the FürElise dataset (153 pieces, ~10 hours). Experiments demonstrate F1 = 0.910, substantially outperforming diffusion baselines (F1 = 0.121), with user study (N=41) confirming quality approaching motion capture. Expert evaluation by professional pianists (N=5) identified anticipatory motion as the key remaining gap, providing concrete directions for future improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出一个四阶段钢琴手部动作合成框架，利用手指-手腕-关节的层次结构，通过统计指尖定位、轨迹优化、手腕估计和姿态合成，在精度和自然度上超越扩散模型基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在精度与自然度的权衡：基于物理的方法精确但僵硬，数据驱动模型自然但位置精度不足。钢琴手部动作具有天然层次结构：指尖位置由钢琴几何和指法决定，手腕和中间关节提供风格自由度。
AI.method: 四阶段框架：1) 基于统计的指尖定位；2) FiLM条件轨迹优化；3) 手腕估计；4) STGCN姿态合成。贡献了FürElise数据集（153首曲目，约10小时）的专家标注指法。
AI.result: F1分数达到0.910，显著优于扩散模型基线（F1=0.121）。用户研究（N=41）确认质量接近动作捕捉。专业钢琴家评估（N=5）指出预期性动作是主要改进方向。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用钢琴手部动作的层次结构，提出的四阶段框架在精度和自然度上取得平衡，超越现有方法。专家评估为未来改进提供了具体方向，特别是增强预期性动作。

title: LOLGORITHM: Funny Comment Generation Agent For Short Videos
summary: Short-form video platforms have become central to multimedia information dissemination, where comments play a critical role in driving engagement, propagation, and algorithmic feedback. However, existing approaches -- including video summarization and live-streaming danmaku generation -- fail to produce authentic comments that conform to platform-specific cultural and linguistic norms. In this paper, we present LOLGORITHM, a novel modular multi-agent framework for stylized short-form video comment generation. LOLGORITHM supports six controllable comment styles and comprises three core modules: video content summarization, video classification, and comment generation with semantic retrieval and hot meme augmentation. We further construct a bilingual dataset of 3,267 videos and 16,335 comments spanning five high-engagement categories across YouTube and Douyin. Evaluation combining automatic scoring and large-scale human preference analysis demonstrates that LOLGORITHM consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving human preference selection rates of 80.46\% on YouTube and 84.29\% on Douyin across 107 respondents. Ablation studies confirm that these gains are attributable to the framework architecture rather than the choice of backbone LLM, underscoring the robustness and generalizability of our approach.

AI.tldr: LOLGORITHM是一个用于生成符合平台文化规范短视频评论的模块化多智能体框架，支持六种可控评论风格，在YouTube和Douyin上分别获得80.46%和84.29%的人类偏好选择率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（视频摘要和直播弹幕生成）无法生成符合平台特定文化和语言规范的真实评论，而评论在推动参与度、传播和算法反馈中起着关键作用。
AI.method: 提出LOLGORITHM模块化多智能体框架，包含三个核心模块：视频内容摘要、视频分类、以及带有语义检索和热门梗增强的评论生成。支持六种可控评论风格，并构建了包含3,267个视频和16,335条评论的双语数据集。
AI.result: 评估显示LOLGORITHM在自动评分和人类偏好分析中始终优于基线方法，在YouTube和Douyin上分别获得80.46%和84.29%的人类偏好选择率。消融研究证实这些改进归因于框架架构而非基础LLM选择。
AI.conclusion: LOLGORITHM框架能够生成符合平台文化规范的真实评论，其模块化架构具有鲁棒性和泛化能力，为短视频平台评论生成提供了有效解决方案。

title: Inferring World Belief States in Dynamic Real-World Environments
summary: We investigate estimating a human's world belief state using a robot's observations in a dynamic, 3D, and partially observable environment. The methods are grounded in mental model theory, which posits that human decision making, contextual reasoning, situation awareness, and behavior planning draw from an internal simulation or world belief state. When in teams, the mental model also includes a team model of each teammate's beliefs and capabilities, enabling fluent teamwork without the need for constant and explicit communication. In this work we replicate a core component of the team model by inferring a teammate's belief state, or level one situation awareness, as a human-robot team navigates a household environment. We evaluate our methods in a realistic simulation, extend to a real-world robot platform, and demonstrate a downstream application of the belief state through an active assistance semantic reasoning task.

AI.tldr: 研究通过机器人观测推断人类队友的世界信念状态，应用于人机团队在家庭环境中的导航，并在仿真和真实机器人平台上验证
AI.motivation: 基于心智模型理论，人类决策、情境推理、态势感知和行为规划都依赖于内部模拟或世界信念状态。在团队中，心智模型还包括对队友信念和能力的团队模型，从而实现无需持续显式通信的流畅协作。本研究旨在复制团队模型的核心组件——推断队友的信念状态（一级态势感知）
AI.method: 在动态、三维、部分可观测环境中，利用机器人观测来估计人类的世界信念状态。方法基于心智模型理论，通过人机团队在家庭环境中的导航任务来推断人类队友的信念状态
AI.result: 在真实仿真环境中评估了方法，扩展到真实世界机器人平台，并通过主动辅助语义推理任务展示了信念状态的下游应用
AI.conclusion: 成功实现了通过机器人观测推断人类队友信念状态的方法，为人机团队协作中的心智模型构建提供了可行方案，并在实际应用中验证了其有效性

title: The Myth of Expert Specialization in MoEs: Why Routing Reflects Geometry, Not Necessarily Domain Expertise
summary: Mixture of Experts (MoEs) are now ubiquitous in large language models, yet the mechanisms behind their "expert specialization" remain poorly understood. We show that, since MoE routers are linear maps, hidden state similarity is both necessary and sufficient to explain expert usage similarity, and specialization is therefore an emergent property of the representation space, not of the routing architecture itself. We confirm this at both token and sequence level across five pre-trained models. We additionally prove that load-balancing loss suppresses shared hidden state directions to maintain routing diversity, which might provide a theoretical explanation for specialization collapse under less diverse data, e.g. small batch. Despite this clean mechanistic account, we find that specialization patterns in pre-trained MoEs resist human interpretation: expert overlap between different models answering the same question is no higher than between entirely different questions ($\sim$60\%); prompt-level routing does not predict rollout-level routing; and deeper layers exhibit near-identical expert activation across semantically unrelated inputs, especially in reasoning models. We conclude that, while the efficiency perspective of MoEs is well understood, understanding expert specialization is at least as hard as understanding LLM hidden state geometry, a long-standing open problem in the literature.

AI.tldr: MoE专家专业化机制源于表征空间相似性而非路由架构本身，但预训练MoE的专业化模式难以解释，理解专家专业化与理解LLM隐藏状态几何同样困难。
AI.motivation: 尽管混合专家模型在大语言模型中普遍应用，但其"专家专业化"机制仍不清楚。研究者希望揭示MoE专家专业化的本质机制，并理解预训练模型中观察到的专业化模式。
AI.method: 通过理论分析证明MoE路由器的线性映射特性，表明隐藏状态相似性足以解释专家使用相似性。在五个预训练模型上进行token和序列级别的验证，分析负载均衡损失对共享隐藏状态方向的影响。
AI.result: 专家专业化是表征空间涌现的属性而非路由架构特性。负载均衡损失抑制共享隐藏状态方向以维持路由多样性。预训练MoE的专业化模式难以解释：不同模型回答相同问题的专家重叠度与回答不同问题相似；提示级路由无法预测展开级路由；深层在语义无关输入上表现出近乎相同的专家激活。
AI.conclusion: 虽然MoE的效率视角已得到很好理解，但理解专家专业化至少与理解LLM隐藏状态几何同样困难，这是文献中长期存在的开放问题。专业化机制源于表征空间而非架构本身，但具体模式仍难以解释。

title: Multi-Frequency Local Plasticity for Visual Representation Learning
summary:
We study how far structured architectural bias can compensate for the absence of end-to-end gradient-based representation learning in visual recognition. Building on the VisNet tradition, we introduce a modular hierarchical framework combining: (i) fixed multi-frequency Gabor decomposition into F=7 parallel streams; (ii) within-stream competitive learning with Hebbian and Oja updates and anti-Hebbian decorrelation; (iii) an associative memory module inspired by modern Hopfield retrieval; and (iv) iterative top-down modulation using local prediction and reconstruction signals.
  Representational layers are trained without end-to-end backpropagation through the full hierarchy; only the final linear readout and top-down projection matrices are optimized by gradient descent. We therefore interpret the model as a hybrid system that is predominantly locally trained but includes a small number of gradient-trained parameters.
  On CIFAR-10, the full model reaches 80.1% +/- 0.3% top-1 accuracy, linear probe), compared with 71.0% for a Hebbian-only baseline and 83.4% for a gradient-trained model on the same fixed Gabor basis. On CIFAR-100, performance is 54.8%. Factorial analysis indicates that multi-frequency streams, associative memory, and top-down feedback contribute largely additively, with a significant Streams x TopDown interaction (p=0.02).
  These results suggest that carefully chosen architectural priors can recover a substantial fraction of the performance typically associated with global gradient training, while leaving a measurable residual gap. Experiments are limited to CIFAR-10/100.

AI.tldr: 研究结构化架构偏置能否补偿端到端梯度学习的缺失，提出混合层次框架，在CIFAR-10上达到80.1%准确率，接近梯度训练模型的83.4%。
AI.motivation: 探索结构化架构偏置能在多大程度上补偿视觉识别中端到端梯度学习的缺失，研究局部训练与少量梯度训练参数结合的混合系统。
AI.method: 提出模块化层次框架：固定多频Gabor分解为7个并行流；流内竞争学习（Hebbian/Oja更新+反Hebbian去相关）；现代Hopfield启发的关联记忆模块；使用局部预测和重建信号的迭代自上而下调制。仅最终线性读出和自上而下投影矩阵使用梯度下降优化。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上达到80.1%准确率（线性探针），相比纯Hebbian基线的71.0%和相同Gabor基上梯度训练模型的83.4%。CIFAR-100上为54.8%。因子分析显示多频流、关联记忆和自上而下反馈贡献基本可加，存在显著的流×自上而下交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 精心选择的架构先验可以恢复通常与全局梯度训练相关的大部分性能，但仍存在可测量的性能差距。实验仅限于CIFAR-10/100数据集。

title: Federated Single-Agent Robotics: Multi-Robot Coordination Without Intra-Robot Multi-Agent Fragmentation
summary: As embodied robots move toward fleet-scale operation, multi-robot coordination is becoming a central systems challenge. Existing approaches often treat this as motivation for increasing internal multi-agent decomposition within each robot. We argue for a different principle: multi-robot coordination does not require intra-robot multi-agent fragmentation. Each robot should remain a single embodied agent with its own persistent runtime, local policy scope, capability state, and recovery authority, while coordination emerges through federation across robots at the fleet level. We present Federated Single-Agent Robotics (FSAR), a runtime architecture for multi-robot coordination built on single-agent robot runtimes. Each robot exposes a governed capability surface rather than an internally fragmented agent society. Fleet coordination is achieved through shared capability registries, cross-robot task delegation, policy-aware authority assignment, trust-scoped interaction, and layered recovery protocols. We formalize key coordination relations including authority delegation, inter-robot capability requests, local-versus-fleet recovery boundaries, and hierarchical human supervision, and describe a fleet runtime architecture supporting shared Embodied Capability Module (ECM) discovery, contract-aware cross-robot coordination, and fleet-level governance. We evaluate FSAR on representative multi-robot coordination scenarios against decomposition-heavy baselines. Results show statistically significant gains in governance locality (d=2.91, p<.001 vs. centralized control) and recovery containment (d=4.88, p<.001 vs. decomposition-heavy), while reducing authority conflicts and policy violations across all scenarios. Our results support the view that the path from embodied agents to embodied fleets is better served by federation across coherent robot runtimes than by fragmentation within them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FSAR架构：多机器人协调不应通过机器人内部的多智能体分解实现，而应让每个机器人保持单一智能体，通过运行时联邦实现舰队级协调。
AI.motivation: 随着机器人向舰队规模发展，多机器人协调成为系统挑战。现有方法倾向于在每个机器人内部增加多智能体分解，但作者认为这会导致不必要的复杂性，主张保持每个机器人的单一智能体特性。
AI.method: 提出联邦单智能体机器人（FSAR）运行时架构：每个机器人作为单一智能体运行，通过共享能力注册表、跨机器人任务委托、策略感知权限分配、信任范围交互和分层恢复协议实现舰队协调。
AI.result: 与分解密集型基线相比，FSAR在治理局部性（d=2.91, p<.001）和恢复包容性（d=4.88, p<.001）方面有显著提升，同时减少了所有场景中的权限冲突和策略违规。
AI.conclusion: 从个体机器人到机器人舰队的演进路径更适合通过连贯运行时之间的联邦实现，而非通过机器人内部的分裂。FSAR架构为多机器人协调提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: Pioneer Agent: Continual Improvement of Small Language Models in Production
summary: Small language models are attractive for production deployment due to their low cost, fast inference, and ease of specialization. However, adapting them to a specific task remains a challenging engineering loop, driven not by training itself but by surrounding decisions: data curation, failure diagnosis, regression avoidance, and iteration control. We present Pioneer Agent, a closed-loop system that automates this lifecycle. In cold-start mode, given only a natural-language task description, the agent acquires data, constructs evaluation sets, and iteratively trains models by jointly optimizing data, hyperparameters, and learning strategy. In production mode, given a deployed model with labeled failures, it diagnoses error patterns, constructs targeted training data, and retrains under explicit regression constraints. To evaluate this setting, we introduce AdaptFT-Bench, a benchmark of synthetic inference logs with progressively increasing noise, designed to test the full adaptation loop: diagnosis, curriculum synthesis, retraining, and verification. Across eight cold-start benchmarks spanning reasoning, math, code generation, summarization, and classification, Pioneer Agent improves over base models by 1.6-83.8 points. On AdaptFT-Bench, it improves or preserves performance in all seven scenarios, while naive retraining degrades by up to 43 points. On two production-style deployments built from public benchmark tasks, it raises intent classification from 84.9% to 99.3% and Entity F1 from 0.345 to 0.810. Beyond performance gains, the agent often discovers effective training strategies, including chain-of-thought supervision, task-specific optimization, and quality-focused data curation, purely from downstream feedback.

AI.tldr: Pioneer Agent是一个自动化小语言模型任务适应的闭环系统，支持冷启动和生产模式，在多个基准测试中显著提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型虽然部署成本低、推理快、易于定制，但针对特定任务进行适应仍面临数据整理、错误诊断、回归避免和迭代控制等工程挑战，需要自动化解决方案。
AI.method: Pioneer Agent是一个闭环系统：冷启动模式下，根据自然语言任务描述自动获取数据、构建评估集，并通过联合优化数据、超参数和学习策略迭代训练模型；生产模式下，根据已部署模型的标注错误诊断错误模式，构建针对性训练数据，并在明确回归约束下重新训练。
AI.result: 在8个冷启动基准测试中，相比基础模型提升1.6-83.8分；在AdaptFT-Bench基准上，所有7个场景都改善或保持性能，而简单重训练下降达43分；在两个生产部署中，意图分类从84.9%提升到99.3%，实体F1从0.345提升到0.810。
AI.conclusion: Pioneer Agent能有效自动化小语言模型的任务适应生命周期，显著提升性能，并能从下游反馈中发现有效的训练策略，如思维链监督、任务特定优化和质量导向数据整理。

title: See Fair, Speak Truth: Equitable Attention Improves Grounding and Reduces Hallucination in Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently hallucinate objects that are absent from the visual input, often because attention during decoding is disproportionately drawn to visually dominant or frequently occurring content. We observe that this inequity in attention allocation is a root cause of object hallucination: when rare, small, or contextually peripheral objects receive insufficient attention, the model fails to ground its generation in the full visual scene. We argue that every object in an image, regardless of its size, frequency or visual salience, deserves equal representational opportunity during decoding. To this end, we propose DOP-OBC, a training-free and architecture-agnostic decoding strategy built on the principle of equitable attention. Two complementary object-aware signals work in tandem: a Dominant Object Penalty (DOP) that softly suppresses attention over-concentration on visually dominant regions, and an Outlier Boost Coefficient (OBC) that amplifies attention toward rare yet confidently detected objects. These signals are injected as per-row logit modulations within the causal attention mask, requiring no weight updates and preserving autoregressive decoding properties. Extensive experiments across image and video MLLMs demonstrate consistent reductions in object hallucination on CHAIR and POPE benchmarks, alongside improvements in GPT-4o assessed captioning quality across correctness, consistency, detail, context and temporal dimensions. DOP-OBC establishes that fairness in attention allocation is not merely a design principle but a practical and effective path toward more faithful multimodal generation.

AI.tldr: DOP-OBC是一种无需训练的解码策略，通过均衡注意力分配来减少MLLMs中的物体幻觉问题，使用主导物体惩罚和离群增强系数来抑制过度关注主导区域并增强对罕见物体的注意力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型经常幻觉出视觉输入中不存在的物体，主要原因是解码时注意力不均衡地集中在视觉主导或频繁出现的内容上，而罕见、小或上下文边缘的物体得不到足够关注，导致模型无法充分基于完整视觉场景生成内容。
AI.method: 提出DOP-OBC解码策略：1) 主导物体惩罚(DOP) - 软性抑制对视觉主导区域的过度关注；2) 离群增强系数(OBC) - 增强对罕见但被自信检测到的物体的注意力。这些信号作为每行logit调制注入因果注意力掩码中，无需权重更新且保持自回归解码特性。
AI.result: 在图像和视频MLLMs上的广泛实验显示，在CHAIR和POPE基准测试中物体幻觉持续减少，同时在GPT-4o评估的标题质量（正确性、一致性、细节、上下文和时间维度）方面有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 注意力分配的公平性不仅是设计原则，而且是实现更忠实多模态生成的实际有效途径。DOP-OBC证明了通过均衡注意力分配可以有效减少物体幻觉问题。

title: Simulator Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Learning of Legged Locomotion via Proprioceptive Distribution Matching
summary: Simulation trained legged locomotion policies often exhibit performance loss on hardware due to dynamics discrepancies between the simulator and the real world, highlighting the need for approaches that adapt the simulator itself to better match hardware behavior. Prior work typically quantify these discrepancies through precise, time-aligned matching of joint and base trajectories. This process requires motion capture, privileged sensing, and carefully controlled initial conditions. We introduce a practical alternative based on proprioceptive distribution matching, which compares hardware and simulation rollouts as distributions of joint observations and actions, eliminating the need for time alignment or external sensing. Using this metric as a black-box objective, we explore adapting simulator dynamics through parameter identification, action-delta models, and residual actuator models. Our approach matches the parameter recovery and policy-performance gains of privileged state-matching baselines across extensive sim-to-sim ablations on the Go2 quadruped. Real-world experiments demonstrate substantial drift reduction using less than five minutes of hardware data, even for a challenging two-legged walking behavior. These results demonstrate that proprioceptive distribution matching provides a practical and effective route to simulator adaptation for sim-to-real transfer of learned legged locomotion.

AI.tldr: 提出基于本体感觉分布匹配的模拟器适应方法，无需运动捕捉或时间对齐，仅用本体感觉数据即可减少模拟与现实间的动力学差异，提升四足机器人学习策略的迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 模拟训练的四足运动策略在硬件上常因模拟与现实动力学差异而性能下降，现有方法需要运动捕捉、特权传感和精确时间对齐，过程复杂且不实用。
AI.method: 提出本体感觉分布匹配方法，将硬件和模拟的rollout视为关节观测和动作的分布进行比较，无需时间对齐或外部传感。以此作为黑盒目标，通过参数识别、动作增量模型和残差执行器模型来适应模拟器动力学。
AI.result: 在Go2四足机器人上，该方法与特权状态匹配基线在参数恢复和策略性能增益上表现相当。真实世界实验中，仅用不到5分钟的硬件数据就能显著减少漂移，即使对于具有挑战性的两足行走行为也有效。
AI.conclusion: 本体感觉分布匹配为学习四足运动的模拟到真实迁移提供了一种实用有效的模拟器适应途径，简化了现有方法对复杂传感和时间对齐的要求。

title: Controllable and Verifiable Tool-Use Data Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Existing synthetic tool-use corpora are primarily designed for offline supervised fine-tuning, yet reinforcement learning (RL) requires executable environments that support reward-checkable online rollouts. We propose COVERT, a two-stage pipeline that first generates reliable base tool-use trajectories through self-evolving synthesis with multi-level validation, and then applies oracle-preserving augmentations that systematically increase environmental complexity. These augmentations introduce distractor tools, indirect or ambiguous user queries, and noisy, multi-format, or erroneous tool outputs, while strictly preserving oracle tool calls and final answers as ground truth. This design enables automatic reward computation via reference matching for standard cases and lightweight judge-assisted verification for special behaviors such as error detection, supporting RL optimization of tool-calling policies. On Qwen2.5-Instruct-14B, COVERT-RL improves overall accuracy on BFCL v3 from 56.5 to 59.9 and on ACEBench from 53.0 to 59.3, with minimal regressions on general-ability benchmarks; when stacked on SFT, it further reaches 62.1 and 61.8, confirming additive gains. These results suggest that oracle-preserving synthetic environments offer a practical RL refinement stage, complementary to SFT, for improving tool-use robustness under ambiguity and unreliable tool feedback.

AI.tldr: COVERT：一个两阶段合成工具使用环境生成框架，支持在线强化学习训练，通过自演化合成和多级验证生成可靠轨迹，再通过保留oracle的增强增加环境复杂度，提升工具使用的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有合成工具使用语料库主要设计用于离线监督微调，但强化学习需要支持奖励可检查的在线环境。需要创建既能增加环境复杂性又能保持oracle工具调用和最终答案真实性的合成环境。
AI.method: 两阶段流程：1）通过自演化合成和多级验证生成可靠的基础工具使用轨迹；2）应用oracle保留增强，系统性地增加环境复杂性，包括引入干扰工具、间接或模糊的用户查询、噪声、多格式或错误的工具输出，同时严格保留oracle工具调用和最终答案作为真实标签。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Instruct-14B上，COVERT-RL将BFCL v3的总体准确率从56.5提升到59.9，ACEBench从53.0提升到59.3，在通用能力基准上回归最小；叠加在SFT上后，分别达到62.1和61.8，确认了增益的累加性。
AI.conclusion: 保留oracle的合成环境为工具使用提供了一个实用的强化学习精炼阶段，与监督微调互补，能够在模糊性和不可靠工具反馈下提高工具使用的鲁棒性。

title: MedLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning for Reliable Medical Visual Question Answering
summary: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for medical visual question answering (VQA), yet their reasoning remains largely text-centric: images are encoded once as static context, and subsequent inference is dominated by language. This paradigm is fundamentally limited in clinical scenarios, where accurate answers often depend on subtle, localized visual evidence that cannot be reliably preserved in static embeddings. We propose \textsc{MedLVR}, a latent visual reasoning framework that introduces an explicit visual evidence state into autoregressive decoding. Instead of relying solely on text-based intermediate reasoning, \textsc{MedLVR} interleaves a short latent reasoning segment within the decoder by reusing hidden states as continuous latent steps, enabling iterative preservation and refinement of query-relevant visual evidence before answer generation. To support effective visual supervision, we adopt a two-stage training strategy: region of interest (ROI)-supervised fine-tuning aligns latent states with clinically relevant image evidence, and Visual-Latent Policy Optimization (VLPO) further optimizes latent reasoning and answer generation under outcome-level rewards. Experiments on OmniMedVQA and five external medical VQA benchmarks show that \textsc{MedLVR} consistently outperforms recent reasoning baselines and improves the average score over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone from 48.3\% to 53.4\%. These results show that latent visual reasoning provides an effective mechanism for preserving diagnostically relevant visual evidence and improving the reliability of medical VQA.

AI.tldr: MedLVR提出了一种潜在视觉推理框架，通过将显式视觉证据状态引入自回归解码，在解码器中插入短潜伏推理段，实现查询相关视觉证据的迭代保留和精炼，从而提升医学视觉问答的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前医学视觉语言模型在视觉问答中主要依赖文本中心推理，图像仅作为静态上下文编码一次，无法可靠保留临床场景中所需的细微局部视觉证据，限制了诊断准确性。
AI.method: 提出MedLVR框架：1) 在解码器中引入显式视觉证据状态，通过重用隐藏状态作为连续潜在步骤，在答案生成前进行迭代视觉证据保留和精炼；2) 采用两阶段训练策略：ROI监督微调使潜在状态与临床相关图像证据对齐，VLPO在结果级奖励下优化潜在推理和答案生成。
AI.result: 在OmniMedVQA和五个外部医学VQA基准测试中，MedLVR持续优于近期推理基线，将Qwen2.5-VL-7B骨干模型的平均得分从48.3%提升至53.4%。
AI.conclusion: 潜在视觉推理为保留诊断相关视觉证据提供了有效机制，显著提高了医学视觉问答的可靠性，解决了传统文本中心推理范式在临床场景中的根本限制。

title: AIM: Intent-Aware Unified world action Modeling with Spatial Value Maps
summary: Pretrained video generation models provide strong priors for robot control, but existing unified world action models still struggle to decode reliable actions without substantial robot-specific training. We attribute this limitation to a structural mismatch: while video models capture how scenes evolve, action generation requires explicit reasoning about where to interact and the underlying manipulation intent. We introduce AIM, an intent-aware unified world action model that bridges this gap via an explicit spatial interface. Instead of decoding actions directly from future visual representations, AIM predicts an aligned spatial value map that encodes task-relevant interaction structure, enabling a control-oriented abstraction of future dynamics. Built on a pretrained video generation model, AIM jointly models future observations and value maps within a shared mixture-of-transformers architecture. It employs intent-causal attention to route future information to the action branch exclusively through the value representation. We further propose a self-distillation reinforcement learning stage that freezes the video and value branches and optimizes only the action head using dense rewards derived from projected value-map responses together with sparse task-level signals. To support training and evaluation, we construct a simulation dataset of 30K manipulation trajectories with synchronized multi-view observations, actions, and value-map annotations. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark show that AIM achieves a 94.0% average success rate, significantly outperforming prior unified world action baselines. Notably, the improvement is more pronounced in long-horizon and contact-sensitive manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicit spatial-intent modeling as a bridge between visual world modeling and robot control.

AI.tldr: AIM是一个意图感知的统一世界动作模型，通过显式空间接口连接视频生成模型和机器人控制，预测对齐的空间价值图来编码任务相关的交互结构，显著提升长视野和接触敏感操作任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一世界动作模型直接从未来视觉表示解码动作，但存在结构不匹配问题：视频模型捕捉场景演化，而动作生成需要显式推理交互位置和操作意图。需要弥合视觉世界建模和机器人控制之间的差距。
AI.method: 1) 基于预训练视频生成模型构建AIM，使用共享的混合变换器架构联合建模未来观测和价值图；2) 采用意图因果注意力机制，通过价值表示将未来信息路由到动作分支；3) 提出自蒸馏强化学习阶段，冻结视频和价值分支，仅使用从投影价值图响应和稀疏任务信号导出的密集奖励优化动作头。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中，AIM达到94.0%的平均成功率，显著优于先前的统一世界动作基线。在长视野和接触敏感操作任务中改进尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 显式空间意图建模作为视觉世界建模和机器人控制之间的桥梁是有效的。AIM通过预测对齐的空间价值图来编码任务相关的交互结构，实现了更可靠的动作生成，特别是在复杂操作任务中。

title: EE-MCP: Self-Evolving MCP-GUI Agents via Automated Environment Generation and Experience Learning
summary: Computer-use agents that combine GUI interaction with structured API calls via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) show promise for automating software tasks. However, existing approaches lack a principled understanding of how agents should balance these two modalities and how to enable iterative self-improvement across diverse applications. We formulate MCP-GUI interplay as a unified hybrid policy learning problem where the agent learns when each modality provides complementary advantages, and show that distillation and experience augmentation target fundamentally different failure modes - requiring application-aware mechanism selection. Built on this formulation, we propose a self-evolving framework with a fully automatic pipeline that orchestrates automatic environment generation and validation, trajectory collection, gap-driven task synthesis, and quality-filtered training - all without manual intervention. A key innovation is our experience bank, which accumulates LLM-learned rules from trajectory comparison, enabling inference-time improvement without fine-tuning. Systematic \textbf{cross-application analysis} across three desktop applications reveals that the optimal strategy depends on MCP-GUI composition: distillation achieves 77.8\% pass rate on MCP-dominant tasks (+17.8pp), while the experience bank excels on GUI-intensive tasks (+10.0pp).

AI.tldr: 提出一个自我演进的框架，通过自动环境生成、轨迹收集和基于经验库的推理时改进，解决MCP-GUI混合策略学习问题，实现跨应用自动化任务的无人工干预优化。
AI.motivation: 现有结合GUI交互和MCP结构化API调用的计算机使用代理缺乏对两种模态平衡原则的理解，以及如何实现跨不同应用的迭代自我改进。
AI.method: 将MCP-GUI交互建模为统一的混合策略学习问题，提出包含自动环境生成与验证、轨迹收集、差距驱动任务合成和质量筛选训练的自我演进框架，核心创新是积累LLM学习规则的经验库。
AI.result: 在三个桌面应用的跨应用分析中，蒸馏方法在MCP主导任务上达到77.8%通过率（+17.8pp），经验库在GUI密集型任务上表现优异（+10.0pp），显示最优策略取决于MCP-GUI组成。
AI.conclusion: MCP-GUI交互需要应用感知的机制选择，蒸馏和经验增强针对不同的失败模式，提出的自我演进框架能够实现无人工干预的跨应用自动化任务优化。

title: Text-Guided 6D Object Pose Rearrangement via Closed-Loop VLM Agents
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong visual reasoning capabilities, yet they still struggle with 3D understanding. In particular, VLMs often fail to infer a text-consistent goal 6D pose of a target object in a 3D scene. However, we find that with some inference-time techniques and iterative reasoning, VLMs can achieve dramatic performance gains. Concretely, given a 3D scene represented by an RGB-D image (or a compositional scene of 3D meshes) and a text instruction specifying a desired state change, we repeat the following loop: observe the current scene; evaluate whether it is faithful to the instruction; propose a pose update for the target object; apply the update; and render the updated scene. Through this closed-loop interaction, the VLM effectively acts as an agent. We further introduce three inference-time techniques that are essential to this closed-loop process: (i) multi-view reasoning with supporting view selection, (ii) object-centered coordinate system visualization, and (iii) single-axis rotation prediction. Without any additional fine-tuning or new modules, our approach surpasses prior methods at predicting the text-guided goal 6D pose of the target object. It works consistently across both closed-source and open-source VLMs. Moreover, when combining our 6D pose prediction with simple robot motion planning, it enables more successful robot manipulation than existing methods. Finally, we conduct an ablation study to demonstrate the necessity of each proposed technique.

AI.tldr: 通过推理时技术和迭代闭环交互，让视觉语言模型在3D场景中预测文本指导的6D目标姿态，无需微调即可超越现有方法并实现机器人操作
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在3D理解方面存在困难，特别是在推断文本一致的6D目标姿态时表现不佳。然而研究发现，通过推理时技术和迭代推理可以显著提升性能。
AI.method: 采用闭环交互循环：观察当前场景→评估是否符合指令→提出目标对象姿态更新→应用更新→渲染更新场景。引入三个关键技术：多视角推理与支持视角选择、对象中心坐标系可视化、单轴旋转预测。
AI.result: 无需额外微调或新模块，该方法在预测文本指导的6D目标姿态方面超越先前方法，在闭源和开源VLM上表现一致。结合简单机器人运动规划，能实现比现有方法更成功的机器人操作。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时技术和迭代闭环交互，视觉语言模型可以作为智能体有效解决3D场景中的6D姿态预测问题，为机器人操作提供了新的解决方案。

title: ViserDex: Visual Sim-to-Real for Robust Dexterous In-hand Reorientation
summary: In-hand object reorientation requires precise estimation of the object pose to handle complex task dynamics. While RGB sensing offers rich semantic cues for pose tracking, existing solutions rely on multi-camera setups or costly ray tracing. We present a sim-to-real framework for monocular RGB in-hand reorientation that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to bridge the visual sim-to-real gap. Our key insight is performing domain randomization in the Gaussian representation space: by applying physically consistent, pre-rendering augmentations to 3D Gaussians, we generate photorealistic, randomized visual data for object pose estimation. The manipulation policy is trained using curriculum-based reinforcement learning with teacher-student distillation, enabling efficient learning of complex behaviors. Importantly, both perception and control models can be trained independently on consumer-grade hardware, eliminating the need for large compute clusters. Experiments show that the pose estimator trained with 3DGS data outperforms those trained using conventional rendering data in challenging visual environments. We validate the system on a physical multi-fingered hand equipped with an RGB camera, demonstrating robust reorientation of five diverse objects even under challenging lighting conditions. Our results highlight Gaussian splatting as a practical path for RGB-only dexterous manipulation. For videos of the hardware deployments and additional supplementary materials, please refer to the project website: https://rffr.leggedrobotics.com/works/viserdex/

AI.tldr: 提出基于3D高斯泼溅的sim-to-real框架，用于单目RGB手内物体重定向，通过高斯表示空间的域随机化生成逼真视觉数据，在消费级硬件上训练感知与控制模型。
AI.motivation: 手内物体重定向需要精确的姿态估计来处理复杂任务动态。虽然RGB感知提供丰富的语义线索，但现有解决方案依赖多摄像头设置或昂贵的射线追踪。
AI.method: 提出sim-to-real框架，集成3D高斯泼溅来弥合视觉sim-to-real差距。核心创新是在高斯表示空间进行域随机化：通过对3D高斯应用物理一致、预渲染增强，生成逼真的随机化视觉数据用于物体姿态估计。使用基于课程的强化学习与师生蒸馏训练操作策略。
AI.result: 使用3DGS数据训练的位姿估计器在挑战性视觉环境中优于传统渲染数据训练的模型。在配备RGB摄像头的物理多指手上验证系统，在挑战性光照条件下成功重定向五个不同物体。
AI.conclusion: 高斯泼溅为RGB-only灵巧操作提供了实用路径，感知和控制模型可在消费级硬件上独立训练，无需大型计算集群。

title: COMPOSITE-Stem
summary: AI agents hold growing promise for accelerating scientific discovery; yet, a lack of frontier evaluations hinders adoption into real workflows. Expert-written benchmarks have proven effective at measuring AI reasoning, but most at this stage have become saturated and only measure performance on constrained outputs. To help address this gap, we introduce COMPOSITE-STEM, a benchmark of 70 expert-written tasks in physics, biology, chemistry, and mathematics, curated by doctoral-level researchers. Our benchmark combines exact-match grading and criterion-based rubrics with an LLM-as-a-jury grading protocol, allowing more flexible assessment of scientifically meaningful outputs. Using an adapted multimodal Terminus-2 agent harness within the Harbor agentic evaluation framework, we evaluate four frontier models. The top-performing model achieves 21%, demonstrating that COMPOSITE-STEM captures capabilities beyond current agent reach. All tasks are open-sourced with contributor permission to support reproducibility and to promote additional research towards AI's acceleration of scientific progress in these domains.

AI.tldr: COMPOSITE-STEM是一个由博士级研究人员设计的70个STEM领域专家任务基准，结合精确匹配和基于标准的评估，用于衡量AI在科学发现中的能力，当前最佳模型仅达到21%准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理在加速科学发现方面潜力巨大，但缺乏前沿评估阻碍了实际工作流程的采用。现有的专家编写基准大多已经饱和，且仅能测量受限输出的性能，需要更灵活的评估方法来衡量科学意义输出。
AI.method: 创建了包含物理、生物、化学和数学的70个专家编写任务基准；结合精确匹配评分和基于标准的评分标准；采用LLM作为评审的评分协议；在Harbor代理评估框架中使用改进的多模态Terminus-2代理来评估四个前沿模型。
AI.result: 最佳性能模型仅达到21%的准确率，表明COMPOSITE-STEM基准捕获了超出当前AI代理能力范围的能力，证明了该基准的挑战性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: COMPOSITE-STEM基准通过开放所有任务支持可重复性，促进了AI在这些领域加速科学进步的研究，为衡量AI在科学发现中的能力提供了更全面和灵活的评估框架。

title: Biomarker-Based Pretraining for Chagas Disease Screening in Electrocardiograms
summary: Chagas disease screening via ECGs is limited by scarce and noisy labels in existing datasets. We propose a biomarker-based pretraining approach, where an ECG feature extractor is first trained to predict percentile-binned blood biomarkers from the MIMIC-IV-ECG dataset. The pretrained model is then fine-tuned on Brazilian datasets for Chagas detection. Our 5-model ensemble, developed by the Ahus AIM team, achieved a challenge score of 0.269 on the hidden test set, ranking 5th in Detection of Chagas Disease from the ECG: The George B. Moody PhysioNet Challenge 2025. Source code and the model are shared on GitHub: github.com/Ahus-AIM/physionet-challenge-2025

AI.tldr: 提出基于生物标志物的预训练方法，通过ECG预测血液生物标志物，然后微调用于恰加斯病检测，在PhysioNet挑战赛中排名第5
AI.motivation: 恰加斯病ECG筛查面临现有数据集标签稀缺且噪声大的问题，需要更有效的特征提取方法
AI.method: 采用生物标志物预训练方法：首先在MIMIC-IV-ECG数据集上训练ECG特征提取器预测百分位分箱的血液生物标志物，然后在巴西数据集上微调用于恰加斯病检测
AI.result: 5模型集成在隐藏测试集上获得0.269的挑战分数，在PhysioNet 2025挑战赛中排名第5
AI.conclusion: 生物标志物预训练方法能有效提升ECG特征提取能力，有助于解决恰加斯病筛查中的标签稀缺问题

title: EmbodiedGovBench: A Benchmark for Governance, Recovery, and Upgrade Safety in Embodied Agent Systems
summary: Recent progress in embodied AI has produced a growing ecosystem of robot policies, foundation models, and modular runtimes. However, current evaluation remains dominated by task success metrics such as completion rate or manipulation accuracy. These metrics leave a critical gap: they do not measure whether embodied systems are governable -- whether they respect capability boundaries, enforce policies, recover safely, maintain audit trails, and respond to human oversight. We present EmbodiedGovBench, a benchmark for governance-oriented evaluation of embodied agent systems. Rather than asking only whether a robot can complete a task, EmbodiedGovBench evaluates whether the system remains controllable, policy-bounded, recoverable, auditable, and evolution-safe under realistic perturbations. The benchmark covers seven governance dimensions: unauthorized capability invocation, runtime drift robustness, recovery success, policy portability, version upgrade safety, human override responsiveness, and audit completeness. We define a benchmark structure spanning single-robot and fleet settings, with scenario templates, perturbation operators, governance metrics, and baseline evaluation protocols. We describe how the benchmark can be instantiated over embodied capability runtimes with modular interfaces and contract-aware upgrade workflows. Our analysis suggests that embodied governance should become a first-class evaluation target. EmbodiedGovBench provides the initial measurement framework for that shift.

AI.tldr: 提出了EmbodiedGovBench基准，用于评估具身AI系统的可治理性，包括可控性、策略边界、可恢复性、可审计性和演进安全性等七个维度，而不仅仅是任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前具身AI评估主要关注任务成功率（如完成率、操作精度），但缺乏对系统可治理性的评估。可治理性包括系统是否尊重能力边界、执行策略、安全恢复、维护审计跟踪和响应人类监督等关键方面。
AI.method: 设计了一个基准框架，涵盖七个治理维度：未经授权能力调用、运行时漂移鲁棒性、恢复成功率、策略可移植性、版本升级安全性、人类覆盖响应性和审计完整性。基准结构包括单机器人和多机器人场景、场景模板、扰动算子、治理度量和基线评估协议。
AI.result: 提出了EmbodiedGovBench基准框架，该框架可以在具身能力运行时上实例化，支持模块化接口和合约感知的升级工作流。分析表明具身治理应成为首要评估目标。
AI.conclusion: 具身治理应成为具身AI系统的一级评估目标，EmbodiedGovBench为这一转变提供了初始的测量框架，填补了当前评估中关于系统可治理性的关键空白。

title: Steered LLM Activations are Non-Surjective
comment: 10 pages main text. ICLR 2026 Workshops (Sci4DL, Re-Align)
summary: Activation steering is a popular white-box control technique that modifies model activations to elicit an abstract change in output behavior. It has also become a standard tool in interpretability (e.g., probing truthfulness, or translating activations into human-readable explanations and safety research (e.g., studying jailbreakability). However, it is unclear whether steered activation states are realizable by any textual prompt. In this work, we cast this question as a surjectivity problem: for a fixed model, does every steered activation admit a pre-image under the model's natural forward pass? Under practical assumptions, we prove that activation steering pushes the residual stream off the manifold of states reachable from discrete prompts. Almost surely, no prompt can reproduce the same internal behavior induced by steering. We also illustrate this finding empirically across three widely used LLMs. Our results establish a formal separation between white-box steerability and black-box prompting. We therefore caution against interpreting the ease and success of activation steering as evidence of prompt-based interpretability or vulnerability, and argue for evaluation protocols that explicitly decouple white-box and black-box interventions.

AI.tldr: 激活导向技术修改模型激活以改变输出行为，但研究发现导向后的激活状态无法通过任何文本提示实现，表明白盒可导向性与黑盒提示之间存在形式化分离。
AI.motivation: 激活导向已成为解释性和安全研究的流行技术，但尚不清楚导向后的激活状态是否可以通过任何文本提示实现。本研究旨在探讨导向激活是否具有文本提示的前像，即是否存在能产生相同内部行为的提示。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为满射性问题：对于固定模型，每个导向激活是否在模型自然前向传递下存在前像？在实用假设下，证明激活导向会将残差流推离离散提示可达的状态流形。通过三个广泛使用的LLM进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明激活导向几乎必然使残差流偏离提示可达流形，实证上验证了三个主流LLM中导向激活无法通过任何文本提示复现。建立了白盒可导向性与黑盒提示之间的形式化分离。
AI.conclusion: 激活导向的成功不应被解释为提示可解释性或漏洞的证据。研究建议评估协议应明确解耦白盒和黑盒干预，并警示不要将激活导向的便捷性和成功过度推广到提示能力上。

title: RobustMedSAM: Degradation-Resilient Medical Image Segmentation via Robust Foundation Model Adaptation
summary: Medical image segmentation models built on Segment Anything Model (SAM) achieve strong performance on clean benchmarks, yet their reliability often degrades under realistic image corruptions such as noise, blur, motion artifacts, and modality-specific distortions. Existing approaches address either medical-domain adaptation or corruption robustness, but not both jointly. In SAM, we find that these capabilities are concentrated in complementary modules: the image encoder preserves medical priors, while the mask decoder governs corruption robustness. Motivated by this observation, we propose RobustMedSAM, which adopts module-wise checkpoint fusion by initializing the image encoder from MedSAM and the mask decoder from RobustSAM under a shared ViT-B architecture. We then fine-tune only the mask decoder on 35 medical datasets from MedSegBench, spanning six imaging modalities and 12 corruption types, while freezing the remaining components to preserve pretrained medical representations. We additionally investigate an SVD-based parameter-efficient variant for limited encoder adaptation. Experiments on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks show that RobustMedSAM improves degraded-image Dice from 0.613 to 0.719 (+0.106) over SAM, demonstrating that structured fusion of complementary pretrained models is an effective and practical approach for robust medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: RobustMedSAM通过融合MedSAM的图像编码器和RobustSAM的掩码解码器，并仅微调解码器，实现了在医学图像分割中同时具备领域适应性和抗干扰鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么关注医学领域适应，要么关注抗干扰鲁棒性，但未能同时解决这两个问题。研究发现SAM中这两个能力分别集中在图像编码器（医学先验）和掩码解码器（抗干扰鲁棒性）中，因此需要一种能同时具备这两种能力的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出RobustMedSAM，采用模块级检查点融合：从MedSAM初始化图像编码器，从RobustSAM初始化掩码解码器（共享ViT-B架构）。然后仅微调掩码解码器，在MedSegBench的35个医学数据集上进行训练，涵盖6种成像模态和12种干扰类型，同时冻结其他组件以保留预训练的医学表示。还研究了基于SVD的参数高效变体用于有限的编码器适应。
AI.result: 在分布内和分布外基准测试中，RobustMedSAM将退化图像的Dice分数从0.613提升到0.719（+0.106），显著优于SAM。实验表明，融合互补预训练模型的结构化方法是实现鲁棒医学图像分割的有效实用方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化融合互补的预训练模型（MedSAM的图像编码器和RobustSAM的掩码解码器），并仅微调解码器，可以同时实现医学领域适应性和抗干扰鲁棒性，为鲁棒医学图像分割提供了一种有效实用的解决方案。

title: CLAW: Composable Language-Annotated Whole-body Motion Generation
summary: Training language-conditioned whole-body controllers for humanoid robots requires large-scale datasets pairing motion trajectories with natural-language descriptions.Existing approaches based on motion capture are costly and limited in diversity, while text-to-motion generative models produce purely kinematic outputs that are not guaranteed to be physically feasible.Therefore, we present CLAW, an interactive web-based pipeline for scalable generation of language-annotated whole-body motion data for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot. CLAW treats the motion modes of a kinematic planner as composable building blocks, each parameterized by movement, heading, speed, pelvis height and duration, and provides two browser-based interfaces -- a real-time keyboard mode and a timeline-based sequence editor -- for exploratory and batch data collection. A low-level whole-body controller tracks the planner's kinematic references in MuJoCo simulation, producing physically grounded trajectories recorded at 50Hz. Simultaneously, a deterministic template-based annotation engine generates diverse natural-language descriptions at multiple stylistic registers for every segment and for the full trajectory. We release the system as open source to support scalable generation of language-motion paired data for humanoid robot learning.

AI.tldr: CLAW：基于网页的交互式流水线，用于为Unitree G1人形机器人生成语言标注的全身运动数据，支持大规模数据收集。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两个问题：1）基于动作捕捉的方法成本高且多样性有限；2）文本到运动生成模型只产生运动学输出，不保证物理可行性。需要一种可扩展的方法来生成语言标注的物理可行运动数据。
AI.method: CLAW将运动规划器的运动模式视为可组合的构建模块，提供两种基于浏览器的界面（实时键盘模式和基于时间线的序列编辑器），通过底层全身控制器在MuJoCo仿真中跟踪运动学参考，同时使用确定性模板的标注引擎生成多样化的自然语言描述。
AI.result: 开发了一个开源系统，能够以50Hz的频率记录物理可行的运动轨迹，并为每个片段和完整轨迹生成多种风格的自然语言描述，支持人形机器人学习的大规模语言-运动配对数据生成。
AI.conclusion: CLAW提供了一个可扩展的解决方案，用于生成语言标注的全身运动数据，解决了现有方法的局限性，并开源支持人形机器人学习社区的发展。

title: MEMENTO: Teaching LLMs to Manage Their Own Context
summary: Reasoning models think in long, unstructured streams with no mechanism for compressing or organizing their own intermediate state. We introduce MEMENTO: a method that teaches models to segment reasoning into blocks, compress each block into a memento, i.e., a dense state summary, and reason forward by attending only to mementos, reducing context, KV cache, and compute. To train MEMENTO models, we release OpenMementos, a public dataset of 228K reasoning traces derived from OpenThoughts-v3, segmented and annotated with intermediate summaries. We show that a two-stage SFT recipe on OpenMementos is effective across different model families (Qwen3, Phi-4, Olmo 3) and scales (8B--32B parameters). Trained models maintain strong accuracy on math, science, and coding benchmarks while achieving ${\sim}2.5\times$ peak KV cache reduction. We extend vLLM to support our inference method, achieving ${\sim}1.75\times$ throughput improvement while also enabling us to perform RL and further improve accuracy. Finally, we identify a dual information stream: information from each reasoning block is carried both by the memento text and by the corresponding KV states, which retain implicit information from the original block. Removing this channel drops accuracy by 15\,pp on AIME24.

AI.tldr: MEMENTO是一种让推理模型将推理过程分段、压缩为memento（密集状态摘要）的方法，通过仅关注memento来减少上下文、KV缓存和计算，同时保持推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型在长推理过程中缺乏压缩和组织中间状态的机制，导致上下文过长、KV缓存占用大、计算效率低。
AI.method: 1) 提出MEMENTO方法：教导模型将推理分段，每段压缩为memento（密集状态摘要），后续推理仅关注memento；2) 发布OpenMementos数据集（228K推理轨迹）；3) 采用两阶段SFT训练；4) 扩展vLLM支持该推理方法。
AI.result: 1) 在多种模型家族（Qwen3, Phi-4, Olmo 3）和规模（8B-32B）上有效；2) 保持数学、科学、编程基准的强准确性；3) 实现约2.5倍峰值KV缓存减少；4) 约1.75倍吞吐量提升；5) 发现双信息流现象：memento文本和对应KV状态都携带信息。
AI.conclusion: MEMENTO方法能有效压缩推理状态、提升效率，同时保持准确性，为高效推理模型提供了新方向，并揭示了推理过程中的双信息流特性。

title: ACCIDENT: A Benchmark Dataset for Vehicle Accident Detection from Traffic Surveillance Videos
summary: We introduce ACCIDENT, a benchmark dataset for traffic accident detection in CCTV footage, designed to evaluate models in supervised (IID and OOD) and zero-shot settings, reflecting both data-rich and data-scarce scenarios. The benchmark consists of a curated set of 2,027 real and 2,211 synthetic clips annotated with the accident time, spatial location, and high-level collision type. We define three core tasks: (i) temporal localization of the accident, (ii) its spatial localization, and (iii) collision type classification. Each task is evaluated using custom metrics that account for the uncertainty and ambiguity inherent in CCTV footage. In addition to the benchmark, we provide a diverse set of baselines, including heuristic, motion-aware, and vision-language approaches, and show that ACCIDENT is challenging. You can access the ACCIDENT at: https://accidentbench.github.io

AI.tldr: ACCIDENT是一个用于CCTV监控视频中交通事故检测的基准数据集，包含真实和合成视频片段，支持监督学习和零样本评估，包含时间定位、空间定位和碰撞类型分类三个任务。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏专门针对CCTV监控视频中交通事故检测的综合性基准数据集，特别是在数据丰富和数据稀缺场景下的评估。需要能够反映实际监控视频中不确定性和模糊性的评估指标。
AI.method: 构建包含2,027个真实视频片段和2,211个合成视频片段的基准数据集，标注事故时间、空间位置和碰撞类型。定义三个核心任务并设计考虑不确定性和模糊性的定制评估指标。提供多种基线方法包括启发式、运动感知和视觉语言方法。
AI.result: 创建了ACCIDENT基准数据集，包含4,238个标注视频片段。实验表明该基准具有挑战性，现有方法在各项任务上表现有限，特别是在零样本设置下。
AI.conclusion: ACCIDENT为交通事故检测研究提供了全面的评估框架，特别关注实际应用中的不确定性和数据稀缺问题。该基准具有挑战性，为未来研究提供了重要方向。

title: Modeling, Analysis and Activation of Planar Viscoelastically-combined Rimless Wheels
comment: This is a corrected version of the IROS 2022 paper. A typographical error in Eq. (14) has been corrected
summary: This paper proposes novel passive-dynamic walkers formed by two cross-shaped frames and eight viscoelastic elements. Since it is a combination of two four-legged rimless wheels via viscoelastic elements, we call it viscoelastically-combined rimless wheel (VCRW). Two types of VCRWs consisting of different cross-shaped frames are introduced; one is formed by combining two Greek-cross-shaped frames (VCRW1), and the other is formed by combining two-link cross-shaped frames that can rotate freely around the central axis (VCRW2). First, we describe the model assumptions and equations of motion and collision. Second, we numerically analyze the basic gait properties of passive dynamic walking. Furthermore, we consider an activation of VCRW2 for generating a stable level gait, and discuss the significance of the study as a novel walking support device.

AI.tldr: 提出两种新型被动动力步行器VCRW1和VCRW2，通过粘弹性元件连接两个十字形框架，分析其步态特性并探讨作为步行辅助设备的潜力。
AI.motivation: 开发新型被动动力步行器，通过粘弹性元件组合两个四足无轮轮，创造更自然的步行机制，为步行辅助设备提供新思路。
AI.method: 提出两种VCRW设计：VCRW1由两个希腊十字形框架组成，VCRW2由可绕中心轴自由旋转的两连杆十字形框架组成。建立运动方程和碰撞模型，进行数值分析研究被动动力步行特性。
AI.result: 数值分析了被动动力步行的基本步态特性，激活VCRW2可产生稳定的水平步态，验证了该设计作为新型步行支持设备的可行性。
AI.conclusion: VCRW设计为被动动力步行器提供了新方案，特别是VCRW2通过激活可实现稳定水平步态，具有作为步行辅助设备的应用潜力。

title: Instructing LLMs to Negotiate using Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: The recent advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has established their potential as autonomous interactive agents. However, they often struggle in strategic games of incomplete information, such as bilateral price negotiation. In this paper, we investigate if Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) can effectively teach LLMs to negotiate. Specifically, we explore the strategic behaviors that emerge during the learning process. We introduce a framework that trains a mid-sized buyer agent against a regulated LLM seller across a wide distribution of real-world products. By grounding reward signals directly in the maximization of economic surplus and strict adherence to private budget constraints, we reveal a novel four-phase strategic evolution. The agent progresses from naive bargaining to using aggressive starting prices, moves through a phase of deadlock, and ultimately develops sophisticated persuasive skills. Our results demonstrate that this verifiable training allows a 30B agent to significantly outperform frontier models over ten times its size in extracting surplus. Furthermore, the trained agent generalizes robustly to stronger counterparties unseen during training and remains effective even when facing hostile, adversarial seller personas.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体通过可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在双边价格谈判中学习到四阶段战略演化，最终30B参数模型在获取经济剩余方面显著超越大十倍的前沿模型，并展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型作为自主交互智能体在战略博弈中表现不佳，特别是在不完全信息场景如双边价格谈判中。研究者希望探索通过可验证奖励的强化学习能否有效教授LLMs谈判技能，并研究学习过程中涌现的战略行为。
AI.method: 提出一个训练框架，让中等规模的买家智能体与受监管的LLM卖家在广泛分布的真实世界产品上进行谈判。通过将奖励信号直接基于经济剩余最大化和严格遵守私有预算约束，实现可验证的强化学习训练。
AI.result: 训练过程中观察到新颖的四阶段战略演化：从天真议价到使用激进起始价格，经历僵局阶段，最终发展出复杂的说服技能。30B参数的智能体在提取经济剩余方面显著超越大十倍的前沿模型，并能泛化到训练中未见过的更强对手，甚至在面对敌对、对抗性卖家角色时仍保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励强化学习能有效教授LLMs在不完全信息战略博弈中的谈判技能，使较小模型在特定任务上超越更大模型，并展现出强大的泛化能力和战略适应性。

title: F3G-Avatar : Face Focused Full-body Gaussian Avatar
summary: Existing full-body Gaussian avatar methods primarily optimize global reconstruction quality and often fail to preserve fine-grained facial geometry and expression details. This challenge arises from limited facial representational capacity that causes difficulties in modeling high-frequency pose-dependent deformations. To address this, we propose F3G-Avatar, a full-body, face-aware avatar synthesis method that reconstructs animatable human representations from multi-view RGB video and regressed pose/shape parameters. Starting from a clothed Momentum Human Rig (MHR) template, front/back positional maps are rendered and decoded into 3D Gaussians through a two-branch architecture: a body branch that captures pose-dependent non-rigid deformations and a face-focused deformation branch that refines head geometry and appearance. The predicted Gaussians are fused, posed with linear blend skinning (LBS), and rendered with differentiable Gaussian splatting. Training combines reconstruction and perceptual objectives with a face-specific adversarial loss to enhance realism in close-up views. Experiments demonstrate strong rendering quality, with face-view performance reaching PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS of 26.243/0.964/0.084 on the AvatarReX dataset. Ablations further highlight contributions of the MHR template and the face-focused deformation. F3G-Avatar provides a practical, high-quality pipeline for realistic, animatable full-body avatar synthesis.

AI.tldr: F3G-Avatar：一种面向全身、关注面部细节的3D高斯化身合成方法，通过双分支架构分别处理身体和面部变形，显著提升了面部几何和表情细节的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有全身高斯化身方法主要优化全局重建质量，但难以保留细粒度的面部几何和表情细节。这源于有限的面部表示能力，导致难以建模高频姿态相关变形。
AI.method: 从穿着服装的MHR模板开始，渲染前后位置图，通过双分支架构解码为3D高斯：身体分支捕捉姿态相关的非刚性变形，面部变形分支细化头部几何和外观。预测的高斯通过线性混合蒙皮进行姿态调整，并使用可微分高斯泼溅渲染。训练结合重建和感知目标，并加入面部特定的对抗损失以增强近景真实感。
AI.result: 在AvatarReX数据集上，面部视角性能达到PSNR 26.243/SSIM 0.964/LPIPS 0.084。消融实验进一步验证了MHR模板和面部变形分支的贡献。
AI.conclusion: F3G-Avatar提供了一个实用、高质量的管道，用于实现逼真、可动画的全身化身合成，特别在面部细节保真度方面表现出色。

title: 3D-Anchored Lookahead Planning for Persistent Robotic Scene Memory via World-Model-Based MCTS
summary: We present 3D-Anchored Lookahead Planning (3D-ALP), a System 2 reasoning engine for robotic manipulation that combines Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with a 3D-consistent world model as the rollout oracle. Unlike reactive policies that evaluate actions from the current camera frame only, 3D-ALP maintains a persistent camera-to-world (c2w) anchor that survives occlusion, enabling accurate replanning to object positions that are no longer directly observable. On a 5-step sequential reach task requiring spatial memory (Experiment E3), 3D-ALP achieves 0.650 0.109 success rate on memory-required steps versus 0.006 0.008 for a greedy reactive baseline (Δ=+0.645), while step 5 success reaches 0.822 against 0.000 for greedy. An ablation study (30 episodes, 3 seeds) isolates tree search spatial memory as the primary driver (+0.533, 82% of gain) with additional benefit from deeper lookahead (+0.111, 17%). We also identify and resolve four structural failure modes in applying UCT-MCTS (Upper Confidence Bounds applied to Trees [10]) to continuous robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 3D-ALP是一种用于机器人操作的System 2推理引擎，结合MCTS和3D一致世界模型，通过持久相机-世界锚点解决遮挡问题，在需要空间记忆的序列任务中显著优于反应式基线。
AI.motivation: 现有反应式策略仅从当前相机帧评估动作，无法处理遮挡情况下的空间记忆需求。需要一种能够维持持久3D表示并支持长期规划的推理系统。
AI.method: 结合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与3D一致世界模型作为rollout oracle，维护持久的相机到世界（c2w）锚点，即使在遮挡情况下也能准确重新规划到不可直接观察的物体位置。
AI.result: 在需要空间记忆的5步序列到达任务中，3D-ALP在需要记忆的步骤上达到0.650成功率，而贪婪反应式基线仅为0.006。树搜索空间记忆是主要性能提升因素（+0.533，占82%增益），更深的前瞻提供额外收益（+0.111，17%）。
AI.conclusion: 3D-ALP通过结合MCTS和持久3D表示，有效解决了机器人操作中的空间记忆和长期规划问题，识别并解决了UCT-MCTS在连续机器人操作中的四个结构失效模式。

title: Evolutionary Token-Level Prompt Optimization for Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models exhibit strong generative performance but remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation, often requiring extensive manual trial and error to obtain satisfactory results. This motivates the development of automated, model-agnostic prompt optimization methods that can systematically explore the conditioning space beyond conventional text rewriting. This work investigates the use of a Genetic Algorithm (GA) for prompt optimization by directly evolving the token vectors employed by CLIP-based diffusion models. The GA optimizes a fitness function that combines aesthetic quality, measured by the LAION Aesthetic Predictor V2, with prompt-image alignment, assessed via CLIPScore. Experiments on 36 prompts from the Parti Prompts (P2) dataset show that the proposed approach outperforms the baseline methods, including Promptist and random search, achieving up to a 23.93% improvement in fitness. Overall, the method is adaptable to image generation models with tokenized text encoders and provides a modular framework for future extensions, the limitations and prospects of which are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出使用遗传算法直接优化CLIP文本编码器的token向量，以提升扩散模型的提示效果，相比基线方法获得最高23.93%的改进。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型对提示词表述高度敏感，需要大量人工试错才能获得满意结果，这促使开发自动化的、模型无关的提示优化方法。
AI.method: 使用遗传算法直接进化CLIP-based扩散模型使用的token向量，优化结合美学质量（LAION Aesthetic Predictor V2）和提示-图像对齐（CLIPScore）的适应度函数。
AI.result: 在Parti Prompts数据集的36个提示上进行实验，该方法优于Promptist和随机搜索等基线方法，实现了最高23.93%的适应度提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于具有token化文本编码器的图像生成模型，提供了一个可扩展的模块化框架，并讨论了其局限性和未来前景。

title: Vector Field Synthesis with Sparse Streamlines Using Diffusion Model
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures; published at IEEE VIS 2025
summary: We present a novel diffusion-based framework for synthesizing 2D vector fields from sparse, coherent inputs (i.e., streamlines) while maintaining physical plausibility. Our method employs a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model with classifier-free guidance, enabling progressive reconstruction that preserves both geometric and physical constraints. Experimental results demonstrate our method's ability to synthesize plausible vector fields that adhere to physical laws while maintaining fidelity to sparse input observations, outperforming traditional optimization-based approaches in terms of flexibility and physical consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的2D矢量场合成框架，从稀疏流线输入生成物理合理的矢量场
AI.motivation: 传统优化方法在从稀疏流线输入合成矢量场时，难以同时保持几何约束和物理一致性，需要更灵活且物理合理的方法
AI.method: 使用条件去噪扩散概率模型，结合无分类器引导，实现渐进式重建，同时保持几何和物理约束
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能合成符合物理定律的合理矢量场，在灵活性和物理一致性方面优于传统优化方法
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型框架能有效从稀疏流线输入合成物理合理的矢量场，为矢量场合成提供了新方法

title: Learning to Forget -- Hierarchical Episodic Memory for Lifelong Robot Deployment
summary: Robots must verbalize their past experiences when users ask "Where did you put my keys?" or "Why did the task fail?" Yet maintaining life-long episodic memory (EM) from continuous multimodal perception quickly exceeds storage limits and makes real-time query impractical, calling for selective forgetting that adapts to users' notions of relevance. We present H$^2$-EMV, a framework enabling humanoids to learn what to remember through user interaction. Our approach incrementally constructs hierarchical EM, selectively forgets using language-model-based relevance estimation conditioned on learned natural-language rules, and updates these rules given user feedback about forgotten details. Evaluations on simulated household tasks and 20.5-hour-long real-world recordings from ARMAR-7 demonstrate that H$^2$-EMV maintains question-answering accuracy while reducing memory size by 45% and query-time compute by 35%. Critically, performance improves over time - accuracy increases 70% in second-round queries by adapting to user-specific priorities - demonstrating that learned forgetting enables scalable, personalized EM for long-term human-robot collaboration.

AI.tldr: H²-EMV框架让机器人通过用户交互学习选择性记忆，构建分层情景记忆，基于语言模型估计相关性进行选择性遗忘，并通过用户反馈更新遗忘规则，实现可扩展的个性化记忆管理。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要长期存储多模态感知数据来回答用户关于过去经历的问题，但完整的情景记忆会迅速超出存储限制且查询效率低下，需要根据用户相关性的选择性遗忘机制。
AI.method: 采用增量构建分层情景记忆，基于语言模型估计相关性进行选择性遗忘，通过用户反馈学习自然语言规则来更新遗忘策略，实现自适应记忆管理。
AI.result: 在模拟家庭任务和20.5小时真实世界记录上，H²-EMV在保持问答准确性的同时，将内存大小减少45%，查询计算时间减少35%，第二轮查询准确率提升70%。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习选择性遗忘，H²-EMV实现了可扩展、个性化的情景记忆系统，能够适应特定用户的优先级，支持长期人机协作。

title: What do your logits know? (The answer may surprise you!)
summary: Recent work has shown that probing model internals can reveal a wealth of information not apparent from the model generations. This poses the risk of unintentional or malicious information leakage, where model users are able to learn information that the model owner assumed was inaccessible. Using vision-language models as a testbed, we present the first systematic comparison of information retained at different "representational levels'' as it is compressed from the rich information encoded in the residual stream through two natural bottlenecks: low-dimensional projections of the residual stream obtained using tuned lens, and the final top-k logits most likely to impact model's answer. We show that even easily accessible bottlenecks defined by the model's top logit values can leak task-irrelevant information present in an image-based query, in some cases revealing as much information as direct projections of the full residual stream.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，即使通过模型top logits等可访问瓶颈，视觉语言模型仍会泄露图像查询中的任务无关信息，信息泄露程度有时接近完整残差流的直接投影。
AI.motivation: 最近研究表明，探测模型内部状态可以揭示大量从模型生成中不明显的信息，这带来了无意或恶意信息泄露的风险。模型用户可能学到模型所有者认为不可访问的信息。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型作为测试平台，首次系统比较不同"表示层次"保留的信息：从残差流中的丰富信息，通过两个自然瓶颈进行压缩：1) 使用tuned lens获得的残差流低维投影，2) 最可能影响模型答案的最终top-k logits。
AI.result: 即使通过模型top logit值定义的易于访问的瓶颈，也会泄露图像查询中的任务无关信息，在某些情况下揭示的信息量与完整残差流的直接投影相当。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部信息泄露风险不仅存在于深层表示中，即使通过看似简单的输出瓶颈（如top logits）也可能发生，这对模型隐私保护提出了新的挑战。

title: Is There Knowledge Left to Extract? Evidence of Fragility in Medically Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adapted through domain-specific fine-tuning, yet it remains unclear whether this improves reasoning beyond superficial visual cues, particularly in high-stakes domains like medicine. We evaluate four paired open-source VLMs (LLaVA vs. LLaVA-Med; Gemma vs. MedGemma) across four medical imaging tasks of increasing difficulty: brain tumor, pneumonia, skin cancer, and histopathology classification. We find that performance degrades toward near-random levels as task difficulty increases, indicating limited clinical reasoning. Medical fine-tuning provides no consistent advantage, and models are highly sensitive to prompt formulation, with minor changes causing large swings in accuracy and refusal rates. To test whether closed-form VQA suppresses latent knowledge, we introduce a description-based pipeline where models generate image descriptions that a text-only model (GPT-5.1) uses for diagnosis. This recovers a limited additional signal but remains bounded by task difficulty. Analysis of vision encoder embeddings further shows that failures stem from both weak visual representations and downstream reasoning. Overall, medical VLM performance is fragile, prompt-dependent, and not reliably improved by domain-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 医学视觉语言模型在复杂医疗任务中表现脆弱，性能随难度增加而下降，医学微调无一致优势，模型对提示词高度敏感
AI.motivation: 评估视觉语言模型在医疗领域是否真正具备临床推理能力，而非仅依赖表面视觉线索，特别是在高风险医疗场景中
AI.method: 评估四对开源VLM（LLaVA vs. LLaVA-Med; Gemma vs. MedGemma）在四个难度递增的医学影像任务上；引入基于描述的诊断流程，让模型生成图像描述，再由纯文本模型进行诊断；分析视觉编码器嵌入
AI.result: 性能随任务难度增加而下降至接近随机水平；医学微调无一致优势；模型对提示词高度敏感，微小变化导致准确率和拒绝率大幅波动；基于描述的流程能恢复有限额外信号但仍受限于任务难度；失败源于视觉表示和下游推理双重问题
AI.conclusion: 医学VLM性能脆弱、依赖提示词，且无法通过领域特定微调可靠改进，表明当前模型在复杂医疗任务中缺乏真正的临床推理能力

title: CLASP: Closed-loop Asynchronous Spatial Perception for Open-vocabulary Desktop Object Grasping
