summary: Robot grasping of desktop object is widely used in intelligent manufacturing, logistics, and agriculture.Although vision-language models (VLMs) show strong potential for robotic manipulation, their deployment in low-level grasping faces key challenges: scarce high-quality multimodal demonstrations, spatial hallucination caused by weak geometric grounding, and the fragility of open-loop execution in dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose Closed-Loop Asynchronous Spatial Perception(CLASP), a novel asynchronous closed-loop framework that integrates multimodal perception, logical reasoning, and state-reflective feedback. First, we design a Dual-Pathway Hierarchical Perception module that decouples high-level semantic intent from geometric grounding. The design guides the output of the inference model and the definite action tuples, reducing spatial illusions. Second, an Asynchronous Closed-Loop Evaluator is implemented to compare pre- and post-execution states, providing text-based diagnostic feedback to establish a robust error-correction loop and improving the vulnerability of traditional open-loop execution in dynamic environments. Finally, we design a scalable multi-modal data engine that automatically synthesizes high-quality spatial annotations and reasoning templates from real and synthetic scenes without human teleoperation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an 87.0% overall success rate. Notably, the proposed framework exhibits remarkable generalization across diverse objects, bridging the sim-to-real gap and providing exceptional robustness in geometrically challenging categories and cluttered scenarios.

AI.tldr: CLASP是一个用于机器人桌面抓取的异步闭环框架，通过解耦语义意图与几何感知、建立状态反馈循环、以及自动生成多模态数据，显著提升了抓取成功率至87.0%，并展现出优秀的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在机器人低级抓取任务中存在三个关键挑战：1）高质量多模态演示数据稀缺；2）几何基础薄弱导致空间幻觉；3）开环执行在动态环境中脆弱。需要解决这些限制以实现可靠的机器人抓取。
AI.method: 提出CLASP框架，包含三个核心组件：1）双路径分层感知模块，解耦高层语义意图与几何基础；2）异步闭环评估器，比较执行前后状态并提供文本诊断反馈；3）可扩展多模态数据引擎，自动合成高质量空间标注和推理模板。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著优于现有基线，达到87.0%的整体成功率。框架展现出卓越的泛化能力，能够跨越不同物体、弥合仿真到现实的差距，在几何挑战性类别和杂乱场景中表现出优异的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CLASP通过解耦感知、建立闭环反馈和自动数据生成，有效解决了VLM在机器人抓取中的关键挑战，为可靠的低级抓取操作提供了创新解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: In-situ process monitoring for defect detection in wire-arc additive manufacturing: an agentic AI approach
summary: AI agents are being increasingly deployed across a wide range of real-world applications. In this paper, we propose an agentic AI framework for in-situ process monitoring for defect detection in wire-arc additive manufacturing (WAAM). The autonomous agent leverages a WAAM process monitoring dataset and a trained classification tool to build AI agents and uses a large language model (LLM) for in-situ process monitoring decision-making for defect detection. A processing agent is developed based on welder process signals, such as current and voltage, and a monitoring agent is developed based on acoustic data collected during the process. Both agents are tasked with identifying porosity defects from processing and monitoring signals, respectively. Ground truth X-ray computed tomography (XCT) data are used to develop classification tools for both the processing and monitoring agents. Furthermore, a multi-agent framework is demonstrated in which the processing and monitoring agents are orchestrated together for parallel decision-making on the given task of defect classification. Evaluation metrics are proposed to determine the efficacy of both individual agents, the combined single-agent, and the coordinated multi-agent system. The multi-agent configuration outperforms all individual-agent counterparts, achieving a decision accuracy of 91.6% and an F1 score of 0.821 on decided runs, across 15 independent runs, and a reasoning quality score of 3.74 out of 5. These in-situ process monitoring agents hold significant potential for autonomous real-time process monitoring and control toward building qualified parts for WAAM and other additive manufacturing processes.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于线弧增材制造缺陷检测的智能体AI框架，通过处理代理和监控代理协同工作实现原位过程监测，多智能体系统在缺陷分类任务中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体在现实应用中的广泛部署，需要开发能够进行原位过程监测的系统，特别是针对线弧增材制造中的缺陷检测问题，以提高制造质量和自动化水平。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于处理信号（电流、电压）的处理代理和基于声学数据的监控代理，两者都使用X射线计算机断层扫描数据训练分类工具，并采用大语言模型进行决策。进一步构建了多智能体框架，协调两个代理进行并行决策。
AI.result: 多智能体配置在所有个体代理中表现最优，在15次独立运行中，决策准确率达到91.6%，F1分数为0.821，推理质量得分为3.74/5。
AI.conclusion: 该原位过程监测智能体框架在缺陷检测方面表现出色，具有在WAAM和其他增材制造过程中实现自主实时过程监测和控制的巨大潜力。

title: Training-Free Object-Background Compositional T2I via Dynamic Spatial Guidance and Multi-Path Pruning
summary: Existing text-to-image diffusion models, while excelling at subject synthesis, exhibit a persistent foreground bias that treats the background as a passive and under-optimized byproduct. This imbalance compromises global scene coherence and constrains compositional control. To address the limitation, we propose a training-free framework that restructures diffusion sampling to explicitly account for foreground-background interactions. Our approach consists of two key components. First, Dynamic Spatial Guidance introduces a soft, time step dependent gating mechanism that modulates foreground and background attention during the diffusion process, enabling spatially balanced generation. Second, Multi-Path Pruning performs multi-path latent exploration and dynamically filters candidate trajectories using both internal attention statistics and external semantic alignment signals, retaining trajectories that better satisfy object-background constraints. We further develop a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate object-background compositionality. Extensive evaluations across multiple diffusion backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in background coherence and object-background compositional alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的扩散采样框架，通过动态空间引导和多路径剪枝解决文本到图像生成中的前景偏见问题，改善前景-背景组合性
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型存在持续的前景偏见，将背景视为被动和未优化的副产品，这种不平衡损害了全局场景连贯性并限制了组合控制
AI.method: 包含两个关键组件：1) 动态空间引导 - 引入软性的时间步依赖门控机制，在扩散过程中调制前景和背景注意力；2) 多路径剪枝 - 执行多路径潜在探索，使用内部注意力统计和外部语义对齐信号动态筛选候选轨迹
AI.result: 在多个扩散骨干模型上的广泛评估显示，在背景连贯性和对象-背景组合对齐方面取得了一致的改进
AI.conclusion: 提出的无需训练框架通过重构扩散采样来显式考虑前景-背景交互，有效解决了扩散模型中的前景偏见问题，提高了场景组合性

title: Learning Racket-Ball Bounce Dynamics Across Diverse Rubbers for Robotic Table Tennis
summary: Accurate dynamic models for racket-ball bounces are essential for reliable control in robotic table tennis. Existing models typically assume simple linear models and are restricted to inverted rubbers, limiting their ability to generalize across the wide variety of rackets encountered in practice. In this work, we present a unified framework for modeling ball-racket interactions across 10 racket configurations featuring different rubber types, including inverted, anti-spin, and pimpled surfaces. Using a high-speed multi-camera setup with spin estimation, we collect a dataset of racket-ball bounces spanning a broad range of incident velocities and spins. We show that key physical parameters governing rebound, such as the Coefficient of Restitution and tangential impulse response, vary systematically with the impact state and differ significantly across rubbers. To capture these effects while preserving physical interpretability, we estimate the parameters of an impulse-based contact model using Gaussian Processes conditioned on the ball's incoming velocity and spin. The resulting model provides both accurate predictions and uncertainty estimations. Compared to the constant parameter baselines, our approach reduces post-impact velocity and spin prediction errors across all racket types, with the largest improvements observed for nonstandard rubbers. Furthermore, the GP-based model enables online identification of racket dynamics with few observations during gameplay.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于高斯过程的统一框架，用于建模不同乒乓球拍橡胶（包括反胶、防弧胶和颗粒胶）与球的碰撞动力学，显著提高了反弹速度和旋转预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有乒乓球机器人控制中的球拍-球碰撞模型通常假设简单的线性模型，且仅限于反胶球拍，无法泛化到实践中遇到的各种球拍类型，限制了机器人系统的适应性和可靠性。
AI.method: 使用高速多摄像头系统收集10种不同橡胶配置球拍的碰撞数据，涵盖广泛的入射速度和旋转范围。采用基于高斯过程的脉冲接触模型，将恢复系数和切向脉冲响应等关键物理参数建模为球入射速度和旋转的函数，同时保持物理可解释性。
AI.result: 相比恒定参数基线模型，该方法在所有球拍类型上都显著降低了碰撞后速度和旋转的预测误差，对非标准橡胶的改进最为明显。基于高斯过程的模型还能通过少量观测实现在线识别球拍动力学。
AI.conclusion: 提出的统一框架能够准确建模不同橡胶球拍的碰撞动力学，提供精确预测和不确定性估计，为机器人乒乓球系统提供了更好的适应性和控制可靠性。

title: GLEaN: A Text-to-image Bias Detection Approach for Public Comprehension
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models, and their encoded biases, increasingly shape the visual media the public encounters. While researchers have produced a rich body of work on bias measurement, auditing, and mitigation in T2I systems, those methods largely target technical stakeholders, leaving a gap in public legibility. We introduce GLEaN (Generative Likeness Evaluation at N-Scale), a portrait-based explainability pipeline designed to make T2I model biases visually understandable to a broad audience. GLEaN comprises three stages: automated large-scale image generation from identity prompts, facial landmark-based filtering and spatial alignment, and median-pixel composition that distills a model's central tendency into a single representative portrait. The resulting composites require no statistical background to interpret; a viewer can see, at a glance, who a model 'imagines' when prompted with 'a doctor' versus a 'felon.' We demonstrate GLEaN on Stable Diffusion XL across 40 social and occupational identity prompts, producing composites that reproduce documented biases and surface new associations between skin tone and predicted emotion. We find in a between-subjects user study (N = 291) that GLEaN portraits communicate biases as effectively as conventional data tables, but require significantly less viewing time. Because the method relies solely on generated outputs, it can also be replicated on any black-box and closed-weight systems without access to model internals. GLEaN offers a scalable, model-agnostic approach to bias explainability, purpose-built for public comprehension, and is publicly available at https://github.com/cultureiolab/GLEaN.

AI.tldr: GLEaN是一个面向公众的可视化文本到图像模型偏见解释工具，通过生成代表性肖像来直观展示模型对不同身份提示的偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型偏见研究方法主要面向技术专家，缺乏公众可理解的可视化工具，需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：1)大规模自动图像生成；2)面部关键点过滤和空间对齐；3)中值像素合成生成代表性肖像。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion XL上测试40个社会职业身份提示，复现已知偏见并发现肤色与预测情绪的新关联。用户研究表明GLEaN肖像与数据表格同样有效但观看时间更短。
AI.conclusion: GLEaN提供了一种可扩展、模型无关的偏见解释方法，专门为公众理解设计，适用于黑盒系统。

title: Do vision models perceive illusory motion in static images like humans?
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshops (Findings). * Equal contribution
summary: Understanding human motion processing is essential for building reliable, human-centered computer vision systems. Although deep neural networks (DNNs) achieve strong performance in optical flow estimation, they remain less robust than humans and rely on fundamentally different computational strategies. Visual motion illusions provide a powerful probe into these mechanisms, revealing how human and machine vision align or diverge. While recent DNN-based motion models can reproduce dynamic illusions such as reverse-phi, it remains unclear whether they can perceive illusory motion in static images, exemplified by the Rotating Snakes illusion. We evaluate several representative optical flow models on Rotating Snakes and show that most fail to generate flow fields consistent with human perception. Under simulated conditions mimicking saccadic eye movements, only the human-inspired Dual-Channel model exhibits the expected rotational motion, with the closest correspondence emerging during the saccade simulation. Ablation analyses further reveal that both luminance-based and higher-order color--feature--based motion signals contribute to this behavior and that a recurrent attention mechanism is critical for integrating local cues. Our results highlight a substantial gap between current optical-flow models and human visual motion processing, and offer insights for developing future motion-estimation systems with improved correspondence to human perception and human-centric AI.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了多个光流模型在静态旋转蛇错觉中的表现，发现只有受人类视觉启发的双通道模型能产生符合人类感知的旋转运动，揭示了当前光流模型与人类视觉运动处理之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 理解人类运动处理对于构建可靠、以人为中心的计算机视觉系统至关重要。虽然深度神经网络在光流估计方面表现出色，但它们仍然不如人类稳健，并且依赖于根本不同的计算策略。视觉运动错觉为探究这些机制提供了有力工具，揭示了人类和机器视觉的异同。
AI.method: 评估了多个代表性光流模型在旋转蛇错觉上的表现，在模拟扫视眼动条件下测试模型，并对人类启发的双通道模型进行消融分析，研究亮度信号、高阶颜色特征信号和循环注意力机制的作用。
AI.result: 大多数光流模型无法产生与人类感知一致的流场。只有在模拟扫视眼动条件下，人类启发的双通道模型表现出预期的旋转运动，且最接近的对应出现在扫视模拟期间。消融分析显示亮度信号和高阶颜色特征信号都对此行为有贡献，循环注意力机制对于整合局部线索至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 当前光流模型与人类视觉运动处理之间存在显著差距，研究结果为开发更符合人类感知和以人为中心AI的未来运动估计系统提供了见解。

title: WM-DAgger: Enabling Efficient Data Aggregation for Imitation Learning with World Models
summary: Imitation learning is a powerful paradigm for training robotic policies, yet its performance is limited by compounding errors: minor policy inaccuracies could drive robots into unseen out-of-distribution (OOD) states in the training set, where the policy could generate even bigger errors, leading to eventual failures. While the Data Aggregation (DAgger) framework tries to address this issue, its reliance on continuous human involvement severely limits scalability. In this paper, we propose WM-DAgger, an efficient data aggregation framework that leverages World Models to synthesize OOD recovery data without requiring human involvement. Specifically, we focus on manipulation tasks with an eye-in-hand robotic arm and only few-shot demonstrations. To avoid synthesizing misleading data and overcome the hallucination issues inherent to World Models, our framework introduces two key mechanisms: (1) a Corrective Action Synthesis Module that generates task-oriented recovery actions to prevent misleading supervision, and (2) a Consistency-Guided Filtering Module that discards physically implausible trajectories by anchoring terminal synthesized frames to corresponding real frames in expert demonstrations. We extensively validate WM-DAgger on multiple real-world robotic tasks. Results that our method significantly improves success rates, achieving a 93.3\% success rate in soft bag pushing with only five demonstrations. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/czs12354-xxdbd/WM-Dagger.

AI.tldr: WM-DAgger：利用世界模型合成OOD恢复数据的高效数据聚合框架，无需人类参与，显著提升模仿学习在机器人操作任务中的成功率
AI.motivation: 模仿学习存在复合误差问题：小的策略不准确会导致机器人进入未见过的OOD状态，进而产生更大错误。传统DAgger框架依赖持续人类参与，可扩展性有限。
AI.method: 提出WM-DAgger框架，利用世界模型合成OOD恢复数据。包含两个关键机制：1）纠正动作合成模块生成面向任务的恢复动作；2）一致性引导过滤模块通过将合成终端帧锚定到专家演示中的真实帧来丢弃物理上不可行的轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界机器人任务上验证，显著提升成功率。在软袋推动任务中仅用5个演示就达到93.3%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: WM-DAgger通过世界模型合成OOD恢复数据，无需人类参与，有效解决了模仿学习的复合误差问题，在少样本演示下实现了高性能的机器人操作。

title: HealthAdminBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Healthcare Administration Tasks
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Benchmark paper introducing 4 simulated environments, 135 tasks, and 1,698 evaluation points for healthcare administrative computer-use agents
summary: Healthcare administration accounts for over $1 trillion in annual spending, making it a promising target for LLM-based computer-use agents (CUAs). While clinical applications of LLMs have received significant attention, no benchmark exists for evaluating CUAs on end-to-end administrative workflows. To address this gap, we introduce HealthAdminBench, a benchmark comprising four realistic GUI environments: an EHR, two payer portals, and a fax system, and 135 expert-defined tasks spanning three administrative task types: Prior Authorization, Appeals and Denials Management, and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Order Processing. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained, verifiable subtasks, yielding 1,698 evaluation points. We evaluate seven agent configurations under multiple prompting and observation settings and find that, despite strong subtask performance, end-to-end reliability remains low: the best-performing agent (Claude Opus 4.6 CUA) achieves only 36.3 percent task success, while GPT-5.4 CUA attains the highest subtask success rate (82.8 percent). These results reveal a substantial gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of real-world administrative workflows. HealthAdminBench provides a rigorous foundation for evaluating progress toward safe and reliable automation of healthcare administrative workflows.

AI.tldr: HealthAdminBench：首个评估LLM医疗管理代理的基准，包含4个GUI环境和135个专家定义任务，发现当前代理在端到端工作流中成功率仅36.3%，存在显著能力差距。
AI.motivation: 医疗管理每年支出超1万亿美元，是LLM计算机使用代理（CUA）的潜在应用领域。虽然LLM的临床应用已受关注，但缺乏评估端到端管理工作流的基准。
AI.method: 创建HealthAdminBench基准，包含4个真实GUI环境（EHR、两个支付方门户、传真系统）和135个专家定义任务，涵盖三大管理任务类型。将任务分解为细粒度可验证子任务，共1698个评估点。评估7种代理配置在多种提示和观察设置下的表现。
AI.result: 尽管子任务表现良好，但端到端可靠性较低：最佳代理（Claude Opus 4.6 CUA）任务成功率仅36.3%，GPT-5.4 CUA获得最高子任务成功率（82.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 当前代理能力与真实医疗管理工作流需求存在显著差距。HealthAdminBench为评估医疗管理工作流自动化进展提供了严格基础。

title: FF3R: Feedforward Feature 3D Reconstruction from Unconstrained views
summary: Recent advances in vision foundation models have revolutionized geometry reconstruction and semantic understanding. Yet, most of the existing approaches treat these capabilities in isolation, leading to redundant pipelines and compounded errors. This paper introduces FF3R, a fully annotation-free feed-forward framework that unifies geometric and semantic reasoning from unconstrained multi-view image sequences. Unlike previous methods, FF3R does not require camera poses, depth maps, or semantic labels, relying solely on rendering supervision for RGB and feature maps, establishing a scalable paradigm for unified 3D reasoning. In addition, we address two critical challenges in feedforward feature reconstruction pipelines, namely global semantic inconsistency and local structural inconsistency, through two key innovations: (i) a Token-wise Fusion Module that enriches geometry tokens with semantic context via cross-attention, and (ii) a Semantic-Geometry Mutual Boosting mechanism combining geometry-guided feature warping for global consistency with semantic-aware voxelization for local coherence. Extensive experiments on ScanNet and DL3DV-10K demonstrate FF3R's superior performance in novel-view synthesis, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, with strong generalization to in-the-wild scenarios, paving the way for embodied intelligence systems that demand both spatial and semantic understanding.

AI.tldr: FF3R是一个无需标注的前馈框架，统一了从多视角图像序列进行几何和语义推理，无需相机位姿、深度图或语义标签，仅通过渲染监督实现RGB和特征图重建。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型通常将几何重建和语义理解分开处理，导致冗余的流程和误差累积。需要一种统一的方法来同时处理几何和语义推理。
AI.method: 1) Token-wise Fusion Module：通过交叉注意力将语义上下文融入几何token；2) Semantic-Geometry Mutual Boosting机制：结合几何引导的特征扭曲实现全局一致性，以及语义感知的体素化实现局部一致性。
AI.result: 在ScanNet和DL3DV-10K数据集上，FF3R在新视角合成、开放词汇语义分割和深度估计方面表现出色，在野外场景中也有很强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FF3R为需要空间和语义理解的具身智能系统铺平了道路，建立了一个可扩展的统一3D推理范式。

title: MR.ScaleMaster: Scale-Consistent Collaborative Mapping from Crowd-Sourced Monocular Videos
summary: Crowd-sourced cooperative mapping from monocular cameras promises scalable 3D reconstruction without specialized sensors, yet remains hindered by two scale-specific failure modes: abrupt scale collapse from false-positive loop closures in repetitive environments, and gradual scale drift over long trajectories and per-robot scale ambiguity that prevent direct multi-session fusion. We present MR.ScaleMaster, a cooperative mapping system for crowd-sourced monocular videos that addresses both failure modes. MR.ScaleMaster introduces three key mechanisms. First, a Scale Collapse Alarm rejects spurious loop closures before they corrupt the pose graph. Second, a Sim(3) anchor node formulation generalizes the classical SE(3) framework to explicitly estimate per-session scale, resolving per-robot scale ambiguity and enforcing global scale consistency. Third, a modular, open-source, plug-and-play interface enables any monocular reconstruction model to integrate without backend modification. On KITTI sequences with up to 15 agents, the Sim(3) formulation achieves a 7.2x ATE reduction over the SE(3) baseline, and the alarm rejects all false-positive loops while preserving every valid constraint. We further demonstrate heterogeneous multi-robot dense mapping fusing MASt3R-SLAM, pi3, and VGGT-SLAM 2.0 within a single unified map.

AI.tldr: MR.ScaleMaster是一个用于众包单目视频的协同建图系统，通过尺度崩溃警报、Sim(3)锚点公式和模块化接口解决尺度崩溃和漂移问题，实现多机器人统一建图。
AI.motivation: 众包单目相机协同建图可以实现无需专用传感器的可扩展3D重建，但面临两个尺度相关的失败模式：重复环境中错误闭环导致的尺度崩溃，以及长轨迹上的尺度漂移和每机器人尺度模糊性阻碍多会话融合。
AI.method: 1. 尺度崩溃警报：在虚假闭环破坏位姿图前拒绝它们；2. Sim(3)锚点公式：将经典SE(3)框架推广到显式估计每会话尺度，解决每机器人尺度模糊并强制全局尺度一致性；3. 模块化开源即插即用接口：使任何单目重建模型无需后端修改即可集成。
AI.result: 在最多15个智能体的KITTI序列上，Sim(3)公式相比SE(3)基线实现了7.2倍的ATE减少，警报拒绝了所有虚假闭环同时保留了每个有效约束。进一步演示了在单个统一地图中融合MASt3R-SLAM、pi3和VGGT-SLAM 2.0的异构多机器人稠密建图。
AI.conclusion: MR.ScaleMaster成功解决了众包单目协同建图中的尺度崩溃和漂移问题，通过创新的尺度管理机制实现了鲁棒的多机器人统一建图，为无需专用传感器的可扩展3D重建提供了有效解决方案。

title: New Hybrid Fine-Tuning Paradigm for LLMs: Algorithm Design and Convergence Analysis Framework
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) typically involves either full fine-tuning, which updates all model parameters, or Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), which adjusts a small subset of parameters. However, both approaches have inherent limitations: full fine-tuning is computationally expensive, while PEFT often struggles to learn new knowledge and exhibits suboptimal performance. To overcome these issues, we propose a novel hybrid fine-tuning approach that jointly updates both LLMs and PEFT modules using a combination of zeroth-order and first-order optimization methods. To analyze our new algorithm, we develop a theoretical framework centered on the concept of hybrid smoothness condition, which accounts for the heterogeneous nature of the optimization landscape in joint LLM and PEFT training. We derive a rigorous convergence analysis for the convergence of reshuffling-type SGD algorithm under multiple learning rates and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive empirical studies across various downstream tasks and model architectures. On the practical side, our results demonstrate consistent performance improvement, making the approach a viable solution for large-scale language model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合零阶和一阶优化的混合微调方法，联合更新LLM和PEFT模块，解决全微调计算成本高和PEFT学习新知识能力不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM微调方法存在局限性：全微调计算成本高，而参数高效微调(PEFT)在学习新知识方面表现不佳且性能次优。需要一种能克服这些限制的新方法。
AI.method: 提出混合微调方法，使用零阶和一阶优化联合更新LLM和PEFT模块。建立基于混合平滑条件的理论框架，分析异构优化景观，推导多学习率下重排型SGD算法的收敛性。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了算法收敛性，实证研究在各种下游任务和模型架构上显示一致的性能提升，表明该方法是大规模语言模型微调的有效解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 混合微调方法结合了全微调和PEFT的优点，通过理论框架和实证验证，为大规模语言模型微调提供了可行的解决方案。

title: PAS: Estimating the target accuracy before domain adaptation
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: The goal of domain adaptation is to make predictions for unlabeled samples from a target domain with the help of labeled samples from a different but related source domain. The performance of domain adaptation methods is highly influenced by the choice of source domain and pre-trained feature extractor. However, the selection of source data and pre-trained model is not trivial due to the absence of a labeled validation set for the target domain and the large number of available pre-trained models. In this work, we propose PAS, a novel score designed to estimate the transferability of a source domain set and a pre-trained feature extractor to a target classification task before actually performing domain adaptation. PAS leverages the generalization power of pre-trained models and assesses source-target compatibility based on the pre-trained feature embeddings. We integrate PAS into a framework that indicates the most relevant pre-trained model and source domain among multiple candidates, thus improving target accuracy while reducing the computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification benchmarks demonstrate that PAS correlates strongly with actual target accuracy and consistently guides the selection of the best-performing pre-trained model and source domain for adaptation.

AI.tldr: PAS是一种评估源域数据集和预训练特征提取器向目标分类任务可迁移性的新评分方法，无需实际执行域适应即可选择最佳源域和预训练模型。
AI.motivation: 域适应方法的性能受源域选择和预训练特征提取器影响很大，但由于目标域缺乏标注验证集且可用预训练模型众多，选择合适的源数据和预训练模型非常困难。
AI.method: 提出PAS评分方法，利用预训练模型的泛化能力，基于预训练特征嵌入评估源域与目标域的兼容性，并将其集成到框架中从多个候选中选择最相关的预训练模型和源域。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上的大量实验表明，PAS与实际目标准确率强相关，能一致性地指导选择性能最佳的预训练模型和源域进行适应。
AI.conclusion: PAS能够有效评估可迁移性，在提高目标准确率的同时减少计算开销，为域适应中的源域和预训练模型选择提供了实用解决方案。

title: Minimal Embodiment Enables Efficient Learning of Number Concepts in Robot
summary: Robots are increasingly entering human-interactive scenarios that require understanding of quantity. How intelligent systems acquire abstract numerical concepts from sensorimotor experience remains a fundamental challenge in cognitive science and artificial intelligence. Here we investigate embodied numerical learning using a neural network model trained to perform sequential counting through naturalistic robotic interaction with a Franka Panda manipulator. We demonstrate that embodied models achieve 96.8\% counting accuracy with only 10\% of training data, compared to 60.6\% for vision-only baselines. This advantage persists when visual-motor correspondences are randomized, indicating that embodiment functions as a structural prior that regularizes learning rather than as an information source. The model spontaneously develops biologically plausible representations: number-selective units with logarithmic tuning, mental number line organization, Weber-law scaling, and rotational dynamics encoding numerical magnitude ($r = 0.97$, slope $= 30.6°$/count). The learning trajectory parallels children's developmental progression from subset-knowers to cardinal-principle knowers. These findings demonstrate that minimal embodiment can ground abstract concepts, improve data efficiency, and yield interpretable representations aligned with biological cognition, which may contribute to embodied mathematics tutoring and safety-critical industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 机器人通过具身交互学习数字概念，比纯视觉方法更高效，并自发形成与生物认知相似的数字表征
AI.motivation: 智能系统如何从感知运动经验中获取抽象数字概念是认知科学和人工智能的基本挑战。研究探索具身学习如何帮助机器人理解数量概念
AI.method: 使用神经网络模型，通过Franka Panda机械臂的自然交互进行序列计数训练，比较具身模型与纯视觉基线的表现
AI.result: 具身模型仅用10%训练数据就达到96.8%计数准确率，而纯视觉基线为60.6%。模型自发形成对数调谐的数字选择性单元、心理数字线组织、韦伯定律缩放和旋转动力学等生物合理表征
AI.conclusion: 最小化的具身性可以锚定抽象概念、提高数据效率，并产生与生物认知一致的可解释表征，有助于具身数学教学和安全关键工业应用

title: FinTrace: Holistic Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLM Tool Calling for Long-Horizon Financial Tasks
summary: Recent studies demonstrate that tool-calling capability enables large language models (LLMs) to interact with external environments for long-horizon financial tasks. While existing benchmarks have begun evaluating financial tool calling, they focus on limited scenarios and rely on call-level metrics that fail to capture trajectory-level reasoning quality. To address this gap, we introduce FinTrace, a benchmark comprising 800 expert-annotated trajectories spanning 34 real-world financial task categories across multiple difficulty levels. FinTrace employs a rubric-based evaluation protocol with nine metrics organized along four axes -- action correctness, execution efficiency, process quality, and output quality -- enabling fine-grained assessment of LLM tool-calling behavior. Our evaluation of 13 LLMs reveals that while frontier models achieve strong tool selection, all models struggle with information utilization and final answer quality, exposing a critical gap between invoking the right tools and reasoning effectively over their outputs. To move beyond diagnosis, we construct FinTrace-Training, the first trajectory-level preference dataset for financial tool-calling, containing 8,196 curated trajectories with tool-augmented contexts and preference pairs. We fine-tune Qwen-3.5-9B using supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization (DPO) and show that training on FinTrace-Training consistently improves intermediate reasoning metrics, with DPO more effectively suppressing failure modes. However, end-to-end answer quality remains a bottleneck, indicating that trajectory-level improvements do not yet fully propagate to final output quality.

AI.tldr: FinTrace是一个金融工具调用基准测试，包含800个专家标注的轨迹，涵盖34个真实金融任务类别，采用四维度九指标评估协议。研究发现前沿模型工具选择能力强，但信息利用和最终答案质量差，揭示了工具调用与有效推理之间的关键差距。作者还构建了首个轨迹级偏好数据集FinTrace-Training，通过SFT和DPO微调Qwen-3.5-9B，改善了中间推理指标，但最终答案质量仍是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有金融工具调用基准测试存在局限性：1) 场景有限；2) 依赖调用级指标，无法捕捉轨迹级推理质量。需要更全面的评估框架来诊断LLM在金融工具调用中的真实能力差距。
AI.method: 1) 构建FinTrace基准：800个专家标注轨迹，涵盖34个真实金融任务类别，多难度级别；2) 设计四维度九指标评估协议（行动正确性、执行效率、过程质量、输出质量）；3) 评估13个LLM；4) 构建FinTrace-Training数据集：8,196个精选轨迹，包含工具增强上下文和偏好对；5) 对Qwen-3.5-9B进行监督微调(SFT)和直接偏好优化(DPO)。
AI.result: 1) 前沿模型工具选择能力强，但所有模型在信息利用和最终答案质量方面表现不佳；2) 训练FinTrace-Training数据集能持续改善中间推理指标；3) DPO能更有效地抑制失败模式；4) 端到端答案质量仍是瓶颈，轨迹级改进尚未完全传导到最终输出质量。
AI.conclusion: 金融工具调用存在关键差距：正确调用工具与有效推理输出之间存在脱节。轨迹级训练能改善中间推理能力，但最终答案质量需要进一步研究。FinTrace为评估和改进LLM金融工具调用能力提供了重要基准和数据集。

title: DINO_4D: Semantic-Aware 4D Reconstruction
summary: In the intersection of computer vision and robotic perception, 4D reconstruction of dynamic scenes serve as the critical bridge connecting low-level geometric sensing with high-level semantic understanding. We present DINO\_4D, introducing frozen DINOv3 features as structural priors, injecting semantic awareness into the reconstruction process to effectively suppress semantic drift during dynamic tracking. Experiments on the Point Odyssey and TUM-Dynamics benchmarks demonstrate that our method maintains the linear time complexity $O(T)$ of its predecessors while significantly improving Tracking Accuracy (APD) and Reconstruction Completeness. DINO\_4D establishes a new paradigm for constructing 4D World Models that possess both geometric precision and semantic understanding.

AI.tldr: DINO_4D利用冻结的DINOv3特征作为结构先验，将语义感知注入动态场景4D重建过程，有效抑制语义漂移，在保持线性时间复杂度的同时显著提升跟踪精度和重建完整性。
AI.motivation: 在计算机视觉和机器人感知的交叉领域，动态场景的4D重建是连接底层几何感知与高层语义理解的关键桥梁。现有方法在动态跟踪过程中容易出现语义漂移问题，需要注入语义意识来提升重建质量。
AI.method: 提出DINO_4D方法，引入冻结的DINOv3特征作为结构先验，将语义感知注入重建过程。该方法保持了前驱方法的线性时间复杂度O(T)，同时通过语义特征有效抑制动态跟踪中的语义漂移。
AI.result: 在Point Odyssey和TUM-Dynamics基准测试上的实验表明，DINO_4D在保持线性时间复杂度的同时，显著提升了跟踪精度(APD)和重建完整性，建立了新的性能标准。
AI.conclusion: DINO_4D为构建既具有几何精度又具备语义理解的4D世界模型建立了新范式，将语义意识成功整合到动态场景重建中，推动了计算机视觉和机器人感知的发展。

title: ComSim: Building Scalable Real-World Robot Data Generation via Compositional Simulation
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material included; Project page: https://faceong.github.io/ComSim/
summary: Recent advancements in foundational models, such as large language models and world models, have greatly enhanced the capabilities of robotics, enabling robots to autonomously perform complex tasks. However, acquiring large-scale, high-quality training data for robotics remains a challenge, as it often requires substantial manual effort and is limited in its coverage of diverse real-world environments. To address this, we propose a novel hybrid approach called Compositional Simulation, which combines classical simulation and neural simulation to generate accurate action-video pairs while maintaining real-world consistency. Our approach utilizes a closed-loop real-sim-real data augmentation pipeline, leveraging a small amount of real-world data to generate diverse, large-scale training datasets that cover a broader spectrum of real-world scenarios. We train a neural simulator to transform classical simulation videos into real-world representations, improving the accuracy of policy models trained in real-world environments. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the sim2real domain gap, resulting in higher success rates in real-world policy model training. Our approach offers a scalable solution for generating robust training data and bridging the gap between simulated and real-world robotics.

AI.tldr: 提出Compositional Simulation方法，结合经典模拟与神经模拟生成准确的动作-视频对，通过真实-模拟-真实数据增强管道，用少量真实数据生成大规模多样化训练数据集，显著减小sim2real域差距。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域基础模型（如大语言模型和世界模型）发展迅速，但获取大规模高质量训练数据仍面临挑战，需要大量人工且难以覆盖多样真实环境。
AI.method: 提出Compositional Simulation混合方法，结合经典模拟和神经模拟，使用闭环真实-模拟-真实数据增强管道，训练神经模拟器将经典模拟视频转换为真实世界表示。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著减小sim2real域差距，在真实世界策略模型训练中获得更高的成功率，为生成鲁棒训练数据提供可扩展解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过组合模拟技术有效桥接模拟与真实机器人之间的差距，为机器人训练提供大规模多样化数据生成方案。

title: AI Achieves a Perfect LSAT Score
summary: This paper reports the first documented instance of a language model achieving a perfect score on an officially disclosed Law School Admission Test (LSAT). Controlled experiments on eight reasoning models show that varying the prompt, shuffling answer choices, and sampling multiple responses have no meaningful effect as drivers of performance. Ablating the thinking phase that models generate before answering, however, lowers frontier accuracy by up to 8 percentage points, predominantly in logical reasoning. Distilled models produce full thinking traces in the same format yet plateau far below frontier performance. A pilot process reward model fine-tuned via QLoRA on official LSAT explanations narrows this gap through Best-of-5 selection, with gains again predominantly in logical reasoning. The gatekeeper of elite legal education since 1948, the LSAT has not merely been passed but answered without a single error by models that reason. The upper bound of the cognitive capacities it has tested is no longer exclusive to human cognition.

AI.tldr: 语言模型首次在官方披露的LSAT考试中获得满分，展示了超越人类认知的推理能力
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型在法律推理考试（LSAT）上的表现极限，探索模型推理能力是否能够达到甚至超越人类精英水平
AI.method: 在8个推理模型上进行控制实验，测试不同提示、答案顺序和多次采样的影响；通过消融思考阶段分析其重要性；使用QLoRA微调的过程奖励模型进行最佳选择
AI.result: 前沿模型在LSAT上获得完美分数；思考阶段对逻辑推理准确性提升达8个百分点；蒸馏模型表现远低于前沿模型；过程奖励模型通过最佳选择缩小了性能差距
AI.conclusion: 语言模型不仅通过了LSAT考试，而且实现了零错误，表明LSAT所测试的认知能力上限不再专属于人类认知

title: Topo-ADV: Generating Topology-Driven Imperceptible Adversarial Point Clouds
summary: Deep neural networks for 3D point cloud understanding have achieved remarkable success in object classification and recognition, yet recent work shows that these models remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing 3D attacks predominantly manipulate geometric properties such as point locations, curvature, or surface structure, implicitly assuming that preserving global shape fidelity preserves semantic content. In this work, we challenge this assumption and introduce the first topology-driven adversarial attack for point cloud deep learning. Our key insight is that the homological structure of a 3D object constitutes a previously unexplored vulnerability surface. We propose Topo-ADV, an end-to-end differentiable framework that incorporates persistent homology as an explicit optimization objective, enabling gradient-based manipulation of topological features during adversarial example generation. By embedding persistence diagrams through differentiable topological representations, our method jointly optimizes (i) a topology divergence loss that alters persistence, (ii) a misclassification objective, and (iii) geometric imperceptibility constraints that preserve visual plausibility. Experiments demonstrate that subtle topology-driven perturbations consistently achieve up to 100% attack success rates on benchmark datasets such as ModelNet40, ShapeNet Part, and ScanObjectNN using PointNet and DGCNN classifiers, while remaining geometrically indistinguishable from the original point clouds, beating state-of-the-art methods on various perceptibility metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于拓扑的3D点云对抗攻击方法Topo-ADV，通过操纵持久同调特征来攻击点云深度学习模型
AI.motivation: 现有3D对抗攻击主要操纵几何属性（如点位置、曲率、表面结构），隐含假设保持全局形状保真度就能保持语义内容。本文挑战这一假设，发现3D对象的同调结构构成先前未被探索的脆弱性表面
AI.method: 提出Topo-ADV端到端可微分框架，将持久同调作为显式优化目标，通过可微分拓扑表示嵌入持久图，联合优化：(1)改变持久性的拓扑散度损失，(2)误分类目标，(3)保持视觉合理性的几何不可感知性约束
AI.result: 在ModelNet40、ShapeNet Part、ScanObjectNN基准数据集上，使用PointNet和DGCNN分类器，微小的拓扑驱动扰动能实现高达100%的攻击成功率，同时在几何上与原始点云难以区分，在各种可感知性指标上优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: 拓扑结构是3D点云深度学习模型中先前未被认识到的脆弱性来源，Topo-ADV证明了通过操纵同调特征可以有效攻击模型，同时保持几何不可感知性

title: EagleVision: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Cross-Domain Perception in High-Speed Autonomous Racing
summary: High-speed autonomous racing presents extreme perception challenges, including large relative velocities and substantial domain shifts from conventional urban-driving datasets. Existing benchmarks do not adequately capture these high-dynamic conditions. We introduce EagleVision, a unified LiDAR-based multi-task benchmark for 3D detection and trajectory prediction in high-speed racing, providing newly annotated 3D bounding boxes for the Indy Autonomous Challenge dataset (14,893 frames) and the A2RL Real competition dataset (1,163 frames), together with 12,000 simulator-generated annotated frames, all standardized under a common evaluation protocol. Using a dataset-centric transfer framework, we quantify cross-domain generalization across urban, simulator, and real racing domains. Urban pretraining improves detection over scratch training (NDS 0.72 vs. 0.69), while intermediate pretraining on real racing data achieves the best transfer to A2RL (NDS 0.726), outperforming simulator-only adaptation. For trajectory prediction, Indy-trained models surpass in-domain A2RL training on A2RL test sequences (FDE 0.947 vs. 1.250), highlighting the role of motion-distribution coverage in cross-domain forecasting. EagleVision enables systematic study of perception generalization under extreme high-speed dynamics. The dataset and benchmark are publicly available at https://avlab.io/EagleVision

AI.tldr: EagleVision是一个用于高速自动驾驶赛车的LiDAR多任务基准测试，包含真实和模拟数据，用于研究极端高速条件下的感知泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 高速自动驾驶赛车面临极端感知挑战，包括大相对速度和与常规城市驾驶数据集的显著领域偏移。现有基准测试无法充分捕捉这些高动态条件。
AI.method: 引入EagleVision基准测试，整合了Indy Autonomous Challenge数据集（14,893帧）、A2RL Real竞赛数据集（1,163帧）和12,000帧模拟生成数据，采用数据集中心化迁移框架量化跨领域泛化能力。
AI.result: 城市预训练提升检测性能（NDS 0.72 vs 0.69）；真实赛车数据中间预训练在A2RL上表现最佳（NDS 0.726）；Indy训练的轨迹预测模型在A2RL测试序列上优于域内训练（FDE 0.947 vs 1.250）。
AI.conclusion: EagleVision为研究极端高速动态下的感知泛化提供了系统工具，揭示了数据分布覆盖对跨领域预测的重要性，数据集和基准测试已公开。

title: LoopGuard: Breaking Self-Reinforcing Attention Loops via Dynamic KV Cache Intervention
summary: Through systematic experiments on long-context generation, we observe a damaging failure mode in which decoding can collapse into persistent repetition loops. We find that this degeneration is driven by collapsed attention patterns, where a subset of heads locks onto a narrow suffix of the history, and is further stabilized by inference-time KV cache reuse. Crucially, since many existing KV cache policies rely on attention-based importance, this collapse can produce spuriously high scores for repetitive tokens, causing cache management to inadvertently amplify repetition. To study this phenomenon in a controlled and reproducible manner, we introduce LoopBench, a benchmark with explicit loop-inducing conditions and loop-oriented metrics that quantify repetition severity and generation instability beyond downstream task scores. Building on these insights, we propose LoopGuard, a lightweight, plug-in KV cache guard that detects loop onset online and disrupts the feedback cycle by pruning repetitive tail spans under a fixed cache budget. Experiments on LoopBench show that LoopGuard reduces loop incidence by over 90 percentage points, while restoring output diversity and reducing token waste.

AI.tldr: 论文发现LLM长文本生成中会出现重复循环崩溃，提出LoopBench基准和LoopGuard缓存防护方法
AI.motivation: 在长文本生成实验中观察到解码会陷入持续重复循环的破坏性故障模式，这种退化由注意力模式崩溃驱动，而KV缓存重用进一步稳定了这种循环
AI.method: 引入LoopBench基准测试，包含明确的循环诱导条件和循环导向指标；提出LoopGuard轻量级插件式KV缓存防护机制，在线检测循环开始并在固定缓存预算下修剪重复尾部片段
AI.result: LoopBench实验显示，LoopGuard将循环发生率降低了90多个百分点，同时恢复了输出多样性并减少了token浪费
AI.conclusion: LLM长文本生成中的重复循环崩溃是一个严重问题，通过LoopGuard的KV缓存防护可以有效检测和缓解这种退化，提高生成稳定性

title: Not Your Stereo-Typical Estimator: Combining Vision and Language for Volume Perception
summary: Accurate volume estimation of objects from visual data is a long-standing challenge in computer vision with significant applications in robotics, logistics, and smart health. Existing methods often rely on complex 3D reconstruction pipelines or struggle with the ambiguity inherent in single-view images. To address these limitations, we introduce a new method that fuses implicit 3D cues from stereo vision with explicit prior knowledge from natural language text. Our approach extracts deep features from a stereo image pair and a descriptive text prompt that contains the object's class and an approximate volume, then integrates them using a simple yet effective projection layer into a unified, multi-modal representation for regression. We conduct extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrating that our text-guided approach significantly outperforms vision-only baselines. Our findings show that leveraging even simple textual priors can effectively guide the volume estimation task, paving the way for more context-aware visual measurement systems. Code: https://gitlab.com/viper-purdue/stereo-typical-estimator.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合立体视觉和文本先验的物体体积估计方法，通过多模态特征融合显著提升单目视觉方法的性能
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖复杂的3D重建流程或难以处理单视图图像的歧义性，需要更有效的体积估计方法
AI.method: 从立体图像对和描述性文本提示中提取深度特征，通过投影层融合成统一的多模态表示进行回归
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，文本引导方法显著优于纯视觉基线方法
AI.conclusion: 利用简单的文本先验能有效指导体积估计任务，为更具上下文感知的视觉测量系统铺平道路

title: Using Unwrapped Full Color Space Palette Recording to Measure Exposedness of a Vehicle Exterior Parts for External Human Machine Interfaces
summary: One of the concerns with autonomous vehicles is their ability to communicate their intent to other road users, specially pedestrians, in order to prevent accidents. External Human-Machine Interfaces (eHMIs) are the proposed solution to this issue, through the introduction of electronic devices on the exterior of a vehicle that communicate when the vehicle is planning on slowing down or yielding. This paper uses the technique of unwrapping the faces of a mesh onto a texture where every pixel is a unique color, as well as a series of animated simulations made and ran in the Unity game engine, to measure how many times is each point on a 2015 Ford F-150 King Ranch is unobstructed to a pedestrian attempting to cross the road at a four-way intersection. By cross-referencing the results with a color-coded map of the labeled parts on the exterior of the vehicle, it was concluded that while the bumper, grill, and hood were the parts of the vehicle visible to the crossing pedestrian most often, the existence of other vehicles on the same lane that might obstruct the view of these makes them insufficient. The study recommends instead a distributive approach to eHMIs by using both the windshield and frontal fenders as simultaneous placements for these devices.

AI.tldr: 研究通过模拟分析，发现车辆前保险杠、格栅和引擎盖虽然是行人最常看到的部位，但由于其他车辆遮挡，这些位置不适合作为eHMI显示界面。建议在挡风玻璃和前翼子板上同时部署eHMI设备。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆需要向行人等道路使用者传达意图以防止事故，外部人机界面(eHMIs)是解决方案，但需要确定最佳安装位置以确保可见性。
AI.method: 使用网格面展开技术将车辆表面映射到纹理上，每个像素分配唯一颜色；在Unity游戏引擎中创建并运行一系列动画模拟，测量在四向交叉路口行人过街时，2015款福特F-150 King Ranch每个表面点对行人的可见频率。
AI.result: 保险杠、格栅和引擎盖是行人最常看到的车辆部位，但由于同车道其他车辆的遮挡，这些位置作为eHMI显示位置不够可靠。
AI.conclusion: 建议采用分布式eHMI方案，同时在挡风玻璃和前翼子板上部署显示设备，以提高行人可见性。

title: Learning Hierarchical and Geometry-Aware Graph Representations for Text-to-CAD
summary: Text-to-CAD code generation is a long-horizon task that translates textual instructions into long sequences of interdependent operations. Existing methods typically decode text directly into executable code (e.g., bpy) without explicitly modeling assembly hierarchy or geometric constraints, which enlarges the search space, accumulates local errors, and often causes cascading failures in complex assemblies. To address this issue, we propose a hierarchical and geometry-aware graph as an intermediate representation. The graph models multi-level parts and components as nodes and encodes explicit geometric constraints as edges. Instead of mapping text directly to code, our framework first predicts structure and constraints, then conditions action sequencing and code generation, thereby improving geometric fidelity and constraint satisfaction. We further introduce a structure-aware progressive curriculum learning strategy that constructs graded tasks through controlled structural edits, explores the model's capability boundary, and synthesizes boundary examples for iterative training. In addition, we build a 12K dataset with instructions, decomposition graphs, action sequences, and bpy code, together with graph- and constraint-oriented evaluation metrics. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in both geometric fidelity and accurate satisfaction of geometric constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于文本到CAD代码生成的分层几何感知图中间表示方法，通过显式建模装配层次和几何约束，结合结构感知的渐进课程学习策略，显著提升了生成代码的几何保真度和约束满足度。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到CAD代码生成方法直接将文本解码为可执行代码（如bpy），没有显式建模装配层次或几何约束，这扩大了搜索空间，累积局部错误，在复杂装配中常导致级联失败。需要更好的中间表示来改善几何保真度和约束满足。
AI.method: 提出分层几何感知图作为中间表示，将多级零件和组件建模为节点，几何约束编码为边。框架先预测结构和约束，再条件化动作序列和代码生成。引入结构感知渐进课程学习策略，通过受控结构编辑构建分级任务，探索模型能力边界并合成边界示例进行迭代训练。
AI.result: 构建了包含12K样本的数据集（指令、分解图、动作序列、bpy代码）以及图和约束导向的评估指标。大量实验表明，该方法在几何保真度和几何约束准确满足方面始终优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入分层几何感知图中间表示和结构感知渐进课程学习策略，显著提升了文本到CAD代码生成的性能，特别是在复杂装配场景中，有效减少了级联失败并提高了约束满足度。

title: PointSplat: Efficient Geometry-Driven Pruning and Transformer Refinement for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently unlocked real-time, high-fidelity novel view synthesis by representing scenes using explicit 3D primitives. However, traditional methods often require millions of Gaussians to capture complex scenes, leading to significant memory and storage demands. Recent approaches have addressed this issue through pruning and per-scene fine-tuning of Gaussian parameters, thereby reducing the model size while maintaining visual quality. These strategies typically rely on 2D images to compute important scores followed by scene-specific optimization. In this work, we introduce PointSplat, 3D geometry-driven prune-and-refine framework that bridges previously disjoint directions of gaussian pruning and transformer refinement. Our method includes two key components: (1) an efficient geometry-driven strategy that ranks Gaussians based solely on their 3D attributes, removing reliance on 2D images during pruning stage, and (2) a dual-branch encoder that separates, re-weights geometric and appearance to avoid feature imbalance. Extensive experiments on ScanNet++ and Replica across varying sparsity levels demonstrate that PointSplat consistently achieves competitive rendering quality and superior efficiency without additional per-scene optimization.

AI.tldr: PointSplat：基于3D几何的Gaussian Splatting剪枝与优化框架，无需2D图像依赖和场景特定优化，实现高效高质量渲染
AI.motivation: 传统3D Gaussian Splatting方法需要数百万高斯分布来表示复杂场景，导致内存和存储需求巨大。现有方法依赖2D图像计算重要性分数并进行场景特定优化，限制了效率和通用性。
AI.method: 提出PointSplat框架，包含两个核心组件：1）仅基于3D属性的几何驱动剪枝策略，消除对2D图像的依赖；2）双分支编码器，分离并重新加权几何和外观特征以避免特征不平衡。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++和Replica数据集上的实验表明，PointSplat在不同稀疏度下都能保持竞争力的渲染质量，同时实现更优的效率，且无需额外的场景特定优化。
AI.conclusion: PointSplat通过纯3D几何驱动的方法，成功桥接了高斯剪枝与transformer优化的方向，实现了高效、高质量的3D场景表示，为实时渲染提供了更实用的解决方案。

title: Efficient Emotion-Aware Iconic Gesture Prediction for Robot Co-Speech
summary: Co-speech gestures increase engagement and improve speech understanding. Most data-driven robot systems generate rhythmic beat-like motion, yet few integrate semantic emphasis. To address this, we propose a lightweight transformer that derives iconic gesture placement and intensity from text and emotion alone, requiring no audio input at inference time. The model outperforms GPT-4o in both semantic gesture placement classification and intensity regression on the BEAT2 dataset, while remaining computationally compact and suitable for real-time deployment on embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 提出基于文本和情感的轻量级Transformer模型，无需音频输入即可生成语义手势，在BEAT2数据集上超越GPT-4o，适合实时部署
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的机器人系统主要生成节奏性手势，缺乏语义强调。协同手势能提高参与度和语音理解，但需要更好的语义手势生成方法
AI.method: 使用轻量级Transformer模型，仅从文本和情感输入推导图标手势的位置和强度，推理时无需音频输入
AI.result: 在BEAT2数据集上，模型在语义手势位置分类和强度回归任务中均超越GPT-4o，同时保持计算紧凑，适合实时部署
AI.conclusion: 提出的轻量级Transformer模型能有效生成语义手势，无需音频输入，在性能和效率上都表现出色，适合具身智能体实时应用

title: Ontological Trajectory Forecasting via Finite Semigroup Iteration and Lie Algebra Approximation in Geopolitical Knowledge Graphs
comment: 18 pages. Code and system available at https://github.com/wuqihang-brave/El-druin
summary: We present EL-DRUIN, an ontological reasoning system for geopolitical intelligence analysis that combines formal ontology, finite semigroup algebra, and Lie algebra approximation to forecast long-run relationship trajectories. Current LLM-based political analysis systems operate as summarisation engines, producing outputs bounded by textual pattern matching. EL-DRUIN departs from this paradigm by modelling geopolitical relationships as states in a finite set of named Dynamic Patterns, composing patterns via a semigroup operation whose structure constants are defined by an explicit composition table, and embedding each pattern as a vector in an 8-dimensional semantic Lie algebra space. Forward simulation iterates this semigroup operation, yielding reachable pattern sets at each discrete timestep; convergence to idempotent absorbing states (fixed points of the composition) constitutes the predicted long-run attractor. Bayesian posterior weights combine ontology-derived confidence priors with a Lie similarity term measuring the cosine similarity between the vector sum of composing patterns and the target pattern vector, providing interpretable, calibrated probabilities that are not self-reported by a language model. Bifurcation points -- steps at which two candidate attractors have near-equal posterior mass -- are detected and exposed to downstream analysis. We demonstrate the framework on six geopolitical scenarios including US-China technology decoupling and the Taiwan Strait military coercion trajectory. The architecture is publicly available as an open-source system with a Streamlit frontend exposing full computation traces, Bayesian posterior breakdowns, and 8D ontological state vectors.

AI.tldr: EL-DRUIN是一个结合形式本体论、有限半群代数和李代数近似的推理系统，用于预测地缘政治关系的长期轨迹，相比传统LLM提供了基于数学模型的概率预测。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的地缘政治分析系统本质上是文本摘要引擎，受限于文本模式匹配。需要一种能够建模地缘政治关系动态、提供可解释概率预测的数学框架。
AI.method: 将地缘政治关系建模为有限动态模式集中的状态，通过半群运算组合模式，结构常数由显式组合表定义。将每个模式嵌入8维语义李代数空间，通过前向模拟迭代半群运算，收敛到幂等吸收状态作为长期吸引子。贝叶斯后验权重结合本体论置信先验和李相似性项。
AI.result: 在六个地缘政治场景中演示了框架，包括中美技术脱钩和台湾海峡军事胁迫轨迹。系统检测分叉点（两个候选吸引子后验质量接近的步骤）并暴露给下游分析。
AI.conclusion: EL-DRUIN提供了一个可解释、可校准的地缘政治关系预测框架，超越了传统LLM的文本模式匹配方法。系统作为开源架构公开，具有Streamlit前端，展示完整计算轨迹、贝叶斯后验分解和8维本体状态向量。

title: From UAV Imagery to Agronomic Reasoning: A Multimodal LLM Benchmark for Plant Phenotyping
summary: To improve crop genetics, high-throughput, effective and comprehensive phenotyping is a critical prerequisite. While such tasks were traditionally performed manually, recent advances in multimodal foundation models, especially in vision-language models (VLMs), have enabled more automated and robust phenotypic analysis. However, plant science remains a particularly challenging domain for foundation models because it requires domain-specific knowledge, fine-grained visual interpretation, and complex biological and agronomic reasoning. To address this gap, we develop PlantXpert, an evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning benchmark for soybean and cotton phenotyping. Our benchmark provides a structured and reproducible framework for agronomic adaptation of VLMs, and enables controlled comparison between base models and their domain-adapted counterparts. We constructed a dataset comprising 385 digital images and more than 3,000 benchmark samples spanning key plant science domains including disease, pest control, weed management, and yield. The benchmark can assess diverse capabilities including visual expertise, quantitative reasoning, and multi-step agronomic reasoning. A total of 11 state-of-the-art VLMs were evaluated. The results indicate that task-specific fine-tuning leads to substantial improvement in accuracy, with models such as Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-30B achieving up to 78%. At the same time, gains from model scaling diminish beyond a certain capacity, generalization across soybean and cotton remains uneven, and quantitative as well as biologically grounded reasoning continue to pose substantial challenges. These findings suggest that PlantXpert can serve as a foundation for assessing evidence-grounded agronomic reasoning and for advancing multimodal model development in plant science.

AI.tldr: 开发了PlantXpert基准测试，用于评估多模态模型在作物表型分析中的表现，发现特定任务微调能显著提升准确性，但模型扩展收益有限，跨作物泛化能力不均，定量和生物推理仍是挑战。
AI.motivation: 作物遗传改良需要高通量、有效的表型分析，传统方法依赖人工。虽然多模态基础模型（特别是视觉语言模型）使自动化表型分析成为可能，但植物科学领域对基础模型提出了特殊挑战：需要领域专业知识、细粒度视觉解释以及复杂的生物和农艺推理能力。
AI.method: 开发了PlantXpert基准测试，这是一个基于证据的多模态推理基准，专门针对大豆和棉花表型分析。构建了包含385张数字图像和3000多个基准样本的数据集，涵盖病害、害虫控制、杂草管理和产量等关键植物科学领域。评估了11个最先进的视觉语言模型，包括Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-30B等。
AI.result: 特定任务微调显著提高了模型准确性，Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-30B模型准确率最高达到78%。然而，模型规模超过一定容量后收益递减，大豆和棉花之间的泛化能力不均，定量推理和基于生物学的推理仍然是重大挑战。
AI.conclusion: PlantXpert可以作为评估基于证据的农艺推理能力的基础，并推动植物科学领域多模态模型的发展。该基准为VLMs的农艺适应提供了结构化和可复现的框架，支持基础模型与其领域适应版本之间的受控比较。

title: Dyadic Partnership(DP): A Missing Link Towards Full Autonomy in Medical Robotics
summary: For the past decades medical robotic solutions were mostly based on the concept of tele-manipulation. While their design was extremely intelligent, allowing for better access, improved dexterity, reduced tremor, and improved imaging, their intelligence was limited. They therefore left cognition and decision making to the surgeon. As medical robotics advances towards high-level autonomy, the scientific community needs to explore the required pathway towards partial and full autonomy. Here, we introduce the concept of Dyadic Partnership(DP), a new paradigm in which robots and clinicians engage in intelligent, expert interaction and collaboration. The Dyadic Partners would discuss and agree on decisions and actions during their dynamic and interactive collaboration relying also on intuitive advanced media using generative AI, such as a world model, and advanced multi-modal visualization. This article outlines the foundational components needed to enable such systems, including foundation models for clinical intelligence, multi-modal intent recognition, co-learning frameworks, advanced visualization, and explainable, trust-aware interaction. We further discuss key challenges such as data scarcity, lack of standardization, and ethical acceptance. Dyadic partnership is introduced and is positioned as a powerful yet achievable, acceptable milestone offering a promising pathway toward safer, more intuitive collaboration and a gradual transition to full autonomy across diverse clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"二元伙伴关系"新范式，让机器人与临床医生进行智能协作，通过生成AI和多模态可视化实现决策共识，作为迈向完全自主的可行里程碑。
AI.motivation: 传统医疗机器人主要基于遥操作概念，虽然设计智能但认知和决策仍依赖外科医生。随着医疗机器人向高级自主性发展，需要探索实现部分和完全自主的路径。
AI.method: 引入二元伙伴关系范式，机器人与临床医生进行智能专家交互协作，使用生成AI（如世界模型）和多模态可视化，共同讨论并达成决策共识。
AI.result: 提出实现此类系统所需的基础组件：临床智能基础模型、多模态意图识别、共同学习框架、高级可视化、可解释的信任感知交互。
AI.conclusion: 二元伙伴关系是一个强大且可实现、可接受的里程碑，为更安全、更直观的协作提供了有前景的路径，并促进向完全自主的渐进过渡。

title: Trust Your Memory: Verifiable Control of Smart Homes through Reinforcement Learning with Multi-dimensional Rewards
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a key foundation for enabling personalized smart home experiences. While existing studies have explored how smart home assistants understand user queries to control devices in real time, their ability to perform memory-driven device control remains challenging from both evaluation and methodological perspectives. In terms of evaluation, existing benchmarks either focus on immediate device control or general open-domain memory retrieval tasks, and therefore cannot effectively evaluate a model's ability to perform memory-driven device control. Methodologically, while memory-driven device control can be approached using Reinforcement Learning, conventional RL methods generally rely on outcome-based supervision (i.e., whether the final task is achieved). This lack of intermediate feedback can lead to sub-optimal performance or local failures in fine-grained memory management tasks (adding, updating, deleting, and utilizing). To address these issues, we first release MemHomeLife, built from anonymized real-world long-term user interaction logs. To enable more fine-grained evaluation of different memory-related subtasks, we further construct MemHome, the first benchmark designed to systematically evaluate memory-driven device control in smart home scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对智能家居中基于记忆的设备控制问题，提出了MemHomeLife数据集和MemHome基准测试，以解决现有评估方法不足和传统强化学习方法缺乏中间反馈的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居助手主要关注实时设备控制，但在基于记忆的设备控制方面存在评估和方法上的挑战。现有基准测试要么关注即时设备控制，要么关注通用开放域记忆检索，无法有效评估模型在记忆驱动设备控制方面的能力。传统强化学习方法缺乏中间反馈，导致在细粒度记忆管理任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 1. 从匿名化的真实世界长期用户交互日志中构建MemHomeLife数据集；2. 创建MemHome基准测试，这是首个专门用于系统评估智能家居场景中记忆驱动设备控制的基准测试。
AI.result: 提出了MemHomeLife数据集和MemHome基准测试，为智能家居记忆驱动设备控制提供了专门的评估框架，能够更细粒度地评估不同记忆相关子任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了智能家居领域记忆驱动设备控制的评估空白，通过构建专门的数据集和基准测试，为未来研究提供了重要的评估工具和方法基础。

title: Does Your VFM Speak Plant? The Botanical Grammar of Vision Foundation Models for Object Detection
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) offer the promise of zero-shot object detection without task-specific training data, yet their performance in complex agricultural scenes remains highly sensitive to text prompt construction. We present a systematic prompt optimization framework evaluating four open-vocabulary detectors -- YOLO World, SAM3, Grounding DINO, and OWLv2 -- for cowpea flower and pod detection across synthetic and real field imagery. We decompose prompts into eight axes and conduct one-factor-at-a-time analysis followed by combinatorial optimization, revealing that models respond divergently to prompt structure: conditions that optimize one architecture can collapse another. Applying model-specific combinatorial prompts yields substantial gains over a naive species-name baseline, including +0.357 mAP@0.5 for YOLO World and +0.362 mAP@0.5 for OWLv2 on synthetic cowpea flower data. To evaluate cross-task generalization, we use an LLM to translate the discovered axis structure to a morphologically distinct target -- cowpea pods -- and compare against prompting using the discovered optimal structures from synthetic flower data. Crucially, prompt structures optimized exclusively on synthetic data transfer effectively to real-world fields: synthetic-pipeline prompts match or exceed those discovered on labeled real data for the majority of model-object combinations (flower: 0.374 vs. 0.353 for YOLO World; pod: 0.429 vs. 0.371 for SAM3). Our findings demonstrate that prompt engineering can substantially close the gap between zero-shot VFMs and supervised detectors without requiring manual annotation, and that optimal prompts are model-specific, non-obvious, and transferable across domains.

AI.tldr: 系统化提示词优化框架显著提升视觉基础模型在农业场景的零样本检测性能，发现最优提示词具有模型特异性且可跨域迁移
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型在复杂农业场景中的零样本检测性能对文本提示词构建高度敏感，需要系统化优化方法来提升检测效果
AI.method: 提出系统化提示词优化框架，将提示词分解为八个维度，对四种开放词汇检测器进行单因素分析和组合优化，并使用LLM将优化结构迁移到形态不同的目标
AI.result: 模型特异性组合提示词相比朴素物种名称基线显著提升性能，合成数据优化的提示词结构能有效迁移到真实田间数据，多数情况下匹配或超过真实数据优化的效果
AI.conclusion: 提示词工程能显著缩小零样本视觉基础模型与监督检测器之间的差距，最优提示词具有模型特异性、非直观性且可跨域迁移，无需人工标注

title: Safe Human-to-Humanoid Motion Imitation Using Control Barrier Functions
summary: Ensuring operational safety is critical for human-to-humanoid motion imitation. This paper presents a vision-based framework that enables a humanoid robot to imitate human movements while avoiding collisions. Human skeletal keypoints are captured by a single camera and converted into joint angles for motion retargeting. Safety is enforced through a Control Barrier Function (CBF) layer formulated as a Quadratic Program (QP), which filters imitation commands to prevent both self-collisions and human-robot collisions. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for real-time collision-aware motion imitation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉的人形机器人运动模仿框架，通过控制屏障函数确保碰撞避免安全
AI.motivation: 人形机器人模仿人类运动时，确保操作安全至关重要，需要避免自碰撞和人机碰撞
AI.method: 使用单摄像头捕捉人体骨骼关键点，转换为关节角度进行运动重定向；通过控制屏障函数（CBF）层作为二次规划问题，过滤模仿指令以防止碰撞
AI.result: 仿真结果验证了该框架在实时碰撞感知运动模仿中的有效性
AI.conclusion: 提出的视觉框架能够实现安全的人形机器人运动模仿，通过CBF确保碰撞避免

title: Learning from Emptiness: De-biasing Listwise Rerankers with Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration
summary: Generative listwise reranking leverages global context for superior retrieval but is plagued by intrinsic position bias, where models exhibit structural sensitivity to input order independent of relevance. Existing mitigations present a dilemma: inference-time aggregation incurs prohibitive latency, while training-based methods often fail to eradicate ingrained priors, particularly in compact models. To resolve this dilemma, we propose CapCal (Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration), a training-free framework that mechanically decouples positional bias from ranking decisions. By estimating the bias distribution via content-free placeholders, CapCal rectifies output logits through an entropy-adaptive contrastive mechanism. Evaluations across 10 benchmarks confirm that CapCal achieves superior performance among training-free methods while preserving single-pass efficiency. Notably, it unlocks the latent potential of lightweight models (e.g., 0.6B), delivering absolute NDCG gains exceeding 10 points and outperforming both permutation-based aggregation and data-augmentation baselines.

AI.tldr: CapCal：一种无需训练的位置偏差校准框架，通过内容无关占位符估计偏差分布，使用熵自适应对比机制修正输出，提升轻量级模型检索性能
AI.motivation: 生成式列表重排利用全局上下文提升检索效果，但存在内在位置偏差问题——模型对输入顺序有结构性敏感，与相关性无关。现有方法面临两难：推理时聚合方法延迟过高，而训练方法难以消除深度嵌入的先验偏差，特别是在紧凑模型中
AI.method: 提出CapCal（内容无关概率校准），这是一个无需训练的框架，通过内容无关占位符估计位置偏差分布，然后使用熵自适应对比机制从排序决策中机械地解耦位置偏差
AI.result: 在10个基准测试中，CapCal在无需训练方法中表现最优，同时保持单次推理效率。特别地，它解锁了轻量级模型（如0.6B）的潜在能力，NDCG绝对增益超过10个百分点，优于基于排列的聚合和数据增强基线方法
AI.conclusion: CapCal有效解决了生成式列表重排中的位置偏差问题，无需额外训练即可显著提升模型性能，特别是对于轻量级模型，在保持效率的同时实现了显著的性能提升

title: BLPR: Robust License Plate Recognition under Viewpoint and Illumination Variations via Confidence-Driven VLM Fallback
summary: Robust license plate recognition in unconstrained environments remains a significant challenge, particularly in underrepresented regions with limited data availability and unique visual characteristics, such as Bolivia. Recognition accuracy in real-world conditions is often degraded by factors such as illumination changes and viewpoint distortion. To address these challenges, we introduce BLPR, a novel deep learning-based License Plate Detection and Recognition (LPDR) framework specifically designed for Bolivian license plates. The proposed system follows a two-stage pipeline where a YOLO-based detector is pretrained on synthetic data generated in Blender to simulate extreme perspectives and lighting conditions, and subsequently fine-tuned on street-level data collected in La Paz, Bolivia. Detected plates are geometrically rectified and passed to a character recognition model. To improve robustness under ambiguous scenarios, a lightweight vision-language model (Gemma3 4B) is selectively triggered as a confidence-based fallback mechanism. The proposed framework further leverages synthetic-to-real domain adaptation to improve robustness under diverse real-world conditions. We also introduce the first publicly available Bolivian LPDR dataset, enabling evaluation under diverse viewpoint and illumination conditions. The system achieves a character-level recognition accuracy of 89.6% on real-world data, demonstrating its effectiveness for deployment in challenging urban environments. Our project is publicly available at https://github.com/EdwinTSalcedo/BLPR.

AI.tldr: 提出BLPR框架，专门用于玻利维亚车牌识别，结合YOLO检测器、几何校正、字符识别和基于置信度的Gemma3 4B视觉语言模型回退机制，在真实数据上达到89.6%字符级准确率。
AI.motivation: 在玻利维亚等数据稀缺、视觉特征独特的欠发达地区，车牌识别面临光照变化、视角扭曲等挑战，现有方法在非约束环境下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：1) 使用Blender生成合成数据预训练YOLO检测器，再在玻利维亚街头数据上微调；2) 检测后几何校正，字符识别；3) 基于置信度触发Gemma3 4B视觉语言模型作为回退机制；4) 合成到真实域适应提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据上达到89.6%字符级识别准确率，并发布了首个公开的玻利维亚车牌检测识别数据集。
AI.conclusion: BLPR框架在挑战性城市环境中有效，通过合成数据预训练、域适应和视觉语言模型回退机制，提升了玻利维亚车牌识别的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: DA-PTQ: Drift-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong potential for embodied AI, yet their deployment on resource-limited robots remains challenging due to high memory and computational demands. While Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides an efficient solution, directly applying PTQ to VLAs often results in severe performance degradation during sequential control. We identify temporal error accumulation as a key factor, where quantization perturbations at the vision-language-to-action interface are progressively amplified, leading to kinematic drift in executed trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Drift-Aware Post-Training Quantization (DA-PTQ), which formulates quantization as a drift-aware optimization problem over sequential decision processes. DA-PTQ consists of two components: (1) Cross-Space Representation Compensation, which mitigates structured distortions between multimodal representations and action space to improve action consistency, and (2) Motion-Driven Mixed-Precision Allocation, which assigns bit-widths by minimizing trajectory-level motion errors. Extensive experiments show that DA-PTQ significantly reduces kinematic drift and achieves comparable performance to full-precision models under low-bit settings, enabling practical deployment of VLAs on resource-limited robotic platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出DA-PTQ方法，通过漂移感知优化解决VLA模型量化中的时间误差累积问题，显著减少运动轨迹漂移，使资源受限机器人能够部署低比特VLA模型。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型在资源受限机器人上部署困难，传统后训练量化方法会导致严重的性能退化，特别是时间误差累积导致运动轨迹漂移。
AI.method: 提出漂移感知后训练量化(DA-PTQ)，包含两个组件：跨空间表示补偿（减少多模态表示与动作空间的结构失真）和运动驱动混合精度分配（通过最小化轨迹级运动误差分配比特宽度）。
AI.result: 实验表明DA-PTQ显著减少运动漂移，在低比特设置下达到与全精度模型相当的性能，实现VLA模型在资源受限机器人平台的实际部署。
AI.conclusion: DA-PTQ有效解决了VLA模型量化中的时间误差累积问题，为资源受限机器人部署高性能视觉-语言-动作模型提供了实用解决方案。

title: SpecMoE: A Fast and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference via Self-Assisted Speculative Decoding
comment: This is an extended version of our work, which is accepted for publication at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC), 2026
summary: The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate the rising computational costs of large language models (LLMs) by selectively activating parameters. However, its high memory requirements and sub-optimal parameter efficiency pose significant challenges for efficient deployment. Although CPU-offloaded MoE inference systems have been proposed in the literature, they offer limited efficiency, particularly for large batch sizes. In this work, we propose SpecMoE, a memory-efficient MoE inference system based on our self-assisted speculative decoding algorithm. SpecMoE demonstrates the effectiveness of applying speculative decoding to MoE inference without requiring additional model training or fine-tuning. Our system improves inference throughput by up to $4.30\times$, while significantly reducing bandwidth requirements of both memory and interconnect on memory-constrained systems.

AI.tldr: SpecMoE：基于自辅助推测解码的内存高效MoE推理系统，无需额外训练即可提升推理吞吐量4.3倍
AI.motivation: 混合专家（MoE）架构虽然能降低大语言模型的计算成本，但存在内存需求高、参数效率低的问题。现有的CPU卸载MoE推理系统效率有限，特别是在大批量处理时表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出SpecMoE系统，基于自辅助推测解码算法，将推测解码技术应用于MoE推理，无需额外的模型训练或微调。
AI.result: 推理吞吐量提升高达4.30倍，同时显著降低内存受限系统中的内存和互连带宽需求。
AI.conclusion: SpecMoE展示了将推测解码应用于MoE推理的有效性，为内存受限系统提供了高效的MoE推理解决方案。

title: I Walk the Line: Examining the Role of Gestalt Continuity in Object Binding for Vision Transformers
summary: Object binding is a foundational process in visual cognition, during which low-level perceptual features are joined into object representations. Binding has been considered a fundamental challenge for neural networks, and a major milestone on the way to artificial models with flexible visual intelligence. Recently, several investigations have demonstrated evidence that binding mechanisms emerge in pretrained vision models, enabling them to associate portions of an image that contain an object. The question remains: how are these models binding objects together? In this work, we investigate whether vision models rely on the principle of Gestalt continuity to perform object binding, over and above other principles like similarity and proximity. Using synthetic datasets, we demonstrate that binding probes are sensitive to continuity across a wide range of pretrained vision transformers. Next, we uncover particular attention heads that track continuity, and show that these heads generalize across datasets. Finally, we ablate these attention heads, and show that they often contribute to producing representations that encode object binding.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了预训练视觉Transformer模型是否依赖格式塔连续性原则进行物体绑定，发现特定注意力头对连续性敏感，且这些头对物体绑定表征有贡献。
AI.motivation: 物体绑定是视觉认知的基础过程，将低级特征组合成物体表征。虽然已有研究表明预训练视觉模型能实现物体绑定，但其具体机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探究模型是否依赖格式塔连续性原则（而非相似性或邻近性）来完成物体绑定。
AI.method: 1. 使用合成数据集测试多种预训练视觉Transformer的绑定探针对连续性的敏感性；2. 识别追踪连续性的特定注意力头，并验证其跨数据集泛化能力；3. 通过消融实验评估这些注意力头对物体绑定表征的贡献。
AI.result: 1. 绑定探针对连续性敏感，广泛存在于多种预训练视觉Transformer中；2. 发现了专门追踪连续性的特定注意力头，且这些头具有跨数据集泛化能力；3. 消融实验表明这些注意力头对产生编码物体绑定的表征有重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉Transformer模型确实依赖格式塔连续性原则进行物体绑定，特定注意力头专门处理连续性信息，这些机制是模型实现物体绑定的关键组成部分。

title: Optimal Kinodynamic Motion Planning Through Anytime Bidirectional Heuristic Search with Tight Termination Condition
summary: This paper introduces Bidirectional Tight Informed Trees (BTIT*), an asymptotically optimal kinodynamic sampling-based motion planning algorithm that integrates an anytime bidirectional heuristic search (Bi-HS) and ensures the \emph{meet-in-the-middle} property (MMP) and optimality (MM-optimality). BTIT* is the first anytime MEET-style algorithm to utilize termination conditions that are efficient to evaluate and enable early termination \emph{on-the-fly} in batch-wise sampling-based motion planning. Experiments show that BTIT* achieves strongly faster time-to-first-solution and improved convergence than representative \emph{non-lazy} informed batch planners on two kinodynamic benchmarks: a 4D double-integrator model and a 10D linearized Quadrotor. The source code is available here.

AI.tldr: BTIT*是一种渐进最优的动力学采样运动规划算法，结合双向启发式搜索和"中间相遇"特性，实现快速首次解和高效收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有动力学采样运动规划算法在首次解时间和收敛速度方面存在不足，需要一种能够快速找到可行解并渐进收敛到最优解的高效算法。
AI.method: 提出BTIT*算法，整合双向启发式搜索(Bi-HS)，确保中间相遇特性和最优性，采用易于评估的终止条件实现批处理采样规划中的即时提前终止。
AI.result: 实验表明，BTIT*在4D双积分器模型和10D线性化四旋翼两个动力学基准测试中，相比代表性非懒惰启发式批处理规划器，实现了更快的首次解时间和改进的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: BTIT*是首个采用易于评估终止条件的即时中间相遇风格算法，在动力学运动规划中表现出优越性能，代码已开源。

title: Inductive Reasoning for Temporal Knowledge Graphs with Emerging Entities
summary: Reasoning on Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGs) is essential for predicting future events and time-aware facts. While existing methods are effective at capturing relational dynamics, their performance is limited by a closed-world assumption, which fails to account for emerging entities not present in the training. Notably, these entities continuously join the network without historical interactions. Empirical study reveals that emerging entities are widespread in TKGs, comprising roughly 25\% of all entities. The absence of historical interactions of these entities leads to significant performance degradation in reasoning tasks. Whereas, we observe that entities with semantic similarities often exhibit comparable interaction histories, suggesting the presence of transferable temporal patterns. Inspired by this insight, we propose TransFIR (Transferable Inductive Reasoning), a novel framework that leverages historical interaction sequences from semantically similar known entities to support inductive reasoning. Specifically, we propose a codebook-based classifier that categorizes emerging entities into latent semantic clusters, allowing them to adopt reasoning patterns from similar entities. Experimental results demonstrate that TransFIR outperforms all baselines in reasoning on emerging entities, achieving an average improvement of 28.6% in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) across multiple datasets. The implementations are available at https://github.com/zhaodazhuang2333/TransFIR.

AI.tldr: TransFIR是一个用于时序知识图谱推理的新框架，专门处理训练集中未出现的新兴实体，通过语义相似性转移已知实体的历史交互模式，显著提升了新兴实体的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时序知识图谱推理方法基于封闭世界假设，无法处理训练集中未出现的新兴实体。实证研究发现约25%的实体是新兴实体，缺乏历史交互导致推理性能显著下降。但观察到语义相似的实体往往具有可比较的交互历史，表明存在可转移的时序模式。
AI.method: 提出TransFIR框架，利用基于码本的分类器将新兴实体分类到潜在语义簇中，使其能够从语义相似的已知实体中采用推理模式。通过转移已知实体的历史交互序列来支持归纳推理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明TransFIR在所有新兴实体推理基准上均优于基线方法，在多个数据集上的平均MRR提升了28.6%。
AI.conclusion: TransFIR通过利用语义相似性转移时序模式，有效解决了时序知识图谱中新兴实体的推理问题，显著提升了归纳推理性能，为开放世界时序知识图谱推理提供了新思路。

title: Cross-Cultural Value Awareness in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: The rapid adoption of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in recent years has been accompanied by growing fairness concerns due to their propensity to reinforce harmful societal stereotypes. While significant attention has been paid to such fairness concerns in the context of social biases, relatively little prior work has examined the presence of stereotypes in LVLMs related to cultural contexts such as religion, nationality, and socioeconomic status. In this work, we aim to narrow this gap by investigating how cultural contexts depicted in images influence the judgments LVLMs make about a person's moral, ethical, and political values. We conduct a multi-dimensional analysis of such value judgments in five popular LVLMs using counterfactual image sets, which depict the same person across different cultural contexts. Our evaluation framework diagnoses LVLM awareness of cultural value differences through the use of Moral Foundations Theory, lexical analyses, and the sensitivity of generated values to depicted cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 研究调查大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)中与文化背景相关的刻板印象，特别是宗教、国籍和社会经济地位如何影响模型对人的道德、伦理和政治价值观的判断。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究关注LVLMs中的社会偏见问题，但较少关注与文化背景相关的刻板印象。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究图像中的文化背景如何影响LVLMs对人的价值观判断。
AI.method: 使用反事实图像集（描绘同一人在不同文化背景下）对五种流行LVLMs进行多维分析，结合道德基础理论、词汇分析和生成值对文化背景的敏感性来评估模型。
AI.result: 论文提出了一个评估框架来诊断LVLMs对文化价值差异的认知程度，但具体结果未在摘要中说明。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了LVLMs中文化刻板印象研究的空白，为理解和评估模型中的文化偏见提供了系统框架。

title: Micro-Dexterity in Biological Micromanipulation: Embodiment, Perception, and Control
summary: Microscale manipulation has advanced substantially in controlled locomotion and targeted transport, yet many biomedical applications require precise and adaptive interaction with biological micro-objects. At these scales, manipulation is realized through three main classes of platforms: embodied microrobots that physically interact as mobile agents, field-mediated systems that generate contactless trapping or manipulation forces, and externally actuated end-effectors that interact through remotely driven physical tools. Unlike macroscale manipulators, these systems function in fluidic, confined, and surface-dominated environments characterized by negligible inertia, dominant interfacial forces, and soft, heterogeneous, and fragile targets. Consequently, classical assumptions of dexterous manipulation, including rigid-body contact, stable grasping, and rich proprioceptive feedback, become difficult to maintain. This review introduces micro-dexterity as a framework for analyzing biological micromanipulation through the coupled roles of embodiment, perception, and control. We examine how classical manipulation primitives, including pushing, reorientation, grasping, and cooperative manipulation, are reformulated at the microscale; compare the architectures that enable them, from contact-based micromanipulators to contactless field-mediated systems and cooperative multi-agent platforms; and review the perception and control strategies required for task execution. We identify the current dexterity gap between laboratory demonstrations and clinically relevant biological manipulation, and outline key challenges for future translation.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出"微灵巧性"框架，分析生物微操作中的体现、感知与控制耦合作用，比较接触式、非接触式和协作式平台，识别实验室演示与临床应用间的灵巧性差距。
AI.motivation: 生物医学应用需要与生物微对象进行精确自适应交互，但微尺度操作面临流体环境、界面力主导、目标脆弱等挑战，传统灵巧操作假设难以维持，需要新的分析框架。
AI.method: 提出微灵巧性框架，分析体现、感知与控制的耦合作用；比较三类平台：实体微机器人、场介导系统、外部驱动末端执行器；研究推动、重定向、抓取、协作等操作原语在微尺度的重新表述。
AI.result: 系统分析了微尺度操作的技术现状，识别了实验室演示与临床应用间的灵巧性差距，比较了不同平台架构的优缺点，总结了当前感知与控制策略。
AI.conclusion: 需要弥合微操作实验室演示与临床生物操作间的差距，未来研究应关注微灵巧性框架下的体现、感知与控制集成，解决微尺度特有的环境与目标挑战。

title: MAVEN-T: Multi-Agent enVironment-aware Enhanced Neural Trajectory predictor with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Trajectory prediction remains a critical yet challenging component in autonomous driving systems, requiring sophisticated reasoning capabilities while meeting strict real-time deployment constraints. While knowledge distillation has demonstrated effectiveness in model compression, existing approaches often fail to preserve complex decision-making capabilities, particularly in dynamic multi-agent scenarios. This paper introduces MAVEN-T, a teacher-student framework that achieves state-of-the-art trajectory prediction through complementary architectural co-design and progressive distillation. The teacher employs hybrid attention mechanisms for maximum representational capacity, while the student uses efficient architectures optimized for deployment. Knowledge transfer is performed via multi-granular distillation with adaptive curriculum learning that dynamically adjusts complexity based on performance. Importantly, the framework incorporates reinforcement learning to overcome the imitation ceiling of traditional distillation, enabling the student to verify, refine, and optimize teacher knowledge through dynamic environmental interaction, potentially achieving more robust decision-making than the teacher itself. Extensive experiments on NGSIM and highD datasets demonstrate 6.2x parameter compression and 3.7x inference speedup while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy, establishing a new paradigm for deploying sophisticated reasoning models under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: MAVEN-T是一个用于轨迹预测的师生框架，通过架构协同设计和渐进式蒸馏，在保持SOTA精度的同时实现6.2倍参数压缩和3.7倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中的轨迹预测需要在满足实时部署约束的同时具备复杂推理能力。现有知识蒸馏方法在动态多智能体场景中难以保持复杂的决策能力，需要新的方法来平衡性能和效率。
AI.method: 提出MAVEN-T师生框架：教师模型使用混合注意力机制获得最大表示能力，学生模型使用高效架构优化部署。通过多粒度蒸馏和自适应课程学习进行知识转移，并引入强化学习来突破传统蒸馏的模仿上限，让学生通过环境交互验证和优化教师知识。
AI.result: 在NGSIM和highD数据集上实现6.2倍参数压缩和3.7倍推理加速，同时保持最先进的预测精度，为资源受限环境下部署复杂推理模型建立了新范式。
AI.conclusion: MAVEN-T通过架构协同设计和渐进蒸馏，结合强化学习突破传统蒸馏限制，实现了在保持高性能的同时显著提升效率，为自动驾驶轨迹预测的实时部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: Unmixing-Guided Spatial-Spectral Mamba with Clustering Tokens for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Although hyperspectral image (HSI) classification is critical for supporting various environmental applications, it is a challenging task due to the spectral-mixture effect, the spatial-spectral heterogeneity and the difficulty to preserve class boundaries and details. This letter presents a novel unmixing-guided spatial-spectral Mamba with clustering tokens for improved HSI classification, with the following contributions. First, to disentangle the spectral mixture effect in HSI for improved pattern discovery, we design a novel spectral unmixing network that not only automatically learns endmembers and abundance maps from HSI but also accounts for endmember variabilities. Second, to generate Mamba token sequences, based on the clusters defined by abundance maps, we design an efficient Top-\textit{K} token selection strategy to adaptively sequence the tokens for improved representational capability. Third, to improve spatial-spectral feature learning and detail preservation, based on the Top-\textit{K} token sequences, we design a novel unmixing-guided spatial-spectral Mamba module that greatly improves traditional Mamba models in terms of token learning and sequencing. Fourth, to learn simultaneously the endmember-abundance patterns and classification labels, a multi-task scheme is designed for model supervision, leading to a new unmixing-classification framework that outputs not only accurate classification maps but also a comprehensive spectral-library and abundance maps. Comparative experiments on four HSI datasets demonstrate that our model can greatly outperform the other state-of-the-art approaches.
