Our results suggest that counting failures in VLMs stem not only from visual perception limits, but also from the underuse of visual evidence during language-stage reasoning. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/leduy99/-CVPRW26-Modality-Attention-Share.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行为与机制分析研究视觉语言模型的计数能力，发现计数失败不仅源于视觉感知限制，更源于语言推理阶段对视觉证据的利用不足，并提出轻量级干预方法Modality Attention Share来改善这一问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在复杂多模态推理任务上表现出色，但在简单的物体计数等基础技能上仍然失败。现有评估大多只关注最终输出，无法揭示模型内部失败的具体原因。
AI.method: 1) 提出COUNTINGTRICKS评估套件，包含简单形状计数案例，用于在不同patch布局和对抗提示条件下暴露漏洞；2) 使用注意力分析和组件探测技术；3) 提出Modality Attention Share干预方法，强制模型在答案生成阶段保持最低限度的视觉注意力。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 计数相关的视觉证据在模态投影阶段最强，但在后续语言层显著退化；2) 模型在语言层更容易受到文本先验的影响；3) Modality Attention Share干预方法能够改善计数性能，表明视觉证据在语言推理阶段的利用不足是计数失败的重要原因。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的计数失败不仅源于视觉感知限制，更关键的是在语言推理阶段对视觉证据的利用不足。通过轻量级干预强制保持视觉注意力可以改善计数性能，这为理解VLM内部机制和改进模型设计提供了重要见解。

title: Agentic Driving Coach: Robustness and Determinism of Agentic AI-Powered Human-in-the-Loop Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Foundation models, including large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used for human-in-the-loop (HITL) cyber-physical systems (CPS) because foundation model-based AI agents can potentially interact with both the physical environments and human users. However, the unpredictable behavior of human users and AI agents, in addition to the dynamically changing physical environments, leads to uncontrollable nondeterminism. To address this urgent challenge of enabling agentic AI-powered HITL CPS, we propose a reactor-model-of-computation (MoC)-based approach, realized by the open-source Lingua Franca (LF) framework. We also carry out a concrete case study using the agentic driving coach as an application of HITL CPS. By evaluating the LF-based agentic HITL CPS, we identify practical challenges in reintroducing determinism into such agentic HITL CPS and present pathways to address them.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用反应器模型计算和Lingua Franca框架来解决基于基础模型的人机协同网络物理系统中的不可控非确定性挑战
AI.motivation: 基础模型（包括大语言模型）越来越多地用于人机协同网络物理系统，但人类用户和AI代理的不可预测行为以及动态变化的物理环境导致了不可控的非确定性，需要解决这一紧迫挑战
AI.method: 提出基于反应器模型计算的方法，通过开源Lingua Franca框架实现，并以智能驾驶教练作为人机协同网络物理系统的具体案例进行研究
AI.result: 通过评估基于LF的智能人机协同网络物理系统，识别了在此类系统中重新引入确定性所面临的实际挑战，并提出了解决这些挑战的途径
AI.conclusion: 反应器模型计算和Lingua Franca框架为解决基于基础模型的人机协同网络物理系统中的非确定性问题提供了有效方法，但仍需进一步解决实际挑战

title: ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables; accepted at EuroMLSys '26 (6th Workshop on Machine Learning and Systems, co-located with EuroSys 2026)
summary: Stateful tool-using LLM agents treat the context window as working memory, yet today's agent harnesses manage residency and durability as best-effort, causing recurring failures: lost state after compaction, bypassed flushes on reset, and destructive writeback. We present \textsc{ClawVM}, a virtual memory layer that manages state as typed pages with minimum-fidelity invariants, multi-resolution representations under a token budget, and validated writeback at every lifecycle boundary. Because the harness already assembles prompts, mediates tools, and observes lifecycle events, it is the natural enforcement point; placing the contract there makes residency and durability deterministic and auditable. Across synthetic workloads, 12 real-session traces, and adversarial stress tests, \textsc{ClawVM} eliminates all policy-controllable faults whenever the minimum-fidelity set fits within the token budget, confirmed by an offline oracle, and adds median <50 microseconds of policy-engine overhead per turn.

AI.tldr: ClawVM是一个为LLM智能体设计的虚拟内存层，通过类型化页面管理状态，确保状态持久性和确定性，消除策略可控的故障。
AI.motivation: 当前基于状态的工具使用LLM智能体将上下文窗口作为工作内存，但现有的代理框架在状态驻留和持久性方面采用尽力而为的方式，导致频繁故障：压缩后状态丢失、重置时绕过刷新、以及破坏性写回。
AI.method: ClawVM是一个虚拟内存层，通过类型化页面管理状态，具有最小保真度不变性、在令牌预算下的多分辨率表示，以及在每个生命周期边界进行验证的写回。由于代理框架已经负责组装提示、协调工具和观察生命周期事件，因此它是自然的执行点。
AI.result: 在合成工作负载、12个真实会话跟踪和对抗性压力测试中，ClawVM消除了所有策略可控的故障（只要最小保真度集在令牌预算内），并通过离线验证器确认，每轮策略引擎开销中位数小于50微秒。
AI.conclusion: 将状态管理合约放置在代理框架中，使状态驻留和持久性变得确定性和可审计，有效解决了当前LLM智能体状态管理的核心问题。

title: Intra-finger Variability of Diffusion-based Latent Fingerprint Generation
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Foundation and Generative Models in Biometrics (FoundGen-Bio), held in conjunction with CVPR 2026
summary: The primary goal of this work is to systematically evaluate the intra-finger variability of synthetic fingerprints (particularly latent prints) generated using a state-of-the-art diffusion model. Specifically, we focus on enhancing the latent style diversity of the generative model by constructing a comprehensive \textit{latent style bank} curated from seven diverse datasets, which enables the precise synthesis of latent prints with over 40 distinct styles encapsulating different surfaces and processing techniques. We also implement a semi-automated framework to understand the integrity of fingerprint ridges and minutiae in the generated impressions. Our analysis indicates that though the generation process largely preserves the identity, a small number of local inconsistencies (addition and removal of minutiae) are introduced, especially when there are poor quality regions in the reference image. Furthermore, mismatch between the reference image and the chosen style embedding that guides the generation process introduces global inconsistencies in the form of hallucinated ridge patterns. These insights highlight the limitations of existing synthetic fingerprint generators and the need to further improve these models to simultaneously enhance both diversity and identity consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了扩散模型生成的合成指纹（特别是潜指纹）的指纹内变异性，发现生成过程虽然大体保持身份一致性，但存在局部细节不一致和全局模式幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有合成指纹生成器在多样性和身份一致性方面存在局限性，需要系统评估扩散模型生成的合成指纹的指纹内变异性，以改进这些模型。
AI.method: 通过构建包含7个不同数据集的潜风格库，实现40多种不同风格的潜指纹精确合成；采用半自动化框架分析生成指纹的脊线和细节完整性。
AI.result: 生成过程大体保持身份一致性，但在参考图像质量较差的区域会出现局部细节不一致（细节点的增减）；参考图像与所选风格嵌入不匹配会导致全局脊线模式幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 现有合成指纹生成器需要进一步改进，以同时增强多样性和身份一致性，当前模型在生成过程中会引入局部和全局不一致性。

title: Beyond Monologue: Interactive Talking-Listening Avatar Generation with Conversational Audio Context-Aware Kernels
summary: Audio-driven human video generation has achieved remarkable success in monologue scenarios, largely driven by advancements in powerful video generation foundation models. Moving beyond monologues, authentic human communication is inherently a full-duplex interactive process, requiring virtual agents not only to articulate their own speech but also to react naturally to incoming conversational audio. Most existing methods simply extend conventional audio-driven paradigms to listening scenarios. However, relying on strict frame-to-frame alignment renders the model's response to long-range conversational dynamics rigid, whereas directly introducing global attention catastrophically degrades lip synchronization. Recognizing the unique temporal Scale Discrepancy between talking and listening behaviors, we introduce a multi-head Gaussian kernel to explicitly inject this physical intuition into the model as a progressive temporal inductive bias. Building upon this, we construct a full-duplex interactive virtual agent capable of simultaneously processing dual-stream audio inputs for both talking and listening. Furthermore, we introduce a rigorously cleaned Talking-Listening dataset VoxHear featuring perfectly decoupled speech and background audio tracks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach successfully fuses strong temporal alignment with deep contextual semantics, setting a new state-of-the-art for generating highly natural and responsive full-duplex interactive digital humans. The project page is available at https://warmcongee.github.io/beyond-monologue/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全双工交互式虚拟代理，能够同时处理说话和倾听的双流音频输入，通过多头高斯核引入时间尺度差异的物理直觉，解决了现有方法在长程对话动态响应和唇部同步之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动的人类视频生成方法主要针对独白场景，而真实的人类交流是全双工交互过程，需要虚拟代理既能表达自己的语音，又能对传入的对话音频做出自然反应。现有方法要么依赖严格的帧对帧对齐导致对长程对话动态响应僵化，要么引入全局注意力严重破坏唇部同步。
AI.method: 提出多头高斯核来显式注入说话和倾听行为之间的时间尺度差异作为渐进式时间归纳偏置，构建能够同时处理说话和倾听双流音频输入的全双工交互虚拟代理。同时引入了经过严格清洗的Talking-Listening数据集VoxHear，具有完美解耦的语音和背景音轨。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法成功融合了强时间对齐和深度上下文语义，在生成高度自然和响应迅速的全双工交互数字人类方面达到了新的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别说话和倾听行为之间的时间尺度差异，并显式地将这种物理直觉注入模型，本文提出的方法能够生成高度自然和响应迅速的全双工交互数字人类，超越了传统的独白场景限制。

title: U$^{2}$Flow: Uncertainty-Aware Unsupervised Optical Flow Estimation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at CVPR 2026
summary: Unsupervised optical flow methods typically lack reliable uncertainty estimation, limiting their robustness and interpretability. We propose U$^{2}$Flow, the first recurrent unsupervised framework that jointly estimates optical flow and per-pixel uncertainty. The core innovation is a decoupled learning strategy that derives uncertainty supervision from augmentation consistency via a Laplace-based maximum likelihood objective, enabling stable training without ground truth. The predicted uncertainty is further integrated into the network to guide adaptive flow refinement and dynamically modulate the regional smoothness loss. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-guided bidirectional flow fusion mechanism that enhances robustness in challenging regions. Extensive experiments on KITTI and Sintel demonstrate that U$^{2}$Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised methods while producing highly reliable uncertainty maps, validating the effectiveness of our joint estimation paradigm. The code is available at https://github.com/sunzunyi/U2FLOW.

AI.tldr: U²Flow：首个循环无监督光流框架，联合估计光流和逐像素不确定性，通过解耦学习策略和拉普拉斯最大似然目标实现稳定训练，无需真实标签。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督光流方法缺乏可靠的不确定性估计，限制了其鲁棒性和可解释性。需要一种能够同时估计光流和不确定性的无监督框架。
AI.method: 提出U²Flow框架，采用解耦学习策略：通过增强一致性推导不确定性监督，使用拉普拉斯最大似然目标实现稳定训练。将预测的不确定性集成到网络中，指导自适应光流细化和区域平滑损失动态调制。引入不确定性引导的双向光流融合机制增强挑战区域的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在KITTI和Sintel数据集上的广泛实验表明，U²Flow在无监督方法中达到最先进性能，同时产生高度可靠的不确定性图，验证了联合估计范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: U²Flow是首个能够联合估计光流和不确定性的无监督循环框架，通过解耦学习策略和不确定性引导的细化机制，在保持高性能的同时提供可靠的不确定性估计，增强了光流估计的鲁棒性和可解释性。

title: TrajOnco: a multi-agent framework for temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHR for multi-cancer early detection
summary: Accurate estimation of cancer risk from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) could support earlier detection and improved care, but modeling such complex patient trajectories remains challenging. We present TrajOnco, a training-free, multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework designed for scalable multi-cancer early detection. Using a chain-of-agents architecture with long-term memory, TrajOnco performs temporal reasoning over sequential clinical events to generate patient-level summaries, evidence-linked rationales, and predicted risk scores. We evaluated TrajOnco on de-identified Truveta EHR data across 15 cancer types using matched case-control cohorts, predicting risk of cancer diagnosis at 1 year. In zero-shot evaluation, TrajOnco achieved AUROCs of 0.64-0.80, performing comparably to supervised machine learning in a lung cancer benchmark while demonstrating better temporal reasoning than single-agent LLMs. The multi-agent design also enabled effective temporal reasoning with smaller-capacity models such as GPT-4.1-mini. The fidelity of TrajOnco's output was validated through human evaluation. Furthermore, TrajOnco's interpretable reasoning outputs can be aggregated to reveal population-level risk patterns that align with established clinical knowledge. These findings highlight the potential of multi-agent LLMs to execute interpretable temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHRs, advancing both scalable multi-cancer early detection and clinical insight generation.

AI.tldr: TrajOnco：一种基于多智能体大语言模型的免训练框架，用于从纵向电子健康记录中进行多癌症早期检测，通过时序推理生成患者风险评分和可解释的临床依据。
AI.motivation: 从纵向电子健康记录中准确估计癌症风险对于早期检测和改善护理至关重要，但建模复杂的患者轨迹仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在可扩展性和可解释性方面存在局限。
AI.method: 提出TrajOnco框架，采用免训练的多智能体大语言模型架构，具有长期记忆功能。通过智能体链结构对序列临床事件进行时序推理，生成患者级摘要、证据关联的推理依据和预测风险评分。
AI.result: 在15种癌症类型的去标识化Truveta EHR数据上进行评估，预测1年内癌症诊断风险。零样本评估显示AUROC为0.64-0.80，在肺癌基准测试中与监督机器学习相当，时序推理能力优于单智能体LLM。多智能体设计使较小容量模型（如GPT-4.1-mini）也能有效进行时序推理。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体大语言模型能够在纵向电子健康记录上执行可解释的时序推理，推进了可扩展的多癌症早期检测和临床洞察生成，其可解释的输出有助于揭示与临床知识一致的群体风险模式。

title: On The Application of Linear Attention in Multimodal Transformers
comment: Workshop on Any-to-Any Multimodal Learning (Any2Any), CVPR 2026
summary: Multimodal Transformers serve as the backbone for state-of-the-art vision-language models, yet their quadratic attention complexity remains a critical barrier to scalability. In this work, we investigate the viability of Linear Attention (LA) as a high-efficiency alternative within multimodal frameworks. By integrating LA, we reduce the computational overhead from quadratic to linear relative to sequence length while preserving competitive performance. We evaluate our approach across ViT-S/16, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16 architectures trained on the LAION-400M dataset, with validation focused on ImageNet-21K zero-shot accuracy. Our systematic evaluation demonstrates that Linear Attention not only yields significant computational savings but also adheres to the same scaling laws as standard softmax attention. These findings position Linear Attention as a robust, scalable solution for next-generation multimodal Transformers tasked with processing increasingly large and complex datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究线性注意力作为多模态Transformer的高效替代方案，将计算复杂度从二次降低到线性，同时在多个ViT架构上保持竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态Transformer作为最先进的视觉语言模型，其二次注意力复杂度成为可扩展性的关键瓶颈。需要寻找高效替代方案来处理日益增大的复杂数据集。
AI.method: 将线性注意力集成到多模态框架中，在ViT-S/16、ViT-B/16和ViT-L/16架构上使用LAION-400M数据集进行训练，通过ImageNet-21K零样本准确率进行验证。
AI.result: 线性注意力不仅显著节省计算资源，而且遵循与标准softmax注意力相同的缩放规律，在保持竞争性能的同时将计算开销从二次降低到线性。
AI.conclusion: 线性注意力是下一代多模态Transformer处理大型复杂数据集的稳健、可扩展解决方案。

title: CWCD: Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding for Structured Medical Report Generation
summary: Interpreting chest X-rays is inherently challenging due to the overlap between anatomical structures and the subtle presentation of many clinically significant pathologies, making accurate diagnosis time-consuming even for experienced radiologists. Recent radiology-focused foundation models, such as LLaVA-Rad and Maira-2, have positioned multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) at the forefront of automated radiology report generation (RRG). However, despite these advances, current foundation models generate reports in a single forward pass. This decoding strategy diminishes attention to visual tokens and increases reliance on language priors as generation proceeds, which in turn introduces spurious pathology co-occurrences in the generated reports. To mitigate these limitations, we propose Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding (CWCD), a novel and modular framework designed to enhance structured radiology report generation (SRRG). Our approach introduces category-specific parameterization and generates category-wise reports by contrasting normal X-rays with masked X-rays using category-specific visual prompts. Experimental results demonstrate that CWCD consistently outperforms baseline methods across both clinical efficacy and natural language generation metrics. An ablation study further elucidates the contribution of each architectural component to overall performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding (CWCD)框架，通过类别特定参数化和对比正常与遮蔽X射线的方法，改善结构化放射学报告生成，解决现有模型单次前向生成导致的视觉注意力衰减和虚假病理共现问题。
AI.motivation: 胸部X光片解读具有挑战性，解剖结构重叠和病理表现细微使得准确诊断耗时。现有放射学基础模型（如LLaVA-Rad、Maira-2）采用单次前向生成策略，导致生成过程中视觉注意力衰减、过度依赖语言先验，从而在生成报告中引入虚假的病理共现关系。
AI.method: 提出Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding (CWCD)框架：1) 引入类别特定参数化；2) 使用类别特定视觉提示，通过对比正常X射线与遮蔽X射线的方法生成类别特定的报告；3) 模块化设计增强结构化放射学报告生成。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CWCD在临床效能和自然语言生成指标上持续优于基线方法。消融研究进一步阐明了每个架构组件对整体性能的贡献。
AI.conclusion: CWCD框架有效解决了现有放射学基础模型在报告生成中的局限性，通过对比解码策略改善了视觉注意力保持和病理描述的准确性，为结构化放射学报告生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Spotlight and Shadow: Attention-Guided Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding for MLLM Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities yet continue to suffer from hallucination, where generated text contradicts visual content. In this paper, we introduce Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding (DaID), a novel contrastive decoding framework that dynamically calibrates each token generation by mining the model's internal perceptual discrepancies. Specifically, DaID identifies a Spotlight layer to amplify visual factual signals and a Shadow layer to suppress textual inertia. By leveraging visual attention distributions to guide this dual-anchor selection process, our method ensures precise, token-specific adaptation. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks and MLLMs demonstrate that DaID significantly mitigates hallucination while enhancing general reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: DaID是一种新颖的对比解码框架，通过挖掘模型内部感知差异来动态校准每个token生成，显著减少MLLM的幻觉问题
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然具有强大的推理能力，但仍然存在幻觉问题，即生成的文本与视觉内容相矛盾。需要一种方法来减少这种幻觉，同时保持或增强模型的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出双锚点内省解码（DaID）框架，通过识别Spotlight层来放大视觉事实信号，识别Shadow层来抑制文本惯性。利用视觉注意力分布来指导这个双锚点选择过程，实现精确的token级适应。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和MLLM上的实验结果表明，DaID显著减轻了幻觉问题，同时增强了通用推理能力。
AI.conclusion: DaID通过挖掘模型内部感知差异的动态校准机制，有效解决了MLLM的幻觉问题，为多模态模型的可靠生成提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Safety Guarantees in Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Cascade Dynamical Systems
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures; submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper considers the problem of zero-shot safety guarantees for cascade dynamical systems. These are systems where a subset of the states (the inner states) affects the dynamics of the remaining states (the outer states) but not vice-versa. We define safety as remaining on a set deemed safe for all times with high probability. We propose to train a safe RL policy on a reduced-order model, which ignores the dynamics of the inner states, but it treats it as an action that influences the outer state. Thus, reducing the complexity of the training. When deployed in the full system the trained policy is combined with a low-level controller whose task is to track the reference provided by the RL policy. Our main theoretical contribution is a bound on the safe probability in the full-order system. In particular, we establish the interplay between the probability of remaining safe after the zero-shot deployment and the quality of the tracking of the inner states. We validate our theoretical findings on a quadrotor navigation task, demonstrating that the preservation of the safety guarantees is tied to the bandwidth and tracking capabilities of the low-level controller.

AI.tldr: 提出一种为级联动力系统提供零样本安全保证的方法：在降阶模型上训练安全RL策略，然后在完整系统中与底层跟踪控制器结合部署，理论分析安全概率边界。
AI.motivation: 级联动力系统（内状态影响外状态但不反之）的安全保证问题。传统方法训练复杂，需要为完整系统设计安全策略。本文旨在通过降阶训练简化复杂度，实现零样本部署的安全保证。
AI.method: 1) 在忽略内状态动力学的降阶模型上训练安全RL策略，将内状态视为影响外状态的动作；2) 部署时，训练的策略与底层控制器结合，底层控制器负责跟踪RL策略提供的参考信号；3) 理论分析完整系统中的安全概率边界，建立安全保持与内状态跟踪质量之间的关系。
AI.result: 理论贡献：推导了完整系统中安全概率的边界，建立了零样本部署后保持安全的概率与内状态跟踪质量之间的数学关系。实验验证：在四旋翼导航任务中验证理论发现，证明安全保证的保持与底层控制器的带宽和跟踪能力密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 通过降阶模型训练RL策略并结合底层跟踪控制器，可以为级联动力系统提供有效的零样本安全保证。安全性能的关键在于底层控制器的跟踪质量，理论分析为系统设计提供了指导原则。

title: DocRevive: A Unified Pipeline for Document Text Restoration
summary: In Document Understanding, the challenge of reconstructing damaged, occluded, or incomplete text remains a critical yet unexplored problem. Subsequent document understanding tasks can benefit from a document reconstruction process. In response, this paper presents a novel unified pipeline combining state-of-the-art Optical Character Recognition (OCR), advanced image analysis, masked language modeling, and diffusion-based models to restore and reconstruct text while preserving visual integrity. We create a synthetic dataset of 30{,}078 degraded document images that simulates diverse document degradation scenarios, setting a benchmark for restoration tasks. Our pipeline detects and recognizes text, identifies degradation with an occlusion detector, and uses an inpainting model for semantically coherent reconstruction. A diffusion-based module seamlessly reintegrates text, matching font, size, and alignment. To evaluate restoration quality, we propose a Unified Context Similarity Metric (UCSM), incorporating edit, semantic, and length similarities with a contextual predictability measure that penalizes deviations when the correct text is contextually obvious. Our work advances document restoration, benefiting archival research and digital preservation while setting a new standard for text reconstruction. The OPRB dataset and code are available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/kpurkayastha/OPRB}{Hugging Face} and \href{https://github.com/kunalpurkayastha/DocRevive}{Github} respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一的文档修复流水线，结合OCR、图像分析、掩码语言建模和扩散模型，修复受损文档文本并保持视觉完整性，创建了包含30,078张退化文档图像的合成数据集OPRB。
AI.motivation: 文档理解中，修复受损、遮挡或不完整文本是一个关键但尚未充分探索的问题。文档修复过程可以提升后续文档理解任务的效果，对档案研究和数字保存具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出统一流水线：1) 使用最先进的OCR检测和识别文本；2) 通过遮挡检测器识别退化区域；3) 使用修复模型进行语义一致的重建；4) 扩散模型模块无缝重新集成文本，匹配字体、大小和对齐方式。创建了包含30,078张退化文档图像的合成数据集OPRB。
AI.result: 开发了完整的文档修复系统，提出了统一上下文相似度度量(UCSM)，结合编辑、语义和长度相似度，并包含上下文可预测性度量，当正确文本在上下文中明显时惩罚偏差。数据集和代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了文档修复领域，有益于档案研究和数字保存，为文本重建设定了新标准。OPRB数据集和代码已在Hugging Face和GitHub上开源。

title: VeriSim: A Configurable Framework for Evaluating Medical AI Under Realistic Patient Noise
summary: Medical large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance on standardized benchmarks, yet these evaluations fail to capture the complexity of real clinical encounters where patients exhibit memory gaps, limited health literacy, anxiety, and other communication barriers. We introduce VeriSim, a truth-preserving patient simulation framework that injects controllable, clinically evidence-grounded noise into patient responses while maintaining strict adherence to medical ground truth through a hybrid UMLS-LLM verification mechanism. Our framework operationalizes six noise dimensions derived from peer-reviewed medical communication literature, capturing authentic clinical phenomena such as patient recall limitations, health literacy barriers, and stigma-driven non-disclosure. Experiments across seven open-weight LLMs reveal that all models degrade significantly under realistic patient noise, with diagnostic accuracy dropping 15-25% and conversation length increasing 34-55%. Notably, smaller models (7B) show 40% greater degradation than larger models (70B+), while medical fine-tuning on standard corpora provides limited robustness benefits against patient communication noise. Evaluation by board-certified clinicians demonstrates high-quality simulation with strong inter-annotator agreement (kappa > 0.80), while LLM-as-a-Judge serves as a validated auxiliary evaluator achieving comparable reliability for scalable assessment. Our results highlight a critical Sim-to-Real gap in current medical AI. We release VeriSim as an open-source noise-injection framework, establishing a rigorous testbed for evaluating clinical robustness.

AI.tldr: VeriSim是一个医疗患者模拟框架，通过注入基于临床证据的可控噪声来评估医疗大语言模型在真实临床场景中的鲁棒性，发现现有模型在面对患者沟通障碍时性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 当前医疗大语言模型在标准化基准测试中表现优异，但这些评估未能捕捉真实临床场景的复杂性，如患者记忆缺失、健康素养有限、焦虑等沟通障碍。需要更真实的评估方法来检验模型在实际临床环境中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出VeriSim框架，通过混合UMLS-LLM验证机制，在保持医学真实性的前提下，向患者回答中注入基于临床证据的可控噪声。该框架基于医学沟通文献定义了六个噪声维度，包括患者回忆限制、健康素养障碍、污名驱动的隐瞒等。使用七个开源LLM进行实验，并由执业医师评估模拟质量。
AI.result: 所有模型在真实患者噪声下性能显著下降：诊断准确率下降15-25%，对话长度增加34-55%。较小模型（7B）比大模型（70B+）性能下降多40%。医疗微调对患者沟通噪声的鲁棒性提升有限。临床医生评估显示高质量模拟（kappa > 0.80），LLM-as-a-Judge作为辅助评估器达到可比可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 当前医疗AI存在显著的模拟到现实差距。VeriSim作为开源噪声注入框架，为评估临床鲁棒性建立了严格测试平台，揭示了现有模型在真实患者沟通障碍面前的脆弱性。

title: Attention-Guided Dual-Stream Learning for Group Engagement Recognition: Fusing Transformer-Encoded Motion Dynamics with Scene Context via Adaptive Gating
summary: Student engagement is crucial for improving learning outcomes in group activities. Highly engaged students perform better both individually and contribute to overall group success. However, most existing automated engagement recognition methods are designed for online classrooms or estimate engagement at the individual level. Addressing this gap, we propose DualEngage, a novel two-stream framework for group-level engagement recognition from in-classroom videos. It models engagement as a joint function of both individual and group-level behaviors. The primary stream models person-level motion dynamics by detecting and tracking students, extracting dense optical flow with the Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms network, encoding temporal motion patterns using a transformer encoder, and finally aggregating per-student representations through attention pooling into a unified representation. The secondary stream captures scene-level spatiotemporal information from the full video clip, leveraging a pretrained three-dimensional Residual Network. The two-stream representations are combined via softmax-gated fusion, which dynamically weights each stream's contribution based on the joint context of both features. DualEngage learns a joint representation of individual actions with overarching group dynamics. We evaluate the proposed approach using fivefold cross-validation on the Classroom Group Engagement Dataset developed by Ocean University of China, achieving an average classification accuracy of 0.9621+/-0.0161 with a macro-averaged F1 of 0.9530+/-0.0204. To understand the contribution of each branch, we further conduct an ablation study comparing single-stream variants against the two-stream model. This work is among the first in classroom engagement recognition to adopt a dual-stream design that explicitly leverages motion cues as an estimator.

AI.tldr: DualEngage：一种用于课堂视频中群体参与度识别的双流框架，通过结合个体运动动态和场景级时空信息，在群体层面识别学生参与度。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化参与度识别方法主要针对在线课堂或个体层面，缺乏对课堂环境中群体参与度的识别。群体参与度对学习成果至关重要，需要同时考虑个体行为和群体动态。
AI.method: 提出DualEngage双流框架：主流通过检测跟踪学生、提取密集光流、使用Transformer编码器编码时间运动模式，并通过注意力池化聚合个体表示；次流从完整视频剪辑中捕获场景级时空信息，使用预训练的3D残差网络。两流表示通过softmax门控融合动态加权结合。
AI.result: 在中国海洋大学开发的课堂群体参与度数据集上，通过五折交叉验证获得平均分类准确率0.9621±0.0161，宏平均F1分数0.9530±0.0204。消融研究验证了双流设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DualEngage是首个在课堂参与度识别中采用双流设计并明确利用运动线索作为估计器的框架，成功建模了个体行为与群体动态的联合表示，为群体参与度识别提供了有效解决方案。

title: PEMANT: Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel
summary: Modeling household-level trip generation is fundamental to accurate demand forecasting, traffic flow estimation, and urban system planning. Existing studies were mostly based on classical machine learning models with limited predictive capability, while recent LLM-based approaches have yet to incorporate behavioral theory or intra-household interaction dynamics, both of which are critical for modeling realistic collective travel decisions. To address these limitations, we propose a novel LLM-based framework, named Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel (PEMANT), which first integrates behavioral theory for individualized persona modeling and then conducts household-level trip planning negotiations via a structured multi-agent conversation. Specifically, PEMANT transforms static sociodemographic attributes into coherent narrative profiles that explicitly encode household-level attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral controls, following our proposed Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior (HA-CoPB) framework. Building on these theory-grounded personas, PEMANT captures real-world household decision negotiation via a structured two-phase multi-agent conversation framework with a novel persona-alignment control mechanism. Evaluated on both national and regional household travel survey datasets, PEMANT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks across datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出PEMANT框架，通过行为理论建模个体角色，并通过结构化多智能体对话进行家庭层面出行规划协商，显著提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多基于传统机器学习模型预测能力有限，而近期基于大语言模型的方法尚未纳入行为理论或家庭内部互动动态，这两者对建模现实集体出行决策至关重要。
AI.method: 提出PEMANT框架：1) 基于Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior (HA-CoPB)框架，将静态社会人口属性转化为明确编码家庭层面态度、主观规范和感知行为控制的连贯叙述性角色；2) 基于这些理论驱动的角色，通过结构化两阶段多智能体对话框架和新型角色对齐控制机制，捕捉现实家庭决策协商过程。
AI.result: 在国家和区域家庭出行调查数据集上的评估表明，PEMANT在多个数据集上始终优于最先进的基准方法。
AI.conclusion: PEMANT通过整合行为理论和结构化多智能体协商，有效建模家庭层面出行生成，为集体出行决策提供了更现实和准确的建模框架。

title: MatRes: Zero-Shot Test-Time Model Adaptation for Simultaneous Matching and Restoration
summary: Real-world image pairs often exhibit both severe degradations and large viewpoint changes, making image restoration and geometric matching mutually interfering tasks when treated independently. In this work, we propose MatRes, a zero-shot test-time adaptation framework that jointly improves restoration quality and correspondence estimation using only a single low-quality and high-quality image pair. By enforcing conditional similarity at corresponding locations, MatRes updates only lightweight modules while keeping all pretrained components frozen, requiring no offline training or additional supervision. Extensive experiments across diverse combinations show that MatRes yields significant gains in both restoration and geometric alignment compared to using either restoration or matching models alone. MatRes offers a practical and widely applicable solution for real-world scenarios where users commonly capture multiple images of a scene with varying viewpoints and quality, effectively addressing the often-overlooked mutual interference between matching and restoration.

AI.tldr: MatRes是一个零样本测试时自适应框架，通过单对低质量-高质量图像联合改进图像恢复和几何匹配，无需离线训练或额外监督。
AI.motivation: 现实世界图像对常同时存在严重退化和大视角变化，导致图像恢复和几何匹配这两个任务相互干扰。现有方法独立处理这两个任务时效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出MatRes框架，通过在对应位置强制条件相似性，仅更新轻量级模块而保持所有预训练组件冻结，实现零样本测试时自适应，无需离线训练或额外监督。
AI.result: 在多种组合的广泛实验中，MatRes相比单独使用恢复或匹配模型，在恢复质量和几何对齐方面都取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: MatRes为现实场景提供了实用且广泛适用的解决方案，有效解决了匹配和恢复之间常被忽视的相互干扰问题。

title: Tracing the Roots: A Multi-Agent Framework for Uncovering Data Lineage in Post-Training LLMs
summary: Post-training data plays a pivotal role in shaping the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet datasets are often treated as isolated artifacts, overlooking the systemic connections that underlie their evolution. To disentangle these complex relationships, we introduce the concept of \textbf{data lineage} to the LLM ecosystem and propose an automated multi-agent framework to reconstruct the evolutionary graph of dataset development. Through large-scale lineage analysis, we characterize domain-specific structural patterns, such as vertical refinement in math-oriented datasets and horizontal aggregation in general-domain corpora. Moreover, we uncover pervasive systemic issues, including \textit{structural redundancy} induced by implicit dataset intersections and the \textit{propagation of benchmark contamination} along lineage paths. To demonstrate the practical value of lineage analysis for data construction, we leverage the reconstructed lineage graph to create a \textit{lineage-aware diversity-oriented dataset}. By anchoring instruction sampling at upstream root sources, this approach mitigates downstream homogenization and hidden redundancy, yielding a more diverse post-training corpus. We further highlight lineage-centric analysis as an efficient and robust topological alternative to sample-level dataset comparison for large-scale data ecosystems. By grounding data construction in explicit lineage structures, our work advances post-training data curation toward a more systematic and controllable paradigm.

AI.tldr: 论文提出数据谱系概念和自动化多智能体框架，用于重建LLM数据集演化图，揭示结构冗余和基准污染传播问题，并基于谱系构建多样性数据集。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM后训练数据通常被当作孤立产物处理，忽视了数据集之间的系统性联系和演化关系，这限制了数据构建的系统性和可控性。
AI.method: 提出数据谱系概念，设计自动化多智能体框架重建数据集演化图，通过大规模谱系分析识别结构模式，并基于谱系图构建谱系感知的多样性导向数据集。
AI.result: 揭示了数学导向数据集的垂直细化和通用领域语料库的水平聚合等特定领域结构模式，发现了结构冗余和基准污染传播等系统性问题，构建的谱系感知数据集能有效缓解下游同质化和隐藏冗余。
AI.conclusion: 基于显式谱系结构的数据构建将后训练数据管理推向更系统化和可控的范式，谱系中心分析为大规模数据生态系统提供了高效稳健的拓扑替代方案。

title: Active Diffusion Matching: Score-based Iterative Alignment of Cross-Modal Retinal Images
summary:
Objective: The study aims to address the challenge of aligning Standard Fundus Images (SFIs) and Ultra-Widefield Fundus Images (UWFIs), which is difficult due to their substantial differences in viewing range and the amorphous appearance of the retina. Currently, no specialized method exists for this task, and existing image alignment techniques lack accuracy.
  Methods: We propose Active Diffusion Matching (ADM), a novel cross-modal alignment method. ADM integrates two interdependent score-based diffusion models to jointly estimate global transformations and local deformations via an iterative Langevin Markov chain. This approach facilitates a stochastic, progressive search for optimal alignment. Additionally, custom sampling strategies are introduced to enhance the adaptability of ADM to given input image pairs.
  Results: Comparative experimental evaluations demonstrate that ADM achieves state-of-the-art alignment accuracy. This was validated on two datasets: a private dataset of SFI-UWFI pairs and a public dataset of SFI-SFI pairs, with mAUC improvements of 5.2 and 0.4 points on the private and public datasets, respectively, compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.
  Conclusion: ADM effectively bridges the gap in aligning SFIs and UWFIs, providing an innovative solution to a previously unaddressed challenge. The method's ability to jointly optimize global and local alignment makes it highly effective for cross-modal image alignment tasks.
  Significance: ADM has the potential to transform the integrated analysis of SFIs and UWFIs, enabling better clinical utility and supporting learning-based image enhancements. This advancement could significantly improve diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes in ophthalmology.

AI.tldr: 提出ADM方法解决标准眼底图像与超广角眼底图像的对齐难题，通过双扩散模型联合优化全局变换与局部形变，在跨模态对齐任务中达到最先进精度。
AI.motivation: 标准眼底图像(SFIs)与超广角眼底图像(UWFIs)由于视野范围和视网膜外观的显著差异，对齐非常困难。目前缺乏专门的方法，现有图像对齐技术精度不足。
AI.method: 提出主动扩散匹配(ADM)方法，集成两个相互依赖的基于分数的扩散模型，通过迭代Langevin马尔可夫链联合估计全局变换和局部形变。采用定制采样策略增强对输入图像对的适应性。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上验证：私有SFI-UWFI对数据集和公开SFI-SFI对数据集。与现有最先进方法相比，mAUC分别提升5.2和0.4个点，达到最先进对齐精度。
AI.conclusion: ADM有效解决了SFIs与UWFIs对齐的难题，为先前未解决的挑战提供了创新解决方案。联合优化全局和局部对齐的能力使其在跨模态图像对齐任务中非常有效。

title: CHAIRO: Contextual Hierarchical Analogical Induction and Reasoning Optimization for LLMs
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 main conference; under official publication process
summary:
Content moderation in online platforms faces persistent challenges due to the evolving complexity of user-generated content and the limitations of traditional rule-based and machine learning approaches. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled more sophisticated moderation via direct prompting or fine-tuning, these approaches often exhibit limited generalization, interpretability, and adaptability to unseen or ambiguous cases.
  In this work, we propose a novel moderation framework that leverages analogical examples to enhance rule induction and decision reliability. Our approach integrates end-to-end optimization of analogical retrieval, rule generation, and moderation classification, enabling the dynamic adaptation of moderation rules to diverse content scenarios. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms both rule-injected fine-tuning baselines and multi-stage static RAG pipelines in terms of moderation accuracy and rule quality. Further evaluations, including human assessments and external model generalization tests, confirm that our framework produces rules with better clarity, interpretability, and applicability. These findings show that analogical example-driven methods can advance robust, explainable, and generalizable content moderation in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于类比示例的内容审核框架，通过端到端优化类比检索、规则生成和审核分类，显著提升审核准确性和规则质量
AI.motivation: 在线平台内容审核面临用户生成内容日益复杂和传统方法（基于规则和机器学习）的局限性。虽然大语言模型（LLMs）通过直接提示或微调实现了更复杂的审核，但这些方法在泛化性、可解释性和对未见/模糊案例的适应性方面存在限制
AI.method: 提出新颖的审核框架，利用类比示例增强规则归纳和决策可靠性。该方法集成端到端优化，包括类比检索、规则生成和审核分类，使审核规则能够动态适应多样化的内容场景
AI.result: 该方法在审核准确性和规则质量方面显著优于规则注入微调基线和多阶段静态RAG流水线。人类评估和外部模型泛化测试证实，该框架生成的规则具有更好的清晰度、可解释性和适用性
AI.conclusion: 类比示例驱动的方法能够推进现实应用中稳健、可解释和可泛化的内容审核

title: Particle Diffusion Matching: Random Walk Correspondence Search for the Alignment of Standard and Ultra-Widefield Fundus Images
summary: We propose a robust alignment technique for Standard Fundus Images (SFIs) and Ultra-Widefield Fundus Images (UWFIs), which are challenging to align due to differences in scale, appearance, and the scarcity of distinctive features. Our method, termed Particle Diffusion Matching (PDM), performs alignment through an iterative Random Walk Correspondence Search (RWCS) guided by a diffusion model. At each iteration, the model estimates displacement vectors for particle points by considering local appearance, the structural distribution of particles, and an estimated global transformation, enabling progressive refinement of correspondences even under difficult conditions. PDM achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple retinal image alignment benchmarks, showing substantial improvement on a primary dataset of SFI-UWFI pairs and demonstrating its effectiveness in real-world clinical scenarios. By providing accurate and scalable correspondence estimation, PDM overcomes the limitations of existing methods and facilitates the integration of complementary retinal image modalities. This diffusion-guided search strategy offers a new direction for improving downstream supervised learning, disease diagnosis, and multi-modal image analysis in ophthalmology.

AI.tldr: 提出PDM方法，通过扩散模型引导的随机游走对应搜索，实现标准眼底图像与超广角眼底图像的鲁棒对齐
AI.motivation: 标准眼底图像(SFIs)与超广角眼底图像(UWFIs)由于尺度差异、外观差异和特征稀缺性，对齐具有挑战性，现有方法存在局限性
AI.method: PDM方法通过迭代的随机游走对应搜索(RWCS)，在扩散模型引导下，结合局部外观、粒子结构分布和全局变换估计，逐步优化对应关系
AI.result: 在多个视网膜图像对齐基准测试中达到最先进性能，在SFI-UWFI配对数据集上显著改进，在真实临床场景中表现有效
AI.conclusion: PDM通过准确可扩展的对应估计克服现有方法局限，促进多模态视网膜图像整合，为眼科下游监督学习、疾病诊断和多模态分析提供新方向

title: CARO: Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization for Robust Content Moderation
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 findings; under official publication process
summary: Current large language models (LLMs), even those explicitly trained for reasoning, often struggle with ambiguous content moderation cases due to misleading "decision shortcuts" embedded in context. Inspired by cognitive psychology insights into expert moderation, we introduce \caro (Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization), a novel two-stage training framework to induce robust analogical reasoning in LLMs. First, \caro bootstraps analogical reasoning chains via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on moderation data and performs supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Second, we propose a customized direct preference optimization (DPO) approach to reinforce analogical reasoning behaviors explicitly. Unlike static retrieval methods, \caro dynamically generates tailored analogical references during inference, effectively mitigating harmful decision shortcuts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \caro substantially outperforms state-of-the-art reasoning models (DeepSeek R1, QwQ), specialized moderation models (LLaMA Guard), and advanced fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented methods, achieving an average F1 score improvement of 24.9\% on challenging ambiguous moderation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CARO是一个两阶段训练框架，通过类比推理优化来提升LLM在模糊内容审核任务中的表现，显著优于现有方法
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型在模糊内容审核任务中表现不佳，容易受到上下文中的"决策捷径"误导。受认知心理学中专家审核的启发，需要开发能够进行稳健类比推理的模型
AI.method: CARO采用两阶段训练框架：1）通过检索增强生成引导类比推理链并进行监督微调；2）采用定制的直接偏好优化方法明确强化类比推理行为。在推理时动态生成定制的类比参考
AI.result: CARO在具有挑战性的模糊审核基准测试中，平均F1分数提升了24.9%，显著优于DeepSeek R1、QwQ、LLaMA Guard等最先进的推理模型和专门审核模型
AI.conclusion: CARO框架通过类比推理优化有效缓解了有害的决策捷径问题，为LLM在模糊内容审核任务中提供了更稳健的推理能力

title: Global monitoring of methane point sources using deep learning on hyperspectral radiance measurements from EMIT
summary: Anthropogenic methane (CH4) point sources drive near-term climate forcing, safety hazards, and system inefficiencies. Space-based imaging spectroscopy is emerging as a tool for identifying emissions globally, but existing approaches largely rely on manual plume identification. Here we present the Methane Analysis and Plume Localization with EMIT (MAPL-EMIT) model, an end-to-end vision transformer framework that leverages the complete radiance spectrum from the Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation (EMIT) instrument to jointly retrieve methane enhancements across all pixels within a scene. This approach brings together spectral and spatial context to significantly lower detection limits. MAPL-EMIT simultaneously supports enhancement quantification, plume delineation, and source localization, even for multiple overlapping plumes. The model was trained on 3.6 million physics-based synthetic plumes injected into global EMIT radiance data. Synthetic evaluation confirms the model's ability to identify plumes with high recall and precision and to capture weaker plumes relative to existing matched-filter approaches. On real-world benchmarks, MAPL-EMIT captures 79% of known hand-annotated NASA L2B plume complexes across a test set of 1084 EMIT granules, while capturing twice as many plausible plumes than identified by human analysts. Further validation against coincident airborne data, top-emitting landfills, and controlled release experiments confirms the model's ability to identify previously uncaptured sources. By incorporating model-generated metrics such as spectral fit scores and estimated noise levels, the framework can further limit false-positive rates. Overall, MAPL-EMIT enables high-throughput implementation on the full EMIT catalog, shifting methane monitoring from labor-intensive workflows to a rapid, scalable paradigm for global plume mapping at the facility scale.

AI.tldr: MAPL-EMIT是一个端到端的视觉Transformer框架，利用EMIT仪器的完整辐射光谱数据，通过联合检索场景中所有像素的甲烷增强来检测和定位甲烷点源排放。
AI.motivation: 人为甲烷点源排放导致近期气候强迫、安全隐患和系统效率低下。现有的基于空间的成像光谱方法主要依赖人工羽流识别，需要更自动化和高效的检测方法。
AI.method: 开发了MAPL-EMIT模型，这是一个端到端的视觉Transformer框架，利用EMIT仪器的完整辐射光谱数据，在360万个基于物理的合成羽流注入全球EMIT辐射数据上进行训练，结合光谱和空间上下文信息。
AI.result: 在合成评估中，模型能够以高召回率和精确度识别羽流，并检测到比现有匹配滤波方法更弱的羽流。在实际测试中，捕获了79%已知手动标注的NASA L2B羽流复合体，并识别出比人工分析多两倍的合理羽流。通过与机载数据、顶级排放垃圾填埋场和受控释放实验的验证，确认了模型识别先前未捕获源的能力。
AI.conclusion: MAPL-EMIT实现了对整个EMIT目录的高通量处理，将甲烷监测从劳动密集型工作流程转变为快速、可扩展的全球设施尺度羽流制图范式。

title: Cooperation in Human and Machine Agents: Promise Theory Considerations
summary: Agent based systems are more common than we may think. A Promise Theory perspective on cooperation, in systems of human-machine agents, offers a unified perspective on organization and functional design with semi-automated efforts, in terms of the abstract properties of autonomous agents, This applies to human efforts, hardware systems, software, and artificial intelligence, with and without management. One may ask how does a reasoning system of components keep to an intended purpose? As the agent paradigm is now being revived, in connection with artificial intelligence agents, I revisit established principles of agent cooperation, as applied to humans, machines, and their mutual interactions. Promise Theory represents the fundamentals of signalling, comprehension, trust, risk, and feedback between agents, and offers some lessons about success and failure.

AI.tldr: 从承诺理论视角分析人机代理系统中的合作，为组织设计和功能实现提供统一框架
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能代理的复兴，需要重新审视人机代理系统中的合作原则，理解组件系统如何保持预期目的
AI.method: 采用承诺理论作为分析框架，研究自主代理之间的信号传递、理解、信任、风险和反馈等基本机制
AI.result: 承诺理论为人类、硬件、软件和人工智能系统提供统一的合作视角，揭示成功与失败的经验教训
AI.conclusion: 承诺理论为人机代理系统的组织设计和功能实现提供了有价值的分析工具，特别适用于半自动化环境中的合作问题

title: Mining Attribute Subspaces for Efficient Fine-tuning of 3D Foundation Models
summary: With the emergence of 3D foundation models, there is growing interest in fine-tuning them for downstream tasks, where LoRA is the dominant fine-tuning paradigm. As 3D datasets exhibit distinct variations in texture, geometry, camera motion, and lighting, there are interesting fundamental questions: 1) Are there LoRA subspaces associated with each type of variation? 2) Are these subspaces disentangled (i.e., orthogonal to each other)? 3) How do we compute them effectively? This paper provides answers to all these questions. We introduce a robust approach that generates synthetic datasets with controlled variations, fine-tunes a LoRA adapter on each dataset, and extracts a LoRA sub-space associated with each type of variation. We show that these subspaces are approximately disentangled. Integrating them leads to a reduced LoRA subspace that enables efficient LoRA fine-tuning with improved prediction accuracy for downstream tasks. In particular, we show that such a reduced LoRA subspace, despite being derived entirely from synthetic data, generalizes to real datasets. An ablation study validates the effectiveness of the choices in our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种方法，通过合成数据集提取与不同3D变化类型（纹理、几何、相机运动、光照）相关的近似解耦LoRA子空间，并将其整合为缩减的LoRA子空间，以提高下游任务微调的效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 随着3D基础模型的出现，使用LoRA进行下游任务微调成为主流。由于3D数据集在纹理、几何、相机运动和光照方面存在显著变化，需要探究：1）是否存在与每种变化类型相关的LoRA子空间？2）这些子空间是否解耦（正交）？3）如何有效计算它们？
AI.method: 提出稳健方法：生成具有受控变化的合成数据集，在每个数据集上微调LoRA适配器，提取与每种变化类型相关的LoRA子空间。证明这些子空间近似解耦，并将其整合为缩减的LoRA子空间。
AI.result: 发现与不同3D变化类型相关的LoRA子空间确实存在且近似解耦。整合后的缩减LoRA子空间能够提高下游任务微调的效率和预测准确性。值得注意的是，这种完全从合成数据导出的缩减LoRA子空间能够泛化到真实数据集。
AI.conclusion: 本文回答了关于3D变化类型与LoRA子空间关系的三个基本问题，提出了一种有效提取和整合解耦LoRA子空间的方法，为3D基础模型的高效微调提供了新思路，并通过消融研究验证了方法的有效性。

title: A Progressive Training Strategy for Vision-Language Models to Counteract Spatio-Temporal Hallucinations in Embodied Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made significant strides in static image understanding but continue to face critical hurdles in spatiotemporal reasoning. A major bottleneck is "multi-image reasoning hallucination", where a massive performance drop between forward and reverse temporal queries reveals a dependence on superficial shortcuts instead of genuine causal understanding. To mitigate this, we first develop a new Chain-of-Thought (CoT) dataset that decomposes intricate reasoning into detailed spatiotemporal steps and definitive judgments. Building on this, we present a progressive training framework: it initiates with supervised pre-training on our CoT dataset to instill logical structures, followed by fine-tuning with scalable weakly-labeled data for broader generalization. Our experiments demonstrate that this approach not only improves backbone accuracy but also slashes the forward-backward performance gap from over 70\% to only 6.53\%. This confirms the method's ability to develop authentic dynamic reasoning and reduce the inherent temporal biases of current VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进式训练框架，通过思维链数据集和弱标注数据，显著减少VLMs在时空推理中的前向-后向性能差距，从70%降至6.53%
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在静态图像理解上取得进展，但在时空推理方面仍面临关键障碍，特别是"多图像推理幻觉"问题，即前向和后向时间查询之间存在巨大性能差距，表明模型依赖表面捷径而非真正的因果理解
AI.method: 1. 创建新的思维链数据集，将复杂推理分解为详细的时空步骤和确定性判断；2. 提出渐进式训练框架：先在CoT数据集上进行监督预训练以建立逻辑结构，然后用可扩展的弱标注数据进行微调以实现更广泛泛化
AI.result: 该方法不仅提高了骨干模型的准确性，还将前向-后向性能差距从超过70%大幅降低到仅6.53%，证实了该方法能够发展真实的动态推理能力并减少当前VLMs固有的时间偏差
AI.conclusion: 通过思维链分解和渐进式训练，能够有效缓解视觉语言模型在时空推理中的幻觉问题，显著提升其因果理解能力，为开发更可靠的动态推理系统提供了有效途径

title: ABot-Claw: A Foundation for Persistent, Cooperative, and Self-Evolving Robotic Agents
summary: Current embodied intelligent systems still face a substantial gap between high-level reasoning and low-level physical execution in open-world environments. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong perception and intuitive responses, their open-loop nature limits long-horizon performance. Agents incorporating System 2 cognitive mechanisms improve planning, but usually operate in closed sandboxes with predefined toolkits and limited real-system control. OpenClaw provides a localized runtime with full system privileges, but lacks the embodied control architecture required for long-duration, multi-robot execution. We therefore propose ABot-Claw, an embodied extension of OpenClaw that integrates: 1) a unified embodiment interface with capability-driven scheduling for heterogeneous robot coordination; 2) a visual-centric cross-embodiment multimodal memory for persistent context retention and grounded retrieval; and 3) a critic-based closed-loop feedback mechanism with a generalist reward model for online progress evaluation, local correction, and replanning. With a decoupled architecture spanning the OpenClaw layer, shared service layer, and robot embodiment layer, ABot-Claw enables real-world interaction, closes the loop from natural language intent to physical action, and supports progressively self-evolving robotic agents in open, dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: ABot-Claw是一个具身智能系统，通过统一接口、视觉记忆和闭环反馈机制，将高级推理与物理执行结合，支持多机器人在开放动态环境中的长期任务执行。
AI.motivation: 当前具身智能系统存在高级推理与低级物理执行之间的鸿沟：VLA模型感知强但开环限制长期性能；System 2认知机制规划好但局限于封闭环境；OpenClaw有系统权限但缺乏具身控制架构。需要解决多机器人长期执行、上下文保持和闭环反馈的问题。
AI.method: 1) 统一具身接口与能力驱动调度，协调异构机器人；2) 视觉中心跨具身多模态记忆，保持持久上下文和接地检索；3) 基于批评者的闭环反馈机制，使用通用奖励模型进行在线进度评估、局部修正和重新规划。采用三层解耦架构：OpenClaw层、共享服务层和机器人具身层。
AI.result: ABot-Claw实现了真实世界交互，闭合了从自然语言意图到物理动作的循环，支持在开放动态环境中逐步自我演进的机器人智能体。
AI.conclusion: ABot-Claw通过整合统一接口、持久记忆和闭环反馈，有效弥合了高级推理与低级物理执行之间的差距，为开放动态环境中的多机器人长期任务执行提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Beyond Compliance: A Resistance-Informed Motivation Reasoning Framework for Challenging Psychological Client Simulation
summary: Psychological client simulators have emerged as a scalable solution for training and evaluating counselor trainees and psychological LLMs. Yet existing simulators exhibit unrealistic over-compliance, leaving counselors underprepared for the challenging behaviors common in real-world practice. To bridge this gap, we present ResistClient, which systematically models challenging client behaviors grounded in Client Resistance Theory by integrating external behaviors with underlying motivational mechanisms. To this end, we propose Resistance-Informed Motivation Reasoning (RIMR), a two-stage training framework. First, RIMR mitigates compliance bias via supervised fine-tuning on RPC, a large-scale resistance-oriented psychological conversation dataset covering diverse client profiles. Second, beyond surface-level response imitation, RIMR models psychologically coherent motivation reasoning before response generation, jointly optimizing motivation authenticity and response consistency via process-supervised reinforcement learning. Extensive automatic and expert evaluations show that ResistClient substantially outperforms existing simulators in challenge fidelity, behavioral plausibility, and reasoning coherence. Moreover, ResistClient facilities evaluation of psychological LLMs under challenging conditions, offering new optimization directions for mental health dialogue systems.

AI.tldr: ResistClient是一个基于客户抵抗理论的心理客户模拟器，通过两阶段训练框架RIMR模拟具有挑战性的客户行为，解决了现有模拟器过度顺从的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有心理客户模拟器存在不现实的过度顺从问题，导致咨询师培训无法应对真实世界中常见的挑战性客户行为，需要开发更真实的模拟器来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 提出ResistClient系统，采用Resistance-Informed Motivation Reasoning (RIMR)两阶段训练框架：1) 在RPC数据集上进行监督微调以减少顺从偏差；2) 通过过程监督强化学习联合优化动机真实性和响应一致性，在生成响应前进行心理一致的动机推理。
AI.result: ResistClient在挑战性保真度、行为合理性和推理一致性方面显著优于现有模拟器，能够有效评估心理LLM在挑战性条件下的表现，为心理健康对话系统提供新的优化方向。
AI.conclusion: ResistClient通过系统建模挑战性客户行为，提供了更真实的心理客户模拟解决方案，有助于提升咨询师培训和心理LLM评估的质量。

title: Degradation-Consistent Paired Training for Robust AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors suffer significant performance degradation under real-world image corruptions such as JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resolution downsampling. We observe that state-of-the-art methods, including B-Free, treat degradation robustness as a byproduct of data augmentation rather than an explicit training objective. In this work, we propose Degradation-Consistent Paired Training (DCPT), a simple yet effective training strategy that explicitly enforces robustness through paired consistency constraints. For each training image, we construct a clean view and a degraded view, then impose two constraints: a feature consistency loss that minimizes the cosine distance between clean and degraded representations, and a prediction consistency loss based on symmetric KL divergence that aligns output distributions across views. DCPT adds zero additional parameters and zero inference overhead. Experiments on the Synthbuster benchmark (9 generators, 8 degradation conditions) demonstrate that DCPT improves the degraded-condition average accuracy by 9.1 percentage points compared to an identical baseline without paired training, while sacrificing only 0.9% clean accuracy. The improvement is most pronounced under JPEG compression (+15.7% to +17.9%). Ablation further reveals that adding architectural components leads to overfitting on limited training data, confirming that training objective improvement is more effective than architectural augmentation for degradation robustness.

AI.tldr: DCPT通过配对一致性约束显式提升AI图像检测器在图像退化条件下的鲁棒性，无需额外参数和推理开销
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在真实世界图像退化（如JPEG压缩、高斯模糊、分辨率下采样）下性能显著下降，当前方法仅将退化鲁棒性视为数据增强的副产品而非明确的训练目标
AI.method: 提出Degradation-Consistent Paired Training (DCPT)：为每个训练图像构建干净视图和退化视图，施加两种约束：1) 特征一致性损失（最小化干净和退化表示间的余弦距离）；2) 基于对称KL散度的预测一致性损失（对齐不同视图的输出分布）
AI.result: 在Synthbuster基准测试（9个生成器，8种退化条件）上，DCPT将退化条件下的平均准确率提升9.1个百分点，仅牺牲0.9%的干净准确率；在JPEG压缩下提升最显著（+15.7%到+17.9%）
AI.conclusion: DCPT通过显式的配对一致性约束有效提升AI图像检测器在退化条件下的鲁棒性，相比架构增强，训练目标改进在有限训练数据下更有效且避免过拟合

title: Thinking Fast, Thinking Wrong: Intuitiveness Modulates LLM Counterfactual Reasoning in Policy Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for causal and counterfactual reasoning, yet their reliability in real-world policy evaluation remains underexplored. We construct a benchmark of 40 empirical policy evaluation cases drawn from economics and social science, each grounded in peer-reviewed evidence and classified by intuitiveness -- whether the empirical finding aligns with (obvious), is unclear relative to (ambiguous), or contradicts (counter-intuitive) common prior expectations. We evaluate four frontier LLMs across five prompting strategies with 2,400 experimental trials and analyze the results using mixed-effects logistic regression. Our findings reveal three key results: (1) a chain-of-thought (CoT) paradox, where chain-of-thought prompting dramatically improves performance on obvious cases but this benefit is nearly eliminated on counter-intuitive ones (interaction OR = 0.053, $p < 0.001$); (2) intuitiveness as the dominant factor, explaining more variance than model choice or prompting strategy (ICC = 0.537); and (3) a knowledge-reasoning dissociation, where citation-based familiarity is unrelated to accuracy ($p = 0.53$), suggesting models possess relevant knowledge but fail to reason with it when findings contradict intuition. We frame these results through the lens of dual-process theory (System 1 vs. System 2) and argue that current LLMs' "slow thinking" may be little more than "slow talking" -- they produce the form of deliberative reasoning without the substance.

AI.tldr: LLMs在政策评估中存在直觉偏见：思维链提示对明显案例有效，但对反直觉案例几乎无效；直觉性比模型选择或提示策略更重要；模型拥有相关知识但无法在反直觉情况下进行推理。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLMs越来越多地用于因果和反事实推理，但它们在真实世界政策评估中的可靠性尚未得到充分探索。研究者希望了解LLMs在处理基于实证证据的政策评估案例时的表现，特别是当结果与直觉预期不一致时。
AI.method: 构建包含40个经济学和社会科学实证政策评估案例的基准，每个案例基于同行评审证据，并按直觉性分类（明显、模糊、反直觉）。评估4个前沿LLM在5种提示策略下的表现，进行2400次实验，使用混合效应逻辑回归分析结果。
AI.result: 发现三个关键结果：1）思维链悖论：思维链提示对明显案例大幅提升性能，但对反直觉案例几乎无效；2）直觉性是主导因素，解释的方差比模型选择或提示策略更多；3）知识-推理分离：基于引用的熟悉度与准确性无关，表明模型拥有相关知识但无法在反直觉情况下进行推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过双过程理论（系统1 vs 系统2）框架解释结果，认为当前LLMs的"慢思考"可能只是"慢说话"——它们产生了深思熟虑推理的形式，但没有实质内容。这揭示了LLMs在反直觉推理方面的根本局限性。

title: Long-Horizon Streaming Video Generation via Hybrid Attention with Decoupled Distillation
summary: Streaming video generation (SVG) distills a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model into an autoregressive model equipped with sliding window attention (SWA). However, SWA inevitably loses distant history during long video generation, and its computational overhead remains a critical challenge to real-time deployment. In this work, we propose Hybrid Forcing, which jointly optimizes temporal information retention and computational efficiency through a hybrid attention design. First, we introduce lightweight linear temporal attention to preserve long-range dependencies beyond the sliding window. In particular, we maintain a compact key-value state to incrementally absorb evicted tokens, retaining temporal context with negligible memory and computational overhead. Second, we incorporate block-sparse attention into the local sliding window to reduce redundant computation within short-range modeling, reallocating computational capacity toward more critical dependencies. Finally, we introduce a decoupled distillation strategy tailored to the hybrid attention design. A few-step initial distillation is performed under dense attention, then the distillation of our proposed linear temporal and block-sparse attention is activated for streaming modeling, ensuring stable optimization. Extensive experiments on both short- and long-form video generation benchmarks demonstrate that Hybrid Forcing consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, our model achieves real-time, unbounded 832x480 video generation at 29.5 FPS on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU without quantization or model compression. The source code and trained models are available at https://github.com/leeruibin/hybrid-forcing.

AI.tldr: 提出Hybrid Forcing方法，通过混合注意力设计优化流式视频生成，结合线性时间注意力和块稀疏注意力，在保持长距离依赖的同时提升计算效率，实现实时高清视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频生成方法使用滑动窗口注意力，存在两个主要问题：1) 在生成长视频时会丢失远距离历史信息；2) 计算开销大，难以实现实时部署。需要同时优化时间信息保留和计算效率。
AI.method: 提出混合注意力设计：1) 轻量级线性时间注意力，通过紧凑的键值状态增量吸收被移出的token，保留长距离依赖；2) 在局部滑动窗口中引入块稀疏注意力，减少短距离建模中的冗余计算；3) 解耦蒸馏策略，先进行密集注意力下的初步蒸馏，再激活线性时间和块稀疏注意力的蒸馏。
AI.result: 在短格式和长格式视频生成基准测试中均达到最先进性能。在单张NVIDIA H100 GPU上实现实时、无限制的832x480视频生成，帧率达到29.5 FPS，无需量化或模型压缩。
AI.conclusion: Hybrid Forcing通过创新的混合注意力设计，有效解决了流式视频生成中的长距离依赖保留和计算效率问题，实现了高质量的实时视频生成，为实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Agent Mentor: Framing Agent Knowledge through Semantic Trajectory Analysis
summary:
AI agent development relies heavily on natural language prompting to define agents' tasks, knowledge, and goals. These prompts are interpreted by Large Language Models (LLMs), which govern agent behavior. Consequently, agentic performance is susceptible to variability arising from imprecise or ambiguous prompt formulations. Identifying and correcting such issues requires examining not only the agent's code, but also the internal system prompts generated throughout its execution lifecycle, as reflected in execution logs.
  In this work, we introduce an analytics pipeline implemented as part of the Agent Mentor open-source library that monitors and incrementally adapts the system prompts defining another agent's behavior. The pipeline improves performance by systematically injecting corrective instructions into the agent's knowledge. We describe its underlying mechanism, with particular emphasis on identifying semantic features associated with undesired behaviors and using them to derive corrective statements.
  We evaluate the proposed pipeline across three exemplar agent configurations and benchmark tasks using repeated execution runs to assess effectiveness. These experiments provide an initial exploration of automating such a mentoring pipeline within future agentic governance frameworks. Overall, the approach demonstrates consistent and measurable accuracy improvements across diverse configurations, particularly in settings dominated by specification ambiguity. For reproducibility, we released our code as open source under the Agent Mentor library.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Agent Mentor开源库中的分析管道，通过监控和自适应调整系统提示来改进AI代理性能，在规范模糊场景中显著提升准确性。
AI.motivation: AI代理开发依赖自然语言提示来定义任务、知识和目标，但提示的模糊或不精确会导致性能不稳定。需要一种系统方法来监控和修正代理执行过程中的内部系统提示。
AI.method: 在Agent Mentor开源库中实现分析管道，监控代理行为并增量调整系统提示。通过识别与不良行为相关的语义特征，生成纠正性指令注入代理知识中。
AI.result: 在三个示例代理配置和基准任务上评估，通过重复执行运行验证有效性。该方法在不同配置下都实现了持续可测量的准确性提升，特别是在规范模糊场景中效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为未来代理治理框架中的自动化指导管道提供了初步探索，展示了通过系统化提示调整改进代理性能的可行性。代码已作为Agent Mentor库开源发布。

title: VGGT-HPE: Reframing Head Pose Estimation as Relative Pose Prediction
summary: Monocular head pose estimation is traditionally formulated as direct regression from a single image to an absolute pose. This paradigm forces the network to implicitly internalize a dataset-specific canonical reference frame. In this work, we argue that predicting the relative rigid transformation between two observed head configurations is a fundamentally easier and more robust formulation. We introduce VGGT-HPE, a relative head pose estimator built upon a general-purpose geometry foundation model. Finetuned exclusively on synthetic facial renderings, our method sidesteps the need for an implicit anchor by reducing the problem to estimating a geometric displacement from an explicitly provided anchor with a known pose. As a practical benefit, the relative formulation also allows the anchor to be chosen at test time - for instance, a near-neutral frame or a temporally adjacent one - so that the prediction difficulty can be controlled by the application. Despite zero real-world training data, VGGT-HPE achieves state-of-the-art results on the BIWI benchmark, outperforming established absolute regression methods trained on mixed and real datasets. Through controlled easy- and hard-pair benchmarks, we also systematically validate our core hypothesis: relative prediction is intrinsically more accurate than absolute regression, with the advantage scaling alongside the difficulty of the target pose. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/VGGT-HPE

AI.tldr: VGGT-HPE提出相对头部姿态估计新范式，通过预测两个头部配置间的相对刚性变换，而非传统绝对回归，实现更鲁棒的姿态估计，在零真实数据训练下达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统单目头部姿态估计采用绝对回归范式，迫使网络隐式内化数据集特定的规范参考系。作者认为预测两个观测头部配置间的相对刚性变换是更简单、更鲁棒的公式化方式。
AI.method: 提出VGGT-HPE相对头部姿态估计器，基于通用几何基础模型构建。仅使用合成面部渲染进行微调，通过提供已知姿态的显式锚点，将问题简化为估计几何位移。测试时可灵活选择锚点（如近中性帧或时间相邻帧）。
AI.result: 在零真实世界训练数据情况下，VGGT-HPE在BIWI基准测试中达到最先进结果，优于在混合和真实数据集上训练的绝对回归方法。通过易/难配对基准测试系统验证了相对预测比绝对回归更准确，且优势随目标姿态难度增加而扩大。
AI.conclusion: 相对头部姿态估计是比绝对回归更优越的范式，通过几何位移预测和显式锚点选择，实现了更高的准确性和鲁棒性，即使仅使用合成数据训练也能超越传统方法。

title: From Perception to Planning: Evolving Ego-Centric Task-Oriented Spatiotemporal Reasoning via Curriculum Learning
summary: Modern vision-language models achieve strong performance in static perception, but remain limited in the complex spatiotemporal reasoning required for embodied, egocentric tasks. A major source of failure is their reliance on temporal priors learned from passive video data, which often leads to spatiotemporal hallucinations and poor generalization in dynamic environments. To address this, we present EgoTSR, a curriculum-based framework for learning task-oriented spatiotemporal reasoning. EgoTSR is built on the premise that embodied reasoning should evolve from explicit spatial understanding to internalized task-state assessment and finally to long-horizon planning. To support this paradigm, we construct EgoTSR-Data, a large-scale dataset comprising 46 million samples organized into three stages: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision, weakly supervised tagging, and long-horizon sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoTSR effectively eliminates chronological biases, achieving 92.4% accuracy on long-horizon logical reasoning tasks while maintaining high fine-grained perceptual precision, significantly outperforming existing open-source and closed-source state-of-the-art models.

AI.tldr: EgoTSR是一个基于课程学习的任务导向时空推理框架，通过三阶段训练消除时序偏差，在长视野逻辑推理任务上达到92.4%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在静态感知上表现良好，但在具身、第一人称任务所需的复杂时空推理上存在局限。主要问题是依赖从被动视频数据学习的时序先验，导致时空幻觉和动态环境泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出EgoTSR课程学习框架，基于"从显式空间理解到内部化任务状态评估，再到长视野规划"的理念。构建EgoTSR-Data数据集（4600万样本），包含三阶段：思维链监督、弱监督标记、长视野序列。
AI.result: EgoTSR有效消除时序偏差，在长视野逻辑推理任务上达到92.4%的准确率，同时保持高细粒度感知精度，显著优于现有开源和闭源SOTA模型。
AI.conclusion: EgoTSR通过课程学习方法解决了现有视觉语言模型在时空推理中的时序偏差问题，为具身智能任务提供了有效的时空推理框架。

title: Dual-Branch Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution
summary: Remote sensing infrared image super-resolution aims to recover sharper thermal observations from low-resolution inputs while preserving target contours, scene layout, and radiometric stability. Unlike visible-image super-resolution, thermal imagery is weakly textured and more sensitive to unstable local sharpening, which makes complementary local and global modeling especially important. This paper presents our solution to the NTIRE 2026 Infrared Image Super-Resolution Challenge, a dual-branch system that combines a HAT-L branch and a MambaIRv2-L branch. The inference pipeline applies test-time local conversion on HAT, eight-way self-ensemble on MambaIRv2, and fixed equal-weight image-space fusion. We report both the official challenge score and a reproducible evaluation on 12 synthetic times-four thermal samples derived from Caltech Aerial RGB-Thermal, on which the fused output outperforms either single branch in PSNR, SSIM, and the overall Score. The results suggest that infrared super-resolution benefits from explicit complementarity between locally strong transformer restoration and globally stable state-space modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于遥感红外图像超分辨率的双分支系统，结合HAT-L和MambaIRv2-L分支，通过测试时局部转换和八路自集成技术，在NTIRE 2026挑战赛中取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 遥感红外图像超分辨率需要从低分辨率输入恢复更清晰的热观测，同时保持目标轮廓、场景布局和辐射稳定性。与可见光图像不同，热图像纹理较弱，对局部锐化更敏感，因此需要互补的局部和全局建模。
AI.method: 提出双分支系统：HAT-L分支（局部强变换器恢复）和MambaIRv2-L分支（全局稳定状态空间建模）。推理流程包括对HAT的测试时局部转换、对MambaIRv2的八路自集成，以及固定等权重图像空间融合。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026红外图像超分辨率挑战赛中取得良好表现，在12个合成四倍热样本（源自Caltech Aerial RGB-Thermal）上，融合输出在PSNR、SSIM和总体得分上均优于任一单分支。
AI.conclusion: 红外超分辨率受益于局部强变换器恢复和全局稳定状态空间建模之间的显式互补性，双分支融合系统能够有效提升性能。

title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?
summary: We introduce Agent^2 RL-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training -- whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, and run complete RL pipelines that improve foundation models. This capability is important because RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks remain largely static: supervised fine-tuning alone yields strong results, leaving interactive RL engineering untested. Agent^2 RL-Bench addresses this with six tasks across three levels -- from static rule-based training to closed-loop online RL with trajectory collection -- each adding a structural requirement that prior levels do not impose. The benchmark provides isolated workspaces with a grading API, runtime instrumentation that records every submission and code revision, and automated post-hoc analysis that generates structured run reports, enabling the first automated diagnostic of agent-driven post-training behavior. Across multiple agent stacks spanning five agent systems and six driver LLMs, we find that agents achieve striking interactive gains -- on ALFWorld, an RL-only agent improves from 5.97 to 93.28 via SFT warm-up and GRPO with online rollouts -- yet make only marginal progress on others (DeepSearchQA: +2.75 within evaluation noise), and that driver choice has a large effect on interactive tasks -- within the same scaffold, switching drivers changes interactive improvement from near-zero to +78pp. More broadly, the benchmark reveals that supervised pipelines dominate agent-driven post-training under fixed budgets, with online RL succeeding as the final best route only on ALFWorld. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/tree/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl_bench.

AI.tldr: Agent^2 RL-Bench是一个评估LLM智能体自主设计、实施和运行完整强化学习流程能力的基准测试，重点关注RL后训练阶段，包含六个任务和三个难度级别。
AI.motivation: RL后训练在模型对齐和专业化中越来越重要，但现有基准测试大多是静态的，仅通过监督微调就能取得良好结果，未能测试交互式RL工程能力。需要评估智能体是否能自主完成完整的RL流程。
AI.method: 创建包含六个任务、三个难度级别的基准测试：从静态规则训练到闭环在线RL与轨迹收集。提供隔离工作空间、评分API、运行时工具记录每次提交和代码修订，以及自动事后分析生成结构化运行报告。
AI.result: 智能体在某些任务上取得显著交互式改进（如ALFWorld从5.97提升到93.28），但在其他任务上进展有限（如DeepSearchQA仅+2.75）。驱动LLM选择对交互任务影响巨大，同一框架下切换驱动LLM可使交互改进从接近零提升到+78个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在固定预算下，监督流程主导智能体驱动的后训练，在线RL仅在ALFWorld上作为最终最佳路径成功。该基准首次实现了对智能体驱动后训练行为的自动化诊断。

title: A Dual Cross-Attention Graph Learning Framework For Multimodal MRI-Based Major Depressive Disorder Detection
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a prevalent mental disorder associated with complex neurobiological changes that cannot be fully captured using a single imaging modality. The use of multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides a more comprehensive understanding of brain changes by combining structural and functional data. Despite this, the effective integration of these modalities remains challenging. In this study, we propose a dual cross-attention-based multimodal fusion framework that explicitly models bidirectional interactions between structural MRI (sMRI) and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) representations. The proposed approach is tested on the large-scale REST-meta-MDD dataset using both structural and functional brain atlas configurations. Numerous experiments conducted under a 10-fold stratified cross-validation demonstrated that the proposed fusion algorithm achieves robust and competitive performance across all atlas types. The proposed method consistently outperforms conventional feature-level concatenation for functional atlases, while maintaining comparable performance for structural atlases. The most effective dual cross-attention multimodal model obtained 84.71% accuracy, 86.42% sensitivity, 82.89% specificity, 84.34% precision, and 85.37% F1-score. These findings emphasize the importance of explicitly modeling cross-modal interactions for multimodal neuroimaging-based MDD classification.

AI.tldr: 提出基于双交叉注意力的多模态融合框架，用于整合结构MRI和功能MRI数据，在抑郁症分类任务中取得优于传统特征拼接方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 重度抑郁症（MDD）具有复杂的神经生物学变化，单一成像模态无法全面捕捉。多模态MRI结合结构和功能数据能提供更全面的理解，但有效整合这些模态仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出双交叉注意力多模态融合框架，显式建模结构MRI（sMRI）和静息态功能MRI（rs-fMRI）表示之间的双向交互作用。在REST-meta-MDD数据集上使用结构和功能脑图谱配置进行测试。
AI.result: 在10折分层交叉验证中，该融合算法在所有图谱类型上都实现了稳健且具有竞争力的性能。对于功能图谱，始终优于传统的特征级拼接方法；对于结构图谱，保持可比性能。最佳模型获得84.71%准确率、86.42%灵敏度、82.89%特异性、84.34%精确度和85.37% F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了显式建模跨模态交互对于基于多模态神经影像的MDD分类的重要性，双交叉注意力框架能有效整合结构和功能MRI信息。

title: Failure Ontology: A Lifelong Learning Framework for Blind Spot Detection and Resilience Design
summary: Personalized learning systems are almost universally designed around a single objective: help people acquire knowledge and skills more efficiently. We argue this framing misses the more consequential problem. The most damaging failures in human life-financial ruin, health collapse, professional obsolescence-are rarely caused by insufficient knowledge acquisition. They arise from the systematic absence of entire conceptual territories from a person's cognitive map: domains they never thought to explore because, from within their existing worldview, those domains did not appear to exist or to matter. We call such absences Ontological Blind Spots and introduce Failure Ontology (F), a formal framework for detecting, classifying, and remediating them across a human lifetime. The framework introduces three original contributions: (1) a four-type taxonomy of blind spots distinguishing domain blindness, structural blindness, weight blindness, and temporal blindness; (2) five convergent failure patterns characterizing how blind spots interact with external disruption to produce catastrophic outcomes; and (3) the Failure Learning Efficiency Theorem, proving that failure-based learning achieves higher sample efficiency than success-based learning under bounded historical data. We illustrate the framework through historical case analysis of the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis and the 2008 subprime mortgage crisis, and through alongitudinal individual case study spanning five life stages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"本体论盲点"概念，认为个人失败主要源于认知地图中缺失整个概念领域，而非知识不足，并建立了失败本体论(F)框架来检测和修复这些盲点。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化学习系统只关注知识获取效率，但人类生活中的重大失败（财务崩溃、健康危机、职业过时）很少源于知识不足，而是源于认知地图中缺失整个概念领域，即"本体论盲点"。
AI.method: 提出失败本体论(F)框架，包含：1）四类盲点分类法（领域盲点、结构盲点、权重盲点、时间盲点）；2）五种失败模式描述盲点如何与外部干扰产生灾难性结果；3）失败学习效率定理，证明在有限历史数据下基于失败的学习比基于成功的学习更高效。
AI.result: 通过1997年亚洲金融危机和2008年次贷危机的历史案例分析，以及跨越五个生命阶段的纵向个体案例研究，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 需要从单纯关注知识获取转向检测和修复本体论盲点，失败本体论框架为理解人类失败的根本原因和设计更有效的学习干预提供了新视角。

title: PhyMix: Towards Physically Consistent Single-Image 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Implicit--Explicit Optimization
summary: Existing single-image 3D indoor scene generators often produce results that look visually plausible but fail to obey real-world physics, limiting their reliability in robotics, embodied AI, and design. To examine this gap, we introduce a unified Physics Evaluator that measures four main aspects: geometric priors, contact, stability, and deployability, which are further decomposed into nine sub-constraints, establishing the first benchmark to measure physical consistency. Based on this evaluator, our analysis shows that state-of-the-art methods remain largely physics-unaware. To overcome this limitation, we further propose a framework that integrates feedback from the Physics Evaluator into both training and inference, enhancing the physical plausibility of generated scenes. Specifically, we propose PhyMix, which is composed of two complementary components: (i) implicit alignment via Scene-GRPO, a critic-free group-relative policy optimization that leverages the Physics Evaluator as a preference signal and biases sampling towards physically feasible layouts, and (ii) explicit refinement via a plug-and-play Test-Time Optimizer (TTO) that uses differentiable evaluator signals to correct residual violations during generation. Overall, our method unifies evaluation, reward shaping, and inference-time correction, producing 3D indoor scenes that are visually faithful and physically plausible. Extensive synthetic evaluations confirm state-of-the-art performance in both visual fidelity and physical plausibility, and extensive qualitative examples in stylized and real-world images further showcase the robustness of the method. We will release codes and models upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的物理评估器衡量3D室内场景生成的物理一致性，并基于此开发PhyMix框架，通过隐式对齐和显式优化提升生成场景的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像3D室内场景生成器虽然视觉上合理，但缺乏物理真实性，限制了在机器人、具身AI和设计中的应用可靠性。需要填补这一差距。
AI.method: 1) 提出统一的物理评估器，包含几何先验、接触、稳定性和可部署性四个主要方面，分解为九个子约束；2) 提出PhyMix框架，包含隐式对齐（Scene-GRPO）和显式优化（TTO）两个互补组件。
AI.result: 分析显示现有SOTA方法大多缺乏物理意识；提出的方法在合成评估中实现了视觉保真度和物理合理性的SOTA性能，在风格化和真实图像中展示了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法统一了评估、奖励塑造和推理时校正，生成既视觉忠实又物理合理的3D室内场景，填补了现有方法的物理一致性空白。

title: Working Paper: Towards Schema-based Learning from a Category-Theoretic Perspective
summary:
We introduce a hierarchical categorical framework for Schema-Based Learning (SBL) structured across four interconnected levels. At the schema level, a free multicategory $Sch_{syn}$ encodes fundamental schemas and transformations. An implementation functor $\mathcal{I}$ maps syntactic schemas to representational languages, inducing via the Grothendieck construction the total category $Sch_{impl}$. Implemented schemas are mapped by a functor $Model$ into the Kleisli category $\mathbf{KL(G)}$ of the Giry monad, yielding probabilistic models, while an instances presheaf assigns evaluated instance spaces. A semantic category $Sch_{sem}$, defined as a full subcategory of $\mathbf{KL(G)}$, provides semantic grounding through an interpretation functor from $Sch_{impl}$.
  At the agent level, $Sch_{impl}$ is equipped with a duoidal structure $\mathcal{O}_{Sch}$ supporting schema-based workflows. A left duoidal action on the category $Mind$ enables workflow execution over mental objects, whose components include mental spaces, predictive models, and a cognitive kernel composed of memory and cognitive modules. Each module is specified by schema-typed interfaces, duoidal workflows, a success condition, and a logical signature. Memory is formalized categorically via memory subsystems, a presheaf $Data_M$, a monoidal operation category $Ops_M$, and read/write natural transformations. Together with the $Body$ category, Mind defines the embodied SBL agent.
  At higher levels, SBL is represented as an object of the agent architecture category $ArchCat$, enabling comparison with heterogeneous paradigms, while the $World$ category models multi-agent and agent-environment interactions. Altogether, the framework forms a weak hierarchical $n$-categorical structure linking schema semantics, cognition, embodiment, architectural abstraction, and world-level interaction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于模式的层次化分类框架，包含模式、实现、代理、架构和世界四个相互关联的层次，用于形式化模式学习系统。
AI.motivation: 需要为模式学习提供一个统一的形式化框架，能够同时处理语法模式、概率模型、认知过程和多智能体交互等多个层面，以建立从基础模式到复杂认知系统的完整数学描述。
AI.method: 采用分层分类方法：1) 模式层定义语法模式及其转换；2) 实现层通过函子将模式映射到概率模型；3) 代理层引入双幺半结构支持工作流，并形式化心智系统；4) 架构层和世界层处理系统比较和多智能体交互。
AI.result: 构建了一个弱层次化n-分类结构，将模式语义、认知、具身化、架构抽象和世界级交互连接起来，为模式学习提供了严格的数学基础。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为模式学习提供了一个全面的分类形式化，能够统一描述从基础模式到复杂认知系统的各个层面，为未来模式学习系统的设计和分析提供了理论基础。

title: VGA-Bench: A Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality Evaluation
summary: The rapid advancement of AIGC-based video generation has underscored the critical need for comprehensive evaluation frameworks that go beyond traditional generation quality metrics to encompass aesthetic appeal. However, existing benchmarks remain largely focused on technical fidelity, leaving a significant gap in holistic assessment-particularly with respect to perceptual and artistic qualities. To address this limitation, we introduce VGA-Bench, a unified benchmark for joint evaluation of video generation quality and aesthetic quality. VGA-Bench is built upon a principled three-tier taxonomy: Aesthetic Quality, Aesthetic Tagging, and Generation Quality, each decomposed into multiple fine-grained sub-dimensions to enable systematic assessment. Guided by this taxonomy, we design 1,016 diverse prompts and generate a large-scale dataset of over 60,000 videos using 12 video generation models, ensuring broad coverage across content, style, and artifacts. To enable scalable and automated evaluation, we annotate a subset of the dataset via human labeling and develop three dedicated multi-task neural assessors: VAQA-Net for aesthetic quality prediction, VTag-Net for automatic aesthetic tagging, and VGQA-Net for generation and basic quality attributes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our models achieve reliable alignment with human judgments, offering both accuracy and efficiency. We release VGA-Bench as a public benchmark to foster research in AIGC evaluation, with applications in content moderation, model debugging, and generative model optimization.

AI.tldr: VGA-Bench：首个联合评估视频生成质量和美学质量的统一基准，包含三层分类体系、大规模数据集和三个专用神经网络评估器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评估基准主要关注技术保真度，缺乏对感知和艺术质量的全面评估，需要更全面的评估框架来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 提出三层分类体系（美学质量、美学标签、生成质量），设计1016个多样化提示，使用12个视频生成模型创建超过6万个视频的大规模数据集，并通过人工标注开发三个专用多任务神经网络评估器（VAQA-Net、VTag-Net、VGQA-Net）。
AI.result: 实验表明，开发的评估模型与人类判断具有可靠的一致性，在准确性和效率方面表现良好，为AIGC评估提供了可扩展的自动化解决方案。
AI.conclusion: VGA-Bench作为一个公开基准，将促进AIGC评估研究，在内容审核、模型调试和生成模型优化等方面具有应用价值。

title: Enhancing Cross-Problem Vehicle Routing via Federated Learning
summary: Vehicle routing problems (VRPs) constitute a core optimization challenge in modern logistics and supply chain management. The recent neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has demonstrated superior efficiency over some traditional algorithms. While serving as a primary NCO approach for solving general VRPs, current cross-problem learning paradigms are still subject to performance degradation and generalizability decay, when transferring from simple VRP variants to those involving different and complex constraints. To strengthen the paradigms, this paper offers an innovative "Multi-problem Pre-train, then Single-problem Fine-tune" framework with Federated Learning (MPSF-FL). This framework exploits the common knowledge of a federated global model to foster efficient cross-problem knowledge sharing and transfer among local models for single-problem fine-tuning. In this way, local models effectively retain common VRP knowledge from up-to-date global model, while being efficiently adapted to downstream VRPs with heterogeneous complex constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework not only enhances the performance in diverse VRPs, but also improves the generalizability in unseen problems.

AI.tldr: 提出MPSF-FL框架，通过联邦学习实现多问题预训练和单问题微调，提升车辆路径问题求解的性能和泛化能力
AI.motivation: 当前神经组合优化方法在解决复杂约束的车辆路径问题时，存在性能下降和泛化能力衰减的问题，需要加强跨问题学习范式
AI.method: 提出"多问题预训练，单问题微调"框架结合联邦学习，利用联邦全局模型共享跨问题知识，本地模型保留通用知识并适应下游复杂约束问题
AI.result: 实验表明该框架不仅提升了多种车辆路径问题的求解性能，还改善了在未见问题上的泛化能力
