comment: 16pages ; Open-source implementation and evaluation scripts will be released in a subsequent revision
summary: Every existing knowledge system separates storage from computation. We show this separation is unnecessary and eliminate it. In a standard triple is_a(Apple, Company), domain context lives in the query or the programmer's mind. In a CDC four-tuple is_a(Apple, Company, @Business), domain becomes a structural field embedded in predicate arity. Any system respecting arity automatically performs domain-scoped inference without external rules. We call this representation-computation unity (RCU). From the four-tuple structure, three inference mechanisms emerge: domain-scoped closure, typed inheritance, and write-time falsification via cycle detection per domain fiber. We establish RCU formally via four theorems. RCU is implementable. We present a working symbolic engine (2400 lines Python+Prolog) resolving four engineering issues: rule-data separation, shared-fiber handling, read-only meta-layer design, and intersective convergence. A central result: CDC domain-constrained inference is distinct from Prolog with a domain argument. Two case studies validate the engine. ICD-11 classification (1247 entities, 3 axes) shows fibers resolve multiple inheritance. CBT clinical reasoning shows generalization to temporal reasoning with session turn as ordered domain index. Multi-constraint queries realize CSP arc-consistency with complexity O(m (N/K)^2), confirming the domain lattice's sparsity governs performance. When domain is structural, data computes itself.

AI.tldr: 提出RCU（表示-计算统一）框架，通过四元组CDC表示将领域上下文嵌入谓词元数中，消除传统知识系统中存储与计算的分离，实现领域约束的自动推理。
AI.motivation: 传统知识系统将存储与计算分离，导致领域上下文存在于查询或程序员头脑中。本文旨在消除这种分离，将领域上下文作为结构字段嵌入谓词元数，实现表示与计算的统一。
AI.method: 提出CDC四元组表示法（如is_a(Apple, Company, @Business)），将领域作为结构字段。开发符号引擎（2400行Python+Prolog），解决规则-数据分离、共享纤维处理、只读元层设计和交集收敛四个工程问题。
AI.result: 从四元组结构涌现三种推理机制：领域约束闭包、类型继承和按领域纤维的写时循环检测。形式化证明四个定理，通过ICD-11分类和CBT临床推理案例验证。多约束查询实现CSP弧一致性，复杂度O(m(N/K)^2)。
AI.conclusion: 当领域成为结构时，数据能够自我计算。CDC领域约束推理与带领域参数的Prolog有本质区别，领域格稀疏性决定性能，实现表示与计算的统一。

title: Anatomy-Informed Deep Learning for Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Segmentation
summary: In CT angiography, the accurate segmentation of abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAAs) is difficult due to large anatomical variability, low-contrast vessel boundaries, and the close proximity of organs whose intensities resemble vascular structures, often leading to false positives. To address these challenges, we propose an anatomy-aware segmentation framework that integrates organ exclusion masks derived from TotalSegmentator into the training process. These masks encode explicit anatomical priors by identifying non-vascular organsand penalizing aneurysm predictions within these regions, thereby guiding the U-Net to focus on the aorta and its pathological dilation while suppressing anatomically implausible predictions. Despite being trained on a relatively small dataset, the anatomy-aware model achieves high accuracy, substantially reduces false positives, and improves boundary consistency compared to a standard U-Net baseline. The results demonstrate that incorporating anatomical knowledge through exclusion masks provides an efficient mechanism to enhance robustness and generalization, enabling reliable AAA segmentation even with limited training data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合器官排除掩码的解剖感知分割框架，用于提高CT血管造影中腹主动脉瘤分割的准确性，减少假阳性
AI.motivation: CT血管造影中腹主动脉瘤分割面临三大挑战：1）解剖结构变异大；2）血管边界对比度低；3）邻近器官强度与血管相似导致假阳性
AI.method: 使用TotalSegmentator生成器官排除掩码，将这些掩码整合到训练过程中，通过识别非血管器官并惩罚这些区域内的动脉瘤预测，引导U-Net专注于主动脉及其病理扩张
AI.result: 尽管在相对较小的数据集上训练，解剖感知模型实现了高精度，显著减少了假阳性，并改善了边界一致性，优于标准U-Net基线
AI.conclusion: 通过排除掩码融入解剖知识提供了一种高效机制来增强鲁棒性和泛化能力，即使在有限训练数据下也能实现可靠的AAA分割

title: EvoNash-MARL: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Medium-Horizon Equity Allocation
summary: Medium-to-long-horizon stock allocation presents significant challenges due toveak predictive structures, non-stadonary market regimes, and the degradationf signals following the application of transaction costs, capacity limits, and tail-isk constraints. Conventional approaches commonly rely on a single predictor orloosely coupled prediction-to-allocation pipeline, limiting robustness underThis work addresses a targeted design question: whetherlistribution shift. 1coupling reinforcement learning (RL), multi-agent policy populations, Policy-Space Response Oracle (PSRO)-style aggregation, league best-response trainingevolutionary replacement, and execution-aware checkpoint selection within ainified walk-forward loop improves allocator robustness at medium to longhorizons. The proposed framework, EvoNash-MARL, integrates these componentswithin an execution-aware allocation loop and further introduces a layeredpolicy architecture comprising a direction head and a risk head, nonlinear signalenhancement, feature-quality reweighting, and constraint-aware checkpointselection. Under a 120-window walk-forward protocol, the resolved v21configuration achieves mean excess Sharpe 0.7600 and robust score -0.0203,anking first among internal controls; on aligned daily out-of-sample returnsrom 2014-01-02 to 2024-01-05, it delivers 19.6% annualized return versus 11.7% for SPY, and in an extended walk-forward evaluation through 2026-02-10 it delivers 20.5% rersus 13.5%. The framework maintains positive performance under realistictress constraints and exhibits structured cross-market generalization; however,lobal strong significance under White's Reality Check (WRC) and SPA-lite testingestablished. Therefore, the results are presented as evidence supporting asnotnore stable medium-to long-horizon training and selection paradigm, ratherhan as prooffof universally superior market-timing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoNash-MARL框架，通过整合强化学习、多智能体策略、PSRO聚合和进化替换等技术，解决中长期股票配置中的预测结构弱、市场非平稳、信号衰减等挑战，在回测中表现出优于基准的收益表现。
AI.motivation: 中长期股票配置面临三大挑战：弱预测结构、非平稳市场机制、以及信号在交易成本、容量限制和尾部风险约束下的衰减。传统方法通常依赖单一预测器或松耦合的预测-配置流程，在分布偏移下鲁棒性有限。
AI.method: 提出EvoNash-MARL框架，整合强化学习、多智能体策略种群、PSRO风格聚合、联盟最佳响应训练、进化替换和执行感知检查点选择。采用分层策略架构（方向头和风险头）、非线性信号增强、特征质量重加权和约束感知检查点选择。
AI.result: 在120窗口滚动回测中，v21配置获得平均超额夏普率0.7600和鲁棒分数-0.0203；在2014-2024年样本外测试中，年化收益19.6% vs SPY的11.7%；在延伸至2026年的测试中，年化收益20.5% vs 13.5%。框架在现实压力约束下保持正收益，并展示跨市场泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持更稳定的中长期训练和选择范式，但未证明普遍优越的市场择时能力。White's Reality Check和SPA-lite测试未达到全局强显著性，因此结果应视为支持性证据而非普遍优越性的证明。

title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Single Image Reflection Removal in the Wild: Datasets, Results, and Methods
summary: In this paper, we review the NTIRE 2026 challenge on single-image reflection removal (SIRR) in the Wild. SIRR is a fundamental task in image restoration. Despite progress in academic research, most methods are tested on synthetic images or limited real-world images, creating a gap in real-world applications. In this challenge, we provide participants with the OpenRR-5k dataset, which requires them to process real-world images that cover a range of reflection scenarios and intensities, with the goal of generating clean images without reflections. The challenge attracted more than 100 registrations, with 11 of them participating in the final testing phase. The top-ranked methods advanced the state-of-the-art reflection removal performance and earned unanimous recognition from the five experts in the field. The proposed OpenRR-5k dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qiuzhangTiTi/OpenRR-5k, and the homepage of this challenge is at https://github.com/caijie0620/OpenRR-5k. Due to page limitations, this article only presents partial content; the full report and detailed analyses are available in the extended arXiv version.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026单图像反射去除挑战赛回顾，使用OpenRR-5k真实世界数据集，11个团队参与最终测试，推动了反射去除技术发展
AI.motivation: 单图像反射去除是图像恢复的基础任务，但现有方法多在合成图像或有限真实图像上测试，与实际应用存在差距，需要真实世界场景的评估
AI.method: 提供OpenRR-5k真实世界反射去除数据集，涵盖多种反射场景和强度，组织挑战赛让参与者处理这些图像以生成无反射的干净图像
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了100多个注册，11个团队参与最终测试，排名靠前的方法提升了反射去除性能，获得领域专家一致认可
AI.conclusion: NTIRE 2026挑战赛通过OpenRR-5k数据集推动了真实世界反射去除技术的发展，数据集和挑战赛主页已公开

title: CSPO: Alleviating Reward Ambiguity for Structured Table-to-LaTeX Generation
summary: Tables contain rich structured information, yet when stored as images their contents remain "locked" within pixels. Converting table images into LaTeX code enables faithful digitization and reuse, but current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often fail to preserve structural, style, or content fidelity. Conventional post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) typically relies on a single aggregated reward, leading to reward ambiguity that conflates multiple behavioral aspects and hinders effective optimization. We propose Component-Specific Policy Optimization (CSPO), an RL framework that disentangles optimization across LaTeX tables components-structure, style, and content. In particular, CSPO assigns component-specific rewards and backpropagates each signal only through the tokens relevant to its component, alleviating reward ambiguity and enabling targeted component-wise optimization. To comprehensively assess performance, we introduce a set of hierarchical evaluation metrics. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of CSPO, underscoring the importance of component-specific optimization for reliable structured generation.

AI.tldr: CSPO是一个针对表格图像转LaTeX的强化学习框架，通过组件特定优化解决奖励模糊问题，提升结构、样式和内容的保真度。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在将表格图像转换为LaTeX代码时，往往无法保持结构、样式或内容的保真度。传统的强化学习后训练通常依赖单一聚合奖励，导致奖励模糊问题，混淆了多个行为方面，阻碍了有效优化。
AI.method: 提出组件特定策略优化（CSPO）框架，将LaTeX表格的优化分解为结构、样式和内容三个组件。为每个组件分配特定奖励，并仅通过与其相关的令牌反向传播每个信号，从而缓解奖励模糊问题，实现有针对性的组件级优化。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明了CSPO的有效性，强调了组件特定优化对于可靠结构化生成的重要性。引入了分层评估指标来全面评估性能。
AI.conclusion: CSPO通过组件特定优化解决了表格图像转LaTeX中的奖励模糊问题，显著提升了结构化生成的可靠性和保真度。

title: SIMPLER: H&E-Informed Representation Learning for Structured Illumination Microscopy
summary: Structured Illumination Microscopy (SIM) enables rapid, high-contrast optical sectioning of fresh tissue without staining or physical sectioning, making it promising for intraoperative and point-of-care diagnostics. Recent foundation and large-scale self-supervised models in digital pathology have demonstrated strong performance on section-based modalities such as Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) and immunohistochemistry (IHC). However, these approaches are predominantly trained on thin tissue sections and do not explicitly address thick-tissue fluorescence modalities such as SIM. When transferred directly to SIM, performance is constrained by substantial modality shift, and naive fine-tuning often overfits to modality-specific appearance rather than underlying histological structure. We introduce SIMPLER (Structured Illumination Microscopy-Powered Learning for Embedding Representations), a cross-modality self-supervised pretraining framework that leverages H&E as a semantic anchor to learn reusable SIM representations. H&E encodes rich cellular and glandular structure aligned with established clinical annotations, while SIM provides rapid, nondestructive imaging of fresh tissue. During pretraining, SIM and H&E are progressively aligned through adversarial, contrastive, and reconstruction-based objectives, encouraging SIM embeddings to internalize histological structure from H&E without collapsing modality-specific characteristics. A single pretrained SIMPLER encoder transfers across multiple downstream tasks, including multiple instance learning and morphological clustering, consistently outperforming SIM models trained from scratch or H&E-only pretraining. Importantly, joint alignment enhances SIM performance without degrading H&E representations, demonstrating asymmetric enrichment rather

AI.tldr: SIMPLER是一个跨模态自监督预训练框架，利用H&E染色作为语义锚点学习可重用的SIM表示，解决SIM与数字病理学模型之间的模态差异问题。
AI.motivation: 结构化照明显微镜(SIM)能够对新鲜组织进行快速、高对比度的光学切片，无需染色或物理切片，在术中诊断和即时诊断中具有潜力。然而，现有的数字病理学基础模型主要基于薄组织切片（如H&E和IHC）训练，直接应用于SIM时存在显著的模态差异问题，简单的微调容易过拟合到模态特定的外观而非底层组织学结构。
AI.method: SIMPLER采用跨模态自监督预训练框架，将H&E作为语义锚点来学习可重用的SIM表示。通过对抗性、对比性和重建性目标逐步对齐SIM和H&E模态，鼓励SIM嵌入从H&E中内化组织学结构，同时保留模态特定特征。使用单个预训练的SIMPLER编码器可迁移到多个下游任务。
AI.result: SIMPLER在多个下游任务（包括多实例学习和形态学聚类）中持续优于从头训练的SIM模型或仅使用H&E预训练的模型。重要的是，联合对齐增强了SIM性能而不降低H&E表示质量，展示了不对称的丰富化效果。
AI.conclusion: SIMPLER框架成功解决了SIM与数字病理学模型之间的模态差异问题，通过跨模态对齐学习可重用的SIM表示，为术中诊断和即时诊断提供了有效的解决方案，同时保持了H&E表示的质量。

title: RAG-KT: Cross-platform Explainable Knowledge Tracing with Multi-view Fusion Retrieval Generation
summary: Knowledge Tracing (KT) infers a student's knowledge state from past interactions to predict future performance. Conventional Deep Learning (DL)-based KT models are typically tied to platform-specific identifiers and latent representations, making them hard to transfer and interpret. Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods can be either ungrounded under prompting or overly domain-dependent under fine-tuning. In addition, most existing KT methods are developed and evaluated under a same-distribution assumption. In real deployments, educational data often arise from heterogeneous platforms with substantial distribution shift, which often degrades generalization. To this end, we propose RAG-KT, a retrieval-augmented paradigm that frames cross-platform KT as reliable context constrained inference with LLMs. It builds a unified multi-source structured context with cross-source alignment via Question Group abstractions and retrieves complementary rich and reliable context for each prediction, enabling grounded prediction and interpretable diagnosis. Experiments on three public KT benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in accuracy and robustness, including strong performance under cross-platform conditions.

AI.tldr: RAG-KT：基于检索增强的知识追踪框架，通过构建统一的多源结构化上下文和跨平台对齐，解决传统深度学习方法难以迁移、解释以及分布偏移的问题，在跨平台条件下实现准确且鲁棒的预测。
AI.motivation: 传统基于深度学习的知识追踪模型通常与平台特定的标识符和潜在表示绑定，难以迁移和解释。基于大语言模型的方法要么在提示下缺乏基础，要么在微调时过度依赖特定领域。此外，现有方法大多在同分布假设下开发和评估，而实际教育数据常来自异质平台，存在显著的分布偏移，影响泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出RAG-KT，一种检索增强范式，将跨平台知识追踪构建为基于可靠上下文约束的LLM推理。通过问题组抽象构建统一的多源结构化上下文并进行跨源对齐，为每个预测检索互补的丰富可靠上下文，实现有基础的预测和可解释的诊断。
AI.result: 在三个公开知识追踪基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性方面取得一致提升，包括在跨平台条件下的强大性能。
AI.conclusion: RAG-KT通过检索增强范式有效解决了知识追踪中的跨平台分布偏移问题，实现了更好的泛化能力和可解释性，为实际教育部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Context Matters: Vision-Based Depression Detection Comparing Classical and Deep Approaches
summary: The classical approach to detecting depression from vision emphasizes interpretable features, such as facial expression, and classifiers such as the Support Vector Machine (SVM). With the advent of deep learning, there has been a shift in feature representations and classification approaches. Contemporary approaches use learnt features from general-purpose vision models such as VGGNet to train machine learning models. Little is known about how classical and deep approaches compare in depression detection with respect to accuracy, fairness, and generalizability, especially across contexts. To address these questions, we compared classical and deep approaches to the detection of depression in the visual modality in two different contexts: Mother-child interactions in the TPOT database and patient-clinician interviews in the Pitt database. In the former, depression was operationalized as a history of depression per the DSM and current or recent clinically significant symptoms. In the latter, all participants met initial criteria for depression per DSM, and depression was reassessed over the course of treatment. The classical approach included handcrafted features with SVM classifiers. Learnt features were turn-level embeddings from the FMAE-IAT that were combined with Multi-Layer Perceptron classifiers. The classical approach achieved higher accuracy in both contexts. It was also significantly fairer than the deep approach in the patient-clinician context. Cross-context generalizability was modest at best for both approaches, which suggests that depression may be context-specific.

AI.tldr: 比较传统方法（手工特征+SVM）与深度学习方法（FMAE-IAT嵌入+MLP）在抑郁检测中的表现，发现传统方法在两个数据库中都更准确，且在患者-临床医生情境中更公平，两种方法的跨情境泛化能力都有限。
AI.motivation: 研究传统方法与深度学习方法在抑郁视觉检测中的比较，特别是在准确性、公平性和泛化性方面的差异，尤其是在不同情境（母婴互动 vs 患者-临床医生访谈）中的表现。
AI.method: 使用两个数据库：TPOT（母婴互动）和Pitt（患者-临床医生访谈）。传统方法使用手工特征+SVM分类器，深度学习方法使用FMAE-IAT的turn-level嵌入+多层感知机分类器。比较两种方法在不同情境下的准确性、公平性和跨情境泛化能力。
AI.result: 传统方法在两个情境中都获得了更高的准确性，在患者-临床医生情境中显著更公平。两种方法的跨情境泛化能力都很有限，表明抑郁表现可能具有情境特异性。
AI.conclusion: 传统方法在抑郁视觉检测中仍然具有优势，特别是在准确性和公平性方面。抑郁检测可能高度依赖于具体情境，跨情境泛化能力有限，这为未来研究提供了重要启示。

title: Delving Aleatoric Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation via Vision Foundation Models
summary: Medical image segmentation supports clinical workflows by precisely delineating anatomical structures and lesions. However, medical image datasets medical image datasets suffer from acquisition noise and annotation ambiguity, causing pervasive data uncertainty that substantially undermines model robustness. Existing research focuses primarily on model architectural improvements and predictive reliability estimation, while systematic exploration of the intrinsic data uncertainty remains insufficient. To address this gap, this work proposes leveraging the universal representation capabilities of visual foundation models to estimate inherent data uncertainty. Specifically, we analyze the feature diversity of the model's decoded representations and quantify their singular value energy to define the semantic perception scale for each class, thereby measuring sample difficulty and aleatoric uncertainty. Based on this foundation, we design two uncertainty-driven application strategies: (1) the aleatoric uncertainty-aware data filtering mechanism to eliminate potentially noisy samples and enhance model learning quality; (2) the dynamic uncertainty-aware optimization strategy that adaptively adjusts class-specific loss weights during training based on the semantic perception scale, combined with a label denoising mechanism to improve training stability. Experimental results on five public datasets encompassing CT and MRI modalities and involving multi-organ and tumor segmentation tasks demonstrate that our method achieves significant and robust performance improvements across various mainstream network architectures, revealing the broad application potential of aleatoric uncertainty in medical image understanding and segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用视觉基础模型的通用表示能力来估计医学图像分割中的数据不确定性，通过特征多样性分析量化语义感知尺度，并设计了两种不确定性驱动的应用策略来提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像数据集存在采集噪声和标注模糊性，导致普遍的数据不确定性，严重影响模型鲁棒性。现有研究主要关注模型架构改进和预测可靠性估计，对内在数据不确定性的系统性探索不足。
AI.method: 利用视觉基础模型的解码表示特征多样性，通过奇异值能量量化每个类别的语义感知尺度，以此衡量样本难度和随机不确定性。基于此设计了两种策略：1) 随机不确定性感知的数据过滤机制；2) 动态不确定性感知的优化策略，结合标签去噪机制。
AI.result: 在五个包含CT和MRI模态的公共数据集上，涵盖多器官和肿瘤分割任务，实验结果表明该方法在各种主流网络架构上均实现了显著且稳健的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法揭示了随机不确定性在医学图像理解和分割任务中的广泛应用潜力，通过系统性处理数据不确定性有效提升了模型鲁棒性。

title: Multi-modal, multi-scale representation learning for satellite imagery analysis just needs a good ALiBi
comment: Originally appeared at the 4th Space Imaging Workshop at the Georgia Institute of Technology, October 7-9, 2024
summary: Vision foundation models have been shown to be effective at processing satellite imagery into representations fit for downstream tasks, however, creating models which operate over multiple spatial resolutions and modes is challenging. This paper presents Scale-ALiBi, a linear bias transformer attention mechanism with a spatial encoding bias to relationships between image patches at different ground sample distance scales. We provide an implementation of Scale-ALiBi over a dataset of aligned high- and low-resolution optical and low-resolution SAR satellite imagery data using a triple-contrastive and reconstructive architecture, show an improvement on the GEO-Bench benchmark, and release the newly curated dataset publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出Scale-ALiBi注意力机制，通过空间编码偏置处理不同地面采样距离尺度的卫星图像，在多分辨率多模态卫星图像处理上取得改进
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉基础模型在处理多分辨率、多模态卫星图像时面临挑战，需要能够有效处理不同地面采样距离尺度的模型
AI.method: 提出Scale-ALiBi线性偏置变换器注意力机制，具有空间编码偏置来处理不同尺度图像块之间的关系；在配准的高/低分辨率光学和低分辨率SAR卫星图像数据集上实现，采用三重对比和重构架构
AI.result: 在GEO-Bench基准测试上显示出改进，并公开了新整理的数据集
AI.conclusion: Scale-ALiBi机制能够有效处理多分辨率多模态卫星图像，为下游任务提供更好的表示，公开的数据集将促进该领域研究

title: CFMS: A Coarse-to-Fine Multimodal Synthesis Framework for Enhanced Tabular Reasoning
summary: Reasoning over tabular data is a crucial capability for tasks like question answering and fact verification, as it requires models to comprehend both free-form questions and semi-structured tables. However, while methods like Chain-of-Thought (CoT) introduce reasoning chains, purely symbolic methodes are inherently limited by their blindness to holistic visual patterns. To address this, we propose the Coarse-to-Fine Multimodal Synthesis framework (CFMS), a novel two-stage paradigm that hierarchically decouples high-level visual perception from granular symbolic reasoning. In the Coarse Stage, CFMS leverages the Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to perform a one-time synthesis of a multi-perspective knowledge tuple. This tuple subsequently serves as a dynamic reasoning map to guide the fine stage, where a symbolic engine executes a targeted and efficient sequence of iterative operations over the table. Extensive experiments on the WikiTQ and TabFact benchmarks demonstrate that CFMS achieves competitive accuracy. The framework exhibits particular robustness when handling large tables and when instantiated with smaller backbone models, validating its effectiveness and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 提出CFMS框架，通过粗粒度视觉感知与细粒度符号推理的两阶段解耦，提升表格数据推理能力
AI.motivation: 现有方法如思维链（CoT）虽然引入了推理链，但纯符号方法对整体视觉模式存在盲点，限制了表格数据推理能力
AI.method: 提出粗到细多模态合成框架（CFMS），分为两阶段：粗粒度阶段使用多模态大语言模型一次性合成多视角知识元组作为动态推理地图；细粒度阶段使用符号引擎执行有针对性的迭代操作
AI.result: 在WikiTQ和TabFact基准测试中达到竞争性准确率，在处理大表格和使用较小骨干模型时表现出特别鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: CFMS框架通过层次化解耦视觉感知和符号推理，有效提升了表格数据推理的准确性和泛化能力

title: Multinex: Lightweight Low-light Image Enhancement via Multi-prior Retinex
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to restore natural visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail under severe illumination degradation. State-of-the-art (SOTA) LLIE techniques often rely on large models and multi-stage training, limiting practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, their dependence on a single color space introduces instability and visible exposure or color artifacts. To address these, we propose Multinex, an ultra-lightweight structured framework that integrates multiple fine-grained representations within a principled Retinex residual formulation. It decomposes an image into illumination and color prior stacks derived from distinct analytic representations, and learns to fuse these representations into luminance and reflectance adjustments required to correct exposure. By prioritizing enhancement over reconstruction and exploiting lightweight neural operations, Multinex significantly reduces computational cost, exemplified by its lightweight (45K parameters) and nano (0.7K parameters) versions. Extensive benchmarks show that all lightweight variants significantly outperform their corresponding lightweight SOTA models, and reach comparable performance to heavy models. Paper page available at https://albrateanu.github.io/multinex.

AI.tldr: Multinex是一个超轻量级的低光图像增强框架，通过整合多种精细表示和Retinex残差公式，在保持高性能的同时大幅减少计算成本（最小版本仅0.7K参数）。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA低光图像增强技术依赖大模型和多阶段训练，难以在边缘设备部署，且单一颜色空间导致不稳定性和可见的曝光/颜色伪影。
AI.method: 提出Multinex框架，基于Retinex残差公式，将图像分解为来自不同分析表示的照明和颜色先验堆栈，学习融合这些表示以进行亮度和反射率调整。
AI.result: 轻量级版本（45K参数）和纳米版本（0.7K参数）在多个基准测试中显著优于对应轻量级SOTA模型，性能接近重型模型。
AI.conclusion: Multinex通过整合多种精细表示和优先考虑增强而非重建，实现了高性能与低计算成本的平衡，为边缘部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: ATANT v1.1: Positioning Continuity Evaluation Against Memory, Long-Context, and Agentic-Memory Benchmarks
comment: Companion paper to arXiv:2604.06710 (ATANT v1.0). 12 pages, 1 table, 2 appendices. Related-work extension; does not modify the v1.0 standard
summary: ATANT v1.0 (arXiv:2604.06710) defined continuity as a system property with 7 required properties and introduced a 10-checkpoint, LLM-free evaluation methodology validated on a 250-story corpus. Since publication, a recurring reviewer and practitioner question has concerned not the framework itself but its relationship to a wider set of memory evaluations: LOCOMO, LongMemEval, BEAM, MemoryBench, Zep's evaluation suite, Letta/MemGPT's evaluations, and RULER. This companion paper, v1.1, does not modify the v1.0 standard. It closes a related-work gap that v1.0 left brief under page limits. We show by structural analysis that none of these benchmarks measures continuity as defined in v1.0: of the 7 required properties, the median existing eval covers 1 property, the mean covers 0.43 when partial credit is scored at 0.5, and no eval covers more than 2. We provide a cell-by-cell property-coverage matrix, identify methodological defects specific to each benchmark (including an empty-gold scoring bug in the LOCOMO reference implementation that renders 23% of its corpus unscorable by construction), and publish our reference implementation's LOCOMO score (8.8%) alongside the structural reason that number is uninformative about continuity. We publish our 8.8% LOCOMO score alongside our 96% ATANT cumulative-scale score as a calibration pair: the 87-point divergence is evidence that the two benchmarks measure different properties, not that one system is an order of magnitude better than another. The position v1.1 takes is not adversarial: each benchmark measures a real capability. The claim is that none of them can adjudicate continuity, and conflating them with continuity evaluation has led the field to under-invest in the properties v1.0 names.

AI.tldr: ATANT v1.1分析现有记忆评估基准与连续性定义的关系，发现这些基准均未充分测量连续性，并指出混淆这些评估导致领域对连续性属性投资不足。
AI.motivation: ATANT v1.0定义了连续性作为系统属性，但v1.0中相关工作的讨论因篇幅限制而简短。v1.1旨在填补这一空白，分析现有记忆评估基准（如LOCOMO、LongMemEval等）与连续性定义的关系，澄清这些基准不能裁决连续性。
AI.method: 通过结构分析比较现有基准与ATANT v1.0定义的7个连续性属性。创建属性覆盖矩阵，识别每个基准的方法缺陷，并提供LOCOMO参考实现中的评分错误分析。发布ATANT与LOCOMO的校准对比分数。
AI.result: 现有基准对连续性属性的覆盖度极低：中位数基准仅覆盖1个属性，平均覆盖0.43个属性（部分覆盖计0.5分），没有基准覆盖超过2个属性。发现LOCOMO参考实现存在空黄金评分错误，导致23%语料无法评分。ATANT得分为96%，而LOCOMO得分为8.8%，87分的差异表明两者测量不同属性。
AI.conclusion: 现有记忆评估基准均不能裁决连续性，将它们与连续性评估混淆导致领域对ATANT v1.0命名的属性投资不足。每个基准测量的是真实能力，但需要明确区分它们与连续性评估的不同。

title: DeepShapeMatchingKit: Accelerated Functional Map Solver and Shape Matching Pipelines Revisited
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, CVPR 2026 Image Matching Workshop (IEEE proceedings)
summary: Deep functional maps, leveraging learned feature extractors and spectral correspondence solvers, are fundamental to non-rigid 3D shape matching. Based on an analysis of open-source implementations, we find that standard functional map implementations solve k independent linear systems serially, which is a computational bottleneck at higher spectral resolution. We thus propose a vectorized reformulation that solves all systems in a single kernel call, achieving up to a 33x speedup while preserving the exact solution. Furthermore, we identify and document a previously unnoticed implementation divergence in the spatial gradient features of the mainstay DiffusionNet: two variants that parameterize distinct families of tangent-plane transformations, and present experiments analyzing their respective behaviors across diverse benchmarks. We additionally revisit overlap prediction evaluation for partial-to-partial matching and show that balanced accuracy provides a useful complementary metric under varying overlap ratios. To share these advancements with the wider community, we present an open-source codebase, DeepShapeMatchingKit, that incorporates these improvements and standardizes training, evaluation, and data pipelines for common deep shape matching methods. The codebase is available at: https://github.com/xieyizheng/DeepShapeMatchingKit

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了深度功能映射的计算瓶颈，提出了向量化优化方案，识别了DiffusionNet中的实现差异，改进了部分匹配评估指标，并发布了开源代码库DeepShapeMatchingKit。
AI.motivation: 深度功能映射在非刚性3D形状匹配中至关重要，但标准实现存在计算瓶颈：需要串行求解k个独立线性系统，在高谱分辨率下效率低下。同时发现DiffusionNet中存在未注意到的实现差异，需要标准化训练和评估流程。
AI.method: 1) 提出向量化重构方案，将k个独立线性系统求解合并为单个内核调用；2) 识别并分析DiffusionNet中两种空间梯度特征的实现差异；3) 重新审视部分匹配中的重叠预测评估，引入平衡准确率作为补充指标；4) 开发开源代码库DeepShapeMatchingKit，整合改进并标准化流程。
AI.result: 1) 向量化优化实现了高达33倍的加速，同时保持精确解；2) 识别了DiffusionNet中两种参数化不同切平面变换族的变体，并分析了它们在多种基准测试中的行为差异；3) 展示了平衡准确率在不同重叠比例下作为补充评估指标的有效性；4) 发布了功能完整的开源代码库。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过计算优化、实现差异分析和评估指标改进，提升了深度形状匹配的效率和可靠性。发布的DeepShapeMatchingKit代码库为社区提供了标准化工具，将促进深度形状匹配方法的进一步发展和应用。

title: Back to the Barn with LLAMAs: Evolving Pretrained LLM Backbones in Finetuning Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have rapidly advanced by leveraging powerful pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) as core reasoning backbones. As new and more capable LLMs emerge with improved reasoning, instruction-following, and generalization, there is a pressing need to efficiently update existing VLMs to incorporate these advancements. However, the integration of new LLMs into VLMs, particularly how the evolving LLMs contribute to multimodal reasoning, alignment, and task-specific performance remains underexplored. Addressing this gap is important for VLM development, given the rapid evolution of pretrained LLM backbones. This study presents a controlled and systematic investigation of how changes in the pretrained LLM backbone affect downstream VLM task performance. By having the vision encoder, training data, and post-training algorithm remain same across LLAMA-1, LLAMA-2, and LLAMA-3 based VLMs, we find that newer LLM backbones do not always lead to better VLMs, but the performance depends on the downstream VLM task. For example, in visual question and answering tasks, newer LLM backbones tend to solve different questions rather than just more questions, and our analysis shows this is driven by differences in how the models process information, including better calibrated confidence and more stable internal representations. We also find that some VLM capabilities appear only in the newest LLM generation, while tasks that depend mainly on visual understanding see little benefit from a newer LLM backbone.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在视觉语言模型中，使用更新的LLM骨干网络并不总是带来更好的性能提升，性能表现取决于具体的下游任务类型。
AI.motivation: 随着更强大的预训练大语言模型不断涌现，如何有效地将新的LLM骨干网络整合到现有视觉语言模型中成为一个迫切需求。然而，新的LLM如何影响多模态推理、对齐和任务特定性能仍然缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 通过控制实验设计，保持视觉编码器、训练数据和后训练算法不变，系统比较了基于LLAMA-1、LLAMA-2和LLAMA-3的VLM在不同下游任务上的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）更新的LLM骨干网络并不总是带来更好的VLM性能；2）在视觉问答任务中，新LLM倾向于解决不同类型的问题而非更多问题；3）某些VLM能力仅在最新一代LLM中出现；4）主要依赖视觉理解的任务从新LLM中获益有限。
AI.conclusion: 选择VLM的LLM骨干网络需要根据具体任务需求进行权衡，不能简单认为更新的LLM总是更好。研究为VLM开发中的骨干网络选择提供了实证指导。

title: Agentic Video Generation: From Text to Executable Event Graphs via Tool-Constrained LLM Planning
summary: Existing multi-agent video generation systems use LLM agents to orchestrate neural video generators, producing visually impressive but semantically unreliable outputs with no ground truth annotations. We present an agentic system that inverts this paradigm: instead of generating pixels, the LLM constructs a formal Graph of Events in Space and Time (GEST) -- a structured specification of actors, actions, objects, and temporal constraints -- which is then executed deterministically in a 3D game engine. A staged LLM refinement pipeline fails entirely at this task (0 of 50 attempts produce an executable specification), motivating a fundamentally different architecture based on a separation of concerns: the LLM handles narrative planning through natural language reasoning, while a programmatic state backend enforces all simulator constraints through validated tool calls, guaranteeing that every generated specification is executable by construction. The system uses a hierarchical two-agent architecture -- a Director that plans the story and a Scene Builder that constructs individual scenes through a round-based state machine -- with dedicated Relation Subagents that populate the logical and semantic edge types of the GEST formalism that procedural generation leaves empty, making this the first approach to exercise the full expressive capacity of the representation. We evaluate in two stages: autonomous generation against procedural baselines via a 3-model LLM jury, where agentic narratives win 79% of text and 74% of video comparisons; and seeded generation where the same text is given to our system, VEO 3.1, and WAN 2.2, with human annotations showing engine-generated videos substantially outperform neural generators on physical validity (58% vs 25% and 20%) and semantic alignment (3.75/5 vs 2.33 and 1.50).

AI.tldr: 提出基于游戏引擎的确定性视频生成系统，用LLM构建结构化事件图(GEST)，而非直接生成像素，确保语义可靠性和物理有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体视频生成系统虽然视觉效果出色，但语义不可靠且缺乏真实标注。需要一种能保证语义一致性和物理有效性的视频生成方法。
AI.method: 采用分层双智能体架构：导演负责故事规划，场景构建器通过回合制状态机构建场景。LLM处理自然语言推理，程序化状态后端通过验证工具调用强制执行模拟器约束，确保所有规范可执行。使用GEST形式化表示法描述演员、动作、对象和时间约束。
AI.result: 自主生成中，智能体叙事在文本比较中胜出79%，视频比较中胜出74%。在种子生成中，引擎生成视频在物理有效性上显著优于神经生成器(58% vs 25%和20%)，语义对齐得分也更高(3.75/5 vs 2.33和1.50)。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LLM的叙事规划能力与游戏引擎的确定性执行相结合，实现了语义可靠、物理有效的视频生成，为结构化视频生成提供了新范式。

title: WebForge: Breaking the Realism-Reproducibility-Scalability Trilemma in Browser Agent Benchmark
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, plus 29-page supplementary. Code: https://github.com/yuandaxia2001/WebForge Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuandaxia/WebForge
summary: Existing browser agent benchmarks face a fundamental trilemma: real-website benchmarks lack reproducibility due to content drift, controlled environments sacrifice realism by omitting real-web noise, and both require costly manual curation that limits scalability. We present WebForge, the first fully automated framework that resolves this trilemma through a four-agent pipeline -- Plan, Generate, Refine, and Validate -- that produces interactive, self-contained web environments end-to-end without human annotation. A seven-dimensional difficulty control framework structures task design along navigation depth, visual complexity, reasoning difficulty, and more, enabling systematic capability profiling beyond single aggregate scores. Using WebForge, we construct WebForge-Bench, a benchmark of 934 tasks spanning 7 domains and 3 difficulty levels. Multi-model experiments show that difficulty stratification effectively differentiates model capabilities, while cross-domain analysis exposes capability biases invisible to aggregate metrics. Together, these results confirm that multi-dimensional evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles that a single aggregate score cannot capture. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/yuandaxia2001/WebForge.

AI.tldr: WebForge是一个完全自动化的框架，通过四智能体流水线（规划、生成、精炼、验证）创建交互式、自包含的网页环境，解决了现有浏览器智能体基准测试的三难困境，并构建了包含934个任务的WebForge-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器智能体基准测试面临三难困境：真实网站基准测试因内容漂移而缺乏可重复性，受控环境通过忽略真实网络噪声而牺牲了真实性，两者都需要昂贵的人工标注限制了可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出WebForge框架，采用四智能体流水线（规划、生成、精炼、验证）自动生成交互式、自包含的网页环境；设计七维度难度控制框架（导航深度、视觉复杂度、推理难度等）结构化任务设计；构建WebForge-Bench基准，包含934个任务，涵盖7个领域和3个难度级别。
AI.result: 多模型实验表明，难度分层能有效区分模型能力，跨领域分析揭示了聚合指标无法捕捉的能力偏差；七维度评估揭示了单一聚合分数无法捕捉的独特能力特征。
AI.conclusion: WebForge解决了浏览器智能体基准测试的三难困境，通过自动化框架和多维度评估提供了更系统化的能力分析，证明多维评估能揭示单一聚合分数无法捕捉的独特能力特征。

title: GTASA: Ground Truth Annotations for Spatiotemporal Analysis, Evaluation and Training of Video Models
summary: Generating complex multi-actor scenario videos remains difficult even for state-of-the-art neural generators, while evaluating them is hard due to the lack of ground truth for physical plausibility and semantic faithfulness. We introduce GTASA, a corpus of multi-actor videos with per-frame spatial relation graphs and event-level temporal mappings, and the system that produced it based on Graphs of Events in Space and Time (GEST): GEST-Engine. We compare our method with both open and closed source neural generators and prove both qualitatively (human evaluation of physical validity and semantic alignment) and quantitatively (via training video captioning models) the clear advantages of our method. Probing four frozen video encoders across 11 spatiotemporal reasoning tasks enabled by GTASA's exact 3D ground truth reveals that self-supervised encoders encode spatial structure significantly better than VLM visual encoders.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GTASA数据集和GEST-Engine系统，用于生成和评估多角色场景视频，相比神经生成方法在物理合理性和语义对齐方面有明显优势，并揭示了自监督编码器在空间结构理解上优于VLM视觉编码器。
AI.motivation: 当前神经生成器难以生成复杂的多角色场景视频，且缺乏评估物理合理性和语义忠实度的地面真值数据，需要系统化的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出GTASA数据集（包含逐帧空间关系图和事件级时间映射）和GEST-Engine系统，基于空间时间事件图（GEST）框架生成多角色视频。
AI.result: 相比开源和闭源神经生成器，在物理有效性和语义对齐的人类评估中表现更优；通过训练视频字幕模型定量验证优势；对11个时空推理任务的探测显示自监督编码器在空间结构编码上显著优于VLM视觉编码器。
AI.conclusion: GTASA数据集和GEST-Engine系统为多角色视频生成和评估提供了有效解决方案，揭示了当前视频编码器在时空推理能力上的差异，为未来研究提供了重要基准。

title: MAFIG: Multi-agent Driven Formal Instruction Generation Framework
summary: Emergency situations in scheduling systems often trigger local functional failures that undermine system stability and even cause system collapse. Existing methods primarily rely on robust scheduling or reactive scheduling, handling emergencies through predefined rules or rescheduling strategies. However, the diversity and unpredictability of real-world emergencies make them difficult to anticipate, which limits the adaptability of these methods in complex scenarios. Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) possess strong potential for complex scheduling tasks because of their extensive prior knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities. Nevertheless, the high inference latency of LLMs and the lengthy contextual information of scheduling systems significantly hinder their application for emergency handling. To mitigate these issues, we propose the Multi-agent Driven Formal Instruction Generation Framework (MAFIG). The framework constrains the decision scope to local functional modules affected by emergency situations and repairs scheduling logic rapidly by generating formal instructions. MAFIG contains a Perception Agent and an Emergency Decision Agent, which mitigates the adverse impact of lengthy system contexts on emergency decision-making. We further introduce span-focused loss-driven local distillation mechanism (SFL) to transfer the decision-making capability of powerful Cloud Large Language Models (C-LLMs) to lightweight local models, reducing inference latency while preserving decision-making effectiveness. Experiments in the Port, Warehousing, and Deck scheduling datasets show success rates of 98.49\%, 94.97\%, and 97.50\%, with average processing times of 0.33 s, 0.23 s, and 0.19 s. These results demonstrate that MAFIG effectively mitigates the impact of emergencies and improves the robustness and adaptability of scheduling systems.

AI.tldr: MAFIG框架使用多智能体驱动形式化指令生成，通过本地蒸馏机制降低LLM推理延迟，有效处理调度系统中的紧急情况
AI.motivation: 调度系统中的紧急情况会导致局部功能故障，影响系统稳定性。现有方法（鲁棒调度或反应式调度）难以应对现实世界中多样且不可预测的紧急情况。LLM虽然具有复杂调度潜力，但高推理延迟和长上下文信息限制了其在应急处理中的应用。
AI.method: 提出多智能体驱动形式化指令生成框架(MAFIG)，包含感知智能体和应急决策智能体，将决策范围限制在受紧急情况影响的局部功能模块。引入跨度聚焦损失驱动的本地蒸馏机制(SFL)，将云端大语言模型的决策能力迁移到轻量级本地模型，降低推理延迟。
AI.result: 在港口、仓储和甲板调度数据集上的实验显示，成功率分别为98.49%、94.97%和97.50%，平均处理时间为0.33秒、0.23秒和0.19秒，有效缓解了紧急情况的影响。
AI.conclusion: MAFIG框架通过多智能体协作和本地蒸馏机制，显著提高了调度系统对紧急情况的处理能力，增强了系统的鲁棒性和适应性，解决了LLM在应急调度中推理延迟高的问题。

title: FishRoPE: Projective Rotary Position Embeddings for Omnidirectional Visual Perception
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) and Bird's Eye View (BEV) representation have advanced visual perception substantially, yet their internal spatial representations assume the rectilinear geometry of pinhole cameras. Fisheye cameras, widely deployed on production autonomous vehicles for their surround-view coverage, exhibit severe radial distortion that renders these representations geometrically inconsistent. At the same time, the scarcity of large-scale fisheye annotations makes retraining foundation models from scratch impractical. We present \ours, a lightweight framework that adapts frozen VFMs to fisheye geometry through two components: a frozen DINOv2 backbone with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) that transfers rich self-supervised features to fisheye without task-specific pretraining, and Fisheye Rotary Position Embedding (FishRoPE), which reparameterizes the attention mechanism in the spherical coordinates of the fisheye projection so that both self-attention and cross-attention operate on angular separation rather than pixel distance. FishRoPE is architecture-agnostic, introduces negligible computational overhead, and naturally reduces to the standard formulation under pinhole geometry. We evaluate \ours on WoodScape 2D detection (54.3 mAP) and SynWoodScapes BEV segmentation (65.1 mIoU), where it achieves state-of-the-art results on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FishRoPE：一种轻量级框架，通过LoRA适配和球面坐标注意力机制，将冻结的视觉基础模型适配到鱼眼相机几何，无需大规模鱼眼标注重新训练。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型和BEV表示假设针孔相机几何，而鱼眼相机存在严重径向畸变，导致几何不一致。同时，大规模鱼眼标注稀缺，从头训练基础模型不现实。
AI.method: 1. 使用冻结的DINOv2骨干网络配合LoRA，将自监督特征迁移到鱼眼图像；2. 提出FishRoPE，在鱼眼投影的球面坐标中重新参数化注意力机制，使注意力基于角度分离而非像素距离。
AI.result: 在WoodScape 2D检测（54.3 mAP）和SynWoodScapes BEV分割（65.1 mIoU）上达到最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: FishRoPE是一种架构无关、计算开销可忽略的轻量级框架，能有效将冻结视觉基础模型适配到鱼眼几何，在针孔几何下自然退化为标准形式。

title: Sanity Checks for Agentic Data Science
summary: Agentic data science (ADS) pipelines have grown rapidly in both capability and adoption, with systems such as OpenAI Codex now able to directly analyze datasets and produce answers to statistical questions. However, these systems can reach falsely optimistic conclusions that are difficult for users to detect. To address this, we propose a pair of lightweight sanity checks grounded in the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework for veridical data science. These checks use reasonable perturbations to screen whether an agent can reliably distinguish signal from noise, acting as a falsifiability constraint that can expose affirmative conclusions as unsupported. Together, the two checks characterize the trustworthiness of an ADS output, e.g. whether it has found stable signal, is responding to noise, or is sensitive to incidental aspects of the input. We validate the approach on synthetic data with controlled signal-to-noise ratios, confirming that the sanity checks track ground-truth signal strength. We then demonstrate the checks on 11 real-world datasets using OpenAI Codex, characterizing the trustworthiness of each conclusion and finding that in 6 of the datasets an affirmative conclusion is not well-supported, even though a single ADS run may support one. We further analyze failure modes of ADS systems and find that ADS self-reported confidence is poorly calibrated to the empirical stability of its conclusions.

AI.tldr: 提出两种基于PCS框架的轻量级合理性检查，用于评估AI数据科学代理输出的可信度，通过合理扰动检测信号稳定性，防止虚假乐观结论。
AI.motivation: AI数据科学代理系统（如OpenAI Codex）能直接分析数据集并回答统计问题，但可能得出难以被用户发现的虚假乐观结论，需要可信度评估方法。
AI.method: 基于可预测性-可计算性-稳定性（PCS）框架，提出两种轻量级合理性检查：使用合理扰动来筛选代理是否能可靠区分信号与噪声，作为可证伪性约束。
AI.result: 在合成数据上验证了合理性检查能追踪真实信号强度；在11个真实数据集上应用OpenAI Codex，发现其中6个数据集的肯定结论缺乏充分支持；AI代理自报置信度与其结论的实证稳定性校准不佳。
AI.conclusion: 提出的合理性检查能有效评估AI数据科学代理输出的可信度，区分稳定信号、噪声响应和输入偶然敏感性，为AI辅助数据分析提供可信度保障。

title: Rethinking Video Human-Object Interaction: Set Prediction over Time for Unified Detection and Anticipation
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, code will be publicly available
summary: Video-based human-object interaction (HOI) understanding requires both detecting ongoing interactions and anticipating their future evolution. However, existing methods usually treat anticipation as a downstream forecasting task built on externally constructed human-object pairs, limiting joint reasoning between detection and prediction. In addition, sparse keyframe annotations in current benchmarks can temporally misalign nominal future labels from actual future dynamics, reducing the reliability of anticipation evaluation. To address these issues, we introduce DETAnt-HOI, a temporally corrected benchmark derived from VidHOI and Action Genome for more faithful multi-horizon evaluation, and HOI-DA, a pair-centric framework that jointly performs subject-object localization, present HOI detection, and future anticipation by modeling future interactions as residual transitions from current pair states. Experiments show consistent improvements in both detection and anticipation, with larger gains at longer horizons. Our results highlight that anticipation is most effective when learned jointly with detection as a structural constraint on pair-level video representation learning. Benchmark and code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了HOI-DA框架，联合执行人-物检测与未来交互预测，并创建了DETAnt-HOI基准用于更可靠的评估
AI.motivation: 现有方法将人-物交互（HOI）检测与预测视为独立任务，限制了联合推理；现有基准的稀疏关键帧标注会导致时间错位，影响预测评估的可靠性
AI.method: 提出HOI-DA框架，将未来交互建模为当前配对状态的残差转换，联合执行主体-物体定位、当前HOI检测和未来预测；并创建DETAnt-HOI基准进行更准确的多时间跨度评估
AI.result: 实验显示在检测和预测任务上都取得了一致改进，特别是在更长的时间跨度上增益更大
AI.conclusion: 预测任务最有效的方式是与检测任务联合学习，作为配对级别视频表示学习的结构约束

title: Diffusion-CAM: Faithful Visual Explanations for dMLLMs
summary: While diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) have recently achieved remarkable strides in multimodal generation, the development of interpretability mechanisms has lagged behind their architectural evolution. Unlike traditional autoregressive models that produce sequential activations, diffusion-based architectures generate tokens via parallel denoising, resulting in smooth, distributed activation patterns across the entire sequence. Consequently, existing Class Activation Mapping (CAM) methods, which are tailored for local, sequential dependencies, are ill-suited for interpreting these non-autoregressive behaviors. To bridge this gap, we propose Diffusion-CAM, the first interpretability method specifically tailored for dMLLMs. We derive raw activation maps by differentiably probing intermediate representations in the transformer backbone, accordingly capturing both latent features and their class-specific gradients. To address the inherent stochasticity of these raw signals, we incorporate four key modules to resolve spatial ambiguity and mitigate intra-image confounders and redundant token correlations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffusion-CAM significantly outperforms SoTA methods in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity, establishing a new standard for understanding the parallel generation process of diffusion multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了Diffusion-CAM，首个专门针对扩散多模态大语言模型的解释性方法，通过梯度探测和四个关键模块解决扩散模型并行去噪带来的解释挑战。
AI.motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型在生成能力上取得显著进展，但其解释性机制发展滞后。传统CAM方法基于局部序列依赖，不适用于扩散模型的并行去噪和平滑分布式激活模式。
AI.method: 通过可微分探测transformer骨干网络的中间表示获取原始激活图，捕获潜在特征和类别特定梯度。引入四个关键模块解决空间模糊性、减轻图像内混淆因素和冗余token相关性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Diffusion-CAM在定位准确性和视觉保真度上显著优于现有最先进方法，为理解扩散多模态系统的并行生成过程建立了新标准。
AI.conclusion: Diffusion-CAM是首个专门针对扩散多模态大语言模型的解释性方法，成功解决了传统方法无法处理的并行生成行为解释问题，为理解扩散模型内部工作机制提供了有效工具。

title: IMPACT: A Dataset for Multi-Granularity Human Procedural Action Understanding in Industrial Assembly
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, benchmark and dataset are available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/IMPACT
summary: We introduce IMPACT, a synchronized five-view RGB-D dataset for deployment-oriented industrial procedural understanding, built around real assembly and disassembly of a commercial angle grinder with professional-grade tools. To our knowledge, IMPACT is the first real industrial assembly benchmark that jointly provides synchronized ego-exo RGB-D capture, decoupled bimanual annotation, compliance-aware state tracking, and explicit anomaly--recovery supervision within a single real industrial workflow. It comprises 112 trials from 13 participants totaling 39.5 hours, with multi-route execution governed by a partial-order prerequisite graph, a six-category anomaly taxonomy, and operator cognitive load measured via NASA-TLX. The annotation hierarchy links hand-specific atomic actions to coarse procedural steps, component assembly states, and per-hand compliance phases, with synchronized null spans across views to decouple perceptual limitations from algorithmic failure. Systematic baselines reveal fundamental limitations that remain invisible to single-task benchmarks, particularly under realistic deployment conditions that involve incomplete observations, flexible execution paths, and corrective behavior. The full dataset, annotations, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/IMPACT.

AI.tldr: IMPACT是首个面向工业流程理解的同步五视角RGB-D数据集，专注于电动角磨机的真实装配与拆卸过程，提供多模态数据、异常恢复监督和认知负荷测量。
AI.motivation: 现有工业装配基准通常缺乏真实部署场景所需的关键特性：同步多视角RGB-D数据、双手分离标注、合规感知状态跟踪、异常恢复监督等。需要构建一个能反映真实工业工作流程复杂性的基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建了包含112次试验、13名参与者、总计39.5小时的同步五视角RGB-D数据集。采用部分有序先决图控制多路径执行，定义了六类异常分类，通过NASA-TLX测量操作员认知负荷。标注层次将手部原子动作与粗粒度流程步骤、组件装配状态和每手合规阶段相连接。
AI.result: 数据集揭示了在单任务基准中不可见的基础性限制，特别是在涉及不完整观察、灵活执行路径和纠正行为的实际部署条件下。提供了完整的基准测试结果。
AI.conclusion: IMPACT填补了工业流程理解基准的空白，为评估算法在真实工业部署场景下的表现提供了全面框架，有助于推动面向实际应用的工业人工智能研究。

title: Min-$k$ Sampling: Decoupling Truncation from Temperature Scaling via Relative Logit Dynamics
summary: The quality of text generated by large language models depends critically on the decoding sampling strategy. While mainstream methods such as Top-$k$, Top-$p$, and Min-$p$ achieve a balance between diversity and accuracy through probability-space truncation, they share an inherent limitation: extreme sensitivity to the temperature parameter. Recent logit-space approaches like Top-$nσ$ achieve temperature invariance but rely on global statistics that are susceptible to long-tail noise, failing to capture fine-grained confidence structures among top candidates. We propose \textbf{Min-$k$ Sampling}, a novel dynamic truncation strategy that analyzes the local shape of the sorted logit distribution to identify "semantic cliffs": sharp transitions from high-confidence core tokens to uncertain long-tail tokens. By computing a position-weighted relative decay rate, Min-$k$ dynamically determines truncation boundaries at each generation step. We formally prove that Min-$k$ achieves strict temperature invariance and empirically demonstrate its low sensitivity to hyperparameter choices. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks, creative writing tasks, and human evaluation show that Min-$k$ consistently improves text quality, maintaining robust performance even under extreme temperature settings where probability-based methods collapse. We make our code, models, and analysis tools publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出Min-k采样方法，通过分析排序logit分布的局部形状来识别"语义悬崖"，实现温度不变性，在各种任务中提升文本质量
AI.motivation: 现有解码采样方法（如Top-k、Top-p、Min-p）对温度参数极度敏感，而最近的对数空间方法（如Top-nσ）虽然实现温度不变性，但依赖全局统计量易受长尾噪声影响，无法捕捉候选词之间的细粒度置信结构
AI.method: 提出Min-k采样，一种动态截断策略，通过分析排序logit分布的局部形状来识别"语义悬崖"（从高置信核心词到不确定长尾词的急剧转变）。通过计算位置加权的相对衰减率，Min-k在每个生成步骤动态确定截断边界
AI.result: 形式化证明Min-k实现严格温度不变性，实证显示对超参数选择敏感性低。在多个推理基准、创意写作任务和人工评估中，Min-k一致提升文本质量，即使在极端温度设置下（基于概率的方法失效时）仍保持稳健性能
AI.conclusion: Min-k采样通过分析logit分布的局部形状动态确定截断边界，解决了现有方法对温度敏感和受长尾噪声影响的问题，在各种文本生成任务中实现更稳定和高质量的生成结果

title: Neural Stochastic Processes for Satellite Precipitation Refinement
summary: Accurate precipitation estimation is critical for flood forecasting, water resource management, and disaster preparedness. Satellite products provide global hourly coverage but contain systematic biases; ground-based gauges are accurate at point locations but too sparse for direct gridded correction. Existing methods fuse these sources by interpolating gauge observations onto the satellite grid, but treat each time step independently and therefore discard temporal structure in precipitation fields. We propose Neural Stochastic Process (NSP), a model that pairs a Neural Process encoder conditioning on arbitrary sets of gauge observations with a latent Neural SDE on a 2D spatial representation. NSP is trained under a single variational objective with simulation-free cost. We also introduce QPEBench, a benchmark of 43{,}756 hourly samples over the Contiguous United States (2021--2025) with four aligned data sources and six evaluation metrics. On QPEBench, NSP outperforms 13 baselines across all six metrics and surpasses JAXA's operational gauge-calibrated product. An additional experiment on Kyushu, Japan confirms generalization to a different region with independent data sources.

AI.tldr: 提出Neural Stochastic Process (NSP)模型，结合神经过程和潜在神经SDE，用于融合卫星和地面雨量计数据以提高降水估计精度，在QPEBench基准测试中优于13个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 准确的降水估计对洪水预报、水资源管理和灾害准备至关重要。卫星产品提供全球小时覆盖但存在系统偏差，地面雨量计在点位置准确但过于稀疏。现有方法独立处理每个时间步，忽略了降水场的时空结构。
AI.method: 提出Neural Stochastic Process (NSP)模型：1) 神经过程编码器以任意雨量计观测为条件；2) 在2D空间表示上使用潜在神经随机微分方程；3) 在单一变分目标下训练，无需模拟成本。还创建了QPEBench基准数据集。
AI.result: 在QPEBench基准测试中，NSP在六个评估指标上均优于13个基线方法，超越了JAXA的业务化雨量计校准产品。在日本九州的额外实验证实了模型在不同区域和独立数据源上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: NSP通过有效融合卫星和雨量计数据，同时捕捉时空相关性，显著提高了降水估计精度，为业务化应用提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models promise parallel generation, yet still lag behind autoregressive (AR) models in quality. We stem this gap to a failure of introspective consistency: AR models agree with their own generations, while DLMs often do not. We define the introspective acceptance rate, which measures whether a model accepts its previously generated tokens. This reveals why AR training has a structural advantage: causal masking and logit shifting implicitly enforce introspective consistency. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Introspective Diffusion Language Model (I-DLM), a paradigm that retains diffusion-style parallel decoding while inheriting the introspective consistency of AR training. I-DLM uses a novel introspective strided decoding (ISD) algorithm, which enables the model to verify previously generated tokens while advancing new ones in the same forward pass. From a systems standpoint, we build I-DLM inference engine on AR-inherited optimizations and further customize it with a stationary-batch scheduler. To the best of our knowledge, I-DLM is the first DLM to match the quality of its same-scale AR counterpart while outperforming prior DLMs in both model quality and practical serving efficiency across 15 benchmarks. It reaches 69.6 on AIME-24 and 45.7 on LiveCodeBench-v6, exceeding LLaDA-2.1-mini (16B) by more than 26 and 15 points, respectively. Beyond quality, I-DLM is designed for the growing demand of large-concurrency serving, delivering about 3x higher throughput than prior state-of-the-art DLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出I-DLM模型，通过自省一致性机制解决扩散语言模型与自回归模型的质量差距问题，首次实现扩散模型在质量上匹配同规模自回归模型，并在推理效率上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然支持并行生成，但在质量上仍落后于自回归模型。研究发现这种差距源于自省一致性问题：自回归模型能接受自己生成的标记，而扩散模型往往不能。自回归训练通过因果掩码和logit偏移隐式保证了自省一致性，而扩散模型缺乏这种机制。
AI.method: 提出自省扩散语言模型（I-DLM），采用自省跨步解码算法，使模型能在同一前向传播中验证已生成标记并推进新标记生成。系统层面，基于自回归优化构建推理引擎，并定制静态批处理调度器。
AI.result: I-DLM在15个基准测试中首次匹配同规模自回归模型质量，在AIME-24上达到69.6分，LiveCodeBench-v6上达到45.7分，分别超过LLaDA-2.1-mini（16B）26分和15分以上。推理吞吐量比现有最佳扩散语言模型提高约3倍。
AI.conclusion: I-DLM通过引入自省一致性机制，成功解决了扩散语言模型与自回归模型的质量差距问题，同时保持了并行解码优势，在模型质量和推理效率上都实现了显著提升，为大规模并发服务提供了高效解决方案。

title: Intelligent Approval of Access Control Flow in Office Automation Systems via Relational Modeling
summary: Office automation (OA) systems play a crucial role in enterprise operations and management, with access control flow approval (ACFA) being a key component that manages the accessibility of various resources. However, traditional ACFA requires approval from the person in charge at each step, which consumes a significant amount of manpower and time. Its intelligence is a crucial issue that needs to be addressed urgently by all companies. In this paper, we propose a novel relational modeling-driven intelligent approval (RMIA) framework to automate ACFA. Specifically, our RMIA consists of two core modules: (1) The binary relation modeling module aims to characterize the coupling relation between applicants and approvers and provide reliable basic information for ACFA decision-making from a coarse-grained perspective. (2) The ternary relation modeling module utilizes specific resource information as its core, characterizing the complex relations between applicants, resources, and approvers, and thus provides fine-grained gain information for informed decision-making. Then, our RMIA effectively fuses these two kinds of information to form the final decision. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted on two product datasets and an online A/B test to verify the effectiveness of RMIA.

AI.tldr: 提出基于关系建模的智能审批框架RMIA，通过二元和三元关系建模自动化办公系统中的访问控制流审批，减少人工和时间消耗。
AI.motivation: 传统办公自动化系统中的访问控制流审批需要逐级人工审批，消耗大量人力和时间，智能化成为企业亟待解决的关键问题。
AI.method: 提出RMIA框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 二元关系建模模块，从粗粒度角度刻画申请人与审批人之间的耦合关系；2) 三元关系建模模块，以具体资源信息为核心，刻画申请人、资源和审批人之间的复杂关系，提供细粒度信息。最后融合两种信息形成最终决策。
AI.result: 在两个产品数据集和在线A/B测试上进行了广泛实验，验证了RMIA的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RMIA框架能够有效自动化访问控制流审批，解决传统审批系统智能化不足的问题，为企业提供高效的智能审批解决方案。

title: DiningBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in the Dietary Domain
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have revolutionized general visual understanding. However, their application in the food domain remains constrained by benchmarks that rely on coarse-grained categories, single-view imagery, and inaccurate metadata. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiningBench, a hierarchical, multi-view benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs across three levels of cognitive complexity: Fine-Grained Classification, Nutrition Estimation, and Visual Question Answering. Unlike previous datasets, DiningBench comprises 3,021 distinct dishes with an average of 5.27 images per entry, incorporating fine-grained "hard" negatives from identical menus and rigorous, verification-based nutritional data. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 29 state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary models. Our experiments reveal that while current VLMs excel at general reasoning, they struggle significantly with fine-grained visual discrimination and precise nutritional reasoning. Furthermore, we systematically investigate the impact of multi-view inputs and Chain-of-Thought reasoning, identifying five primary failure modes. DiningBench serves as a challenging testbed to drive the next generation of food-centric VLM research. All codes are released in https://github.com/meituan/DiningBench.

AI.tldr: DiningBench是一个用于评估视觉语言模型在食物领域性能的分层多视角基准，包含3,021道菜肴，每道菜平均5.27张图像，涵盖细粒度分类、营养估计和视觉问答三个认知复杂度级别。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在食物领域的应用受到限制，因为现有基准依赖粗粒度类别、单视角图像和不准确的元数据，需要更全面的评估工具来推动食物中心VLM研究。
AI.method: 构建DiningBench基准，包含3,021道不同菜肴，每道菜平均5.27张多视角图像，采用分层设计：细粒度分类（包含来自相同菜单的"困难"负样本）、营养估计（基于验证的数据）和视觉问答。评估了29个开源和专有模型，并系统研究多视角输入和思维链推理的影响。
AI.result: 当前VLM在一般推理方面表现良好，但在细粒度视觉辨别和精确营养推理方面存在显著困难。识别了五种主要失败模式，多视角输入和思维链推理对性能有影响但有限。
AI.conclusion: DiningBench作为一个具有挑战性的测试平台，揭示了当前VLM在食物领域的局限性，特别是细粒度视觉辨别和营养推理能力不足，将推动下一代食物中心VLM研究的发展。

title: From Topology to Trajectory: LLM-Driven World Models For Supply Chain Resilience
summary: Semiconductor supply chains face unprecedented resilience challenges amidst global geopolitical turbulence. Conventional Large Language Model (LLM) planners, when confronting such non-stationary "Policy Black Swan" events, frequently suffer from Decision Paralysis or a severe Grounding Gap due to the absence of physical environmental modeling. This paper introduces ReflectiChain, a cognitive agentic framework tailored for resilient macroeconomic supply chain planning. The core innovation lies in the integration of Latent Trajectory Rehearsal powered by a generative world model, which couples reflection-in-action (System 2 deliberation) with delayed reflection-on-action. Furthermore, we leverage a Retrospective Agentic RL mechanism to enable autonomous policy evolution during the deployment phase (test-time). Evaluations conducted on our high-fidelity benchmark, Semi-Sim, demonstrate that under extreme scenarios such as export bans and material shortages, ReflectiChain achieves a 250% improvement in average step rewards over the strongest LLM baselines. It successfully restores the Operability Ratio (OR) from a deficient 13.3% to over 88.5% while ensuring robust gradient convergence. Ablation studies further underscore that the synergy between physical grounding constraints and double-loop learning is fundamental to bridging the gap between semantic reasoning and physical reality for long-horizon strategic planning.

AI.tldr: ReflectiChain：一种用于弹性宏观经济供应链规划的认知代理框架，通过潜在轨迹预演和回顾性代理强化学习，在极端政策黑天鹅事件下显著提升决策性能。
AI.motivation: 半导体供应链面临前所未有的弹性挑战，传统LLM规划器在应对非平稳的"政策黑天鹅"事件时，由于缺乏物理环境建模，经常出现决策瘫痪或严重的接地差距问题。
AI.method: 提出ReflectiChain框架，核心创新包括：1）基于生成世界模型的潜在轨迹预演，将行动中反思（系统2深思）与延迟行动后反思相结合；2）回顾性代理强化学习机制，在部署阶段实现自主策略演化。
AI.result: 在高保真基准Semi-Sim上的评估显示，在出口禁令和材料短缺等极端场景下，ReflectiChain相比最强LLM基线实现了250%的平均步奖励提升，将可操作性比率从不足的13.3%恢复到超过88.5%，同时确保稳健的梯度收敛。
AI.conclusion: 消融研究表明，物理接地约束与双环学习的协同作用是弥合语义推理与物理现实之间差距、实现长期战略规划的关键。

title: SignReasoner: Compositional Reasoning for Complex Traffic Sign Understanding via Functional Structure Units
summary: Accurate semantic understanding of complex traffic signs-including those with intricate layouts, multi-lingual text, and composite symbols-is critical for autonomous driving safety. Current models, both specialized small ones and large Vision Language Models (VLMs), suffer from a significant bottleneck: a lack of compositional generalization, leading to failure when encountering novel sign configurations. To overcome this, we propose SignReasoner, a novel paradigm that transforms general VLMs into expert traffic sign reasoners. Our core innovation is Functional Structure Unit (FSU), which shifts from common instance-based modeling to flexible function-based decomposition. By breaking down complex signs into minimal, core functional blocks (e.g., Direction, Notice, Lane), our model learns the underlying structural grammar, enabling robust generalization to unseen compositions. We define this decomposition as the FSU-Reasoning task and introduce a two-stage VLM post-training pipeline to maximize performance: Iterative Caption-FSU Distillation that enhances the model's accuracy in both FSU-reasoning and caption generation; FSU-GRPO that uses Tree Edit Distance (TED) to compute FSU differences as the rewards in GRPO algorithm, boosting reasoning abilities. Experiments on the newly proposed FSU-Reasoning benchmark, TrafficSignEval, show that SignReasoner achieves new SOTA with remarkable data efficiency and no architectural modification, significantly improving the traffic sign understanding in various VLMs.

AI.tldr: SignReasoner：通过功能结构单元（FSU）将通用视觉语言模型转化为交通标志专家，解决复杂交通标志的组合泛化问题，无需修改模型架构即可实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前自动驾驶中，复杂交通标志（包含复杂布局、多语言文本和复合符号）的语义理解存在瓶颈。现有模型（包括专用小模型和大视觉语言模型）缺乏组合泛化能力，在遇到新颖标志配置时容易失败。
AI.method: 提出SignReasoner范式，核心创新是功能结构单元（FSU），将实例建模转向基于功能的分解。通过将复杂标志分解为最小核心功能块（如方向、通知、车道），学习底层结构语法。采用两阶段VLM后训练：1）迭代Caption-FSU蒸馏增强FSU推理和描述生成准确性；2）FSU-GRPO使用树编辑距离计算FSU差异作为GRPO算法奖励，提升推理能力。
AI.result: 在新提出的FSU-Reasoning基准TrafficSignEval上，SignReasoner实现了新的SOTA性能，具有显著的数据效率，且无需架构修改，大幅提升了各种VLM的交通标志理解能力。
AI.conclusion: SignReasoner通过功能结构单元分解和专门的后训练策略，有效解决了复杂交通标志的组合泛化问题，为自动驾驶安全提供了更可靠的交通标志理解方案。

title: EmergentBridge: Improving Zero-Shot Cross-Modal Transfer in Unified Multimodal Embedding Models
summary: Unified multimodal embedding spaces underpin practical applications such as cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot recognition. In many real deployments, however, supervision is available only for a small subset of modality pairs (e.g., image--text), leaving \emph{unpaired} modality pairs (e.g., audio$\leftrightarrow$depth, infrared$\leftrightarrow$audio) weakly connected and thus performing poorly on zero-shot transfer. Addressing this sparse-pairing regime is therefore essential for scaling unified embedding systems to new tasks without curating exhaustive pairwise data. We propose \textbf{EmergentBridge}, an embedding-level bridging framework that improves performance on these unpaired pairs \emph{without requiring exhaustive pairwise supervision}. Our key observation is that naively aligning a new modality to a synthesized proxy embedding can introduce \emph{gradient interference}, degrading the anchor-alignment structure that existing retrieval/classification relies on. EmergentBridge addresses this by (i) learning a mapping that produces a \emph{noisy bridge anchor} (a proxy embedding of an already-aligned modality) from an anchor embedding, and (ii) enforcing proxy alignment only in the subspace orthogonal to the anchor-alignment direction, preserving anchor alignment while strengthening non-anchor connectivity. Across nine datasets spanning multiple modalities, EmergentBridge consistently outperforms prior binding baselines on zero-shot classification and retrieval, demonstrating strong emergent alignment.

AI.tldr: EmergentBridge：一种嵌入级桥接框架，用于改善稀疏配对多模态系统中的未配对模态对性能，无需成对监督
AI.motivation: 实际应用中，多模态嵌入空间通常只有部分模态对有监督数据（如图像-文本），而未配对模态对（如音频-深度、红外-音频）连接较弱，导致零样本迁移性能差。需要解决稀疏配对问题，避免收集所有成对数据的成本。
AI.method: 提出EmergentBridge框架：1）学习从锚点嵌入生成噪声桥接锚点（已对齐模态的代理嵌入）；2）仅在正交于锚点对齐方向的子空间中强制代理对齐，保持锚点对齐结构的同时增强非锚点连接性。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种模态的九个数据集上，EmergentBridge在零样本分类和检索任务上持续优于现有绑定基线方法，展示了强大的涌现对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: EmergentBridge能够有效改善稀疏配对多模态系统中未配对模态对的性能，无需成对监督，为扩展统一嵌入系统到新任务提供了实用解决方案。

title: Enhancing Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding in 3D CT Report Generation via Discriminative Guidance
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) for radiology report generation (RRG) can produce long-form chest CT reports from volumetric scans and show strong potential to improve radiology workflow efficiency and consistency. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) training supervision is often coarse, aligning a whole CT volume with a full free-text report without explicit alignment for fine-grained attributes or pathology locations; and (ii) evaluation is typically holistic (lexical overlap, entity matching, or LLM-as-a-judge scores) and not diagnostic for spatial grounding. We propose \emph{Discriminative Cue-Prompting with Prompt Dropout (DCP-PD)}, a plug-and-play framework that distills fine-grained cues from free-text reports and uses them to guide report generation while mitigating shortcut reliance via prompt dropout. DCP-PD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE, improving macro F1 from $=0.501$ to $0.603$ (20% relative), and substantially boosts out-of-distribution performance on Rad-ChestCT from F1 $=0.266$ to $0.503$ (89% relative). Finally, we introduce a hierarchical, location-aware question-set protocol (presence $\rightarrow$ laterality $\rightarrow$ lobe) to directly assess pathology-location grounding, showing that fine-grained spatial localization remains challenging even for models that score highly on current benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出DCP-PD框架，通过从自由文本报告中提取细粒度线索并利用提示丢弃来指导放射报告生成，显著提升CT报告生成性能，并引入分层位置感知评估协议揭示空间定位挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成方法存在两个关键限制：1) 训练监督粗糙，将整个CT体积与完整自由文本报告对齐，缺乏细粒度属性或病理位置的显式对齐；2) 评估通常是整体性的（词汇重叠、实体匹配或LLM评分），缺乏空间定位的诊断性评估。
AI.method: 提出判别性线索提示与提示丢弃(DCP-PD)框架：1) 从自由文本报告中提取细粒度线索；2) 使用这些线索指导报告生成；3) 通过提示丢弃缓解捷径依赖；4) 引入分层位置感知问题集协议（存在性→侧向性→肺叶）直接评估病理位置定位。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE数据集上实现最先进性能，宏观F1从0.501提升至0.603（相对提升20%）；在Rad-ChestCT数据集上，分布外性能从F1=0.266大幅提升至0.503（相对提升89%）。
AI.conclusion: DCP-PD框架有效提升了放射报告生成的性能，但通过分层位置感知评估发现，即使在高分模型中，细粒度空间定位仍然具有挑战性，表明当前基准评估存在局限性。

title: AI Integrity: A New Paradigm for Verifiable AI Governance
summary: AI systems increasingly shape high-stakes decisions in healthcare, law, defense, and education, yet existing governance paradigms -- AI Ethics, AI Safety, and AI Alignment -- share a common limitation: they evaluate outcomes rather than verifying the reasoning process itself. This paper introduces AI Integrity, a concept defined as a state in which the Authority Stack of an AI system -- its layered hierarchy of values, epistemological standards, source preferences, and data selection criteria -- is protected from corruption, contamination, manipulation, and bias, and maintained in a verifiable manner. We distinguish AI Integrity from the three existing paradigms, define the Authority Stack as a 4-layer cascade model (Normative, Epistemic, Source, and Data Authority) grounded in established academic frameworks -- Schwartz Basic Human Values for normative authority, Walton argumentation schemes with GRADE/CEBM hierarchies for epistemic authority, and Source Credibility Theory for source authority -- characterize the distinction between legitimate cascading and Authority Pollution, and identify Integrity Hallucination as the central measurable threat to value consistency. We further specify the PRISM (Profile-based Reasoning Integrity Stack Measurement) framework as the operational methodology, defining six core metrics and a phased research roadmap. Unlike normative frameworks that prescribe which values are correct, AI Integrity is a procedural concept: it requires that the path from evidence to conclusion be transparent and auditable, regardless of which values a system holds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"AI完整性"新概念，区别于AI伦理、安全和对齐，强调验证AI推理过程而非结果，通过权威堆栈模型保护AI系统的价值层级免受污染，并建立PRISM框架进行测量。
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理范式（AI伦理、AI安全、AI对齐）主要评估结果而非验证推理过程本身，存在共同局限性。在医疗、法律、国防、教育等高风险决策领域，需要确保AI系统的推理过程透明可审计。
AI.method: 提出AI完整性概念，定义权威堆栈四层模型（规范性权威、认知权威、来源权威、数据权威），基于学术框架建立理论基础。区分合法级联与权威污染，识别完整性幻觉为主要威胁。开发PRISM框架作为操作方法，包含六个核心指标和分阶段研究路线图。
AI.result: 建立了AI完整性的理论框架，区别于现有治理范式。提出了可操作的权威堆栈模型和PRISM测量框架，为验证AI推理过程提供了系统化方法。
AI.conclusion: AI完整性作为程序性概念，强调从证据到结论的路径必须透明可审计，无论系统持有何种价值观。这为高风险领域的AI治理提供了新的视角和工具，弥补了现有范式的不足。

title: PERCEPT-Net: A Perceptual Loss Driven Framework for Reducing MRI Artifact Tissue Confusion
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Medical Physics. Code available upon request
summary: Purpose: Existing deep learning-based MRI artifact correction models exhibit poor clinical generalization due to inherent artifact-tissue confusion, failing to discriminate artifacts from anatomical structures. To resolve this, we introduce PERCEPT-Net, a framework leveraging dedicated perceptual supervision for structure-preserving artifact suppression. Method: PERCEPT-Net utilizes a residual U-Net backbone integrated with a multi-scale recovery module and dual attention mechanisms to preserve anatomical context and salient features. The core mechanism, Motion Perceptual Loss (MPL), provides artifact-aware supervision by learning generalizable motion artifact representations. This logic directly guides the network to suppress artifacts while maintaining anatomical fidelity. Training utilized a hybrid dataset of real and simulated sequences, followed by prospective validation via objective metrics and expert radiologist assessments. Result: PERCEPT-Net outperformed state-of-the-art methods on clinical data. Ablation analysis established a direct causal link between MPL and performance; its omission caused a significant deterioration in structural consistency (p < 0.001) and tissue contrast (p < 0.001). Radiologist evaluations corroborated these objective metrics, scoring PERCEPT-Net significantly higher in global image quality (median 3 vs. 2, p < 0.001) and verifying the preservation of critical diagnostic structures. Conclusion: By integrating task-specific, artifact-aware perceptual learning, PERCEPT-Net suppresses motion artifacts in clinical MRI without compromising anatomical integrity. This framework improves clinical robustness and provides a verifiable mechanism to mitigate over-smoothing and structural degradation in medical image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: PERCEPT-Net通过引入运动感知损失(MPL)来解决MRI运动伪影校正中的伪影-组织混淆问题，实现了结构保留的伪影抑制，在临床数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的MRI伪影校正模型存在伪影-组织混淆问题，无法区分伪影和解剖结构，导致临床泛化能力差。
AI.method: 使用残差U-Net骨干网络，集成多尺度恢复模块和双重注意力机制，核心是运动感知损失(MPL)提供伪影感知监督，学习可泛化的运动伪影表示。
AI.result: 在临床数据上优于最先进方法，消融分析显示MPL与性能直接因果关联，放射科医生评估在全局图像质量上评分显著更高(p<0.001)。
AI.conclusion: 通过集成任务特定的伪影感知感知学习，PERCEPT-Net能在不损害解剖完整性的情况下抑制临床MRI中的运动伪影，提高临床鲁棒性并减轻过平滑和结构退化。

title: PRISM Risk Signal Framework: Hierarchy-Based Red Lines for AI Behavioral Risk
summary: Current approaches to AI safety define red lines at the case level: specific prompts, specific outputs, specific harms. This paper argues that red lines can be set more fundamentally -- at the level of value, evidence, and source hierarchies that govern AI reasoning. Using the PRISM (Profile-based Reasoning Integrity Stack Measurement) framework, we define a taxonomy of 27 behavioral risk signals derived from structural anomalies in how AI systems prioritize values (L4), weight evidence types (L3), and trust information sources (L2). Each signal is evaluated through a dual-threshold principle combining absolute rank position and relative win-rate gap, producing a two-tier classification (Confirmed Risk vs. Watch Signal). The hierarchy-based approach offers three advantages over case-specific red lines: it is anticipatory rather than reactive (detecting dangerous reasoning structures before they produce harmful outputs), comprehensive rather than enumerative (a single value-hierarchy signal subsumes an unlimited number of case-specific violations), and measurable rather than subjective (grounded in empirical forced-choice data). We demonstrate the framework's detection capacity using approximately 397,000 forced-choice responses from 7 AI models across three Authority Stack layers, showing that the signal taxonomy successfully discriminates between models with structurally extreme profiles, models with context-dependent risk, and models with balanced hierarchies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于价值、证据和来源层次结构的AI安全红线设置方法，替代传统的案例级红线，通过PRISM框架检测AI推理中的结构异常风险信号。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全方法在案例层面设置红线（特定提示、输出、危害），这种方法反应性、枚举性且主观。需要更根本地在AI推理的层次结构层面设置红线，实现前瞻性、全面性和可测量的安全检测。
AI.method: 使用PRISM框架，从AI系统的价值优先级（L4）、证据类型权重（L3）和信息源信任（L2）三个层次中提取27个行为风险信号。采用双重阈值原则（绝对排名位置和相对胜率差距）进行两级分类（确认风险vs观察信号）。
AI.result: 基于约397,000个强制选择响应和7个AI模型的数据，证明该框架能有效区分：具有结构极端配置的模型、具有上下文依赖风险的模型、以及具有平衡层次结构的模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于层次结构的红线设置方法相比案例级方法具有三大优势：前瞻性而非反应性、全面性而非枚举性、可测量而非主观性。PRISM框架能检测危险的推理结构，在产生有害输出前识别风险。

title: ReContraster: Making Your Posters Stand Out with Regional Contrast
summary: Effective poster design requires rapidly capturing attention and clearly conveying messages. Inspired by the ``contrast effects'' principle, we propose ReContraster, the first training-free model to leverage regional contrast to make posters stand out. By emulating the cognitive behaviors of a poster designer, ReContraster introduces the compositional multi-agent system to identify elements, organize layout, and evaluate generated poster candidates. To further ensure harmonious transitions across region boundaries, ReContraster integrates the hybrid denoising strategy during the diffusion process. We additionally contribute a new benchmark dataset for comprehensive evaluation. Seven quantitative metrics and four user studies confirm its superiority over relevant state-of-the-art methods, producing visually striking and aesthetically appealing posters.

AI.tldr: ReContraster：首个基于区域对比的无训练海报设计模型，通过多智能体系统模拟设计师认知行为，实现视觉冲击力强的海报生成
AI.motivation: 有效海报设计需要快速吸引注意力并清晰传达信息。受"对比效应"原则启发，现有方法缺乏专门利用区域对比来突出海报的无训练模型
AI.method:
1. 引入组合式多智能体系统模拟设计师认知行为：识别元素、组织布局、评估候选海报
2. 集成混合去噪策略确保区域边界间的和谐过渡
3. 无训练方法，直接利用区域对比原理
AI.result:
1. 构建了新的基准数据集用于全面评估
2. 7个定量指标和4个用户研究证实其优于相关SOTA方法
3. 能生成视觉冲击力强且美观的海报
AI.conclusion: ReContraster是首个利用区域对比的无训练海报设计模型，通过模拟设计师认知过程和多智能体协作，在视觉吸引力和美学质量上表现出色

title: Hodoscope: Unsupervised Monitoring for AI Misbehaviors
summary:
Existing approaches to monitoring AI agents rely on supervised evaluation: human-written rules or LLM-based judges that check for known failure modes. However, novel misbehaviors may fall outside predefined categories entirely and LLM-based judges can be unreliable. To address this, we formulate unsupervised monitoring, drawing an analogy to unsupervised learning. Rather than checking for specific misbehaviors, an unsupervised monitor assists humans in discovering problematic agent behaviors without prior assumptions about what counts as problematic, leaving that determination to the human.
  We observe that problematic behaviors are often distinctive: a model exploiting a benchmark loophole exhibits actions absent from well-behaved baselines, and a vulnerability unique to one evaluation manifests as behavioral anomalies when the same model runs across multiple benchmarks. This motivates using group-wise behavioral differences as the primary signal for unsupervised monitoring. We introduce Hodoscope, a tool that operationalizes this insight. Hodoscope compares behavior distributions across groups and highlights distinctive and potentially suspicious action patterns for human review. Using Hodoscope, we discover a previously unknown vulnerability in the Commit0 benchmark (unsquashed git history allowing ground-truth recovery, inflating scores for at least five models) and independently recover known exploits on ImpossibleBench and SWE-bench. Quantitative evaluation estimates that our method reduces review effort by 6-23$\times$ compared to naive uniform sampling. Finally, we show that behavior descriptions discovered through Hodoscope could improve the detection accuracy of LLM-based judges, demonstrating a path from unsupervised to supervised monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督监控方法Hodoscope，通过比较不同组间的行为差异来发现AI代理的异常行为，无需预先定义问题类别，显著减少人工审查工作量。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理监控方法依赖监督评估（人工规则或LLM评判），但无法检测新型异常行为，且LLM评判不可靠。需要一种无监督方法帮助人类发现未知问题行为。
AI.method: 提出无监督监控框架Hodoscope，基于"问题行为通常具有独特性"的观察，通过比较不同组（如不同基准测试）间的行为分布差异，识别异常行为模式供人工审查。
AI.result: 1) 发现Commit0基准中的未知漏洞（未压缩的git历史允许恢复真实答案，至少影响五个模型得分）；2) 独立复现ImpossibleBench和SWE-bench的已知漏洞；3) 相比均匀采样减少6-23倍审查工作量；4) Hodoscope发现的行为描述可提升LLM评判的检测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 无监督监控通过行为差异分析能有效发现AI代理的未知问题行为，显著降低人工审查成本，并为从无监督到监督监控的转化提供路径。

title: Parameter Efficient Fine-tuning for Domain-specific Gastrointestinal Disease Recognition
summary: Despite recent advancements in the field of medical image analysis with the use of pretrained foundation models, the issue of distribution shifts between cross-source images largely remains adamant. To circumvent that issue, investigators generally train a separate model for each source. However, this method becomes expensive when we fully fine-tune pretrained large models for a single dataset, as we must store multiple copies of those models. Thus, in this work, we propose using a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) module for fine-tuning downstream classification tasks. LoRAs learn lightweight task-specific low-rank matrices that perturb pretrained weights to optimize those downstream tasks. For gastrointestinal tract diseases, they exhibit significantly better results than end-to-end finetuning with improved parameter efficiency. Code is available at: github.com/sanjay931/peft-gi-recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出使用LoRA模块微调下游分类任务，解决跨源医学图像分布偏移问题，相比端到端微调参数效率更高
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析中，跨源图像分布偏移问题严重，传统方法为每个数据源单独训练模型成本高昂，特别是微调大型预训练模型时需要存储多个模型副本
AI.method: 使用低秩适应（LoRA）模块进行下游分类任务微调，LoRA学习轻量级的任务特定低秩矩阵来扰动预训练权重以优化下游任务
AI.result: 在胃肠道疾病识别任务中，LoRA方法相比端到端微调取得了显著更好的结果，同时提高了参数效率
AI.conclusion: LoRA方法为医学图像分析中的跨源分布偏移问题提供了参数高效的解决方案，代码已开源

title: Towards Proactive Information Probing: Customer Service Chatbots Harvesting Value from Conversation
summary: Customer service chatbots are increasingly expected to serve not merely as reactive support tools for users, but as strategic interfaces for harvesting high-value information and business intelligence. In response, we make three main contributions. 1) We introduce and define a novel task of Proactive Information Probing, which optimizes when to probe users for pre-specified target information while minimizing conversation turns and user friction. 2) We propose PROCHATIP, a proactive chatbot framework featuring a specialized conversation strategy module trained to master the delicate timing of probes. 3) Experiments demonstrate that PROCHATIP significantly outperforms baselines, exhibiting superior capability in both information probing and service quality. We believe that our work effectively redefines the commercial utility of chatbots, positioning them as scalable, cost-effective engines for proactive business intelligence. Our code is available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/PROCHATIP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了主动信息探测任务和PROCHATIP框架，通过优化探测时机来主动从用户获取商业情报，同时减少对话轮次和用户摩擦。
AI.motivation: 当前客服聊天机器人主要作为被动支持工具，但企业需要将其转变为主动收集高价值信息和商业情报的战略接口。
AI.method: 提出PROCHATIP主动聊天机器人框架，包含专门训练的对话策略模块，用于掌握探测目标信息的最佳时机。
AI.result: 实验表明PROCHATIP显著优于基线方法，在信息探测和服务质量方面都表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作重新定义了聊天机器人的商业效用，将其定位为可扩展、经济高效的主动商业情报引擎。

title: AIM-Bench: Benchmarking and Improving Affective Image Manipulation via Fine-Grained Hierarchical Control
summary: Affective Image Manipulation (AIM) aims to evoke specific emotions through targeted editing.
