This design reconciles the high expressivity of layer-wise adaptation with only negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on W4A4 and W3A3 quantization demonstrate that ReSpinQuant achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming global rotation methods and matching the accuracy of computationally expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: ReSpinQuant是一个量化框架，通过离线激活旋转融合和残差子空间旋转匹配基，在保持层间适应性的同时实现最小推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有旋转后量化方法存在权衡：全局旋转方法可融合到权重中实现推理高效，但表达能力有限（单旋转矩阵）；层间方法精度高但无法融合旋转矩阵，需要在线计算导致显著开销。需要一种既能保持层间适应性的高表达能力，又只有可忽略推理开销的方法。
AI.method: ReSpinQuant采用离线激活旋转融合和高效的残差子空间旋转匹配基。通过离线处理将激活旋转矩阵融合到权重中，避免在线计算开销，同时利用残差子空间旋转实现层间适应性。
AI.result: 在W4A4和W3A3量化实验中，ReSpinQuant实现了最先进的性能，优于全局旋转方法，并与计算昂贵的层间方法精度相当，同时只有最小开销。
AI.conclusion: ReSpinQuant成功解决了旋转后量化中的表达能力和推理开销的权衡问题，通过离线融合和残差子空间旋转，实现了高精度和低开销的统一。

title: MapATM: Enhancing HD Map Construction through Actor Trajectory Modeling
summary: High-definition (HD) mapping tasks, which perform lane detections and predictions, are extremely challenging due to non-ideal conditions such as view occlusions, distant lane visibility, and adverse weather conditions. Those conditions often result in compromised lane detection accuracy and reduced reliability within autonomous driving systems. To address these challenges, we introduce MapATM, a novel deep neural network that effectively leverages historical actor trajectory information to improve lane detection accuracy, where actors refer to moving vehicles. By utilizing actor trajectories as structural priors for road geometry, MapATM achieves substantial performance enhancements, notably increasing AP by 4.6 for lane dividers and mAP by 2.6 on the challenging NuScenes dataset, representing relative improvements of 10.1% and 6.1%, respectively, compared to strong baseline methods. Extensive qualitative evaluations further demonstrate MapATM's capability to consistently maintain stable and robust map reconstruction across diverse and complex driving scenarios, underscoring its practical value for autonomous driving applications.

AI.tldr: MapATM：利用历史车辆轨迹作为道路几何先验，提升高精地图车道线检测精度的深度神经网络
AI.motivation: 高精地图构建中的车道线检测面临遮挡、远距离可视性差、恶劣天气等挑战，导致检测精度和可靠性下降，影响自动驾驶系统性能。
AI.method: 提出MapATM深度神经网络，利用历史车辆轨迹信息作为道路几何的结构先验，通过轨迹数据增强车道线检测的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在NuScenes数据集上，车道分隔线AP提升4.6，mAP提升2.6，相对改进分别为10.1%和6.1%，优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MapATM能够在复杂驾驶场景中保持稳定鲁棒的地图重建，证明了利用车辆轨迹作为道路几何先验的有效性，具有实际应用价值。

title: RESP: Reference-guided Sequential Prompting for Visual Glitch Detection in Video Games
summary: Visual glitches in video games degrade player experience and perceived quality, yet manual quality assurance cannot scale to the growing test surface of modern game development. Prior automation efforts, particularly those using vision-language models (VLMs), largely operate on single frames or rely on limited video-level baselines that struggle under realistic scene variation, making robust video-level glitch detection challenging. We present RESP, a practical multi-frame framework for gameplay glitch detection with VLMs. Our key idea is reference-guided prompting: for each test frame, we select a reference frame from earlier in the same video, establishing a visual baseline and reframing detection as within-video comparison rather than isolated classification. RESP sequentially prompts the VLM with reference/test pairs and aggregates noisy frame predictions into a stable video-level decision without fine-tuning the VLM. To enable controlled analysis of reference effects, we introduce RefGlitch, a synthetic dataset of manually labeled reference/test frame pairs with balanced coverage across five glitch types. Experiments across five VLMs and three datasets (one synthetic, two real-world) show that reference guidance consistently strengthens frame-level detection and that the improved frame-level evidence reliably transfers to stronger video-level triage under realistic QA conditions. Code and data are available at: \href{https://github.com/PipiZong/RESP_code.git}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: RESP是一个基于视觉语言模型的多帧游戏故障检测框架，通过参考帧引导提示实现视频级故障检测，无需微调模型。
AI.motivation: 视频游戏中的视觉故障会降低玩家体验和感知质量，但手动质量保证无法扩展到现代游戏开发日益增长的测试范围。现有的自动化方法（特别是使用视觉语言模型的方法）大多基于单帧或有限的视频级基准，难以应对真实场景变化，使得鲁棒的视频级故障检测具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出RESP框架，核心思想是参考引导提示：为每个测试帧从同一视频的早期部分选择一个参考帧，建立视觉基准，将检测重新定义为视频内比较而非孤立分类。RESP顺序提示VLM处理参考/测试帧对，并将噪声帧预测聚合为稳定的视频级决策，无需微调VLM。还引入了RefGlitch合成数据集，包含手动标记的参考/测试帧对，覆盖五种故障类型。
AI.result: 在五个VLM和三个数据集（一个合成，两个真实世界）上的实验表明，参考引导持续增强了帧级检测能力，改进的帧级证据可靠地转化为现实QA条件下更强的视频级故障筛选能力。
AI.conclusion: RESP提供了一个实用的多帧框架，通过参考引导提示显著提高了游戏故障检测的性能，能够有效应对真实场景变化，为游戏质量保证提供了可扩展的自动化解决方案。

title: FlowCoMotion: Text-to-Motion Generation via Token-Latent Flow Modeling
summary: Text-to-motion generation is driven by learning motion representations for semantic alignment with language. Existing methods rely on either continuous or discrete motion representations. However, continuous representations entangle semantics with dynamics, while discrete representations lose fine-grained motion details. In this context, we propose FlowCoMotion, a novel motion generation framework that unifies both treatments from a modeling perspective. Specifically, FlowCoMotion employs token-latent coupling to capture both semantic content and high-fidelity motion details. In the latent branch, we apply multi-view distillation to regularize the continuous latent space, while in the token branch we use discrete temporal resolution quantization to extract high-level semantic cues. The motion latent is then obtained by combining the representations from the two branches through a token-latent coupling network. Subsequently, a velocity field is predicted based on the textual conditions. An ODE solver integrates this velocity field from a simple prior, thereby guiding the sample to the potential state of the target motion. Extensive experiments show that FlowCoMotion achieves competitive performance on text-to-motion benchmarks, including HumanML3D and SnapMoGen.

AI.tldr: FlowCoMotion提出了一种统一的文本到动作生成框架，通过token-latent耦合同时捕捉语义内容和高质量动作细节，解决了连续表示纠缠语义与动态、离散表示丢失细节的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法依赖连续或离散动作表示，但连续表示将语义与动态纠缠在一起，而离散表示会丢失细粒度动作细节，需要一种能同时解决这两个问题的统一框架。
AI.method: FlowCoMotion采用token-latent耦合架构：1) 潜在分支使用多视角蒸馏正则化连续潜在空间；2) 令牌分支使用离散时间分辨率量化提取高层语义线索；3) 通过token-latent耦合网络结合两个分支的表示；4) 基于文本条件预测速度场；5) 使用ODE求解器从简单先验积分生成目标动作。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D和SnapMoGen等文本到动作基准测试中，FlowCoMotion取得了具有竞争力的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: FlowCoMotion通过统一连续和离散表示的处理方法，成功解决了现有文本到动作生成中的语义-动态纠缠和细节丢失问题，实现了高质量的语义对齐动作生成。

title: Structured State-Space Regularization for Compact and Generation-Friendly Image Tokenization
comment: Related blog posts in https://jinsingsangsung.github.io/collections/blog/ : Towards 2-Dimensional State-Space Models series
summary: Image tokenizers are central to modern vision models as they often operate in latent spaces. An ideal latent space must be simultaneously compact and generation-friendly: it should capture image's essential content compactly while remaining easy to model with generative approaches. In this work, we introduce a novel regularizer to align latent spaces with these two objectives. The key idea is to guide tokenizers to mimic the hidden state dynamics of state-space models (SSMs), thereby transferring their critical property, frequency awareness, to latent features. Grounded in a theoretical analysis of SSMs, our regularizer enforces encoding of fine spatial structures and frequency-domain cues into compact latent features; leading to more effective use of representation capacity and improved generative modelability. Experiments demonstrate that our method improves generation quality in diffusion models while incurring only minimal loss in reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的正则化方法，通过让图像分词器模仿状态空间模型的隐藏状态动态，将频率感知特性转移到潜在特征中，从而创建既紧凑又适合生成的潜在空间。
AI.motivation: 理想的图像潜在空间需要同时具备紧凑性和生成友好性：既要紧凑地捕捉图像核心内容，又要便于生成模型建模。当前方法难以同时满足这两个目标。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的正则化方法，引导图像分词器模仿状态空间模型（SSMs）的隐藏状态动态，从而将SSMs的关键特性——频率感知——转移到潜在特征中。该方法基于SSMs的理论分析，强制将精细空间结构和频域线索编码到紧凑的潜在特征中。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在扩散模型中提高了生成质量，同时只带来最小的重建保真度损失。
AI.conclusion: 通过将状态空间模型的频率感知特性转移到图像分词器的潜在空间中，可以创建既紧凑又适合生成的潜在表示，从而更有效地利用表示容量并改善生成模型的可建模性。

title: LDEPrompt: Layer-importance guided Dual Expandable Prompt Pool for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Prompt-based class-incremental learning methods typically construct a prompt pool consisting of multiple trainable key-prompts and perform instance-level matching to select the most suitable prompt embeddings, which has shown promising results. However, existing approaches face several limitations, including fixed prompt pools, manual selection of prompt embeddings, and strong reliance on the pretrained backbone for prompt selection. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{L}ayer-importance guided \textbf{D}ual \textbf{E}xpandable \textbf{P}rompt Pool (\textbf{LDEPrompt}), which enables adaptive layer selection as well as dynamic freezing and expansion of the prompt pool. Extensive experiments on widely used class-incremental learning benchmarks demonstrate that LDEPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: LDEPrompt是一种基于层重要性指导的双扩展提示池方法，通过自适应层选择和动态提示池扩展，解决了现有提示池固定、手动选择提示嵌入和过度依赖预训练骨干网络的问题，在类增量学习任务上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的类增量学习方法存在三个主要问题：1）提示池固定不变，无法适应新任务；2）需要手动选择提示嵌入；3）提示选择过度依赖预训练骨干网络。这些问题限制了方法的适应性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出LDEPrompt方法，包含两个核心机制：1）基于层重要性的自适应层选择，指导提示选择过程；2）动态冻结和扩展的双扩展提示池，能够根据新任务需求自适应调整提示池结构。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的类增量学习基准测试上进行了大量实验，LDEPrompt取得了最先进的性能，验证了其有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: LDEPrompt通过自适应层选择和动态提示池扩展，有效解决了现有提示池方法的局限性，在类增量学习任务上表现出优越的性能和可扩展性。

title: CDPR: Cross-modal Diffusion with Polarization for Reliable Monocular Depth Estimation
comment: preprint version of IEEE TMM 2026 Regular Paper
summary: Monocular depth estimation is a fundamental yet challenging task in computer vision, especially under complex conditions such as textureless surfaces, transparency, and specular reflections. Recent diffusion-based approaches have significantly advanced performance by reformulating depth prediction as a denoising process in the latent space. However, existing methods rely solely on RGB inputs, which often lack sufficient cues in challenging regions. In this work, we present CDPR - Cross-modal Diffusion with Polarization for Reliable Monocular Depth Estimation - a novel diffusion-based framework that integrates physically grounded polarization priors to enhance estimation robustness. Specifically, we encode both RGB and polarization (AoLP/DoLP) images into a shared latent space via a pre-trained Variational Autoencoder (VAE), and dynamically fuse multi-modal information through a learnable confidence-aware gating mechanism. This fusion module adaptively suppresses noisy signals in polarization inputs while preserving informative cues, particularly around reflective or transparent surfaces, and provides the integrated latent representation for subsequent monocular depth estimation. Beyond depth estimation, we further verify that our framework can be easily generalized to surface normal prediction with minimal modification, showcasing its scalability to general polarization-guided dense prediction tasks. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets validate that CDPR significantly outperforms RGB-only baselines in challenging regions while maintaining competitive performance in standard scenes.

AI.tldr: CDPR提出了一种结合偏振信息的跨模态扩散框架，用于提升单目深度估计在复杂场景（如反光、透明表面）下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于RGB的单目深度估计在纹理缺失、透明和镜面反射等复杂条件下表现不佳，而偏振信息能提供额外的物理线索来改善这些区域的深度预测。
AI.method: 提出CDPR框架：1) 使用预训练VAE将RGB和偏振图像编码到共享潜空间；2) 设计可学习的置信度感知门控机制动态融合多模态信息，抑制噪声并保留有用线索；3) 基于融合后的潜表示进行深度估计。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，CDPR在挑战性区域显著优于仅使用RGB的基线方法，同时在标准场景中保持竞争力。框架还可轻松扩展到表面法线预测任务。
AI.conclusion: CDPR通过融合偏振先验有效提升了单目深度估计在复杂条件下的鲁棒性，展示了偏振引导的密集预测任务的扩展潜力。

title: Efficient Transceiver Design for Aerial Image Transmission and Large-scale Scene Reconstruction
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ISIT-w
summary: Large-scale three-dimensional (3D) scene reconstruction in low-altitude intelligent networks (LAIN) demands highly efficient wireless image transmission. However, existing schemes struggle to balance severe pilot overhead with the transmission accuracy required to maintain reconstruction fidelity. To strike a balance between efficiency and reliability, this paper proposes a novel deep learning-based end-to-end (E2E) transceiver design that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) directly into the training process. By jointly optimizing the communication modules via the combined 3DGS rendering loss, our approach explicitly improves scene recovery quality. Furthermore, this task-driven framework enables the use of a sparse pilot scheme, significantly reducing transmission overhead while maintaining robust image recovery under low-altitude channel conditions. Extensive experiments on real-world aerial image datasets demonstrate that the proposed E2E design significantly outperforms existing baselines, delivering superior transmission performance and accurate 3D scene reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于深度学习的端到端收发器设计，将3D高斯泼溅直接集成到训练过程中，用于低空智能网络中的大规模3D场景重建，显著减少导频开销同时保持重建质量。
AI.motivation: 低空智能网络中大规模3D场景重建需要高效的无线图像传输，但现有方案难以平衡严重的导频开销与保持重建保真度所需的传输精度。
AI.method: 提出基于深度学习的端到端收发器设计，将3D高斯泼溅直接集成到训练过程中，通过联合优化通信模块和3DGS渲染损失，采用稀疏导频方案显著减少传输开销。
AI.result: 在真实世界航拍图像数据集上的大量实验表明，所提出的端到端设计显著优于现有基线，提供优越的传输性能和准确的3D场景重建。
AI.conclusion: 该任务驱动的框架在效率和可靠性之间取得了良好平衡，能够在低空信道条件下保持鲁棒的图像恢复，同时显著减少传输开销。

title: OmniScript: Towards Audio-Visual Script Generation for Long-Form Cinematic Video
summary: Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in short-form video understanding, yet translating long-form cinematic videos into detailed, temporally grounded scripts remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces the novel video-to-script (V2S) task, aiming to generate hierarchical, scene-by-scene scripts encompassing character actions, dialogues, expressions, and audio cues. To facilitate this, we construct a first-of-its-kind human-annotated benchmark and propose a temporally-aware hierarchical evaluation framework. Furthermore, we present OmniScript, an 8B-parameter omni-modal (audio-visual) language model tailored for long-form narrative comprehension. OmniScript is trained via a progressive pipeline that leverages chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning for plot and character reasoning, followed by reinforcement learning using temporally segmented rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that despite its parameter efficiency, OmniScript significantly outperforms larger open-source models and achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art proprietary models, including Gemini 3-Pro, in both temporal localization and multi-field semantic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视频到脚本（V2S）新任务，构建首个人工标注基准，并开发OmniScript模型，在长视频叙事理解上超越开源模型，媲美商业模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在短视频理解上表现优异，但将长电影视频转换为详细、时间定位的脚本仍具挑战。需要解决长视频叙事理解中的层次化、场景化脚本生成问题。
AI.method: 提出视频到脚本（V2S）任务，构建首个人工标注基准，设计时间感知的层次化评估框架。开发OmniScript模型（8B参数），采用渐进式训练流程：先通过思维链监督微调进行情节和角色推理，再使用时序分段奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: 尽管参数效率高，OmniScript显著超越更大的开源模型，在时间定位和多领域语义准确性上达到与Gemini 3-Pro等最先进商业模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniScript模型在长视频叙事理解方面表现出色，证明了参数效率模型通过专门训练方法能够达到商业模型的性能水平，为视频到脚本任务提供了有效解决方案。

title: Semantic-Geometric Dual Compression: Training-Free Visual Token Reduction for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated immense potential in Earth observation. However, the massive visual tokens generated when processing Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) imagery introduce prohibitive computational overhead, severely bottlenecking their inference efficiency. Existing visual token compression methods predominantly adopt static and uniform compression strategies, neglecting the inherent "Semantic-Geometric Duality" in remote sensing interpretation tasks. Specifically, object semantic tasks focus on the abstract semantics of objects and benefit from aggressive background pruning, whereas scene geometric tasks critically rely on the integrity of spatial topology. To address this challenge, we propose DualComp, a task-adaptive dual-stream token compression framework. Dynamically guided by a lightweight pre-trained router, DualComp decouples feature processing into two dedicated pathways. In the object semantic stream, the Spatially-Contiguous Semantic Aggregator (SCSA) utilizes size-adaptive clustering to aggregates redundant background while protecting small object. In the scene geometric stream, the Instruction-Guided Structure Recoverer (IGSR) introduces a greedy path-tracing topology completion mechanism to reconstruct spatial skeletons. Experiments on the UHR remote sensing benchmark XLRS-Bench demonstrate that DualComp accomplishes high-fidelity remote sensing interpretation at an exceptionally low computational cost, achieving simultaneous improvements in both efficiency and accuracy.

AI.tldr: DualComp是一个面向超高分辨率遥感图像的任务自适应双流令牌压缩框架，通过动态路由将特征处理解耦为对象语义流和场景几何流，显著降低计算开销同时提升精度。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在处理超高分辨率遥感图像时会产生大量视觉令牌，带来巨大的计算开销。现有的视觉令牌压缩方法采用静态均匀压缩策略，忽略了遥感解释任务中固有的"语义-几何二元性"：对象语义任务关注抽象语义需要激进背景剪枝，而场景几何任务依赖空间拓扑完整性。
AI.method: 提出DualComp框架：1) 通过轻量级预训练路由器动态引导，将特征处理解耦为两个专用路径；2) 在对象语义流中，使用空间连续语义聚合器通过尺寸自适应聚类聚合冗余背景同时保护小对象；3) 在场景几何流中，使用指令引导结构恢复器引入贪婪路径追踪拓扑完成机制重建空间骨架。
AI.result: 在超高分辨率遥感基准XLRS-Bench上的实验表明，DualComp能够以极低的计算成本实现高保真度的遥感解释，在效率和准确性方面同时获得提升。
AI.conclusion: DualComp通过任务自适应的双流令牌压缩框架，有效解决了超高分辨率遥感图像处理中的计算效率瓶颈，同时考虑了遥感解释任务的语义-几何二元特性，实现了效率与精度的双重优化。

title: BoxTuning: Directly Injecting the Object Box for Multimodal Model Fine-Tuning
summary: Object-level spatial-temporal understanding is essential for video question answering, yet existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode frames holistically and lack explicit mechanisms for fine-grained object grounding. Recent work addresses this by serializing bounding box coordinates as text tokens, but this text-coordinate paradigm suffers from a fundamental modality mismatch: object information is inherently visual, yet encoding it as text incurs a high token cost that forces aggressive temporal downsampling. We propose BoxTuning, which resolves this mismatch by injecting object spatial-temporal information directly into the visual modality. Colored bounding boxes and trajectory trails are rendered onto video frames as visual prompts, with only a concise color-to-object legend retained as text. This reduces the token cost significantly, achieving 87-93% text token reduction in practice. It also preserves full temporal resolution, where the trajectory trails further encode inter-frame motion direction and speed within each keyframe, recovering fine-grained dynamics that text-coordinate methods are forced to discard. Experimental results on five video QA benchmarks (CLEVRER, Perception Test, STAR, NExT-QA, IntentQA) show that BoxTuning surpasses text-coordinate baselines on spatially oriented tasks and nearly eliminates the accuracy degradation observed on reasoning-centric tasks, establishing visual prompting as a more natural and efficient paradigm for conveying object information to video MLLMs.

AI.tldr: BoxTuning通过将物体边界框和轨迹渲染为视觉提示，而非文本坐标，显著减少token消耗并保持完整时间分辨率，在视频问答任务中优于文本坐标方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型缺乏细粒度物体定位机制，而将边界框坐标序列化为文本token的方法存在模态不匹配问题：物体信息本质上是视觉的，但编码为文本会导致高token成本，迫使进行激进的时间下采样。
AI.method: 提出BoxTuning方法，将物体空间-时间信息直接注入视觉模态。在视频帧上渲染彩色边界框和轨迹轨迹作为视觉提示，仅保留简洁的颜色-物体图例作为文本。这显著减少了token成本，同时保持完整时间分辨率，轨迹轨迹还能编码帧间运动方向和速度。
AI.result: 在五个视频QA基准测试（CLEVRER、Perception Test、STAR、NExT-QA、IntentQA）中，BoxTuning在空间导向任务上超越了文本坐标基线，并几乎消除了在推理中心任务上观察到的准确率下降，实现了87-93%的文本token减少。
AI.conclusion: 视觉提示是向视频MLLMs传达物体信息的更自然和高效的范式，解决了文本-坐标范式中的模态不匹配问题，同时保持了细粒度的时空动态信息。

title: Sparse Hypergraph-Enhanced Frame-Event Object Detection with Fine-Grained MoE
summary: Integrating frame-based RGB cameras with event streams offers a promising solution for robust object detection under challenging dynamic conditions. However, the inherent heterogeneity and data redundancy of these modalities often lead to prohibitive computational overhead or suboptimal feature fusion. In this paper, we propose Hyper-FEOD, a high-performance and efficient detection framework, which synergistically optimizes multi-modal interaction through two core components. First, we introduce Sparse Hypergraph-enhanced Cross-Modal Fusion (S-HCF), which leverages the inherent sparsity of event streams to construct an event-guided activity map. By performing high-order hypergraph modeling exclusively on selected motion-critical sparse tokens, S-HCF captures complex non-local dependencies between RGB and event data while overcoming the traditional complexity bottlenecks of hypergraph computation. Second, we design a Fine-Grained Mixture of Experts (FG-MoE) Enhancement module to address the diverse semantic requirements of different image regions. This module employs specialized hypergraph experts tailored for object boundaries, internal textures, and backgrounds, utilizing a pixel-level spatial gating mechanism to adaptively route and enhance features. Combined with a load-balancing loss and zero-initialization strategy, FG-MoE ensures stable training and precise feature refinement without disrupting the pre-trained backbone's distribution. Experimental results on mainstream RGB-Event benchmarks demonstrate that Hyper-FEOD achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while maintaining a lightweight footprint suitable for real-time edge deployment.

AI.tldr: Hyper-FEOD：一种高性能高效的RGB-事件融合检测框架，通过稀疏超图跨模态融合和细粒度专家混合模块，在动态挑战条件下实现准确且轻量的目标检测。
AI.motivation: RGB相机与事件流融合为动态挑战条件下的鲁棒目标检测提供了有前景的解决方案，但模态间的异构性和数据冗余导致计算开销大或特征融合不理想。
AI.method: 提出Hyper-FEOD框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 稀疏超图增强跨模态融合(S-HCF)，利用事件流稀疏性构建事件引导活动图，在运动关键稀疏标记上进行高阶超图建模；2) 细粒度专家混合增强模块(FG-MoE)，针对不同图像区域语义需求，使用专门超图专家处理边界、纹理和背景，结合像素级空间门控机制。
AI.result: 在主流RGB-Event基准测试中，Hyper-FEOD实现了优越的精度-效率权衡，超越现有最先进方法，同时保持轻量级特性，适合实时边缘部署。
AI.conclusion: Hyper-FEOD通过创新的稀疏超图融合和细粒度专家混合机制，有效解决了RGB-事件融合中的计算复杂性和特征融合挑战，为动态环境下的高效目标检测提供了实用解决方案。

title: Naka-GS: A Bionics-inspired Dual-Branch Naka Correction and Progressive Point Pruning for Low-Light 3DGS
summary: Low-light conditions severely hinder 3D restoration and reconstruction by degrading image visibility, introducing color distortions, and contaminating geometric priors for downstream optimization. We present NAKA-GS, a bionics-inspired framework for low-light 3D Gaussian Splatting that jointly improves photometric restoration and geometric initialization. Our method starts with a Naka-guided chroma-correction network, which combines physics-prior low-light enhancement, dual-branch input modeling, frequency-decoupled correction, and mask-guided optimization to suppress bright-region chromatic artifacts and edge-structure errors. The enhanced images are then fed into a feed-forward multi-view reconstruction model to produce dense scene priors. To further improve Gaussian initialization, we introduce a lightweight Point Preprocessing Module (PPM) that performs coordinate alignment, voxel pooling, and distance-adaptive progressive pruning to remove noisy and redundant points while preserving representative structures. Without introducing heavy inference overhead, NAKA-GS improves restoration quality, training stability, and optimization efficiency for low-light 3D reconstruction. The proposed method was presented in the NTIRE 3D Restoration and Reconstruction (3DRR) Challenge, and outperformed the baseline methods by a large margin. The code is available at https://github.com/RunyuZhu/Naka-GS

AI.tldr: NAKA-GS是一个仿生启发的低光照3D高斯泼溅框架，通过联合改进光度恢复和几何初始化来解决低光照条件下的3D重建问题。
AI.motivation: 低光照条件严重阻碍3D恢复和重建，会降低图像可见度、引入颜色失真，并污染下游优化的几何先验。
AI.method: 1. Naka引导的色度校正网络：结合物理先验低光照增强、双分支输入建模、频率解耦校正和掩码引导优化；2. 前馈多视图重建模型生成密集场景先验；3. 轻量级点预处理模块(PPM)：进行坐标对齐、体素池化和距离自适应渐进剪枝。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 3D恢复和重建挑战中，NAKA-GS大幅优于基线方法，提高了恢复质量、训练稳定性和优化效率，且不引入沉重的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: NAKA-GS通过仿生启发的框架有效解决了低光照3D重建问题，联合改进光度恢复和几何初始化，为低光照条件下的3D高斯泼溅提供了高效解决方案。

title: Hierarchical Textual Knowledge for Enhanced Image Clustering
summary: Image clustering aims to group images in an unsupervised fashion. Traditional methods focus on knowledge from visual space, making it difficult to distinguish between visually similar but semantically different classes. Recent advances in vision-language models enable the use of textual knowledge to enhance image clustering. However, most existing methods rely on coarse class labels or simple nouns, overlooking the rich conceptual and attribute-level semantics embedded in textual space. In this paper, we propose a knowledge-enhanced clustering (KEC) method that constructs a hierarchical concept-attribute structured knowledge with the help of large language models (LLMs) to guide clustering. Specifically, we first condense redundant textual labels into abstract concepts and then automatically extract discriminative attributes for each single concept and similar concept pairs, via structured prompts to LLMs. This knowledge is instantiated for each input image to achieve the knowledge-enhanced features. The knowledge-enhanced features with original visual features are adapted to various downstream clustering algorithms. We evaluate KEC on 20 diverse datasets, showing consistent improvements across existing methods using additional textual knowledge. KEC without training outperforms zero-shot CLIP on 14 out of 20 datasets. Furthermore, the naive use of textual knowledge may harm clustering performance, while KEC provides both accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出KEC方法，利用LLM构建层次化概念-属性结构化知识来增强图像聚类，避免简单文本标签的局限性
AI.motivation: 传统图像聚类方法仅依赖视觉空间知识，难以区分视觉相似但语义不同的类别。现有基于视觉语言模型的方法大多使用粗粒度类别标签或简单名词，忽略了文本空间中丰富的概念和属性级语义
AI.method: 1) 使用LLM将冗余文本标签压缩为抽象概念；2) 通过结构化提示自动提取单个概念和相似概念对之间的区分性属性；3) 为每个输入图像实例化知识，获得知识增强特征；4) 将知识增强特征与原始视觉特征结合，适配各种下游聚类算法
AI.result: 在20个多样化数据集上评估，相比现有使用额外文本知识的方法获得一致改进。无训练的KEC在20个数据集中14个上优于零样本CLIP。同时证明简单使用文本知识可能损害聚类性能，而KEC提供准确性和鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: KEC方法通过LLM构建层次化概念-属性结构化知识，有效增强图像聚类性能，解决了传统方法在视觉相似但语义不同类别上的区分难题，同时避免了简单文本知识可能带来的负面影响

title: rPPG-VQA: A Video Quality Assessment Framework for Unsupervised rPPG Training
summary: Unsupervised remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) promises to leverage unlabeled video data, but its potential is hindered by a critical challenge: training on low-quality "in-the-wild" videos severely degrades model performance. An essential step missing here is to assess the suitability of the videos for rPPG model learning before using them for the task. Existing video quality assessment (VQA) methods are mainly designed for human perception and not directly applicable to the above purpose. In this work, we propose rPPG-VQA, a novel framework for assessing video suitability for rPPG. We integrate signal-level and scene-level analyses and design a dual-branch assessment architecture. The signal-level branch evaluates the physiological signal quality of the videos via robust signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) estimation with a multi-method consensus mechanism, and the scene-level branch uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to identify interferences like motion and unstable lighting. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage adaptive sampling (TAS) strategy that utilizes the quality score to curate optimal training datasets. Experiments show that by training on large-scale, "in-the-wild" videos filtered by our framework, we can develop unsupervised rPPG models that achieve a substantial improvement in accuracy on standard benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tianyang-Dai/rPPG-VQA.

AI.tldr: 提出rPPG-VQA框架，通过信号级和场景级双分支评估视频对远程光电容积描记术(rPPG)的适用性，结合两阶段自适应采样策略筛选训练数据，显著提升无监督rPPG模型性能。
AI.motivation: 无监督远程光电容积描记术(rPPG)需要利用未标记视频数据，但现有方法在"野外"低质量视频上训练会严重降低模型性能。缺乏评估视频对rPPG学习适用性的方法，而现有的视频质量评估方法主要针对人类感知设计，不适用于此目的。
AI.method: 提出rPPG-VQA框架：1) 信号级分支通过多方法共识机制进行稳健的信噪比估计，评估视频生理信号质量；2) 场景级分支使用多模态大语言模型识别运动和光照不稳定等干扰；3) 提出两阶段自适应采样策略，利用质量分数筛选最优训练数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，通过使用该框架筛选的大规模"野外"视频进行训练，可以开发出在标准基准测试中准确性显著提高的无监督rPPG模型。
AI.conclusion: rPPG-VQA框架能有效评估视频对rPPG学习的适用性，通过质量筛选显著提升无监督rPPG模型性能，为利用大规模未标记视频数据提供了有效解决方案。

title: Boxes2Pixels: Learning Defect Segmentation from Noisy SAM Masks
comment: Accepted for presentation at the AI4RWC Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary:
Accurate defect segmentation is critical for industrial inspection, yet dense pixel-level annotations are rarely available. A common workaround is to convert inexpensive bounding boxes into pseudo-masks using foundation segmentation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM). However, these pseudo-labels are systematically noisy on industrial surfaces, often hallucinating background structure while missing sparse defects.
  To address this limitation, a noise-robust box-to-pixel distillation framework, Boxes2Pixels, is proposed that treats SAM as a noisy teacher rather than a source of ground-truth supervision. Bounding boxes are converted into pseudo-masks offline by SAM, and a compact student is trained with (i) a hierarchical decoder over frozen DINOv2 features for semantic stability, (ii) an auxiliary binary localization head to decouple sparse foreground discovery from class prediction, and (iii) a one-sided online self-correction mechanism that relaxes background supervision when the student is confident, targeting teacher false negatives.
  On a manually annotated wind turbine inspection benchmark, the proposed Boxes2Pixels improves anomaly mIoU by +6.97 and binary IoU by +9.71 over the strongest baseline trained under identical weak supervision. Moreover, online self-correction increases the binary recall by +18.56, while the model employs 80\% fewer trainable parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/CLendering/Boxes2Pixels.

AI.tldr: Boxes2Pixels：一种噪声鲁棒的框到像素蒸馏框架，利用SAM作为噪声教师而非真值监督，通过分层解码器、辅助定位头和在线自校正机制，在工业缺陷分割中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 工业检测中精确的缺陷分割至关重要，但密集像素级标注难以获取。现有方法使用SAM将廉价边界框转换为伪掩码，但这些伪标签在工业表面上存在系统性噪声，经常错误包含背景结构而遗漏稀疏缺陷。
AI.method: 提出Boxes2Pixels框架：1）将SAM作为噪声教师离线生成伪掩码；2）使用分层解码器处理冻结的DINOv2特征以保持语义稳定性；3）引入辅助二值定位头将稀疏前景发现与类别预测解耦；4）采用单边在线自校正机制，在学生模型置信时放松背景监督，针对教师的假阴性错误。
AI.result: 在风力涡轮机检测基准测试中，Boxes2Pixels相比最强基线提升异常mIoU +6.97和二元IoU +9.71。在线自校正使二元召回率提升+18.56，同时模型参数量减少80%。
AI.conclusion: Boxes2Pixels通过将SAM视为噪声教师并引入分层解码、辅助定位和在线自校正，有效解决了工业缺陷分割中伪标签噪声问题，在减少参数的同时显著提升了分割性能。

title: RADA: Region-Aware Dual-encoder Auxiliary learning for Barely-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Deep learning has greatly advanced medical image segmentation, but its success relies heavily on fully supervised learning, which requires dense annotations that are costly and time-consuming for 3D volumetric scans. Barely-supervised learning reduces annotation burden by using only a few labeled slices per volume. Existing methods typically propagate sparse annotations to unlabeled slices through geometric continuity to generate pseudo-labels, but this strategy lacks semantic understanding, often resulting in low-quality pseudo-labels. Furthermore, medical image segmentation is inherently a pixel-level visual understanding task, where accuracy fundamentally depends on the quality of local, fine-grained visual features. Inspired by this, we propose RADA, a novel Region-Aware Dual-encoder Auxiliary learning pipeline which introduces a dual-encoder framework pre-trained on Alpha-CLIP to extract fine-grained, region-specific visual features from the original images and limited annotations. The framework combines image-level fine-grained visual features with text-level semantic guidance, providing region-aware semantic supervision that bridges image-level semantics and pixel-level segmentation. Integrated into a triple-view training framework, RADA achieves SOTA performance under extremely sparse annotation settings on LA2018, KiTS19 and LiTS, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: RADA：一种用于医学图像分割的区域感知双编码器辅助学习框架，通过Alpha-CLIP预训练提取细粒度视觉特征，结合文本语义指导，在极稀疏标注下实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割通常需要密集标注，成本高昂。现有方法通过几何连续性传播稀疏标注生成伪标签，但缺乏语义理解，导致伪标签质量低。医学图像分割本质上是像素级视觉理解任务，精度依赖于局部细粒度视觉特征质量。
AI.method: 提出RADA（区域感知双编码器辅助学习框架）：1）基于Alpha-CLIP预训练的双编码器框架，从原始图像和有限标注中提取细粒度、区域特定的视觉特征；2）结合图像级细粒度视觉特征与文本级语义指导，提供区域感知语义监督；3）集成到三视图训练框架中。
AI.result: 在LA2018、KiTS19和LiTS数据集上，在极稀疏标注设置下实现了最先进的性能，展示了跨不同数据集的强大泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RADA通过结合细粒度视觉特征和文本语义指导，有效解决了医学图像分割中稀疏标注的挑战，为降低标注成本提供了有效解决方案。

title: Do Instance Priors Help Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation?
summary: Semantic segmentation requires dense pixel-level annotations, which are costly and time-consuming to acquire. To address this, we present SeSAM, a framework that uses a foundational segmentation model, i.e. Segment Anything Model (SAM), with weak labels, including coarse masks, scribbles, and points. SAM, originally designed for instance-based segmentation, cannot be directly used for semantic segmentation tasks. In this work, we identify specific challenges faced by SAM and determine appropriate components to adapt it for class-based segmentation using weak labels. Specifically, SeSAM decomposes class masks into connected components, samples point prompts along object skeletons, selects SAM masks using weak-label coverage, and iteratively refines labels using pseudo-labels, enabling SAM-generated masks to be effectively used for semantic segmentation. Integrated with a semi-supervised learning framework, SeSAM balances ground-truth labels, SAM-based pseudo-labels, and high-confidence pseudo-labels, significantly improving segmentation quality. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and weak annotation types show that SeSAM consistently outperforms weakly supervised baselines while substantially reducing annotation cost relative to fine supervision.

AI.tldr: SeSAM是一个利用Segment Anything Model (SAM)进行弱监督语义分割的框架，通过分解类别掩码、采样点提示、选择掩码和迭代优化，显著降低了标注成本并提升了分割质量。
AI.motivation: 语义分割需要密集的像素级标注，成本高昂且耗时。现有的基础分割模型SAM虽然强大，但专为实例分割设计，无法直接用于基于类别的语义分割任务。
AI.method: 1. 将类别掩码分解为连通组件；2. 沿物体骨架采样点提示；3. 使用弱标签覆盖率选择SAM掩码；4. 使用伪标签迭代优化标签；5. 与半监督学习框架集成，平衡真实标签、SAM伪标签和高置信度伪标签。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和弱标注类型上的实验表明，SeSAM始终优于弱监督基线方法，同时相对于精细监督显著降低了标注成本。
AI.conclusion: SeSAM成功地将SAM适应于基于类别的语义分割任务，通过弱标签实现了高质量的分割结果，为降低语义分割的标注成本提供了有效解决方案。

authors: Rixta A. H. van Eijck van Heslinga
title: Development and evaluation of CADe systems in low-prevalence setting: The RARE25 challenge for early detection of Barrett's neoplasia
comment: The final author list is currently being finalized and will be updated in subsequent versions
summary: Computer-aided detection (CADe) of early neoplasia in Barrett's esophagus is a low-prevalence surveillance problem in which clinically relevant findings are rare. Although many CADe systems report strong performance on balanced or enriched datasets, their behavior under realistic prevalence remains insufficiently characterized. The RARE25 challenge addresses this gap by introducing a large-scale, prevalence-aware benchmark for neoplasia detection. It includes a public training set and a hidden test set reflecting real-world incidence. Methods were evaluated using operating-point-specific metrics emphasizing high sensitivity and accounting for prevalence. Eleven teams from seven countries submitted approaches using diverse architectures, pretraining, ensembling, and calibration strategies. While several methods achieved strong discriminative performance, positive predictive values remained low, highlighting the difficulty of low-prevalence detection and the risk of overestimating clinical utility when prevalence is ignored. All methods relied on fully supervised classification despite the dominance of normal findings, indicating a lack of prevalence-agnostic approaches such as anomaly detection or one-class learning. By releasing a public dataset and a reproducible evaluation framework, RARE25 aims to support the development of CADe systems robust to prevalence shift and suitable for clinical surveillance workflows.

AI.tldr: RARE25挑战赛针对巴雷特食管早期肿瘤检测的低患病率问题，建立了大规模、考虑患病率的基准测试，发现现有方法在真实患病率下阳性预测值较低，缺乏患病率无关的检测方法。
AI.motivation: 巴雷特食管早期肿瘤的计算机辅助检测是一个低患病率监测问题，现有CADe系统在平衡或富集数据集上表现良好，但在真实患病率下的行为特征不足，需要评估其在临床实际场景中的表现。
AI.method: RARE25挑战赛引入大规模、考虑患病率的基准测试，包括公开训练集和反映真实世界发病率的隐藏测试集。使用强调高灵敏度并考虑患病率的操作点特定指标进行评估。11个团队提交了使用多样化架构、预训练、集成和校准策略的方法。
AI.result: 虽然多种方法实现了强大的判别性能，但阳性预测值仍然较低，突显了低患病率检测的困难以及忽略患病率时高估临床效用的风险。所有方法都依赖于完全监督分类，缺乏患病率无关的方法如异常检测或单类学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过发布公共数据集和可复现的评估框架，RARE25旨在支持开发对患病率变化具有鲁棒性且适合临床监测工作流程的CADe系统。研究强调了在低患病率环境中考虑真实患病率的重要性。

title: Precision Synthesis of Multi-Tracer PET via VLM-Modulated Rectified Flow for Stratifying Mild Cognitive Impairment
summary: The biological definition of Alzheimer's disease (AD) relies on multi-modal neuroimaging, yet the clinical utility of positron emission tomography (PET) is limited by cost and radiation exposure, hindering early screening at preclinical or prodromal stages. While generative models offer a promising alternative by synthesizing PET from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), achieving subject-specific precision remains a primary challenge. Here, we introduce DIReCT$++$, a Domain-Informed ReCTified flow model for synthesizing multi-tracer PET from MRI combined with fundamental clinical information. Our approach integrates a 3D rectified flow architecture to capture complex cross-modal and cross-tracer relationships with a domain-adapted vision-language model (BiomedCLIP) that provides text-guided, personalized generation using clinical scores and imaging knowledge. Extensive evaluations on multi-center datasets demonstrate that DIReCT$++$ not only produces synthetic PET images ($^{18}$F-AV-45 and $^{18}$F-FDG) of superior fidelity and generalizability but also accurately recapitulates disease-specific patterns. Crucially, combining these synthesized PET images with MRI enables precise personalized stratification of mild cognitive impairment (MCI), advancing a scalable, data-efficient tool for the early diagnosis and prognostic prediction of AD. The source code will be released on https://github.com/ladderlab-xjtu/DIReCT-PLUS.

AI.tldr: DIReCT++ 是一种基于3D整流流架构的生成模型，能够从MRI和临床信息合成多示踪剂PET图像，用于阿尔茨海默病的早期筛查和个性化分层。
AI.motivation: PET成像在阿尔茨海默病诊断中成本高且有辐射暴露，限制了其在临床前或前驱期的早期筛查应用。需要开发能够从更易获取的MRI生成高质量PET图像的替代方法。
AI.method: 提出DIReCT++模型，结合3D整流流架构捕获跨模态和跨示踪剂关系，使用领域适应的视觉语言模型(BiomedCLIP)提供基于临床评分和影像知识的文本引导个性化生成。
AI.result: 在多中心数据集上验证，DIReCT++生成的合成PET图像(¹⁸F-AV-45和¹⁸F-FDG)具有优越的保真度和泛化能力，能准确再现疾病特异性模式，结合MRI能精确分层轻度认知障碍。
AI.conclusion: DIReCT++为阿尔茨海默病的早期诊断和预后预测提供了一个可扩展、数据高效的工具，通过合成PET图像克服了传统PET成像的成本和辐射限制。

title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding
summary: We benchmark how internal reasoning traces, which we call thought streams, affect video scene understanding in vision-language models. Using four configurations of Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite across scenes extracted from 100 hours of video, we ask three questions: does more thinking lead to better outputs, where do the gains stop, and what do these models actually think about? We introduce three evaluation metrics. Contentfulness measures how much of the thought stream is useful scene content versus meta-commentary. Thought-Final Coverage measures how faithfully the thought stream translates into the final output. Dominant Entity Analysis identifies which subjects, actions, and settings the model focuses on. GPT-5 serves as an independent judge. We find that quality gains from additional thinking plateau quickly, with most improvement occurring in the first few hundred tokens. Flash Lite offers the best balance between quality and token usage. Tight reasoning budgets cause the model to add content in the final output that it never reasoned about, a form of compression-step hallucination. Despite being different model tiers, Flash and Flash Lite produce similar thought streams, though they differ in style: Flash discusses its reasoning process, while Lite focuses on describing the scene.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了Gemini 2.5 Flash和Flash Lite在视频场景理解中的思维流效果，发现质量提升在最初几百个token后趋于平稳，Flash Lite在质量和token使用上达到最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 探索视觉语言模型中内部推理轨迹（思维流）如何影响视频场景理解，研究更多思考是否带来更好输出、收益何时停止以及模型实际思考内容。
AI.method: 使用Gemini 2.5 Flash和Flash Lite的四种配置，从100小时视频中提取场景，引入三个评估指标：内容丰富度、思维-最终覆盖度、主导实体分析，并用GPT-5作为独立评判者。
AI.result: 质量提升随额外思考快速达到平台期，大部分改进发生在最初几百个token；Flash Lite在质量和token使用上达到最佳平衡；推理预算紧张会导致模型在最终输出中添加未推理过的内容（压缩步幻觉）；Flash和Flash Lite思维流相似但风格不同。
AI.conclusion: 思维流对视频场景理解有积极影响但收益递减，需要平衡推理成本与质量，不同模型层级在推理风格上存在差异，压缩步幻觉是需要关注的问题。

title: Towards Adaptive Open-Set Object Detection via Category-Level Collaboration Knowledge Mining
comment: 15 pages,9 figures,accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Existing object detectors often struggle to generalize across domains while adapting to emerging novel categories. Adaptive open-set object detection (AOOD) addresses this challenge by training on base categories in the source domain and adapting to both base and novel categories in the target domain without target annotations. However, current AOOD methods remain limited by weak cross-domain representations, ambiguity among novel categories, and source-domain feature bias. To address these issues, we propose a category-level collaboration knowledge mining strategy that exploits both inter-class and intra-class relationships across domains. Specifically, we construct a clustering-based memory bank to encode class prototypes, auxiliary features, and intra-class disparity information, and iteratively update it via unsupervised clustering to enhance category-level knowledge representation. We further design a base-to-novel selection metric to discover source-domain features related to novel categories and use them to initialize novel-category classifiers. In addition, an adaptive feature assignment strategy transfers the learned category-level knowledge to the target domain and asynchronously updates the memory bank to alleviate source-domain bias. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our method consistently surpasses state-of-the-art AOOD methods by 1.1-5.5 mAP.

AI.tldr: 提出一种类别级协作知识挖掘策略，通过跨域类别关系增强自适应开放集目标检测性能
AI.motivation: 现有自适应开放集目标检测方法存在跨域表示弱、新类别模糊、源域特征偏差等问题，需要更有效的跨域知识挖掘
AI.method: 1) 构建基于聚类的记忆库编码类别原型、辅助特征和类内差异信息；2) 设计基类到新类选择指标初始化新类别分类器；3) 自适应特征分配策略转移类别级知识并异步更新记忆库
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，方法比现有最优AOOD方法提升1.1-5.5 mAP
AI.conclusion: 通过类别级协作知识挖掘策略，有效解决了跨域表示弱、新类别模糊和源域偏差问题，显著提升了自适应开放集目标检测性能

title: MedP-CLIP: Medical CLIP with Region-Aware Prompt Integration
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has demonstrated outstanding performance in global image understanding and zero-shot transfer through large-scale text-image alignment. However, the core of medical image analysis often lies in the fine-grained understanding of specific anatomical structures or lesion regions. Therefore, precisely comprehending region-of-interest (RoI) information provided by medical professionals or perception models becomes crucial. To address this need, we propose MedP-CLIP, a region-aware medical vision-language model (VLM). MedP-CLIP innovatively integrates medical prior knowledge and designs a feature-level region prompt integration mechanism, enabling it to flexibly respond to various prompt forms (e.g., points, bounding boxes, masks) while maintaining global contextual awareness when focusing on local regions. We pre-train the model on a meticulously constructed large-scale dataset (containing over 6.4 million medical images and 97.3 million region-level annotations), equipping it with cross-disease and cross-modality fine-grained spatial semantic understanding capabilities. Experiments demonstrate that MedP-CLIP significantly outperforms baseline methods in various medical tasks, including zero-shot recognition, interactive segmentation, and empowering multimodal large language models. This model provides a scalable, plug-and-play visual backbone for medical AI, combining holistic image understanding with precise regional analysis.

AI.tldr: MedP-CLIP是一个区域感知的医学视觉语言模型，通过集成医学先验知识和特征级区域提示机制，能够灵活响应多种提示形式（点、边界框、掩码），在保持全局上下文感知的同时关注局部区域。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析的核心在于对特定解剖结构或病变区域的细粒度理解，而现有的CLIP模型主要关注全局图像理解。因此，需要能够精确理解医学专业人员或感知模型提供的感兴趣区域（RoI）信息的模型。
AI.method: 提出MedP-CLIP模型，创新性地集成医学先验知识，设计特征级区域提示集成机制，能够灵活响应各种提示形式（点、边界框、掩码）。在精心构建的大规模数据集（包含640多万医学图像和9730万区域级标注）上进行预训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，MedP-CLIP在多种医学任务中显著优于基线方法，包括零样本识别、交互式分割和赋能多模态大语言模型。模型具备跨疾病和跨模态的细粒度空间语义理解能力。
AI.conclusion: MedP-CLIP为医学AI提供了一个可扩展、即插即用的视觉骨干网络，将整体图像理解与精确区域分析相结合，能够满足医学图像分析中对局部区域细粒度理解的需求。

title: LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment: Methods and Results
comment: Accepted by CVPR2026 Workshop; LoViF Challenge
summary: This paper reviews the LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment. This challenge aims to raise a new direction, i.e., how to evaluate the loss of semantic information from the human perspective, intending to promote the development of some new directions, like semantic coding, processing, and semantic-oriented optimization, etc. Unlike existing datasets of quality assessment, we form a dataset of human-oriented semantic quality assessment, termed the SeIQA dataset. This dataset is divided into three parts for this competition: (i) training data: 510 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground truth references; (ii) validation data: 80 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground-truth references; (iii) testing data: 160 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground-truth references. The primary objective of this challenge is to establish a new and powerful benchmark for human-oriented semantic image quality assessment. There are a total of 58 teams registered in this competition, and 6 teams submitted valid solutions and fact sheets for the final testing phase. These submissions achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the SeIQA dataset.

AI.tldr: LoViF 2026挑战赛聚焦于从人类视角评估图像语义信息损失，提出了新的研究方向，并建立了SeIQA数据集作为基准，吸引了58支团队参与，6支团队提交了达到SOTA性能的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有图像质量评估方法主要关注像素级失真，缺乏从人类视角评估语义信息损失的能力。为了推动语义编码、处理和语义导向优化等新方向的发展，需要建立人类导向的语义图像质量评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了SeIQA数据集，包含510对训练图像、80对验证图像和160对测试图像（每对包含退化图像和其对应的真实参考图像）。通过挑战赛形式，邀请研究团队开发人类导向的语义图像质量评估方法。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了58支团队注册，其中6支团队提交了有效的解决方案和最终测试报告。这些提交在SeIQA数据集上达到了最先进的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: LoViF 2026挑战赛成功建立了人类导向语义图像质量评估的新基准，推动了该领域的发展，为语义编码、处理和优化等新方向提供了评估基础。

title: 3DTV: A Feedforward Interpolation Network for Real-Time View Synthesis
summary:
Real-time free-viewpoint rendering requires balancing multi-camera redundancy with the latency constraints of interactive applications. We address this challenge by combining lightweight geometry with learning and propose 3DTV, a feedforward network for real-time sparse-view interpolation. A Delaunay-based triplet selection ensures angular coverage for each target view. Building on this, we introduce a pose-aware depth module that estimates a coarse-to-fine depth pyramid, enabling efficient feature reprojection and occlusion-aware blending. Unlike methods that require scene-specific optimization, 3DTV runs feedforward without retraining, making it practical for AR/VR, telepresence, and interactive applications. Our experiments on challenging multi-view video datasets demonstrate that 3DTV consistently achieves a strong balance of quality and efficiency, outperforming recent real-time novel-view baselines. Crucially, 3DTV avoids explicit proxies, enabling robust rendering across diverse scenes. This makes it a practical solution for low-latency multi-view streaming and interactive rendering.
  Project Page: https://stefanmschulz.github.io/3DTV_webpage/

AI.tldr: 3DTV是一个用于实时稀疏视角插值的前馈网络，结合轻量级几何与学习，无需场景特定优化即可实现实时自由视点渲染，适用于AR/VR和远程呈现等交互应用。
AI.motivation: 实时自由视点渲染需要在多相机冗余性与交互应用的延迟约束之间取得平衡。现有方法通常需要场景特定优化，难以满足实时交互需求。
AI.method: 提出3DTV网络：1) 使用Delaunay三角剖分选择三元组确保角度覆盖；2) 引入姿态感知深度模块估计从粗到细的金字塔深度，实现高效特征重投影和遮挡感知融合；3) 避免显式代理，采用前馈架构无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在挑战性多视角视频数据集上的实验表明，3DTV在质量和效率之间取得了良好平衡，优于最近的实时新视角基线方法，能够跨多样场景实现鲁棒渲染。
AI.conclusion: 3DTV为低延迟多视角流媒体和交互渲染提供了实用解决方案，无需场景特定优化即可实现实时自由视点渲染，适用于AR/VR、远程呈现等交互应用。

title: H-SPAM: Hierarchical Superpixel Anything Model
summary: Superpixels offer a compact image representation by grouping pixels into coherent regions. Recent methods have reached a plateau in terms of segmentation accuracy by generating noisy superpixel shapes. Moreover, most existing approaches produce a single fixed-scale partition that limits their use in vision pipelines that would benefit multi-scale representations. In this work, we introduce H-SPAM (Hierarchical Superpixel Anything Model), a unified framework for generating accurate, regular, and perfectly nested hierarchical superpixels. Starting from a fine partition, guided by deep features and external object priors, H-SPAM constructs the hierarchy through a two-phase region merging process that first preserves object consistency and then allows controlled inter-object grouping. The hierarchy can also be modulated using visual attention maps or user input to preserve important regions longer in the hierarchy. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that H-SPAM strongly outperforms existing hierarchical methods in both accuracy and regularity, while performing on par with most recent state-of-the-art non-hierarchical methods. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/waldo-j/hspam.

AI.tldr: H-SPAM是一个生成准确、规则且完美嵌套的层次化超像素的统一框架，通过两阶段区域合并过程构建层次结构，在准确性和规则性上优于现有层次化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有超像素方法在分割精度上已达到瓶颈，产生噪声形状，且大多生成单一固定尺度的分割，限制了在需要多尺度表示的视觉管道中的应用。
AI.method: H-SPAM从精细分割开始，利用深度特征和外部对象先验指导，通过两阶段区域合并过程构建层次结构：第一阶段保持对象一致性，第二阶段允许受控的对象间分组。还可以使用视觉注意力图或用户输入来调节层次结构。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中，H-SPAM在准确性和规则性上显著优于现有层次化方法，同时与最新的非层次化方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: H-SPAM提供了一个统一的层次化超像素生成框架，能够产生准确、规则且完美嵌套的超像素层次结构，为视觉任务提供了更好的多尺度表示。

title: Sign Language Recognition in the Age of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Sign Language Research (MSLR), 8 pages, 3 figures
summary: Recent Vision Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of multimodal reasoning tasks. This raises the question of whether such general-purpose models can also address specialized visual recognition problems such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR) without task-specific training. In this work, we investigate the capability of modern VLMs to perform ISLR in a zero-shot setting. We evaluate several open-source and proprietary VLMs on the WLASL300 benchmark. Our experiments show that, under prompt-only zero-shot inference, current open-source VLMs remain far behind classic supervised ISLR classifiers by a wide margin. However, follow-up experiments reveal that these models capture partial visual-semantic alignment between signs and text descriptions. Larger proprietary models achieve substantially higher accuracy, highlighting the importance of model scale and training data diversity. All our code is publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了现代视觉语言模型在零样本设置下进行孤立手语识别的能力，发现开源模型表现远落后于传统监督方法，但部分模型已具备视觉-语义对齐能力，更大规模的专有模型表现更好。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型在多模态推理任务中表现出色，研究者想知道这些通用模型是否也能解决专门的视觉识别问题，如孤立手语识别，而无需特定任务训练。
AI.method: 在WLASL300基准上评估多个开源和专有视觉语言模型，采用提示式零样本推理方法，分析模型在孤立手语识别任务上的表现。
AI.result: 开源视觉语言模型在零样本孤立手语识别上远落后于传统监督分类器，但确实捕捉到了手语与文本描述之间的部分视觉-语义对齐。更大规模的专有模型准确率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 当前开源视觉语言模型在零样本孤立手语识别方面仍有很大提升空间，模型规模和训练数据多样性是关键因素，但模型已展现出一定的视觉-语义对齐能力。

title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: AI Flash Portrait (Track 3)
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshop. Includes supplementary material as ancillary file
summary: In this paper, we present a comprehensive overview of the NTIRE 2026 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) challenge, with a specific focus on Track 3: AI Flash Portrait. Despite significant advancements in deep learning for image restoration, existing models still encounter substantial challenges in real-world low-light portrait scenarios. Specifically, they struggle to achieve an optimal balance among noise suppression, detail preservation, and faithful illumination and color reproduction. To bridge this gap, this challenge aims to establish a novel benchmark for real-world low-light portrait restoration. We comprehensively evaluate the proposed algorithms utilizing a hybrid evaluation system that integrates objective quantitative metrics with rigorous subjective assessment protocols. For this competition, we provide a dataset containing 800 groups of real-captured low-light portrait data. Each group consists of a 1K-resolution low-light input image, a 1K ground truth (GT), and a 1K person mask. This challenge has garnered widespread attention from both academia and industry, attracting over 100 participating teams and receiving more than 3,000 valid submissions. This report details the motivation behind the challenge, the dataset construction process, the evaluation metrics, and the various phases of the competition. The released dataset and baseline code for this track are publicly available from the same \href{https://github.com/zsn1434/AI_Flash-BaseLine/tree/main}{GitHub repository}, and the official challenge webpage is hosted on \href{https://www.codabench.org/competitions/12885/}{CodaBench}.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 RAIM挑战赛Track 3：AI Flash Portrait，针对真实世界低光人像修复，建立新基准，吸引了100+团队参与，提供800组真实拍摄数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习图像修复模型在真实世界低光人像场景中仍面临挑战，难以在噪声抑制、细节保留、光照和色彩还原之间取得最佳平衡，需要建立新的基准来推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 通过竞赛形式，提供800组真实拍摄的低光人像数据集（包含1K分辨率低光输入、GT和人物掩码），采用混合评估系统结合客观量化指标和严格主观评估协议来全面评估算法性能。
AI.result: 挑战赛获得了学术界和工业界的广泛关注，吸引了超过100个团队参与，收到3000+有效提交，建立了真实世界低光人像修复的新基准。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛成功建立了真实世界低光人像修复的新基准，推动了该领域的研究发展，数据集和基线代码已公开，为后续研究提供了重要资源。

title: Seg2Change: Adapting Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation Model for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Change detection is a fundamental task in remote sensing, aiming to quantify the impacts of human activities and ecological dynamics on land-cover changes. Existing change detection methods are limited to predefined classes in training datasets, which constrains their scalability in real-world scenarios. In recent years, numerous advanced open-vocabulary semantic segmentation models have emerged for remote sensing imagery. However, there is still a lack of an effective framework for directly applying these models to open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD), a novel task that integrates vision and language to detect changes across arbitrary categories. To address these challenges, we first construct a category-agnostic change detection dataset, termed CA-CDD. Further, we design a category-agnostic change head to detect the transitions of arbitrary categories and index them to specific classes. Based on them, we propose Seg2Change, an adapter designed to adapt open-vocabulary semantic segmentation models to change detection task. Without bells and whistles, this simple yet effective framework achieves state-of-the-art OVCD performance (+9.52 IoU on WHU-CD and +5.50 mIoU on SECOND). Our code is released at https://github.com/yogurts-sy/Seg2Change.

AI.tldr: 提出Seg2Change框架，通过适配器将开放词汇语义分割模型应用于变化检测任务，实现任意类别的变化检测
AI.motivation: 现有变化检测方法局限于预定义类别，缺乏处理任意类别变化的能力；开放词汇语义分割模型虽已发展，但缺乏直接应用于变化检测的有效框架
AI.method: 构建类别无关变化检测数据集CA-CDD，设计类别无关变化头检测任意类别变化，提出Seg2Change适配器将开放词汇分割模型适配到变化检测任务
AI.result: 在WHU-CD数据集上IoU提升9.52，在SECOND数据集上mIoU提升5.50，达到最先进的开放词汇变化检测性能
AI.conclusion: Seg2Change框架简单有效，成功将开放词汇语义分割模型适配到变化检测任务，解决了现有方法类别受限的问题

title: Bridging the RGB-IR Gap: Consensus and Discrepancy Modeling for Text-Guided Multispectral Detection
summary: Text-guided multispectral object detection uses text semantics to guide semantic-aware cross-modal interaction between RGB and IR for more robust perception. However, notable limitations remain: (1) existing methods often use text only as an auxiliary semantic enhancement signal, without exploiting its guiding role to bridge the inherent granularity asymmetry between RGB and IR; and (2) conventional data-driven attention-based fusion tends to emphasize stable consensus while overlooking potentially valuable cross-modal discrepancies. To address these issues, we propose a semantic bridge fusion framework with bi-support modeling for multispectral object detection. Specifically, text is used as a shared semantic bridge to align RGB and IR responses under a unified category condition, while the recalibrated thermal semantic prior is projected onto the RGB branch for semantic-level mapping fusion. We further formulate RGB-IR interaction evidence into the regular consensus support and the complementary discrepancy support that contains potentially discriminative cues, and introduce them into fusion via dynamic recalibration as a structured inductive bias. In addition, we design a bidirectional semantic alignment module for closed-loop vision-text guidance enhancement. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed fusion framework and its superior detection performance on multispectral benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenwang5372/Bridging-RGB-IR-Gap.

AI.tldr: 提出语义桥接融合框架，通过文本作为共享语义桥梁对齐RGB和IR模态，并引入双向支持建模（共识支持和差异支持）来提升多光谱目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导多光谱目标检测方法存在两个主要问题：1）文本仅作为辅助语义增强信号，未充分利用其桥梁作用来弥合RGB和IR之间的粒度不对称性；2）传统数据驱动的注意力融合倾向于强调稳定共识，而忽略了可能有价值的跨模态差异。
AI.method: 提出语义桥接融合框架：1）使用文本作为共享语义桥梁，在统一类别条件下对齐RGB和IR响应；2）将重新校准的热语义先验投影到RGB分支进行语义级映射融合；3）将RGB-IR交互证据建模为常规共识支持和包含潜在判别线索的互补差异支持，并通过动态重新校准引入融合过程；4）设计双向语义对齐模块实现闭环视觉-文本引导增强。
AI.result: 在多个多光谱基准测试上进行了广泛实验，证明了所提融合框架的有效性，并展示了优越的目标检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过文本作为语义桥梁和双向支持建模，能够有效弥合RGB和IR模态之间的差距，提升多光谱目标检测的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: Decoupled Similarity for Task-Aware Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Token pruning has emerged as an effective approach to reduce the substantial computational overhead of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by discarding less informative visual tokens while preserving performance. However, existing methods typically rely on individual attention sources from different LVLM components, resulting in incomplete and suboptimal pruning decisions due to biased attention distributions. To address this problem, we propose DeSAP, a novel Decoupled Similarity-Aware Pruning method for precise, task-aware token pruning within the visual encoder. Specifically, DeSAP introduces a decoupled similarity to capture fine-grained cross-modal relevance between visual features and text tokens, providing explicit task-related guidance for pruning. By integrating decoupled similarity with visual saliency signals derived from visual attention, DeSAP performs token pruning under the guidance of both task-related and visual cues, enabling robust pruning even under aggressive pruning ratios. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and architectures show that DeSAP consistently outperforms SOTA methods in both accuracy and efficiency. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, DeSAP achieves a 10 times FLOPs reduction and a 2.3 times prefill speedup by retaining only 11.1% of visual tokens, while maintaining 98.1% of the original performance.

AI.tldr: DeSAP是一种解耦相似性感知的视觉token剪枝方法，通过结合任务相关性和视觉显著性信号，在保持性能的同时大幅减少LVLMs的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法通常依赖单个注意力源，导致注意力分布偏差和不完整的剪枝决策，需要更精确的任务感知剪枝方法。
AI.method: 提出解耦相似性来捕捉视觉特征与文本token之间的细粒度跨模态相关性，结合视觉注意力产生的视觉显著性信号，在任务相关和视觉线索双重指导下进行token剪枝。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，仅保留11.1%的视觉token即可实现10倍FLOPs减少和2.3倍预填充加速，同时保持98.1%的原始性能，在多个基准测试和架构上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: DeSAP通过解耦相似性和视觉显著性信号的结合，实现了精确的任务感知token剪枝，在保持性能的同时显著提升LVLMs的计算效率。

title: Script-a-Video: Deep Structured Audio-visual Captions via Factorized Streams and Relational Grounding
summary: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are transforming video captioning from a descriptive endpoint into a semantic interface for both video understanding and generation. However, the dominant paradigm still casts videos as monolithic narrative paragraphs that entangle visual, auditory, and identity information. This dense coupling not only compromises representational fidelity but also limits scalability, since even local edits can trigger global rewrites. To address this structural bottleneck, we propose Multi-Stream Scene Script (MTSS), a novel paradigm that replaces monolithic text with factorized and explicitly grounded scene descriptions. MTSS is built on two core principles: Stream Factorization, which decouples a video into complementary streams (Reference, Shot, Event, and Global), and Relational Grounding, which reconnects these isolated streams through explicit identity and temporal links to maintain holistic video consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MTSS consistently enhances video understanding across various models, achieving an average reduction of 25% in the total error rate on Video-SALMONN-2 and an average performance gain of 67% on the Daily-Omni reasoning benchmark. It also narrows the performance gap between smaller and larger MLLMs, indicating a substantially more learnable caption interface. Finally, even without architectural adaptation, replacing monolithic prompts with MTSS in multi-shot video generation yields substantial human-rated improvements: a 45% boost in cross-shot identity consistency, a 56% boost in audio-visual alignment, and a 71% boost in temporal controllability.

AI.tldr: MTSS提出一种新的视频描述范式，将单一段落式描述分解为多流场景脚本，通过流分解和关系接地提升视频理解和生成能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型将视频描述为单一叙事段落，导致视觉、听觉和身份信息纠缠在一起。这种密集耦合不仅损害表示保真度，还限制可扩展性，因为局部编辑可能触发全局重写。
AI.method: 提出多流场景脚本（MTSS），基于两个核心原则：1）流分解：将视频解耦为互补流（参考、镜头、事件和全局）；2）关系接地：通过显式身份和时间链接重新连接这些孤立流，保持视频整体一致性。
AI.result: 在视频理解方面，MTSS在Video-SALMONN-2上平均减少25%总错误率，在Daily-Omni推理基准上平均提升67%性能。在视频生成方面，即使没有架构适配，也能显著提升跨镜头身份一致性（45%）、视听对齐（56%）和时间可控性（71%）。
AI.conclusion: MTSS通过结构化分解和显式接地，解决了当前视频描述范式的结构瓶颈，显著提升了视频理解和生成能力，缩小了大小模型之间的性能差距，提供了更易学习的描述接口。

title: Variational Latent Entropy Estimation Disentanglement: Controlled Attribute Leakage for Face Recognition
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (TIFS). 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary: Face recognition embeddings encode identity, but they also encode other factors such as gender and ethnicity. Depending on how these factors are used by a downstream system, separating them from the information needed for verification is important for both privacy and fairness. We propose Variational Latent Entropy Estimation Disentanglement (VLEED), a post-hoc method that transforms pretrained embeddings with a variational autoencoder and encourages a distilled representation where the categorical variable of interest is separated from identity-relevant information. VLEED uses a mutual information-based objective realised through the estimation of the entropy of the categorical attribute in the latent space, and provides stable training with fine-grained control over information removal. We evaluate our method on IJB-C, RFW, and VGGFace2 for gender and ethnicity disentanglement, and compare it to various state-of-the-art methods. We report verification utility, predictability of the disentangled variable under linear and nonlinear classifiers, and group disparity metrics based on false match rates. Our results show that VLEED offers a wide range of privacy-utility tradeoffs over existing methods and can also reduce recognition bias across demographic groups.

AI.tldr: VLEED是一种后处理方法，使用变分自编码器转换预训练的人脸嵌入，通过互信息目标分离身份信息与性别/种族等属性，实现隐私保护与公平性平衡。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别嵌入不仅编码身份信息，还包含性别、种族等敏感属性。这些属性在下游系统中的使用可能涉及隐私和公平性问题，因此需要将其与身份验证所需信息分离。
AI.method: 提出VLEED方法：使用变分自编码器转换预训练嵌入，通过基于互信息的目标函数（通过估计潜在空间中分类属性的熵实现）鼓励分离表示，其中分类变量与身份相关信息分离。该方法提供稳定的训练和对信息移除的细粒度控制。
AI.result: 在IJB-C、RFW和VGGFace2数据集上评估性别和种族解缠，与多种SOTA方法比较。结果显示VLEED在隐私-效用权衡方面优于现有方法，并能减少跨人口群体的识别偏见。
AI.conclusion: VLEED提供了一种有效的后处理方法，能够在人脸识别嵌入中分离敏感属性与身份信息，实现隐私保护与公平性的平衡，为下游应用提供更安全的表示。

title: A Deep Equilibrium Network for Hyperspectral Unmixing
summary: Hyperspectral unmixing (HU) is crucial for analyzing hyperspectral imagery, yet achieving accurate unmixing remains challenging. While traditional methods struggle to effectively model complex spectral-spatial features, deep learning approaches often lack physical interpretability. Unrolling-based methods, despite offering network interpretability, inadequately exploit spectral-spatial information and incur high memory costs and numerical precision issues during backpropagation. To address these limitations, we propose DEQ-Unmix, which reformulates abundance estimation as a deep equilibrium model, enabling efficient constant-memory training via implicit differentiation. It replaces the gradient operator of the data reconstruction term with a trainable convolutional network to capture spectral-spatial information. By leveraging implicit differentiation, DEQ-Unmix enables efficient and constant-memory backpropagation. Experiments on synthetic and two real-world datasets demonstrate that DEQ-Unmix achieves superior unmixing performance while maintaining constant memory cost.

AI.tldr: 提出DEQ-Unmix方法，通过深度平衡模型重构丰度估计，实现恒定内存训练，提升高光谱解混性能
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以建模复杂光谱-空间特征，深度学习方法缺乏物理可解释性，展开式方法内存成本高且数值精度问题，需要更高效可解释的解混方法
AI.method: 将丰度估计重构为深度平衡模型，用可训练卷积网络替换数据重构项的梯度算子来捕获光谱-空间信息，利用隐式微分实现高效恒定内存反向传播
AI.result: 在合成和两个真实数据集上的实验表明，DEQ-Unmix实现了优越的解混性能，同时保持恒定内存成本
AI.conclusion: DEQ-Unmix通过深度平衡模型和隐式微分，有效解决了高光谱解混中的性能、可解释性和内存效率问题

title: Empowering Video Translation using Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Recent developments in video translation have further enhanced cross-lingual access to video content, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) playing an increasingly important supporting role. With strong multimodal understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities, MLLMs-based video translation systems are overcoming the limitations of traditional cascaded pipelines that separately handle automatic speech recognition, machine translation, text-to-speech and lip synchronization. These MLLM-powered approaches not only achieve competitive or superior translation quality, but also demonstrate stronger robustness in zero-shot settings and multi-speaker scenarios, while jointly modeling semantic fidelity, timing, speaker identity, and emotional consistency. However, despite the rapid progress of MLLMs and extensive surveys on general video-language understanding, a focused and systematic review of how MLLMs empower video translation tasks is still lacking. To fill this gap, we provide the first comprehensive overview of MLLMs-based video translation, organized around a three-role taxonomy: 1) Semantic Reasoner, which characterizes how MLLMs perform video understanding, temporal reasoning, and multimodal fusion; 2) Expressive Performer, which analyzes LLM-driven and LLM-augmented techniques for expressive, controllable speech generation; and 3) Visual Synthesizer, which examines different types of video generators for high-fidelity lip-sync and visual alignment. Finally, we discuss open challenges in video understanding, temporal modeling, and multimodal alignment, and outline promising future research directions for MLLMs-powered video translation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统综述了基于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的视频翻译研究，提出了三角色分类法：语义推理器、表达性表演者和视觉合成器，并讨论了该领域的开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLMs在视频翻译中发挥越来越重要的作用，克服了传统级联管道的局限，但目前缺乏对这一领域的系统性综述。本文旨在填补这一空白，为MLLMs赋能的视频翻译提供全面概述。
AI.method: 提出三角色分类法：1）语义推理器（视频理解、时序推理、多模态融合）；2）表达性表演者（LLM驱动和增强的表达性语音生成技术）；3）视觉合成器（高保真唇同步和视觉对齐的视频生成器）。
AI.result: MLLMs赋能的视频翻译方法不仅达到竞争性或更优的翻译质量，而且在零样本设置和多说话人场景中表现出更强的鲁棒性，同时联合建模语义保真度、时序、说话人身份和情感一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统综述了MLLMs在视频翻译中的应用，提出了三角色分类框架，并指出了视频理解、时序建模和多模态对齐等开放挑战，为未来研究提供了方向。

title: Any 3D Scene is Worth 1K Tokens: 3D-Grounded Representation for Scene Generation at Scale
summary: 3D scene generation has long been dominated by 2D multi-view or video diffusion models. This is due not only to the lack of scene-level 3D latent representation, but also to the fact that most scene-level 3D visual data exists in the form of multi-view images or videos, which are naturally compatible with 2D diffusion architectures. Typically, these 2D-based approaches degrade 3D spatial extrapolation to 2D temporal extension, which introduces two fundamental issues: (i) representing 3D scenes via 2D views leads to significant representation redundancy, and (ii) latent space rooted in 2D inherently limits the spatial consistency of the generated 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose, for the first time, to perform 3D scene generation directly within an implicit 3D latent space to address these limitations. First, we repurpose frozen 2D representation encoders to construct our 3D Representation Autoencoder (3DRAE), which grounds view-coupled 2D semantic representations into a view-decoupled 3D latent representation. This enables representing 3D scenes observed from arbitrary numbers of views--at any resolution and aspect ratio--with fixed complexity and rich semantics. Then we introduce 3D Diffusion Transformer (3DDiT), which performs diffusion modeling in this 3D latent space, achieving remarkably efficient and spatially consistent 3D scene generation while supporting diverse conditioning configurations. Moreover, since our approach directly generates a 3D scene representation, it can be decoded to images and optional point maps along arbitrary camera trajectories without requiring per-trajectory diffusion sampling pass, which is common in 2D-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出首个在隐式3D潜在空间中直接生成3D场景的方法，解决了传统2D扩散模型在3D场景生成中的表示冗余和空间一致性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前3D场景生成主要依赖2D多视图或视频扩散模型，存在两个根本问题：1) 通过2D视图表示3D场景导致显著表示冗余；2) 基于2D的潜在空间限制了生成3D场景的空间一致性。
AI.method: 提出3D表示自编码器(3DRAE)，利用冻结的2D表示编码器将视图耦合的2D语义表示转换为视图解耦的3D潜在表示；然后引入3D扩散变换器(3DDiT)，在该3D潜在空间中进行扩散建模。
AI.result: 实现了高效且空间一致的3D场景生成，支持多样化的条件配置，能够沿任意相机轨迹解码为图像和可选点云图，无需每轨迹扩散采样。
AI.conclusion: 首次在隐式3D潜在空间中直接进行3D场景生成，解决了2D方法的局限性，为3D场景生成提供了更高效和一致的新范式。

title: A Compact and Efficient 1.251 Million Parameter Machine Learning CNN Model PD36-C for Plant Disease Detection: A Case Study
summary: Deep learning has markedly advanced image based plant disease diagnosis as improved hardware and dataset quality have enabled increasingly accurate neural network models. This paper presents PD36 C, a compact convolutional neural network (1,250,694 parameters and 4.77 MB) for plant disease classification. Trained with TensorFlow Keras on the New Plant Diseases Dataset (87k images, 38 classes), PD36 C is designed for robustness and edge deployability, complemented by a Qt for Python desktop application that offers an intuitive GUI and offline inference on commodity hardware. Across experiments, training accuracy reached 0.99697 by epoch 30, and average test accuracy was 0.9953 across 38 classes. Per class performance is uniformly high; on the lower end, Corn (maize) Cercospora leaf spot achieved precision around 0.9777 and recall around 0.9634, indicating occasional confusion with visually similar categories, while on the upper end numerous classes including Apple Black rot, Cedar apple rust, Blueberry healthy, Cherry Powdery mildew, Cherry healthy, and all four grape categories achieved perfect precision 1.00 and recall of 1.00, indicating no false positives and strong coverage. These results show that with a well curated dataset and careful architectural design, small CNNs can achieve competitive accuracy compared with recent baselines while remaining practical for edge scenarios. We also note typical constraints such as adverse weather, low quality imagery, and leaves exhibiting multiple concurrent diseases that can degrade performance and warrant future work on domain robustness. Overall, PD36 C and its application pipeline contribute a field ready, efficient solution for AI assisted plant disease detection in smart agriculture.

AI.tldr: PD36 C是一个紧凑的卷积神经网络（125万参数，4.77MB），用于植物病害分类，在87k图像、38类数据集上达到99.5%测试准确率，并配有桌面应用支持离线推理。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在植物病害诊断方面取得显著进展，但现有模型往往参数庞大，不适合边缘部署。需要开发紧凑、高效的神经网络模型，能够在资源受限的设备上实现高精度病害分类，满足智慧农业的实际应用需求。
AI.method: 提出PD36 C紧凑卷积神经网络，使用TensorFlow Keras在New Plant Diseases Dataset（87k图像，38类）上训练。模型设计注重鲁棒性和边缘部署能力，参数仅1,250,694个，大小4.77MB。同时开发了基于Qt for Python的桌面应用程序，提供直观GUI和离线推理功能。
AI.result: 训练准确率在第30轮达到0.99697，38个类别的平均测试准确率为0.9953。多个类别（如苹果黑腐病、雪松苹果锈病、蓝莓健康、樱桃白粉病等）实现完美精度和召回率（1.00）。玉米尾孢叶斑病等较难类别精度约0.9777，召回率约0.9634。模型在边缘设备上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的数据集和架构，小型CNN能够达到与最新基线相当的准确率，同时保持边缘部署的实用性。PD36 C及其应用管道为智慧农业中的AI辅助植物病害检测提供了现场就绪的解决方案。未来需要解决恶劣天气、低质量图像和并发病害等挑战。

title: LoGo-MR: Screening Breast MRI for Cancer Risk Prediction by Efficient Omni-Slice Modeling
summary: Efficient and explainable breast cancer (BC) risk prediction is critical for large-scale population-based screening. Breast MRI provides functional information for personalized risk assessment. Yet effective modeling remains challenging as fully 3D CNNs capture volumetric context at high computational cost, whereas lightweight 2D CNNs fail to model inter-slice continuity. Importantly, breast MRI modeling for shor- and long-term BC risk stratification remains underexplored. In this study, we propose LoGo-MR, a 2.5D local-global structural modeling framework for five-year BC risk prediction. Aligned with clinical interpretation, our framework first employs neighbor-slice encoding to capture subtle local cues linked to short-term risk. It then integrates transformer-enhanced multiple-instance learning (MIL) to model distributed global patterns related to long-term risk and provide interpretable slice importance. We further apply this framework across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes as LoGo3-MR to capture complementary volumetric information. This multi-plane formulation enables voxel-level risk saliency mapping, which may assist radiologists in localizing risk-relevant regions during breast MRI interpretation. Evaluated on a large breast MRI screening cohort (~7.5K), our method outperforms 2D/3D baselines and existing SOTA MIL methods, achieving AUCs of 0.77-0.69 for 1- to 5-year prediction and improving C-index by ~6% over 3D CNNs. LoGo3-MR further improves overall performance with interpretable localization across three planes, and validation across seven backbones shows consistent gains. These results highlight the clinical potential of efficient MRI-based BC risk stratification for large-scale screening. Code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出LoGo-MR框架，一种2.5D局部-全局结构建模方法，用于五年乳腺癌风险预测，结合邻层编码和Transformer增强的多实例学习，在大型MRI筛查队列中优于现有方法
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌风险预测需要高效且可解释的方法。现有3D CNN计算成本高，2D CNN无法建模层间连续性，且短期和长期风险分层研究不足
AI.method: 提出LoGo-MR框架：1) 邻层编码捕捉局部细微线索（短期风险）；2) Transformer增强的多实例学习建模分布式全局模式（长期风险）；3) 扩展到三平面（LoGo3-MR）获取互补体积信息；4) 生成体素级风险显著性图
AI.result: 在约7.5K的乳腺MRI筛查队列中，方法优于2D/3D基线和现有SOTA MIL方法，1-5年预测AUC为0.77-0.69，C-index比3D CNN提高约6%，LoGo3-MR进一步提升性能并提供三平面可解释定位
AI.conclusion: LoGo-MR框架在计算效率和性能间取得平衡，提供可解释的风险定位，展示了基于MRI的乳腺癌风险分层在大规模筛查中的临床潜力

title: LEADER: Learning Reliable Local-to-Global Correspondences for LiDAR Relocalization
summary: LiDAR relocalization has attracted increasing attention as it can deliver accurate 6-DoF pose estimation in complex 3D environments. Recent learning-based regression methods offer efficient solutions by directly predicting global poses without the need for explicit map storage. However, these methods often struggle in challenging scenes due to their equal treatment of all predicted points, which is vulnerable to noise and outliers. In this paper, we propose LEADER, a robust LiDAR-based relocalization framework enhanced by a simple, yet effective geometric encoder. Specifically, a Robust Projection-based Geometric Encoder architecture which captures multi-scale geometric features is first presented to enhance descriptiveness in geometric representation. A Truncated Relative Reliability loss is then formulated to model point-wise ambiguity and mitigate the influence of unreliable predictions. Extensive experiments on the Oxford RobotCar and NCLT datasets demonstrate that LEADER outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 24.1% and 73.9% relative reductions in position error over existing techniques, respectively. The source code is released on https://github.com/JiansW/LEADER.

AI.tldr: LEADER是一个基于LiDAR的鲁棒重定位框架，通过几何编码器和截断相对可靠性损失来提升在挑战性场景中的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习型回归方法在复杂场景中表现不佳，因为它们平等对待所有预测点，容易受到噪声和异常值的影响。
AI.method: 提出了LEADER框架，包含：1) 鲁棒的基于投影的几何编码器架构，捕捉多尺度几何特征；2) 截断相对可靠性损失，建模点级模糊性并减轻不可靠预测的影响。
AI.result: 在Oxford RobotCar和NCLT数据集上的实验表明，LEADER优于现有最先进方法，位置误差分别相对减少了24.1%和73.9%。
AI.conclusion: LEADER通过有效的几何编码和可靠性建模，显著提升了LiDAR重定位在挑战性场景中的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: What Do Vision-Language Models Encode for Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment?
summary: Personalized image aesthetics assessment (PIAA) is an important research problem with practical real-world applications. While methods based on vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for PIAA, it remains unclear whether they internally encode rich, multi-level aesthetic attributes required for effective personalization. In this paper, we first analyze the internal representations of VLMs to examine the presence and distribution of such aesthetic attributes, and then leverage them for lightweight, individual-level personalization without model fine-tuning. Our analysis reveals that VLMs encode diverse aesthetic attributes that propagate into the language decoder layers. Building on these representations, we demonstrate that simple linear models can perform PIAA effectively. We further analyze how aesthetic information is transferred across layers in different VLM architectures and across image domains. Our findings provide insights into how VLMs can be utilized for modeling subjective, individual aesthetic preferences. Our code is available at https://github.com/ynklab/vlm-latent-piaa.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了视觉语言模型（VLMs）内部是否编码了丰富的多层级美学属性，并利用这些表示进行轻量级的个性化图像美学评估，无需微调模型。
AI.motivation: 个性化图像美学评估（PIAA）具有重要的实际应用价值。虽然基于视觉语言模型的方法很有前景，但尚不清楚这些模型内部是否编码了有效个性化所需的多层级美学属性。
AI.method: 首先分析VLMs内部表示中美学属性的存在和分布情况，然后利用这些表示进行轻量级的个体级个性化，无需模型微调。研究发现VLMs编码了多样化的美学属性，这些属性传播到语言解码器层。
AI.result: 分析表明VLMs编码了多样的美学属性，简单的线性模型就能有效执行PIAA。研究还分析了不同VLM架构中美学信息如何在层间传递，以及跨图像领域的传递情况。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了VLMs如何编码美学属性，为利用VLMs建模主观的个体美学偏好提供了见解，展示了无需微调即可实现个性化美学评估的可行性。

title: From Redaction to Restoration: Deep Learning for Medical Image Anonymization and Reconstruction
summary: Removing patient-specific information from medical images is crucial to enable sharing and open science without compromising patient identities. However, many methods currently used for deidentification have negative effects on downstream image analysis tasks because of removal of relevant but non-identifiable information. This work presents an end-to-end deep learning framework for transforming raw clinical image volumes into de-identified, analysis-ready datasets without compromising downstream utility. The methodology developed and tested in this work first detects and redacts regions likely to contain protected health information (PHI), such as burned-in text and metadata, and then uses a generative deep learning model to inpaint the redacted areas with anatomically and imaging plausible content. The proposed pipeline leverages a lightweight hybrid architecture, combining CRNN-based redaction with a latent-diffusion inpainting restoration module (Stable Diffusion 2). We evaluate the approach using both privacy-oriented metrics, which quantify residual PHI and success of redaction, and image-quality and task-based metrics, which assess the fidelity of restored volumes for representative deep learning applications. Our results suggest that the proposed method yields de-identified medical images that are visually coherent, maintaining fidelity for downstream models, while substantially reducing the risk of patient re-identification. By automating anonymization and image reconstruction within a single workflow, and dissemination of large-scale medical imaging collections, thereby lowering a key barrier to data sharing and multi-institutional collaboration in medical imaging AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一个端到端深度学习框架，通过检测并遮盖PHI区域，然后使用生成模型修复，实现医学影像的去标识化，同时保持下游分析任务的可用性。
AI.motivation: 当前医学影像去标识化方法在移除患者身份信息时，常常会同时移除与诊断相关的非标识信息，从而影响下游图像分析任务的性能。需要一种既能保护隐私又不损害影像分析效用的方法。
AI.method: 采用混合架构：首先使用CRNN检测并遮盖可能包含PHI的区域（如烧录文本和元数据），然后使用潜在扩散修复模型（Stable Diffusion 2）对遮盖区域进行修复，生成解剖学和影像学上合理的内容。
AI.result: 该方法生成的去标识化医学影像在视觉上连贯，同时保持了下游深度学习模型的保真度。隐私指标显示PHI残留显著减少，图像质量和任务指标表明修复后的影像适合代表性深度学习应用。
AI.conclusion: 提出的端到端框架能够有效生成去标识化的医学影像，既保护患者隐私，又保持下游分析任务的可用性。通过自动化匿名化和图像重建流程，降低了医学影像数据共享和多机构协作的障碍。
